================================================================================
PROJECT: Code & Ladders — DSA Adventure
================================================================================

PURPOSE:
Code & Ladders — DSA Adventure is an interactive, gamified educational platform
designed to teach university-level Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) through an
interactive 100-level board inspired by the classic Snake & Ladder game.

Each of the 100 tiles corresponds to a curated milestone in computer science:
- Tiles 1-20: Foundations, Asymptotic Analysis (Big-O, Omega, Theta), and Arrays
- Tiles 21-40: Linear Data Structures (Singly/Doubly/Circular Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues)
- Tiles 41-60: Searching, Sorting Algorithms, Recursion, and Divide & Conquer
- Tiles 61-80: Trees (Binary Trees, BST, AVL, Heaps) and Graphs (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra)
- Tiles 81-100: Dynamic Programming, Greedy Algorithms, Backtracking, and Advanced Topics

Core Game & Learning Mechanics:
- Dice Movement & Checkpoints: Roll the dice to traverse the curriculum. Checkpoints
  evaluate mastery before advancing to subsequent stages.
- Optimization Ladders: Finding optimal time/space complexity solutions allows the
  player to climb forward on the board.
- Misconception Snakes: Common programming errors, edge-case bugs, and anti-patterns
  penalize the player, followed by an immediate explanatory review to fix misunderstandings.
- Interactive DSA Mini-Games: Dedicated interactive labs for AVL tree balancing,
  BST construction, stack expressions, circular queue operations, sorting step-races,
  and graph pathfinding.
- Novelty Diagnostics: Cognitive Error DNA analysis, algorithm complexity benchmarking,
  interactive decision trade-off lab, and spaced revision scheduling.
- Student Tools: Exam practice mode, flashcard revision, mistake logging, customizable
  dark/light themes, energy abilities, and comprehensive achievement tracking.

TECHNOLOGY DETECTED & UTILIZED:
- Language & Runtime: TypeScript (v5.x/v6.x) & Modern JavaScript (ES Modules)
- Frontend Framework: React 19 (Functional Components, Custom Hooks, Context API)
- Build System & Bundler: Vite (v8.x) with @vitejs/plugin-react
- Styling & Layout: Tailwind CSS v4 (@tailwindcss/vite) + Semantic CSS Theme Variables
- Iconography: Lucide React (lucide-react v1.61+)
- Celebration FX: Canvas-Confetti (canvas-confetti v1.9+)
- Test Framework: Vitest (v5.x) with 143 unit and integration tests
- Code Quality & Linting: Oxlint
- Deployment Target: Modern Web Browsers (Responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile)

PROJECT STRUCTURE & ARCHITECTURE:
- Root & Shell: index.html, src/main.tsx, src/App.tsx, src/context/ThemeContext.tsx
- Board Presentation: src/components/Board/ (Grid, Viewport, Cell rendering, SVG paths)
- Controls & Sidebars: src/components/Controls/, src/components/Sidebars/, src/components/Header.tsx
- Challenge Modules: src/components/Challenges/
- Interactive DSA Mechanics: src/components/DSAMechanics/ (AVL, BST, Stack, Queue, Graph, Sort)
- Evolution & Boss Encounters: src/components/Evolution/ (Bosses, Bug Bot, Mutations, Routes)
- Diagnostic & Novelty Labs: src/components/Novelty/ (Error DNA, Complexity, Decision Lab)
- Academic Tools: src/components/Dashboard/, src/components/Achievements/, src/components/Shop/
- Core Game Engines: src/hooks/useGameState.ts, src/engine/ (Game, Economy, Adaptive, Error DNA)
- Concrete DSA Implementations: src/algorithms/ (Searching, Sorting, Linked Lists, Trees, Graphs)
- Domain Models & Types: src/types/ (Game, Challenge, Curriculum, Evolution, Learner, Rewards)
- Syllabus & Question Data: src/data/ (100 curriculum milestones, challenges, snakes, ladders)
- Global Styles: src/index.css, src/App.css
- Build & Configurations: package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig*.json
- Automated Tests: src/test/ (11 test suites verifying 100% of game mechanics)

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useGameState } from './hooks/useGameState';
import { SQUARE_MAP, CURRICULUM_100 } from './data/curriculum100';
import { Header } from './components/Header';
import { LeftSidebar } from './components/Sidebars/LeftSidebar';
import { RightSidebar } from './components/Sidebars/RightSidebar';
import { MobileDrawer } from './components/Sidebars/MobileDrawer';
import { BoardViewport } from './components/Board/BoardViewport';
import { TileDetailModal } from './components/Board/TileDetailModal';
import { DiceControls } from './components/Controls/DiceControls';
import { ChallengeModal } from './components/Challenges/ChallengeModal';
import { ResetModal } from './components/Dashboard/ResetModal';
import { RevisionModal } from './components/Dashboard/RevisionModal';
import { AdaptiveModal } from './components/Dashboard/AdaptiveModal';
import { SettingsModal } from './components/Dashboard/SettingsModal';
import { VictoryModal } from './components/Dashboard/VictoryModal';
import { SyllabusModal } from './components/Dashboard/SyllabusModal';
import { PracticeModeModal } from './components/Dashboard/PracticeModeModal';
import { ExamModeModal } from './components/Dashboard/ExamModeModal';
import { DSALabModal } from './components/Dashboard/DSALabModal';
import { AlgorithmCardsModal } from './components/Dashboard/AlgorithmCardsModal';
import { MistakeLogModal } from './components/Dashboard/MistakeLogModal';
import { ShopModal } from './components/Shop/ShopModal';
import { AchievementsModal } from './components/Achievements/AchievementsModal';
import { MovementToast } from './components/Common/MovementToast';
import { SquareMetadata } from './types/curriculum';

// Evolution Components
import { EnergyActionBar } from './components/Evolution/EnergyActionBar';
import { RouteModal } from './components/Evolution/RouteModal';
import { SnakeRecoveryModal } from './components/Evolution/SnakeRecoveryModal';
import { LadderChoiceModal } from './components/Evolution/LadderChoiceModal';
import { BossBattleModal } from './components/Evolution/BossBattleModal';
import { BugBotModal } from './components/Evolution/BugBotModal';
import { MutationModal } from './components/Evolution/MutationModal';
import { MasteryModal } from './components/Evolution/MasteryModal';

// Novelty Systems
import { ErrorDNAModal } from './components/Novelty/ErrorDNAModal';
import { ComplexityMeterModal } from './components/Novelty/ComplexityMeterModal';
import { WhatIfSimulatorModal } from './components/Novelty/WhatIfSimulatorModal';
import { KnowledgeGraphModal } from './components/Novelty/KnowledgeGraphModal';
import { DecisionLabModal } from './components/Novelty/DecisionLabModal';

export const App: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    gameState,
    displayedPosition,
    isRolling,
    isMoving,
    lastDiceRoll,
    activeChallenge,
    isChallengeOpen,
    isResetModalOpen,
    isRevisionModalOpen,
    isAdaptiveModalOpen,
    isSettingsModalOpen,
    isVictoryModalOpen,
    isShopModalOpen,
    isAchievementsModalOpen,
    currentNotification,
    isAutoplayRunning,
    isAutoplayPaused,
    autoplaySpeed,

    // Evolution state
    isRouteModalOpen,
    currentDecisionTile,
    availableRouteOptions,
    activeIntelligentSnake,
    isSnakeRecoveryModalOpen,
    activeOptimizationLadder,
    isLadderChoiceModalOpen,
    activeBossBattle,
    isBossModalOpen,
    activeBugBotScenario,
    isBugBotModalOpen,
    activeMutation,
    isMutationModalOpen,
    isMasteryModalOpen,

    handleRollDice,
    handleOpenSquareChallenge,
    handleCompleteChallenge,
    handlePurchaseCosmetic,
    handleEquipCosmetic,
    startAutoplay,
    pauseAutoplay,
    resumeAutoplay,
    stopAutoplay,
    setAutoplaySpeed,
    handleResetGame,
    updateSettings,
    handleAwardReward,
    handleRecordPracticeMistake,
    dismissNotification,

    // Evolution actions
    handleSelectRoute,
    handleUseAbility,
    handleSelectSnakeChoice,
    handleSelectLadderOption,
    handleBossVictory,
    handleBugBotVictory,
    handleResolveMutation,
    triggerBugBotDuel,
    triggerDecisionCrossroads,

    setIsResetModalOpen,
    setIsRevisionModalOpen,
    setIsAdaptiveModalOpen,
    setIsSettingsModalOpen,
    setIsVictoryModalOpen,
    setIsShopModalOpen,
    setIsAchievementsModalOpen,
    setIsChallengeOpen,
    setIsRouteModalOpen,
    setIsSnakeRecoveryModalOpen,
    setIsLadderChoiceModalOpen,
    setIsBossModalOpen,
    setIsBugBotModalOpen,
    setIsMutationModalOpen,
    setIsMasteryModalOpen
  } = useGameState();

  const [inspectingSquare, setInspectingSquare] = useState<SquareMetadata | null>(null);
  const [showLeftSidebar, setShowLeftSidebar] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [showRightSidebar, setShowRightSidebar] = useState<boolean>(true);

  // Novelty Modals State
  const [isErrorDnaOpen, setIsErrorDnaOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isComplexityMeterOpen, setIsComplexityMeterOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isWhatIfOpen, setIsWhatIfOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isKnowledgeGraphOpen, setIsKnowledgeGraphOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isDecisionLabOpen, setIsDecisionLabOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Student Academic Modals State
  const [isSyllabusOpen, setIsSyllabusOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isPracticeModeOpen, setIsPracticeModeOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isExamModeOpen, setIsExamModeOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isDSALabOpen, setIsDSALabOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isAlgorithmCardsOpen, setIsAlgorithmCardsOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isMistakeLogOpen, setIsMistakeLogOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const currentSquare = useMemo(() => {
    return SQUARE_MAP.get(displayedPosition) || CURRICULUM_100[0];
  }, [displayedPosition]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen lg:h-screen lg:overflow-hidden w-full bg-[var(--app-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] flex flex-col font-sans select-none antialiased transition-colors duration-200">
      {/* Top Application Header */}
      <Header
        totalXp={gameState.totalScore}
        coinBalance={gameState.coins}
        streak={gameState.streak}
        learnerProfile={gameState.learnerProfile}
        settings={gameState.settings}
        onToggleSound={() => updateSettings({ soundEnabled: !gameState.settings.soundEnabled })}
        onOpenSettings={() => setIsSettingsModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenAdaptive={() => setIsAdaptiveModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenRevision={() => setIsRevisionModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenReset={() => setIsResetModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenShop={() => setIsShopModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenAchievements={() => setIsAchievementsModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenSyllabus={() => setIsSyllabusOpen(true)}
        onOpenPracticeMode={() => setIsPracticeModeOpen(true)}
        onOpenExamMode={() => setIsExamModeOpen(true)}
        onOpenDSALab={() => setIsDSALabOpen(true)}
        onOpenAlgorithmCards={() => setIsAlgorithmCardsOpen(true)}
        onOpenMistakeLog={() => setIsMistakeLogOpen(true)}
        onOpenComplexityMeter={() => setIsComplexityMeterOpen(true)}
      />

      {/* Floating Movement Reward / Penalty / Level-Up Toast */}
      <MovementToast
        notification={currentNotification}
        onDismiss={dismissNotification}
      />

      {/* Main Game Dashboard */}
      <main className="flex-1 w-full max-w-[1920px] mx-auto px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-2.5 xl:gap-3.5 items-stretch justify-center overflow-hidden">
        {/* Left Sidebar: Rules & Legend */}
        {showLeftSidebar && (
          <div className="hidden lg:flex flex-col flex-shrink-0 w-60 xl:w-64 max-h-[calc(100vh-68px)] overflow-y-auto pr-1 scrollbar-thin transition-all">
            <LeftSidebar />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Center Board & Controls */}
        <section className="flex-1 w-full flex flex-col items-center justify-between gap-1.5 h-full max-h-[calc(100vh-68px)] min-h-0 overflow-hidden">
          {/* Top Row: Sidebar Toggles & Energy Action Bar */}
          <div className="w-full flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowLeftSidebar(prev => !prev)}
              className={`hidden lg:flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold transition shadow-sm shrink-0 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer ${
                showLeftSidebar 
                  ? 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]' 
                  : 'bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] hover:bg-[var(--color-indigo-border)] border-[var(--color-indigo)] text-[var(--color-indigo)]'
              }`}
              title={showLeftSidebar ? 'Collapse Rules & Legend Sidebar' : 'Show Rules & Legend Sidebar'}
            >
              <span>{showLeftSidebar ? '◀ Legend' : '▶ Legend'}</span>
            </button>

            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <EnergyActionBar
                energy={gameState.energy}
                hasShield={gameState.activeShield}
                hasLadderBoost={gameState.activeLadderBoost}
                canReroll={!isRolling && !isMoving && !isAutoplayRunning}
                turn={gameState.turnsCompleted + 1}
                currentRouteType={gameState.currentRouteType}
                onOpenCrossroads={() => triggerDecisionCrossroads(15)}
                onOpenBugBot={() => triggerBugBotDuel()}
                onUseAbility={handleUseAbility}
              />
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => setShowRightSidebar(prev => !prev)}
              className={`hidden lg:flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold transition shadow-sm shrink-0 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer ${
                showRightSidebar 
                  ? 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]' 
                  : 'bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] hover:bg-[var(--color-indigo-border)] border-[var(--color-indigo)] text-[var(--color-indigo)]'
              }`}
              title={showRightSidebar ? 'Collapse Stats Sidebar' : 'Show Stats Sidebar'}
            >
              <span>{showRightSidebar ? 'Stats ▶' : 'Stats ◀'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* 1-100 Serpentine Board with Dedicated Zoom & Viewport */}
          <div className="flex-1 w-full min-h-0">
            <BoardViewport
              currentPosition={displayedPosition}
              completedSquares={gameState.completedSquares}
              equippedMarker={gameState.equippedCosmetics.playerMarker}
              boardTheme={gameState.equippedCosmetics.boardTheme}
              onSelectSquare={(sq) => setInspectingSquare(sq)}
              topicMasteryMap={gameState.topicMasteryMap}
            />
          </div>

          {/* Unified Dice & Autoplay Movement Controller */}
          <DiceControls
            currentPosition={displayedPosition}
            lastDiceRoll={lastDiceRoll}
            diceSkin={gameState.equippedCosmetics.diceSkin}
            isRolling={isRolling}
            isMoving={isMoving}
            isAutoplayRunning={isAutoplayRunning}
            isAutoplayPaused={isAutoplayPaused}
            autoplaySpeed={autoplaySpeed}
            onRollDice={handleRollDice}
            onStartAutoplay={startAutoplay}
            onPauseAutoplay={pauseAutoplay}
            onResumeAutoplay={resumeAutoplay}
            onStopAutoplay={stopAutoplay}
            onSetAutoplaySpeed={setAutoplaySpeed}
          />
        </section>

        {/* Right Sidebar: Focus & Progression */}
        {showRightSidebar && (
          <div className="hidden lg:flex flex-col flex-shrink-0 w-64 xl:w-72 max-h-[calc(100vh-68px)] overflow-y-auto pr-1 scrollbar-thin transition-all">
            <RightSidebar
              currentSquare={currentSquare}
              completedCount={gameState.completedSquares.length}
              totalAttempts={gameState.learnerProfile.totalAttempts}
              totalCorrect={gameState.learnerProfile.totalCorrect}
              accuracy={gameState.learnerProfile.overallAccuracy}
              streak={gameState.streak}
              recoveryStreak={gameState.recoveryStreak}
              laddersClimbed={gameState.laddersClimbed}
              snakesEncountered={gameState.snakesEncountered}
              totalScore={gameState.totalScore}
              coinBalance={gameState.coins}
              recentActivities={gameState.recentActivities}
              onStartChallenge={handleOpenSquareChallenge}
              topicMasteryMap={gameState.topicMasteryMap}
              misconceptions={gameState.misconceptions}
              onOpenErrorDNA={() => setIsErrorDnaOpen(true)}
              onOpenDecisionLab={() => setIsDecisionLabOpen(true)}
              onOpenComplexityMeter={() => setIsComplexityMeterOpen(true)}
              onOpenWhatIfSimulator={() => setIsWhatIfOpen(true)}
              onOpenKnowledgeGraph={() => setIsKnowledgeGraphOpen(true)}
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </main>

      {/* Touch-Friendly Mobile Drawer */}
      <MobileDrawer
        currentSquare={currentSquare}
        completedCount={gameState.completedSquares.length}
        totalAttempts={gameState.learnerProfile.totalAttempts}
        totalCorrect={gameState.learnerProfile.totalCorrect}
        accuracy={gameState.learnerProfile.overallAccuracy}
        streak={gameState.streak}
        recoveryStreak={gameState.recoveryStreak}
        laddersClimbed={gameState.laddersClimbed}
        snakesEncountered={gameState.snakesEncountered}
        totalScore={gameState.totalScore}
        coinBalance={gameState.coins}
        recentActivities={gameState.recentActivities}
        onStartChallenge={handleOpenSquareChallenge}
      />

      {/* Interactive Challenge Modal */}
      {activeChallenge && (
        <ChallengeModal
          challenge={activeChallenge}
          isOpen={isChallengeOpen}
          consecutiveIncorrect={gameState.consecutiveIncorrect}
          energy={gameState.energy}
          activeShield={gameState.activeShield}
          activeSecondChance={gameState.activeSecondChance}
          onClose={() => setIsChallengeOpen(false)}
          onSubmit={(res, isFirst, isRecovery) => handleCompleteChallenge(res, isFirst, isRecovery, isAutoplayRunning)}
          onUseAbility={handleUseAbility}
        />
      )}

      {/* Evolution: Route Decision Modal */}
      <RouteModal
        isOpen={isRouteModalOpen}
        tile={currentDecisionTile}
        routeOptions={availableRouteOptions}
        currentSelectedRoute={gameState.currentRouteType}
        onSelectRoute={handleSelectRoute}
        onClose={() => setIsRouteModalOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* Evolution: Intelligent Snake Recovery Modal */}
      <SnakeRecoveryModal
        isOpen={isSnakeRecoveryModalOpen}
        snake={activeIntelligentSnake}
        hasShield={gameState.activeShield}
        onUseShield={() => handleUseAbility('shield')}
        onSelectChoice={handleSelectSnakeChoice}
        onClose={() => setIsSnakeRecoveryModalOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* Evolution: Optimization Ladder Modal */}
      <LadderChoiceModal
        isOpen={isLadderChoiceModalOpen}
        ladder={activeOptimizationLadder}
        hasLadderBoost={gameState.activeLadderBoost}
        onSelectOption={handleSelectLadderOption}
        onClose={() => setIsLadderChoiceModalOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* Evolution: Regional Boss Battle Modal */}
      <BossBattleModal
        isOpen={isBossModalOpen}
        boss={activeBossBattle}
        onVictory={handleBossVictory}
        onClose={() => setIsBossModalOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* Evolution: BugBot Rival Modal */}
      <BugBotModal
        isOpen={isBugBotModalOpen}
        scenario={activeBugBotScenario}
        onVictory={handleBugBotVictory}
        onClose={() => setIsBugBotModalOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* Evolution: Board Mutation Modal */}
      <MutationModal
        isOpen={isMutationModalOpen}
        mutation={activeMutation}
        onResolve={handleResolveMutation}
        onClose={() => setIsMutationModalOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* Evolution: Cognitive Mastery Modal */}
      <MasteryModal
        isOpen={isMasteryModalOpen}
        topicMasteryMap={gameState.topicMasteryMap}
        onClose={() => setIsMasteryModalOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* Cosmetics & Themes Shop Modal */}
      <ShopModal
        isOpen={isShopModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsShopModalOpen(false)}
        coinBalance={gameState.coins}
        purchasedIds={gameState.purchasedCosmetics}
        equipped={gameState.equippedCosmetics}
        onPurchaseItem={handlePurchaseCosmetic}
        onEquipItem={handleEquipCosmetic}
      />

      {/* Achievements Modal */}
      <AchievementsModal
        isOpen={isAchievementsModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsAchievementsModalOpen(false)}
        achievements={gameState.achievements}
      />

      {/* Spaced Revision Modal */}
      <RevisionModal
        isOpen={isRevisionModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsRevisionModalOpen(false)}
        revisionQueue={gameState.learnerProfile.revisionQueue}
        onStartRevision={(sqId) => handleOpenSquareChallenge(sqId)}
      />

      {/* Adaptive Mastery Modal */}
      <AdaptiveModal
        isOpen={isAdaptiveModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsAdaptiveModalOpen(false)}
        learnerProfile={gameState.learnerProfile}
        onJumpToSquare={(sqId) => handleOpenSquareChallenge(sqId)}
      />

      {/* Game Settings Modal */}
      <SettingsModal
        isOpen={isSettingsModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsSettingsModalOpen(false)}
        settings={gameState.settings}
        onUpdateSettings={updateSettings}
      />

      {/* Reset Confirmation Modal */}
      <ResetModal
        isOpen={isResetModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsResetModalOpen(false)}
        onConfirmReset={handleResetGame}
      />

      {/* Victory Celebration Modal */}
      <VictoryModal
        isOpen={isVictoryModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsVictoryModalOpen(false)}
        onPlayAgain={handleResetGame}
        totalScore={gameState.totalScore}
        coins={gameState.coins}
        laddersClimbed={gameState.laddersClimbed}
        snakesEncountered={gameState.snakesEncountered}
        turnsCompleted={gameState.turnsCompleted}
        questionsAttempted={gameState.questionsAttempted}
        questionsCorrect={gameState.questionsCorrect}
        longestStreak={gameState.longestStreak}
        energyUsed={gameState.energyUsed}
        topicMasteryMap={gameState.topicMasteryMap}
      />

      {/* Tile Curriculum & Checkpoint Inspection Modal */}
      <TileDetailModal
        square={inspectingSquare}
        isOpen={inspectingSquare !== null}
        isCurrent={inspectingSquare?.id === displayedPosition}
        isCompleted={inspectingSquare ? gameState.completedSquares.includes(inspectingSquare.id) : false}
        onClose={() => setInspectingSquare(null)}
        onStartChallenge={(sqId) => {
          setInspectingSquare(null);
          handleOpenSquareChallenge(sqId);
        }}
      />

      {/* Novelty: Cognitive Error DNA & Learning Debt Diagnostics */}
      <ErrorDNAModal
        isOpen={isErrorDnaOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsErrorDnaOpen(false)}
        learnerProfile={gameState.learnerProfile}
        misconceptions={gameState.misconceptions}
        topicMasteryMap={gameState.topicMasteryMap}
        onJumpToDrill={(squareId: number) => {
          setIsErrorDnaOpen(false);
          handleOpenSquareChallenge(squareId);
        }}
      />

      {/* Novelty: Asymptotic Complexity Benchmark */}
      <ComplexityMeterModal
        isOpen={isComplexityMeterOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsComplexityMeterOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* Novelty: What-If Structural Simulator */}
      <WhatIfSimulatorModal
        isOpen={isWhatIfOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsWhatIfOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* Novelty: DSA Curriculum Knowledge Roadmap */}
      <KnowledgeGraphModal
        isOpen={isKnowledgeGraphOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsKnowledgeGraphOpen(false)}
        completedSquares={gameState.completedSquares}
        topicMasteryMap={gameState.topicMasteryMap}
        onJumpToStage={(firstTile: number) => {
          setIsKnowledgeGraphOpen(false);
          handleOpenSquareChallenge(firstTile);
        }}
      />

      {/* Novelty: Algorithm Decision Lab */}
      <DecisionLabModal
        isOpen={isDecisionLabOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsDecisionLabOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* Student Syllabus Tracker Modal */}
      <SyllabusModal
        isOpen={isSyllabusOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsSyllabusOpen(false)}
        completedSquares={gameState.completedSquares}
        onSelectRange={([start]) => handleOpenSquareChallenge(start)}
      />

      {/* Practice Mode (10 Questions per Outcome with Explanations) */}
      <PracticeModeModal
        isOpen={isPracticeModeOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsPracticeModeOpen(false)}
        onRecordResult={handleAwardReward}
        onRecordMistake={handleRecordPracticeMistake}
      />

      {/* Exam Mode (20 Questions Timed Mock Test) */}
      <ExamModeModal
        isOpen={isExamModeOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsExamModeOpen(false)}
        onRecordResult={handleAwardReward}
      />

      {/* DSA Interactive Mechanics Laboratory (10 Visual Simulations) */}
      <DSALabModal
        isOpen={isDSALabOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsDSALabOpen(false)}
        onAwardReward={handleAwardReward}
      />

      {/* Algorithm Study Flashcards */}
      <AlgorithmCardsModal
        isOpen={isAlgorithmCardsOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsAlgorithmCardsOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* Academic Mistake Log & Concept Remediation */}
      <MistakeLogModal
        isOpen={isMistakeLogOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsMistakeLogOpen(false)}
        learnerProfile={gameState.learnerProfile}
        onRetryChallenge={(challenge) => {
          setIsMistakeLogOpen(false);
          handleOpenSquareChallenge(challenge.squareId);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default App;

FILE: src/context/ThemeContext.tsx

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export type Theme = 'light' | 'dark';

interface ThemeContextType {
  theme: Theme;
  isDark: boolean;
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  setTheme: (theme: Theme) => void;
}

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const ThemeProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [theme, setThemeState] = useState<Theme>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('code_ladders_theme');
      if (saved === 'light' || saved === 'dark') {
        return saved;
      }
      if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches) {
        return 'light';
      }
    }
    return 'dark'; // default to dark
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    if (theme === 'dark') {
      root.classList.add('dark');
      root.classList.remove('light');
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
      root.style.colorScheme = 'dark';
    } else {
      root.classList.remove('dark');
      root.classList.add('light');
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
      root.style.colorScheme = 'light';
    }
    localStorage.setItem('code_ladders_theme', theme);
  }, [theme]);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    setThemeState(prev => (prev === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'));
  };

  const setTheme = (newTheme: Theme) => {
    setThemeState(newTheme);
  };

  const isDark = theme === 'dark';

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, isDark, toggleTheme, setTheme }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useTheme = (): ThemeContextType => {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { 
  ZoomIn, 
  ZoomOut, 
  RotateCcw, 
  Crosshair, 
  ChevronLeft, 
  ChevronRight, 
  ChevronUp, 
  ChevronDown,
  Compass, 
  ArrowRight,
  Eye
} from 'lucide-react';
import { BoardGrid } from './BoardGrid';
import { SquareMetadata } from '../../types/curriculum';
import { TopicMasteryScore } from '../../types/evolution';

interface BoardViewportProps {
  currentPosition: number;
  completedSquares: number[];
  equippedMarker?: string;
  boardTheme?: string;
  onSelectSquare: (square: SquareMetadata) => void;
  topicMasteryMap?: Record<string, TopicMasteryScore>;
}

const ZOOM_STEPS = [0.75, 0.85, 1.0, 1.15, 1.3];
const BASE_TILE_WIDTH = 138;
const BASE_TILE_HEIGHT = 118;

const ROW_SECTIONS = [
  { label: '1–10', center: 5, min: 1, max: 10 },
  { label: '11–20', center: 15, min: 11, max: 20 },
  { label: '21–30', center: 25, min: 21, max: 30 },
  { label: '31–40', center: 35, min: 31, max: 40 },
  { label: '41–50', center: 45, min: 41, max: 50 },
  { label: '51–60', center: 55, min: 51, max: 60 },
  { label: '61–70', center: 65, min: 61, max: 70 },
  { label: '71–80', center: 75, min: 71, max: 80 },
  { label: '81–90', center: 85, min: 81, max: 90 },
  { label: '91–100', center: 95, min: 91, max: 100 },
];

export const BoardViewport: React.FC<BoardViewportProps> = ({
  currentPosition,
  completedSquares,
  equippedMarker,
  boardTheme,
  onSelectSquare,
  topicMasteryMap
}) => {
  const [zoomIndex, setZoomIndex] = useState(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('board_zoom_level');
    if (saved) {
      const idx = ZOOM_STEPS.indexOf(parseFloat(saved));
      if (idx !== -1) return idx;
    }
    return 2; // index 2 is 1.0 (100%)
  });

  const zoom = ZOOM_STEPS[zoomIndex];
  const viewportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Jump input state
  const [jumpInput, setJumpInput] = useState<string>('');
  const [jumpError, setJumpError] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Scroll visibility cues state
  const [canScrollUp, setCanScrollUp] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [canScrollDown, setCanScrollDown] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [visibleRangeText, setVisibleRangeText] = useState<string>('Levels 1–100');

  // Save zoom preference
  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem('board_zoom_level', zoom.toString());
  }, [zoom]);

  const handleZoomIn = () => {
    if (zoomIndex < ZOOM_STEPS.length - 1) {
      setZoomIndex(prev => prev + 1);
    }
  };

  const handleZoomOut = () => {
    if (zoomIndex > 0) {
      setZoomIndex(prev => prev - 1);
    }
  };

  const handleResetZoom = () => {
    setZoomIndex(2); // 1.0
  };

  // Robust geometric centering to any tile inside the viewport container
  const scrollToTile = useCallback((tileId: number, highlight = true) => {
    const container = viewportRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const clampedId = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, Math.round(tileId)));
    const el = document.getElementById(`cell-${clampedId}`);
    if (!el) return;

    const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    const elRect = el.getBoundingClientRect();

    const currentScrollTop = container.scrollTop;
    const currentScrollLeft = container.scrollLeft;

    const deltaY = (elRect.top - containerRect.top) - (containerRect.height / 2) + (elRect.height / 2);
    const deltaX = (elRect.left - containerRect.left) - (containerRect.width / 2) + (elRect.width / 2);

    container.scrollTo({
      top: Math.max(0, currentScrollTop + deltaY),
      left: Math.max(0, currentScrollLeft + deltaX),
      behavior: 'smooth'
    });

    if (highlight) {
      // Remove any existing highlight first
      document.querySelectorAll('.tile-focus-pulse').forEach(node => {
        node.classList.remove('tile-focus-pulse');
      });

      el.classList.add('tile-focus-pulse');
      setTimeout(() => {
        el.classList.remove('tile-focus-pulse');
      }, 2000);
    }
  }, []);

  // Update visible range and scroll cues on scroll
  const handleScroll = useCallback(() => {
    const container = viewportRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const { scrollTop, scrollHeight, clientHeight } = container;
    setCanScrollUp(scrollTop > 40);
    setCanScrollDown(scrollTop + clientHeight < scrollHeight - 40);

    // Calculate approximate visible levels based on row geometry
    // In our 10x10 board:
    // Row 0 is Top (levels 91-100)
    // Row 9 is Bottom (levels 1-10)
    const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    let minId = 100;
    let maxId = 1;
    let anyFound = false;

    // Check sample tile samples to locate bounding levels in view
    for (let id = 1; id <= 100; id += 2) {
      const el = document.getElementById(`cell-${id}`);
      if (el) {
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.bottom > containerRect.top && rect.top < containerRect.bottom) {
          anyFound = true;
          if (id < minId) minId = id;
          if (id > maxId) maxId = id;
        }
      }
    }

    if (anyFound) {
      setVisibleRangeText(`Levels ${minId}–${maxId} of 100`);
    }
  }, []);

  // Initial scroll to player's current tile on mount or when currentPosition moves
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      scrollToTile(currentPosition, false);
      handleScroll();
    }, 350);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [currentPosition, scrollToTile, handleScroll]);

  // Jump to Level handler
  const handleJumpSubmit = (e?: React.FormEvent) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    const num = parseInt(jumpInput.trim(), 10);
    if (!isNaN(num) && num >= 1 && num <= 100) {
      setJumpError(false);
      scrollToTile(num, true);
      setJumpInput('');
    } else {
      setJumpError(true);
      setTimeout(() => setJumpError(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  // Scroll page up/down buttons
  const scrollPage = (direction: 'up' | 'down') => {
    const container = viewportRef.current;
    if (!container) return;
    const delta = direction === 'up' ? -container.clientHeight * 0.75 : container.clientHeight * 0.75;
    container.scrollBy({ top: delta, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  const tileWidth = Math.round(BASE_TILE_WIDTH * zoom);
  const tileHeight = Math.round(BASE_TILE_HEIGHT * zoom);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col w-full h-full bg-[var(--board-bg)] rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border-subtle)] shadow-md overflow-hidden relative transition-colors duration-200">
      {/* 1. TOP VIEWPORT TOOLBAR */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 sm:px-4 py-2 bg-[var(--header-bg)] border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] z-30 backdrop-blur-md shrink-0">
        {/* Left: Focus & Stepper Navigation */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 flex-wrap">
          {/* Focus You Button */}
          <button
            onClick={() => scrollToTile(currentPosition, true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] hover:bg-[var(--color-indigo-border)] border border-[var(--color-indigo)] text-[var(--color-indigo)] text-xs font-black transition-all shadow-sm active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
            title="Smoothly center and highlight your current position"
          >
            <Crosshair className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-indigo)] animate-spin-slow" />
            <span>Focus You (Lvl {currentPosition})</span>
          </button>

          {/* Previous / Next Level Stepper */}
          <div className="flex items-center bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] rounded-xl border border-[var(--border-subtle)] p-0.5 shadow-inner">
            <button
              onClick={() => scrollToTile(currentPosition - 1, true)}
              disabled={currentPosition <= 1}
              className="flex items-center gap-0.5 px-2 py-1 text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-xs font-bold transition rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
              title={`View previous level (${currentPosition - 1})`}
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Lvl {currentPosition - 1}</span>
            </button>

            <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)] px-1 font-mono">|</span>

            <button
              onClick={() => scrollToTile(currentPosition + 1, true)}
              disabled={currentPosition >= 100}
              className="flex items-center gap-0.5 px-2 py-1 text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-xs font-bold transition rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
              title={`View next level (${currentPosition + 1})`}
            >
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Lvl {currentPosition + 1}</span>
              <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Jump to Level Input */}
          <form onSubmit={handleJumpSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                type="number"
                min="1"
                max="100"
                value={jumpInput}
                onChange={(e) => setJumpInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="1–100"
                className={`w-16 sm:w-20 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] border text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] placeholder-[var(--text-muted)] focus:outline-none transition ${
                  jumpError 
                    ? 'border-[var(--color-rose)] ring-2 ring-[var(--color-rose-border)]' 
                    : 'border-[var(--border-subtle)] focus:border-[var(--color-cyan)]'
                }`}
                title="Enter any level number from 1 to 100"
              />
            </div>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-indigo)] hover:bg-[var(--color-indigo-hover)] text-white text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            >
              Go
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>

        {/* Right: Position Indicator & Zoom Controls */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
          {/* Live Viewport Position Indicator */}
          <div className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[11px] font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)] shadow-inner">
            <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-cyan)] shrink-0" />
            <span className="font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]">{visibleRangeText}</span>
          </div>

          {/* Zoom Toolbar */}
          <div className="flex items-center bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] rounded-xl border border-[var(--border-subtle)] p-0.5 shadow-inner">
            <button
              onClick={handleZoomOut}
              disabled={zoomIndex === 0}
              className="p-1.5 text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] disabled:opacity-30 disabled:hover:text-[var(--text-muted)] transition-colors rounded cursor-pointer"
              title="Zoom Out"
            >
              <ZoomOut className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={handleResetZoom}
              className="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:text-[var(--color-cyan)] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Reset Zoom to 100%"
            >
              {Math.round(zoom * 100)}%
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={handleZoomIn}
              disabled={zoomIndex === ZOOM_STEPS.length - 1}
              className="p-1.5 text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] disabled:opacity-30 disabled:hover:text-[var(--text-muted)] transition-colors rounded cursor-pointer"
              title="Zoom In"
            >
              <ZoomIn className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>

            {zoom !== 1.0 && (
              <button
                onClick={handleResetZoom}
                className="p-1.5 ml-0.5 text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--color-amber)] transition-colors rounded border-l border-[var(--border-subtle)] cursor-pointer"
                title="Reset to 100%"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. SECTION / ROW NAVIGATION CHIPS (1-10 ... 91-100) */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-[var(--header-bg)] border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] overflow-x-auto text-[11px] font-mono shrink-0 custom-scrollbar z-20">
        <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-semibold uppercase text-[10px] tracking-wider shrink-0 mr-1 flex items-center gap-1">
          <Compass className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-cyan)]" />
          <span>Jump Row:</span>
        </span>
        {ROW_SECTIONS.map((sec) => {
          const isPlayerInRow = currentPosition >= sec.min && currentPosition <= sec.max;
          return (
            <button
              key={sec.label}
              onClick={() => scrollToTile(sec.center, true)}
              className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-bold transition shrink-0 cursor-pointer text-xs ${
                isPlayerInRow
                  ? 'bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] border border-[var(--color-indigo)] text-[var(--color-indigo)] shadow-sm'
                  : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
              }`}
              title={`Scroll to levels ${sec.label}`}
            >
              {sec.label}
              {isPlayerInRow && <span className="ml-1 text-[9px] text-[var(--color-indigo)]">●</span>}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* 3. SCROLLABLE BOARD CANVAS */}
      <div 
        ref={viewportRef}
        onScroll={handleScroll}
        className="flex-1 w-full overflow-x-auto overflow-y-auto board-scroll-viewport relative select-none scroll-smooth focus:outline-none"
        tabIndex={0}
      >
        <div className="min-w-fit min-h-fit w-full flex flex-col items-center justify-start p-4 sm:p-8 pb-36 sm:pb-48">
          <BoardGrid
            currentPosition={currentPosition}
            completedSquares={completedSquares}
            equippedMarker={equippedMarker}
            boardTheme={boardTheme}
            onSelectSquare={onSelectSquare}
            tileWidth={tileWidth}
            tileHeight={tileHeight}
            topicMasteryMap={topicMasteryMap}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 4. SUBTLE SCROLL DIRECTION CUES */}
      {canScrollUp && (
        <button
          onClick={() => scrollPage('up')}
          className="absolute top-20 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-30 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--color-cyan)] text-[11px] font-bold shadow-xl backdrop-blur-md flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all animate-bounce cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
          title="Scroll up to view higher levels"
        >
          <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-cyan)]" />
          <span>Levels Above (Scroll Up)</span>
        </button>
      )}

      {canScrollDown && (
        <button
          onClick={() => scrollPage('down')}
          className="absolute bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-30 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--color-cyan)] text-[11px] font-bold shadow-xl backdrop-blur-md flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all animate-bounce cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
          title="Scroll down to view lower levels"
        >
          <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-cyan)]" />
          <span>Levels Below (Scroll Down)</span>
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: src/components/Board/BoardGrid.tsx

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { SquareMetadata } from '../../types/curriculum';
import { SQUARE_MAP } from '../../data/curriculum100';
import { BoardCell } from './BoardCell';
import { SnakeLadderSvg } from './SnakeLadderSvg';
import { TopicMasteryScore } from '../../types/evolution';
import { normalizeDsaTopic } from '../../engine/masteryEngine';

interface BoardGridProps {
  currentPosition: number;
  completedSquares: number[];
  equippedMarker?: string;
  boardTheme?: string;
  topicMasteryMap?: Record<string, TopicMasteryScore>;
  onSelectSquare: (square: SquareMetadata) => void;
  tileWidth?: number;
  tileHeight?: number;
}

export const BoardGrid: React.FC<BoardGridProps> = ({
  currentPosition,
  completedSquares,
  equippedMarker,
  boardTheme = 'theme-obsidian-navy',
  topicMasteryMap,
  onSelectSquare,
  tileWidth = 138,
  tileHeight = 118
}) => {
  const orderedSquares = useMemo(() => {
    const list: SquareMetadata[] = [];
    for (let gridRow = 0; gridRow < 10; gridRow++) {
      const bottomRow = 9 - gridRow;
      const isEven = bottomRow % 2 === 0;
      for (let gridCol = 0; gridCol < 10; gridCol++) {
        const colInRow = isEven ? gridCol : 9 - gridCol;
        const squareId = bottomRow * 10 + colInRow + 1;
        const sq = SQUARE_MAP.get(squareId);
        if (sq) list.push(sq);
      }
    }
    return list;
  }, []);

  const completedSet = useMemo(() => new Set(completedSquares), [completedSquares]);

  const getThemeClass = () => {
    switch (boardTheme) {
      case 'theme-cyberpunk-indigo':
        return 'bg-[#111827] border-[#8B5CF6]/60 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(139,92,246,0.15)]';
      case 'theme-emerald-matrix':
        return 'bg-[#111827] border-[#10B981]/60 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(16,185,129,0.15)]';
      case 'theme-solar-amber':
        return 'bg-[#111827] border-[#F59E0B]/60 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(245,158,11,0.15)]';
      case 'theme-obsidian-navy':
      default:
        return 'bg-[#111827] border-[#263449] shadow-2xl';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div 
      className={`relative mx-auto p-4 rounded-3xl border-2 shadow-2xl transition-colors duration-500 shrink-0 ${getThemeClass()}`}
      style={{
        '--tile-width': `${tileWidth}px`,
        '--tile-height': `${tileHeight}px`,
        '--tile-gap': '10px',
        width: `calc(10 * var(--tile-width) + 9 * var(--tile-gap) + 32px)`,
        height: `calc(10 * var(--tile-height) + 9 * var(--tile-gap) + 32px)`,
        minWidth: `calc(10 * var(--tile-width) + 9 * var(--tile-gap) + 32px)`,
        minHeight: `calc(10 * var(--tile-height) + 9 * var(--tile-gap) + 32px)`,
      } as React.CSSProperties}
    >
      {/* 10x10 Serpentine Grid Container */}
      <div 
        className="relative grid grid-cols-10 grid-rows-10"
        style={{
          gap: 'var(--tile-gap, 10px)',
          width: 'calc(10 * var(--tile-width) + 9 * var(--tile-gap))',
          height: 'calc(10 * var(--tile-height) + 9 * var(--tile-gap))',
        }}
      >
        {/* Layer 1: SVG Snakes & Ladders Paths behind cards (z-0) */}
        <SnakeLadderSvg />

        {/* Layer 2: 100 Clear, Readable Level Cards (z-10) with Mastered Tile Evolution */}
        {orderedSquares.map(square => {
          const canonical = normalizeDsaTopic(square.topic);
          const tm = topicMasteryMap?.[canonical];
          return (
            <BoardCell
              key={`cell-${square.id}`}
              square={square}
              isCurrent={square.id === currentPosition}
              isCompleted={completedSet.has(square.id)}
              equippedMarker={equippedMarker}
              masteryScore={tm?.score}
              masteryLevel={tm?.level}
              onSelect={onSelectSquare}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { 
  Trophy, 
  Zap, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Code, 
  Layers, 
  Search, 
  FolderTree, 
  Network, 
  Sparkles, 
  ArrowUpRight, 
  ArrowDownRight, 
  Star 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { SquareMetadata } from '../../types/curriculum';
import { SNAKES_AND_LADDERS } from '../../data/snakesAndLadders';
import { PlayerMarker } from './PlayerMarker';

interface BoardCellProps {
  square: SquareMetadata;
  isCurrent: boolean;
  isCompleted: boolean;
  equippedMarker?: string;
  masteryScore?: number;
  masteryLevel?: string;
  onSelect: (square: SquareMetadata) => void;
}

/**
 * Natural human-friendly title formatting for student cards:
 * Replaces overly formal generated phrasing with concise, punchy topic names.
 */
function formatTopicName(title: string): string {
  let clean = title.replace(/\s*\([^)]*\)/g, '').trim();
  clean = clean.replace(/Primitive Operations & Computational Cost Analysis/i, 'Primitive Operations');
  clean = clean.replace(/Comparative Asymptotic Function Analysis/i, 'Compare Function Growth');
  clean = clean.replace(/Exponential & Factorial Growth Dominance/i, 'Exponential vs Factorial');
  clean = clean.replace(/Algorithm Correctness & Specifications/i, 'Algorithm Correctness');
  clean = clean.replace(/Strict Upper Bounds \(O-Notation\)/i, 'Big-O Notation');
  clean = clean.replace(/Strict Lower Bounds \(Omega-Notation\)/i, 'Big-Omega Notation');
  clean = clean.replace(/Tight Bounds \(Theta-Notation\)/i, 'Big-Theta Notation');
  clean = clean.replace(/Instruction Counting Model/i, 'Instruction Counting');
  return clean;
}

function formatDifficulty(diff: string): string {
  if (diff === 'easy') return 'Easy';
  if (diff === 'medium') return 'Med';
  if (diff === 'hard') return 'Hard';
  return 'Exp';
}

export const BoardCell: React.FC<BoardCellProps> = ({
  square,
  isCurrent,
  isCompleted,
  equippedMarker,
  masteryScore,
  onSelect
}) => {
  // Check for ladders and snakes
  const ladder = SNAKES_AND_LADDERS.find(item => item.type === 'ladder' && item.from === square.id);
  const snake = SNAKES_AND_LADDERS.find(item => item.type === 'snake' && item.from === square.id);
  const ladderDestination = SNAKES_AND_LADDERS.find(item => item.type === 'ladder' && item.to === square.id);
  const snakeDestination = SNAKES_AND_LADDERS.find(item => item.type === 'snake' && item.to === square.id);

  // Card theme styling with calm, human borders rather than excessive neon glows
  const getCardClasses = () => {
    // 1. Current Player Tile
    if (isCurrent) {
      return 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--color-indigo)] text-[var(--text-primary)] ring-2 ring-[var(--color-indigo)]/50 shadow-sm z-20 scale-[1.01]';
    }
    // 2. Tile 100 Finish
    if (square.id === 100) {
      return 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--color-violet)] text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:border-[var(--color-violet)] shadow-sm';
    }
    // 3. Snake Tile (Mistake trap)
    if (snake) {
      return 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--color-rose)] text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:border-[var(--color-rose)] shadow-sm';
    }
    // 4. Ladder Tile (Optimization leap)
    if (ladder) {
      return 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--color-amber)] text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:border-[var(--color-amber)] shadow-sm';
    }
    // 5. Checkpoint Tile
    if (square.isCheckpoint) {
      return 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--color-amber)] text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:border-[var(--color-amber)] shadow-sm';
    }
    // 6. Mastered Tile
    if ((masteryScore ?? 0) >= 80) {
      return 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--color-emerald)] text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:border-[var(--color-emerald)] shadow-sm';
    }
    // 7. Completed Tile
    if (isCompleted) {
      return 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--color-cyan)] text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:border-[var(--color-cyan)] shadow-sm';
    }
    // 8. Standard Tile
    return 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:border-[var(--color-indigo)]/50 shadow-sm';
  };

  const getStageIcon = () => {
    switch (square.stage) {
      case 'co1_math_analysis': 
      case 'co1_asymptotic': 
      case 'co1_recurrence_sub': 
      case 'co1_master_tree': 
        return <Code className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-emerald)] shrink-0" />;
      case 'co2_stacks': 
      case 'co2_queues': 
      case 'co2_linked_lists': 
        return <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-cyan)] shrink-0" />;
      case 'co3_sorting_searching': 
        return <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-indigo)] shrink-0" />;
      case 'co4_trees': 
        return <FolderTree className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-violet)] shrink-0" />;
      case 'co4_graphs_algorithms': 
        return <Network className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-violet)] shrink-0" />;
      default: 
        return <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-cyan)] shrink-0" />;
    }
  };

  const formattedNumber = square.id < 10 ? `0${square.id}` : `${square.id}`;
  const topicName = formatTopicName(square.title);

  return (
    <div
      id={`cell-${square.id}`}
      role="button"
      tabIndex={0}
      onClick={() => onSelect(square)}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          onSelect(square);
        }
      }}
      aria-label={`Level ${square.id}: ${square.title}. Status: ${isCurrent ? 'Current' : isCompleted ? 'Completed' : 'Available'}`}
      style={{
        width: 'var(--tile-width, 135px)',
        height: 'var(--tile-height, 115px)',
        minWidth: 'var(--tile-width, 135px)',
        minHeight: 'var(--tile-height, 115px)'
      }}
      className={`relative z-10 rounded-2xl border p-2 sm:p-2.5 flex flex-col justify-between transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer select-none group text-left ${getCardClasses()} ${
        !isCurrent ? 'hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow' : ''
      }`}
    >
      {/* 1. TOP ROW: Level Number and Status/Badge */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] pb-1">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className={`font-mono font-bold text-base sm:text-lg tracking-tight leading-none ${
            isCurrent 
              ? 'text-[var(--color-indigo)]' 
              : square.id === 100 
                ? 'text-[var(--color-violet)]' 
                : 'text-[var(--text-primary)]'
          }`}>
            {formattedNumber}
          </span>
          {getStageIcon()}
        </div>

        {/* Status Indicator */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          {isCurrent ? (
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] border border-[var(--color-indigo-border)] text-[var(--color-indigo)] font-semibold text-[9.5px] flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--color-indigo)]" />
              You
            </span>
          ) : (masteryScore ?? 0) >= 80 ? (
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] border border-[var(--color-emerald-border)] text-[var(--color-emerald)] font-medium text-[9.5px] flex items-center gap-0.5 shadow-sm" title={`Mastered (${masteryScore}%)`}>
              <Star className="w-2.5 h-2.5 fill-[var(--color-emerald)] text-[var(--color-emerald)]" />
              Master
            </span>
          ) : (masteryScore ?? 0) >= 55 ? (
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--color-cyan-light)] border border-[var(--color-cyan-border)] text-[var(--color-cyan)] font-medium text-[9.5px] flex items-center gap-0.5 shadow-sm" title={`Strong (${masteryScore}%)`}>
              <Sparkles className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-[var(--color-cyan)]" />
              Strong
            </span>
          ) : isCompleted ? (
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--color-cyan-light)] border border-[var(--color-cyan-border)] text-[var(--color-cyan)] font-medium text-[9.5px] flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm" title="Completed">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-[var(--color-cyan)]" />
              Done
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-[9.5px] font-mono font-medium text-[var(--text-muted)]" title="Difficulty">
              {formatDifficulty(square.difficulty)}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. MIDDLE ROW: Topic Name and Short Description */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-center py-1">
        <h4 className="font-bold text-[12.5px] sm:text-[13px] md:text-[13.5px] text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-tight tracking-tight line-clamp-2 break-words group-hover:text-[var(--color-indigo)] transition-colors">
          {topicName}
        </h4>
        <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-[10.5px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] leading-tight line-clamp-1 mt-0.5 font-normal">
          {square.subtopic || square.summary || square.topic}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* 3. BOTTOM ROW: Type Badge */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full pt-1 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
        {square.id === 100 ? (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[var(--color-violet-light)] border border-[var(--color-violet-border)] text-[var(--color-violet)] font-semibold text-[9.5px] shadow-sm">
            <Trophy className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-[var(--color-violet)]" />
            Finish (100)
          </span>
        ) : square.id === 1 ? (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] border border-[var(--color-indigo-border)] text-[var(--color-indigo)] font-semibold text-[9.5px] shadow-sm">
            Start
          </span>
        ) : ladder ? (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[var(--color-amber-light)] border border-[var(--color-amber-border)] text-[var(--color-amber)] font-medium text-[9.5px] shadow-sm">
            <Zap className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-[var(--color-amber)]" />
            <span>Ladder &rarr; {ladder.to}</span>
          </span>
        ) : snake ? (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] border border-[var(--color-rose-border)] text-[var(--color-rose)] font-medium text-[9.5px] shadow-sm">

            <span>Snake &darr; {snake.to}</span>
          </span>
        ) : ladderDestination ? (

      {/* 4. PLAYER TOKEN (Non-overlapping Anchor) */}

        <div className="absolute -top-3 -right-3 z-30 pointer-events-none">
          <PlayerMarker equippedMarker={equippedMarker} />

    </div>
  );

FILE: src/components/Board/SnakeLadderSvg.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { SNAKES_AND_LADDERS } from '../../data/snakesAndLadders';
import { getSquarePercentCoords } from '../../engine/gameEngine';

export const SnakeLadderSvg: React.FC = () => {
  return (
    <svg 
      className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-none z-0"
      viewBox="0 0 1000 1000"
      preserveAspectRatio="none"
    >
      <defs>
        {/* Glow filter for ladders */}
        <filter id="ladder-glow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
          <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" floodColor="#f59e0b" floodOpacity="0.5" />
        </filter>
        {/* Glow filter for snakes */}
        <filter id="snake-glow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
          <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" floodColor="#f43f5e" floodOpacity="0.6" />
        </filter>

        {/* Snake skin gradient */}
        <linearGradient id="snake-gradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
          <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#f43f5e" />
          <stop offset="50%" stopColor="#e11d48" />
          <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#9f1239" />
        </linearGradient>

        {/* Ladder rail gradient */}
        <linearGradient id="ladder-gradient" x1="0%" y1="100%" x2="0%" y2="0%">
          <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#b45309" />
          <stop offset="50%" stopColor="#f59e0b" />
          <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#fef08a" />
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>

      {/* Render Ladders */}
      {SNAKES_AND_LADDERS.filter(item => item.type === 'ladder').map(ladder => {
        const fromCoord = getSquarePercentCoords(ladder.from);
        const toCoord = getSquarePercentCoords(ladder.to);

        const x1 = fromCoord.x * 10;
        const y1 = fromCoord.y * 10;
        const x2 = toCoord.x * 10;
        const y2 = toCoord.y * 10;

        // Vector math for parallel ladder rails
        const dx = x2 - x1;
        const dy = y2 - y1;
        const length = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (length === 0) return null;

        const perpX = (-dy / length) * 12;
        const perpY = (dx / length) * 12;

        const rail1Start = { x: x1 + perpX, y: y1 + perpY };
        const rail1End = { x: x2 + perpX, y: y2 + perpY };
        const rail2Start = { x: x1 - perpX, y: y1 - perpY };
        const rail2End = { x: x2 - perpX, y: y2 - perpY };

        // Generate ladder rungs
        const rungCount = Math.max(4, Math.floor(length / 28));
        const rungs = [];
        for (let i = 1; i < rungCount; i++) {
          const t = i / rungCount;
          const rx1 = rail1Start.x + t * (rail1End.x - rail1Start.x);
          const ry1 = rail1Start.y + t * (rail1End.y - rail1Start.y);
          const rx2 = rail2Start.x + t * (rail2End.x - rail2Start.x);
          const ry2 = rail2Start.y + t * (rail2End.y - rail2Start.y);
          rungs.push(
            <line
              key={`rung-${ladder.id}-${i}`}
              x1={rx1}
              y1={ry1}
              x2={rx2}
              y2={ry2}
              stroke="url(#ladder-gradient)"
              strokeWidth="4"
              strokeLinecap="round"
            />
          );
        }

        return (
          <g key={ladder.id} filter="url(#ladder-glow)" opacity="0.9">
            {/* Left Rail */}
            <line
              x1={rail1Start.x}
              y1={rail1Start.y}
              x2={rail1End.x}
              y2={rail1End.y}
              stroke="url(#ladder-gradient)"
              strokeWidth="5"
              strokeLinecap="round"
            />
            {/* Right Rail */}
            <line
              x1={rail2Start.x}
              y1={rail2Start.y}
              x2={rail2End.x}
              y2={rail2End.y}
              stroke="url(#ladder-gradient)"
              strokeWidth="5"
              strokeLinecap="round"
            />
            {/* Ladder Rungs */}
            {rungs}
          </g>
        );
      })}

      {/* Render Snakes */}
      {SNAKES_AND_LADDERS.filter(item => item.type === 'snake').map(snake => {
        // Snake starts at head (snake.from) and slides down to tail (snake.to)
        const headCoord = getSquarePercentCoords(snake.from);
        const tailCoord = getSquarePercentCoords(snake.to);

        const hx = headCoord.x * 10;
        const hy = headCoord.y * 10;
        const tx = tailCoord.x * 10;
        const ty = tailCoord.y * 10;

        // Curving sinusoidal control points
        const midX = (hx + tx) / 2;
        const midY = (hy + ty) / 2;
        const offset = ((snake.from % 2 === 0) ? 1 : -1) * 60;

        const cp1X = midX + offset;
        const cp1Y = hy + (midY - hy) * 0.4;
        const cp2X = midX - offset;
        const cp2Y = midY + (ty - midY) * 0.6;

        const pathD = `M ${hx} ${hy} C ${cp1X} ${cp1Y}, ${cp2X} ${cp2Y}, ${tx} ${ty}`;

        return (
          <g key={snake.id} filter="url(#snake-glow)" opacity="0.92">
            {/* Outer body */}
            <path
              d={pathD}
              fill="none"
              stroke="url(#snake-gradient)"
              strokeWidth="11"
              strokeLinecap="round"
            />
            {/* Inner scale texture pattern */}
            <path
              d={pathD}
              fill="none"
              stroke="#fb7185"
              strokeWidth="4"
              strokeDasharray="6 8"
              strokeLinecap="round"
            />
            {/* Snake Head */}
            <circle cx={hx} cy={hy} r="10" fill="#e11d48" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth="2" />
            <circle cx={hx - 3} cy={hy - 2} r="2" fill="#000" />
            <circle cx={hx + 3} cy={hy - 2} r="2" fill="#000" />
            
            {/* Snake Tail */}
            <circle cx={tx} cy={ty} r="4" fill="#9f1239" />
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
};

        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

import React from 'react';
import { Compass, Sparkles, Bot, Play, Pause, Square } from 'lucide-react';
import { AutoplaySpeed } from '../../types/game';

interface DiceControlsProps {
  currentPosition: number;
  lastDiceRoll: number;
  diceSkin?: string;
  isRolling: boolean;
  isMoving: boolean;
  isAutoplayRunning: boolean;
  isAutoplayPaused?: boolean;
  autoplaySpeed?: AutoplaySpeed;
  onRollDice: () => void;
  onStartAutoplay?: () => void;
  onPauseAutoplay?: () => void;
  onResumeAutoplay?: () => void;
  onStopAutoplay?: () => void;
  onSetAutoplaySpeed?: (speed: AutoplaySpeed) => void;
}

export const DiceControls: React.FC<DiceControlsProps> = ({
  currentPosition,
  lastDiceRoll,
  diceSkin = 'dice-classic-ivory',
  isRolling,
  isMoving,
  isAutoplayRunning,
  isAutoplayPaused = false,
  autoplaySpeed = 1,
  onRollDice,
  onStartAutoplay,
  onPauseAutoplay,
  onResumeAutoplay,
  onStopAutoplay,
  onSetAutoplaySpeed
}) => {
  const getSkinStyles = () => {
    switch (diceSkin) {
      case 'dice-ruby-prism':
        return {
          cubeBg: 'bg-[#F43F5E] border-[#F43F5E] shadow-sm',
          pipColor: 'bg-[#F8FAFC]'
        };
      case 'dice-emerald-cyber':
        return {
          cubeBg: 'bg-[#10B981] border-[#10B981] shadow-sm',
          pipColor: 'bg-[#080D1A]'
        };
      case 'dice-gold-royale':
        return {
          cubeBg: 'bg-[#F59E0B] border-[#F59E0B] shadow-sm',
          pipColor: 'bg-[#080D1A]'
        };
      case 'dice-classic-ivory':
      default:
        return {
          cubeBg: 'bg-[#F8FAFC] border-[#263449] shadow-sm',
          pipColor: 'bg-[#080D1A]'
        };
    }
  };

  const { cubeBg, pipColor } = getSkinStyles();

  // Render dice face pips (1 to 6)
  const renderDicePips = (value: number) => {
    switch (value) {
      case 1:
        return <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${pipColor} mx-auto my-auto`} />;
      case 2:
        return (
          <div className="w-full h-full p-0.5 flex justify-between">
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor} self-end`} />
          </div>
        );
      case 3:
        return (
          <div className="w-full h-full p-0.5 flex flex-col justify-between items-center">
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor} self-start`} />
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor} self-center`} />
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor} self-end`} />
          </div>
        );
      case 4:
        return (
          <div className="w-full h-full p-0.5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-0.5 items-center justify-items-center">
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
          </div>
        );
      case 5:
        return (
          <div className="w-full h-full p-0.5 grid grid-cols-3 gap-0.5 items-center justify-items-center">
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
            <div />
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
            <div />
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
            <div />
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
            <div />
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
          </div>
        );
      case 6:
      default:
        return (
          <div className="w-full h-full p-0.5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-0.5 items-center justify-items-center">
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
            <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${pipColor}`} />
          </div>
        );
    }
  };

  const progressPercent = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, currentPosition));

  return (
    <div 
      className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 py-2 bg-[var(--header-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-md backdrop-blur-md shrink-0 transition-colors duration-200"
    >
      {/* 3D Dice Button (Primary Action: Indigo -> Violet Gradient CTA) */}
      <button
        onClick={onRollDice}
        disabled={isRolling || isMoving || isAutoplayRunning}
        className="flex items-center gap-3 min-h-[48px] px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#6366F1] to-[#8B5CF6] hover:from-[#4F46E5] hover:to-[#7C3AED] border border-[#6366F1] text-white shadow-lg shadow-[#6366F1]/25 transition-all transform active:scale-95 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed shrink-0"
        aria-label="Roll the Dice"
      >
        {/* Animated 3D Die Cube */}
        <div 
          className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-lg ${cubeBg} shadow-md border flex items-center justify-center transition-transform shrink-0 ${
            isRolling ? 'animate-spin' : ''
          }`}
        >
          {renderDicePips(lastDiceRoll)}
        </div>

        <div className="text-left">
          <div className="text-sm font-black tracking-wide leading-tight text-white">
            {isRolling ? 'Rolling...' : isMoving ? 'Moving...' : 'Roll Dice'}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-white/90 font-medium leading-none mt-0.5">
            {isAutoplayRunning ? 'Autoplay Active' : `Rolled ${lastDiceRoll} • Click to Move`}
          </div>
        </div>
      </button>

      {/* Center Position Badge */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-xl text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs shrink-0 shadow-sm">
        <Compass className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-indigo)]" />
        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] hidden sm:inline">Position:</span>
        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[var(--color-indigo)] bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] border border-[var(--color-indigo-border)] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg font-mono">
          Tile {currentPosition} of 100
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Progress Bar */}
      <div className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-1 max-w-[200px]">
        <div className="flex-1">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] mb-1">
            <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
              <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-[var(--color-teal)]" />
              Progress
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono font-medium text-[var(--color-teal)] text-[10px]">{progressPercent}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="w-full h-2 bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <div 
              className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--color-cyan)] to-[var(--color-teal)] rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
              style={{ width: `${progressPercent}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Integrated Autoplay Section */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 pl-2 border-l border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
        {!isAutoplayRunning ? (
          <button
            onClick={onStartAutoplay}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-h-[44px] px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-teal-light)] hover:bg-[var(--color-teal-border)] border border-[var(--color-teal)] text-[var(--color-teal)] font-bold text-xs transition shadow-sm cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            title="Start automated demonstration on the real game board"
          >
            <Bot className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-teal)]" />
            <span>Autoplay</span>
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            {isAutoplayPaused ? (
              <button
                onClick={onResumeAutoplay}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-h-[44px] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-emerald)] hover:opacity-90 text-white font-bold text-xs transition cursor-pointer shadow active:scale-95"
              >
                <Play className="w-3 h-3 fill-white" /> Resume
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                onClick={onPauseAutoplay}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-h-[44px] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-amber)] hover:opacity-90 text-white font-bold text-xs transition cursor-pointer shadow active:scale-95"
              >
                <Pause className="w-3 h-3 fill-white" /> Pause
              </button>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={onStopAutoplay}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-h-[44px] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-rose)] hover:opacity-90 text-white font-bold text-xs transition cursor-pointer shadow active:scale-95"
            >
              <Square className="w-3 h-3 fill-white" /> Stop
            </button>

            {/* Speed Buttons */}
            {onSetAutoplaySpeed && (
              <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1 ml-1 bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] p-1 rounded-xl border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
                {([1, 2, 4] as AutoplaySpeed[]).map((spd) => (
                  <button
                    key={spd}
                    onClick={() => onSetAutoplaySpeed(spd)}
                    className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                      autoplaySpeed === spd
                        ? 'bg-[var(--color-indigo)] text-white shadow-sm'
                        : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {spd}x
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { 
  Play, 
  Pause, 
  Square, 
  Bot 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { AutoplaySpeed } from '../../types/game';

interface AutoplayBarProps {
  isRunning: boolean;
  isPaused: boolean;
  speed: AutoplaySpeed;
  onStart: () => void;
  onPause: () => void;
  onResume: () => void;
  onStop: () => void;
  onSetSpeed: (speed: AutoplaySpeed) => void;
}

export const AutoplayBar: React.FC<AutoplayBarProps> = ({
  isRunning,
  isPaused,
  speed,
  onStart,
  onPause,
  onResume,
  onStop,
  onSetSpeed
}) => {
  return (
    <div 
      className="w-full mx-auto px-2.5 py-1 bg-[#111827] border border-[#263449] rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs shrink-0"
      style={{ maxWidth: 'min(100%, calc(100vh - 200px), 680px)' }}
    >
      {/* Left: Autoplay status */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
        <Bot className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isRunning ? 'text-[#22D3EE] animate-pulse' : 'text-[#64748B]'}`} />
        <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#94A3B8]">
          Autoplay
        </span>
        {isRunning && (
          <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold border ${
            isPaused ? 'bg-[#F59E0B]/20 text-[#F59E0B] border-[#F59E0B]/40' : 'bg-[#2563EB]/20 text-[#22D3EE] border-[#2563EB]/40'
          }`}>
            {isPaused ? 'PAUSED' : 'LIVE'}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Center: Controls */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
        {!isRunning ? (
          <button
            onClick={onStart}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#2563EB] hover:bg-[#1d4ed8] text-[#F8FAFC] font-bold text-[10.5px] transition shadow cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Play className="w-2.5 h-2.5 fill-white" /> Start
          </button>
        ) : (
          <>
            {isPaused ? (
              <button
                onClick={onResume}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#10B981] hover:bg-[#059669] text-[#F8FAFC] font-bold text-[10.5px] transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Play className="w-2.5 h-2.5 fill-white" /> Resume
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                onClick={onPause}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#F59E0B] hover:bg-[#d97706] text-[#080D1A] font-bold text-[10.5px] transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Pause className="w-2.5 h-2.5 fill-current" /> Pause
              </button>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={onStop}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#F43F5E] hover:bg-[#e11d48] text-[#F8FAFC] font-bold text-[10.5px] transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Square className="w-2.5 h-2.5 fill-white" /> Stop
            </button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Right: Speed Toggles */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-mono shrink-0">
        <span className="text-[#64748B] hidden sm:inline">Speed:</span>
        {([1, 2, 4] as AutoplaySpeed[]).map((spd) => (
          <button
            key={spd}
            onClick={() => onSetSpeed(spd)}
            className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
              speed === spd
                ? 'bg-[#2563EB] text-[#F8FAFC] shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-[#080D1A] text-[#94A3B8] border border-[#263449] hover:bg-[#172033] hover:text-[#F8FAFC]'
            }`}
          >
            {spd}x
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
