import React from 'react';
import { 
  Play, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Circle, 
  Flame, 
  Target,
  AlertCircle,
  Activity,
  Network,
  Gauge,
  Sliders,
  Workflow,
  ArrowUpRight
} from 'lucide-react';
import { SquareMetadata } from '../../types/curriculum';
import { ActivityRecord } from '../../types/game';
import { TopicMasteryScore, MisconceptionRecord } from '../../types/evolution';
import { calculateLearningDebt } from '../../engine/errorDnaEngine';

interface RightSidebarProps {
  currentSquare: SquareMetadata;
  completedCount: number;
  totalAttempts: number;
  totalCorrect: number;
  accuracy: number;
  streak: number;
  recoveryStreak: number;
  laddersClimbed: number;
  snakesEncountered: number;
  totalScore: number;
  coinBalance: number;
  recentActivities: ActivityRecord[];
  onStartChallenge: (squareId: number) => void;
  topicMasteryMap?: Record<string, TopicMasteryScore>;
  misconceptions?: MisconceptionRecord[];
  onOpenErrorDNA?: () => void;
  onOpenDecisionLab?: () => void;
  onOpenComplexityMeter?: () => void;
  onOpenWhatIfSimulator?: () => void;
  onOpenKnowledgeGraph?: () => void;
}

export const RightSidebar: React.FC<RightSidebarProps> = ({
  currentSquare,
  completedCount: _completedCount,
  totalAttempts,
  totalCorrect,
  accuracy,
  streak,
  recoveryStreak: _recoveryStreak,
  laddersClimbed: _laddersClimbed,
  snakesEncountered: _snakesEncountered,
  totalScore: _totalScore,
  coinBalance: _coinBalance,
  recentActivities: _recentActivities,
  onStartChallenge,
  topicMasteryMap = {},
  misconceptions = [],
  onOpenErrorDNA,
  onOpenDecisionLab,
  onOpenComplexityMeter,
  onOpenWhatIfSimulator,
  onOpenKnowledgeGraph
}) => {
  const incorrectCount = Math.max(0, totalAttempts - totalCorrect);
  const debt = calculateLearningDebt(topicMasteryMap, misconceptions);

  const getHealthBadge = () => {
    if (accuracy >= 0.8 && debt.debtPercentage <= 30) {
      return { 
        label: 'On Track', 
        color: 'text-[var(--color-emerald)] bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] border-[var(--color-emerald-border)]' 
      };
    }
    if (accuracy >= 0.5 && debt.debtPercentage <= 60) {
      return { 
        label: 'In Progress', 
        color: 'text-[var(--color-cyan)] bg-[var(--color-cyan-light)] border-[var(--color-cyan-border)]' 
      };
    }
    return { 
      label: 'Needs Review', 
      color: 'text-[var(--color-rose)] bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] border-[var(--color-rose-border)]' 
    };
  };

  const health = getHealthBadge();

  return (
    <aside className="w-full flex flex-col gap-2.5 text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
      {/* Card 1: Current Tile */}
      <div className="bg-[var(--sidebar-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl p-3.5 shadow-sm transition-colors duration-200">
        <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-1.5">
          Current Tile
        </div>

        {/* Square Title Header */}
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 mb-2.5">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#6366F1] to-[#4F46E5] text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm shadow-sm shrink-0">
            {currentSquare.id}
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-tight truncate">
              {currentSquare.title}
            </h3>
            <p className="text-[10.5px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] mt-0.5 line-clamp-1 font-normal">
              {currentSquare.summary}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Checkpoint Checklist */}
        <div className="mb-2.5 bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-xl p-2.5 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-[var(--color-cyan)] mb-1 flex items-center gap-1">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 text-[var(--color-cyan)]" />
            Checkpoint Criteria
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            {currentSquare.checkpointTasks.slice(0, 3).map((task, idx) => (
              <div key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-1 text-[10.5px] text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                <Circle className="w-2 h-2 text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1 shrink-0" />
                <span className="leading-snug truncate font-normal">{task}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Start Challenge CTA (Primary Button: Indigo) */}
        <button
          onClick={() => onStartChallenge(currentSquare.id)}
          className="w-full py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#6366F1] to-[#4F46E5] hover:from-[#4F46E5] hover:to-[#4338CA] text-white font-bold text-xs tracking-wide shadow-md shadow-[#6366F1]/20 transition-all transform active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-white" />
          Solve Challenge & Move
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Card 2: Player Statistics Panel */}
      <div className="bg-[var(--sidebar-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl p-3.5 shadow-sm transition-colors duration-200">
        <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
          <span>Player Statistics</span>
          <Target className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-indigo)]" />
        </h3>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
          {/* Tile Position */}
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col shadow-sm">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)] font-medium">Position</span>
            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[var(--color-indigo)] text-xs mt-0.5">
              Tile {currentSquare.id} of 100
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Accuracy */}
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col shadow-sm">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)] font-medium">Accuracy</span>
            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[var(--color-emerald)] text-xs mt-0.5">
              {(accuracy * 100).toFixed(0)}%
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Solved vs Failed */}
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col shadow-sm">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)] font-medium">Solved / Failed</span>
            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] text-[11px] mt-0.5">
              <span className="text-[var(--color-emerald)]">{totalCorrect}</span> / <span className="text-[var(--color-rose)]">{incorrectCount}</span>
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Active Streak */}
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col shadow-sm">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)] font-medium">Current Streak</span>
            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[var(--color-orange)] text-[11px] mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1">
              <Flame className="w-3 h-3 fill-[var(--color-orange)]" /> {streak}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Card 3: Topics to Review & Readiness */}
      <div className="bg-[var(--sidebar-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl p-3.5 shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-2 transition-colors duration-200">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-cyan)]" />
            <span>Topics to Review</span>
          </div>
          <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-medium border ${health.color}`}>
            {health.label}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Learning Review Gauge */}
        <div className="bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-xl p-2.5 flex flex-col gap-1.5 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
            <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
              <AlertCircle className="w-3 h-3 text-[var(--color-rose)]" /> Review Needed
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[var(--color-rose)]">
              {debt.totalMisconceptions > 0 ? `${debt.totalMisconceptions} items` : 'None'}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="w-full bg-[var(--board-bg)] rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <div 
              className={`h-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                debt.debtPercentage < 30 ? 'bg-[var(--color-emerald)]' :
                debt.debtPercentage < 60 ? 'bg-[var(--color-amber)]' : 'bg-[var(--color-rose)]'
              }`}
              style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(5, debt.debtPercentage))}%` }}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] mt-0.5">
            <span>{debt.totalMisconceptions} concepts to review</span>
            {onOpenErrorDNA && (
              <button

            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Card 4: Study & Exploration Tools */}
      <div className="bg-[var(--sidebar-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl p-3 shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-2 transition-colors duration-200">

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { HelpCircle, BarChart3, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { LeftSidebar } from './LeftSidebar';
import { RightSidebar } from './RightSidebar';
import { SquareMetadata } from '../../types/curriculum';
import { ActivityRecord } from '../../types/game';

interface MobileDrawerProps {
  currentSquare: SquareMetadata;
  completedCount: number;
  totalAttempts: number;
  totalCorrect: number;
  accuracy: number;
  streak: number;
  recoveryStreak: number;
  laddersClimbed: number;
  snakesEncountered: number;
  totalScore: number;
  coinBalance: number;
  recentActivities: ActivityRecord[];
  onStartChallenge: (squareId: number) => void;
}

export const MobileDrawer: React.FC<MobileDrawerProps> = ({
  currentSquare,
  completedCount,
  totalAttempts,
  totalCorrect,
  accuracy,
  streak,
  recoveryStreak,
  laddersClimbed,
  snakesEncountered,
  totalScore,
  coinBalance,
  recentActivities,
  onStartChallenge
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'none' | 'rules' | 'progress'>('none');

  if (activeTab === 'none') {
    return (
      <div className="fixed bottom-3 right-3 lg:hidden z-40 flex items-center gap-2">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('rules')}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[#06B6D4] shadow-xl font-bold text-xs hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] cursor-pointer transition-colors"
        >
          <HelpCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-[#06B6D4]" />
          Rules & Legend
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('progress')}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[#10B981] shadow-xl font-bold text-xs hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] cursor-pointer transition-colors"
        >
          <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4 text-[#10B981]" />
          Challenge & Stats
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 lg:hidden flex flex-col justify-end bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm">
      <div className="w-full max-h-[85vh] bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-t-3xl p-4 overflow-y-auto flex flex-col text-[var(--text-primary)]">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] mb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('rules')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'rules' ? 'bg-[#6366F1] text-white shadow-sm' : 'text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
              }`}
            >
              How It Works & Legend
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('progress')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'progress' ? 'bg-[#6366F1] text-white shadow-sm' : 'text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
              }`}
            >
              Challenge & Stats
            </button>
          </div>
          <button 
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('none')}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto pb-4">
          {activeTab === 'rules' ? (
            <LeftSidebar />
          ) : (
            <RightSidebar
              currentSquare={currentSquare}
              completedCount={completedCount}
              totalAttempts={totalAttempts}
              totalCorrect={totalCorrect}
              accuracy={accuracy}
              streak={streak}
              recoveryStreak={recoveryStreak}
              laddersClimbed={laddersClimbed}
              snakesEncountered={snakesEncountered}
              totalScore={totalScore}
              coinBalance={coinBalance}
              recentActivities={recentActivities}
              onStartChallenge={(sq) => {
                setActiveTab('none');
                onStartChallenge(sq);
              }}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: src/components/Common/MovementToast.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { 
  Zap, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  RotateCcw, 
  Crown, 
  Trophy, 
  TrendingUp, 
  X 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { MovementNotification } from '../../types/rewards';

interface MovementToastProps {
  notification: MovementNotification | null;
  onDismiss: () => void;
}

export const MovementToast: React.FC<MovementToastProps> = ({
  notification,
  onDismiss
}) => {
  if (!notification) return null;

  const getStyle = () => {
    switch (notification.type) {
      case 'bonus':
        return 'border-[var(--color-emerald)] shadow-[var(--color-emerald)]/20';
      case 'penalty':
        return 'border-[var(--color-rose)] shadow-[var(--color-rose)]/20';
      case 'recovery':
        return 'border-[var(--color-cyan)] shadow-[var(--color-cyan)]/20';
      case 'level_up':
        return 'border-[var(--color-violet)] shadow-[var(--color-violet)]/20';
      case 'achievement':
        return 'border-[var(--color-amber)] shadow-[var(--color-amber)]/20';
      case 'ladder':
        return 'border-[var(--color-amber)] shadow-[var(--color-amber)]/20';
      case 'snake':
        return 'border-[var(--color-rose)] shadow-[var(--color-rose)]/20';
      default:
        return 'border-[var(--color-indigo)] shadow-[var(--color-indigo)]/20';
    }
  };

  const getIcon = () => {
    switch (notification.type) {
      case 'bonus': return <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-emerald)]" />;
      case 'penalty': return <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-rose)]" />;
      case 'recovery': return <RotateCcw className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-cyan)] animate-spin" />;
      case 'level_up': return <Crown className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-violet)]" />;
      case 'achievement': return <Trophy className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-amber)]" />;
      case 'ladder': return <Zap className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-amber)]" />;
      case 'snake': return <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-rose)]" />;
      default: return <Zap className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-indigo)]" />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed top-18 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 animate-bounce transition-all duration-300 pointer-events-auto">
      <div className={`px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border-2 shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-3 backdrop-blur-md text-[var(--text-primary)] transition-colors duration-200 ${getStyle()}`}>
        <div className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          {getIcon()}
        </div>

        <div>
          <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-black tracking-wide leading-tight uppercase flex items-center gap-2">
            <span>{notification.title}</span>
            {notification.tilesDelta !== undefined && (
              <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] font-mono text-xs text-[var(--color-indigo)] font-bold">
                {notification.tilesDelta > 0 ? `+${notification.tilesDelta}` : notification.tilesDelta} TILES
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] leading-tight mt-0.5">
            {notification.subtitle}
          </div>
        </div>

        <button 
          onClick={onDismiss}
          className="ml-2 p-1 text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer"
        >
          <X className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


================================================================================
SECTION: 5. Challenge Interfaces
Description: Interactive multiple-choice and code challenge modal evaluated on landing
================================================================================
============================================================
FILE: src/components/Challenges/ChallengeModal.tsx
============================================================

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  X, 
  CheckCircle, 
  AlertOctagon, 
  Lightbulb, 
  Zap, 
  Bug, 
  Layers, 
  ArrowRight,
  TrendingUp,
  RotateCcw,
  Shield,
  Search,
  Sparkles,
  HelpCircle,
  AlertTriangle
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Challenge, ChallengeAttemptResult } from '../../types/challenge';
import { calculateCorrectMovement, calculateIncorrectPenalty } from '../../engine/economyEngine';
import { EnergyAbility } from '../../types/evolution';

interface ChallengeModalProps {
  challenge: Challenge;
  isOpen: boolean;
  consecutiveIncorrect: number;
  energy?: number;
  activeShield?: boolean;
  activeSecondChance?: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSubmit: (result: ChallengeAttemptResult, isFirstAttempt: boolean, isRecovery: boolean) => void;
  onUseAbility?: (abilityId: EnergyAbility['id']) => void;
}

export const ChallengeModal: React.FC<ChallengeModalProps> = ({
  challenge,
  isOpen,
  consecutiveIncorrect,
  energy = 0,
  activeShield = false,
  activeSecondChance = false,
  onClose,
  onSubmit,
  onUseAbility
}) => {
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [unlockedHintTier, setUnlockedHintTier] = useState<number>(0);
  const [hasSubmitted, setHasSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [isCorrect, setIsCorrect] = useState(false);
  const [attemptCount, setAttemptCount] = useState(1);
  const [hadPreviousFailure, setHadPreviousFailure] = useState(false);
  const [eliminatedOptions, setEliminatedOptions] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [secondChanceUsed, setSecondChanceUsed] = useState(false);
  const [showForfeitConfirm, setShowForfeitConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [confidenceLevel, setConfidenceLevel] = useState<'low' | 'medium' | 'high'>('medium');
  const [reasoningChoice, setReasoningChoice] = useState<number | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const isOptimization = challenge.type === 'optimize_algorithm' && !!challenge.optimizationComparison;
  const isSnakeDebugging = challenge.skillCategory === 'debugging' || !!challenge.bugInfo;

  const prospectiveReward = calculateCorrectMovement(
    challenge.difficulty,
    attemptCount === 1 && !hadPreviousFailure,
    hadPreviousFailure
  );

  const prospectivePenalty = calculateIncorrectPenalty(consecutiveIncorrect + 1);

  // Debug Scan: Eliminates 1 incorrect option
  const handleDebugScan = () => {
    if (energy < 20 || eliminatedOptions.length > 0) return;
    if (onUseAbility) {
      onUseAbility('debug_scan');
    }
    const correctIdx = challenge.correctOptionIndex ?? 0;
    const incorrectIndices = (challenge.options || [])
      .map((_, i) => i)
      .filter(i => i !== correctIdx && !eliminatedOptions.includes(i));
    
    if (incorrectIndices.length > 0) {
      const toEliminate = incorrectIndices[Math.floor(Math.random() * incorrectIndices.length)];
      setEliminatedOptions(prev => [...prev, toEliminate]);
    }
  };

  // Progressive Hint Unlock
  const handleUnlockHint = (targetTier: number) => {
    if (targetTier > unlockedHintTier) {
      if (targetTier >= 2 && onUseAbility) {
        onUseAbility('hint');
      }
      setUnlockedHintTier(targetTier);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (selectedOption === null) return;

    const correct = selectedOption === (challenge.correctOptionIndex ?? 0);
    
    // Check if Second Chance ability is active and player failed
    if (!correct && (activeSecondChance || secondChanceUsed === false && activeSecondChance)) {
      setSecondChanceUsed(true);
      if (onUseAbility) {
        onUseAbility('second_chance');
      }
      setSelectedOption(null);
      return;
    }

    setIsCorrect(correct);
    setHasSubmitted(true);

    if (!correct) {
      setHadPreviousFailure(true);
    }
  };

  const handleFinish = (forceFail: boolean = false) => {
    const finalCorrect = forceFail ? false : isCorrect;
    const isFirst = attemptCount === 1 && !hadPreviousFailure && !forceFail;
    const isRecovery = hadPreviousFailure && finalCorrect;

    onSubmit({
      challengeId: challenge.id,
      squareId: challenge.squareId,
      isCorrect: finalCorrect,
      selectedOptionIndex: selectedOption ?? undefined,
      scoreAwarded: finalCorrect 
        ? (challenge.difficulty === 'hard' || challenge.difficulty === 'expert' ? 60 : challenge.difficulty === 'medium' ? 35 : 20) 
        : 3,
      timeSpentSeconds: 15,
      hintUsed: unlockedHintTier > 0,
      skillCategory: challenge.skillCategory,
      topic: challenge.topic,
      feedback: finalCorrect ? 'Concept verified successfully' : challenge.explanation
    }, isFirst, isRecovery);

    // Reset local state
    setSelectedOption(null);
    setUnlockedHintTier(0);
    setHasSubmitted(false);
    setAttemptCount(1);
    setHadPreviousFailure(false);
    setEliminatedOptions([]);
    setSecondChanceUsed(false);
    setShowForfeitConfirm(false);
  };

  const handleRetry = () => {
    // Player failed attempt and wants to try again for recovery bonus
    const isFirst = attemptCount === 1 && !hadPreviousFailure;
    
    // Execute penalty for this incorrect attempt
    onSubmit({
      challengeId: challenge.id,
      squareId: challenge.squareId,
      isCorrect: false,
      selectedOptionIndex: selectedOption ?? undefined,
      scoreAwarded: 3,
      timeSpentSeconds: 15,
      hintUsed: unlockedHintTier > 0,
      skillCategory: challenge.skillCategory,
      topic: challenge.topic,
      feedback: challenge.explanation
    }, isFirst, false);

    // Allow retry on this challenge
    setAttemptCount(prev => prev + 1);
    setHasSubmitted(false);
    setSelectedOption(null);
  };

  // Safe Close Handler: Prevents bypassing penalties!
  const handleModalClose = () => {
    if (hasSubmitted) {
      // If submitted and wrong, close must execute consequence
      handleFinish(false);
    } else {
      // Unsubmitted attempt: confirm forfeit
      setShowForfeitConfirm(true);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmForfeit = () => {
    handleFinish(true); // Forfeit applies failure penalty
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div 
        className="relative w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden text-[var(--text-primary)] transition-colors duration-200"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="challenge-modal-title"
      >
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            {isOptimization ? (
              <span className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-amber-light)] text-[var(--color-amber)] border border-[var(--color-amber-border)]">
                <Zap className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>
            ) : isSnakeDebugging ? (
              <span className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] text-[var(--color-rose)] border border-[var(--color-rose-border)]">
                <Bug className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] text-[var(--color-indigo)] border border-[var(--color-indigo-border)]">
                <Layers className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>
            )}
            <div>
              <span className="text-[11px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider text-[var(--text-secondary)] flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>Tile {challenge.squareId} &bull; {challenge.topic}</span>
                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--color-cyan)] font-mono text-[10px]">
                  {challenge.difficulty.toUpperCase()}
                </span>
                {activeShield && (
                  <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] text-[var(--color-indigo)] border border-[var(--color-indigo-border)] font-bold text-[10px] flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Shield className="w-3 h-3" /> Shield Active
                  </span>
                )}
              </span>
              <h2 id="challenge-modal-title" className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-tight">
                {challenge.title}
              </h2>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={handleModalClose}
            aria-label="Close Challenge"
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Dynamic Movement Stakes Banner */}
        <div className="px-5 py-2 bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] flex-wrap gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[var(--color-emerald)] font-semibold">
            <TrendingUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Success: {prospectiveReward.badgeText}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[var(--color-rose)] font-semibold">
            <AlertOctagon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>
              Mistake: {activeShield ? '🛡️ Absorbed by Invariant Shield (0 penalty)' : prospectivePenalty.badgeText}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Forfeit Confirmation Banner */}
        {showForfeitConfirm && (
          <div className="px-5 py-3 bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] border-b border-[var(--color-rose-border)] flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs text-[var(--text-primary)] animate-fadeIn">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-rose)] flex-shrink-0" />
              <span>Conceding will apply the standard mistake penalty ({prospectivePenalty.badgeText}). Are you sure?</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowForfeitConfirm(false)}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer"
              >
                Keep Trying
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleConfirmForfeit}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-[var(--color-rose)] hover:opacity-90 text-white text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer"
              >
                Concede & Slide Back
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Second Chance Notification */}
        {secondChanceUsed && (
          <div className="px-5 py-2 bg-[var(--color-amber-light)] border-b border-[var(--color-amber-border)] text-xs text-[var(--text-primary)] flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-amber)]" />
            <span><strong>SECOND CHANCE TRIGGERED:</strong> Incorrect penalty waived! Select another answer.</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-5 overflow-y-auto flex-1 flex flex-col gap-4 text-xs sm:text-sm">
          {/* Prompt statement */}
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] font-medium leading-relaxed shadow-sm">
            {challenge.prompt}
          </div>

          {/* Code Snippet */}
          {!isOptimization && challenge.codeSnippet && (
            <div className="rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] shadow-sm">
              <div className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[11px] font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)] flex items-center justify-between">
                <span>Code Example</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--color-indigo)]">TypeScript / Python</span>
              </div>
              <pre className="p-3.5 font-mono text-xs text-[var(--color-indigo)] overflow-x-auto leading-relaxed">
                <code>{challenge.codeSnippet}</code>
              </pre>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Dry Run Tracing Steps */}
          {challenge.traceSteps && (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] shadow-sm">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                Execution Dry-Run
              </span>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                {challenge.traceSteps.map((s, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="text-xs text-[var(--text-primary)] flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] text-[var(--color-indigo)] border border-[var(--color-indigo-border)] font-mono rounded text-[10px]">
                      Step {s.step}
                    </span>
                    <span>{s.explanation}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Options List */}
          {challenge.options && (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 mt-1">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                  Select the Optimal Answer:
                </span>
                {!hasSubmitted && eliminatedOptions.length === 0 && energy >= 20 && (
                  <button
                    onClick={handleDebugScan}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--color-cyan)] hover:opacity-80 bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--color-cyan-border)] px-2 py-0.5 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Search className="w-3 h-3" />
                    <span>Debug Scan: Eliminate 1 Choice (20⚡)</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
              {challenge.options.map((opt, idx) => {
                const isSelected = selectedOption === idx;
                const isEliminated = eliminatedOptions.includes(idx);
                let optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:border-[var(--color-indigo)]/70 shadow-sm';

                if (isEliminated) {
                  optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-muted)] line-through opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed';
                } else if (hasSubmitted) {
                  if (idx === challenge.correctOptionIndex) {
                    optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] border-2 border-[var(--color-emerald)] text-[var(--color-emerald)] font-semibold shadow-sm';
                  } else if (isSelected && !isCorrect) {
                    optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] border-2 border-[var(--color-rose)] text-[var(--color-rose)] shadow-sm';
                  }
                } else if (isSelected) {
                  optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] border-2 border-[var(--color-indigo)] text-[var(--text-primary)] shadow-sm';
                }

                return (
                  <button
                    key={idx}
                    disabled={hasSubmitted || isEliminated}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedOption(idx)}
                    className={`w-full p-3 rounded-xl border text-left flex items-start gap-3 transition cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-default ${optionStyle}`}
                  >
                    <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full border border-current flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                      {String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm leading-snug flex-1">{opt}</span>
                    {isEliminated && (
                      <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-[var(--color-rose)] bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-[var(--color-rose-border)]">
                        Eliminated
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Metacognitive Calibration: Confidence Rating */}
          {!hasSubmitted && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#080D1A] border border-[#263449] flex flex-col gap-1.5 mt-1">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="font-bold text-[#F8FAFC] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#22D3EE]" />
                  Metacognitive Calibration: How confident are you?
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-[#94A3B8] font-mono">Confidence vs Accuracy</span>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                {[
                  { level: 'low', label: 'Unsure (30%)', desc: 'Educated guess' },
                  { level: 'medium', label: 'Moderate (70%)', desc: 'Fairly confident' },
                  { level: 'high', label: 'Certain (95%)', desc: 'Proof verified' }
                ].map(c => (
                  <button
                    key={c.level}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setConfidenceLevel(c.level as any)}
                    className={`p-2 rounded-lg border text-center transition cursor-pointer ${
                      confidenceLevel === c.level
                        ? c.level === 'low'
                          ? 'bg-[#22D3EE]/20 border-[#22D3EE] text-[#22D3EE] font-bold shadow-sm'
                          : c.level === 'medium'
                          ? 'bg-[#F59E0B]/20 border-[#F59E0B] text-[#F59E0B] font-bold shadow-sm'
                          : 'bg-[#10B981]/20 border-[#10B981] text-[#10B981] font-bold shadow-sm'
                        : 'bg-[#172033] border-[#263449] text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-[#F8FAFC]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="text-xs">{c.label}</div>
                    <div className="text-[9.5px] opacity-75">{c.desc}</div>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Explain-Your-Answer Reasoning Justification for Hard/Expert/Optimization Challenges */}
          {!hasSubmitted && (challenge.difficulty === 'hard' || challenge.difficulty === 'expert' || isOptimization) && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col gap-2 mt-1">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[var(--color-amber)] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-amber)]" />
                Explain Your Answer: Why does this strategy scale?
              </span>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                {[
                  'It maintains strict inductive invariants while bounding auxiliary memory allocation',
                  'It executes parallel hardware instructions to bypass CPU clock limits',
                  'It relies on compiler garbage collection to handle unbounded recursion'
                ].map((reason, rIdx) => (
                  <button
                    key={rIdx}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setReasoningChoice(rIdx)}
                    className={`p-2 rounded-lg border text-left text-xs transition cursor-pointer ${
                      reasoningChoice === rIdx
                        ? 'bg-[var(--color-amber-light)] border-[var(--color-amber)] text-[var(--text-primary)] font-semibold'
                        : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {reason}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Progressive 3-Tier Hint Section */}
          {challenge.hints && challenge.hints.length > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-1 flex flex-col gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)] flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Lightbulb className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-amber)]" />
                  Progressive Hints:
                </span>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  {[1, 2, 3].map(tier => {
                    const isUnlocked = unlockedHintTier >= tier;
                    const canAfford = tier === 1 || energy >= (tier === 2 ? 10 : 15);
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={tier}
                        onClick={() => handleUnlockHint(tier)}
                        disabled={isUnlocked}
                        className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-semibold border transition cursor-pointer ${
                          isUnlocked 
                            ? 'bg-[var(--color-amber-light)] border-[var(--color-amber-border)] text-[var(--color-amber)]' 
                            : canAfford
                              ? 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--color-amber)]'
                              : 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-muted)] opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed'
                        }`}
                      >
                        Hint {tier} {tier === 1 ? '(Free)' : tier === 2 ? '(10⚡)' : '(15⚡)'}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              {unlockedHintTier > 0 && (
                <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-amber-light)] border border-[var(--color-amber-border)] text-[var(--text-primary)] text-xs flex flex-col gap-1.5 animate-fadeIn">
                  {challenge.hints.slice(0, unlockedHintTier).map((h, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-[var(--card-bg)] text-[var(--color-amber)] font-mono text-[10px]">
                        Tier {i + 1}
                      </span>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-relaxed">{h}</p>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Post-submission Deep Explanation with Objective & Trap */}
          {hasSubmitted && (
            <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border flex flex-col gap-3 animate-fadeIn ${
              isCorrect ? 'bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] border-[var(--color-emerald-border)] text-[var(--text-primary)]' : 'bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] border-[var(--color-rose-border)] text-[var(--text-primary)]'
            }`}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold text-sm">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {isCorrect ? (
                    <>
                      <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-emerald)]" />
                      <span className="text-[var(--color-emerald)]">{prospectiveReward.explanation}</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <AlertOctagon className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-rose)]" />
                      <span className="text-[var(--color-rose)]">
                        {activeShield 
                          ? 'Shield absorbed the penalty! 0 backward movement.' 
                          : prospectivePenalty.explanation}
                      </span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] leading-relaxed">
                {challenge.explanation}
              </p>

              {/* Metacognitive Diagnostic Insight */}
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs shadow-sm">
                <span className="text-lg">
                  {isCorrect && confidenceLevel === 'high' ? '🎯' :
                   !isCorrect && confidenceLevel === 'high' ? '⚠️' :
                   isCorrect && confidenceLevel === 'low' ? '💡' : '📚'}
                </span>
                <div>
                  <div className="font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                    {isCorrect && confidenceLevel === 'high' ? 'Calibrated Technical Mastery! 🎯' :
                     !isCorrect && confidenceLevel === 'high' ? 'Overconfidence Blindspot Detected! ⚠️' :
                     isCorrect && confidenceLevel === 'low' ? 'Algorithmic Intuition Verified! 💡' : 'Constructive Gap Identified 📚'}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] mt-0.5 leading-snug">
                    {isCorrect && confidenceLevel === 'high'
                      ? 'You were highly confident and your algorithmic reasoning was spot-on. True technical mastery demonstrated!'
                      : !isCorrect && confidenceLevel === 'high'
                      ? 'You felt 95% certain, but tripped on a subtle edge case or invariant. Review the pitfall analysis below to eliminate this blindspot.'
                      : isCorrect && confidenceLevel === 'low'
                      ? 'You doubted your knowledge, but your conceptual intuition was correct! Trust your algorithmic pattern recognition.'
                      : 'You accurately anticipated uncertainty. Systematic review of this concept will solidify the missing invariant.'}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Learning Objective & Trap */}
              {(challenge.learningObjective || challenge.commonMistake) && (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[11px]">
                  {challenge.learningObjective && (
                    <div className="p-2 rounded bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex items-start gap-1.5">
                      <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-cyan)] flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      <div>
                        <span className="font-bold text-[var(--color-cyan)]">Core Takeaway: </span>
                        <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">{challenge.learningObjective}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {challenge.commonMistake && (
                    <div className="p-2 rounded bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex items-start gap-1.5">
                      <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-amber)] flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      <div>
                        <span className="font-bold text-[var(--color-amber)]">Common Pitfall: </span>
                        <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">{challenge.commonMistake}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer Controls */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3.5 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-medium">
            Category: <span className="text-[var(--text-primary)] capitalize">{challenge.skillCategory}</span> &bull; 
            Difficulty: <span className="text-[var(--text-primary)] capitalize">{challenge.difficulty}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            {!hasSubmitted ? (
              <>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowForfeitConfirm(true)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--color-rose)] cursor-pointer transition"
                >
                  Concede (-penalty)
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={handleSubmit}
                  disabled={selectedOption === null}
                  className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-indigo)] hover:bg-[var(--color-indigo-hover)] disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-wide shadow-md transition cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed active:scale-95"
                >
                  Submit Answer
                </button>
              </>
            ) : !isCorrect ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleFinish(false)}
                  className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] font-semibold text-xs transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Accept Penalty & Continue
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={handleRetry}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-indigo)] hover:bg-[var(--color-indigo-hover)] text-white font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-wide shadow-md transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Retry for Comeback (+1 Recovery Tile)</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <button
                onClick={() => handleFinish(false)}
                className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-emerald)] hover:bg-[var(--color-emerald-hover)] text-white font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-wide shadow-md transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
              >
                <span>Continue Forward</span>
                <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Search, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

interface BinarySearchPathModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAwardReward?: (xp: number, coins: number) => void;
}

const SORTED_ARRAY = [2, 5, 8, 12, 16, 23, 38, 56, 72, 91];
const TARGET = 23;

export const BinarySearchPathModal: React.FC<BinarySearchPathModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onAwardReward
}) => {
  const [low, setLow] = useState<number>(0);
  const [high, setHigh] = useState<number>(SORTED_ARRAY.length - 1);
  const [stepCount, setStepCount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<string>('Select the correct MID index for the current [low..high] range.');
  const [isFound, setIsFound] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [hasClaimed, setHasClaimed] = useState<boolean>(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const expectedMid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);

  const handleSelectMid = (idx: number) => {
    if (isFound) return;

    if (idx !== expectedMid) {
      setFeedback(`Incorrect mid index! Formula is floor((${low} + ${high}) / 2) = ${expectedMid}.`);
      return;
    }

    const val = SORTED_ARRAY[idx];
    setStepCount(prev => prev + 1);

    if (val === TARGET) {
      setIsFound(true);
      setFeedback(`🎯 Target ${TARGET} FOUND at index ${idx} in ${stepCount + 1} comparisons!`);
      if (!hasClaimed) {
        setHasClaimed(true);
        onAwardReward?.(40, 20);
      }
    } else if (val < TARGET) {
      setFeedback(`Value ${val} < ${TARGET}. Target is in the right half. Low moves to mid + 1 (${idx + 1}).`);
      setLow(idx + 1);
    } else {
      setFeedback(`Value ${val} > ${TARGET}. Target is in the left half. High moves to mid - 1 (${idx - 1}).`);
      setHigh(idx - 1);
    }
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setLow(0);
    setHigh(SORTED_ARRAY.length - 1);
    setStepCount(0);
    setIsFound(false);
    setFeedback('Select the correct MID index for the current [low..high] range.');
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-xl bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 text-[var(--text-primary)]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#06B6D4]/20 border border-[#06B6D4]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#06B6D4]">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase text-[#06B6D4]">CO3 Mini-Game</span>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black">Binary Search Path Challenge</h3>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Target and Range Info */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-center text-xs font-mono">
          <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] block">TARGET</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-sm text-[#06B6D4]">{TARGET}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] block">LOW</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-sm text-[#10B981]">{low}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] block">HIGH</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-sm text-[#F43F5E]">{high}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] block">STEPS</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-sm">{stepCount}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Array Items Clickable Grid */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            Click the box that corresponds to `mid = floor((${low} + ${high}) / 2)`:
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-5 sm:grid-cols-10 gap-1.5 w-full">
            {SORTED_ARRAY.map((val, idx) => {
              const inRange = idx >= low && idx <= high;
              const isLow = idx === low;
              const isHigh = idx === high;
              const isTargetMatch = isFound && val === TARGET;

              return (
                <button
                  key={idx}
                  disabled={!inRange || isFound}
                  onClick={() => handleSelectMid(idx)}
                  className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-xl border text-xs font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-default ${
                    isTargetMatch
                      ? 'bg-[#10B981] text-white shadow-lg border-[#10B981] scale-105'
                      : inRange
                      ? 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[#06B6D4] text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:border-[#10B981] hover:scale-105'
                      : 'border-dashed border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] opacity-25'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">[{idx}]</span>
                  <span className="font-black text-sm my-0.5">{val}</span>
                  <span className="text-[8px] font-bold">
                    {isLow && 'LOW'}
                    {isHigh && !isLow && 'HIGH'}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Feedback banner */}
        <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs font-mono ${
          isFound
            ? 'bg-[#10B981]/15 border-[#10B981]/40 text-[#10B981]'
            : 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]'
        }`}>
          {feedback}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <button
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Reset</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}

          >
            Done
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Network, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

interface BSTBuilderModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAwardReward?: (xp: number, coins: number) => void;
}

interface PlacementStep {
  val: number;
  question: string;
  options: { label: string; isCorrect: boolean }[];
  explanation: string;
}

const STEPS: PlacementStep[] = [
  {
    val: 30,
    question: 'Where should incoming value [30] be placed relative to root [50]?',
    options: [
      { label: 'Left child of 50 (since 30 < 50)', isCorrect: true },
      { label: 'Right child of 50 (since 30 > 50)', isCorrect: false }
    ],
    explanation: 'In a BST, keys smaller than the parent go to the left subtree: 30 < 50, so it becomes the left child of 50.'
  },
  {
    val: 70,
    question: 'Where should incoming value [70] be placed relative to root [50]?',
    options: [
      { label: 'Right child of 50 (since 70 > 50)', isCorrect: true },
      { label: 'Left child of 30', isCorrect: false }
    ],
    explanation: '70 is greater than root 50, so it becomes the right child of 50.'
  },
  {
    val: 20,
    question: 'Where should incoming value [20] be placed?',
    options: [
      { label: 'Left child of 30 (since 20 < 50 and 20 < 30)', isCorrect: true },
      { label: 'Right child of 30', isCorrect: false },
      { label: 'Left child of 70', isCorrect: false }
    ],
    explanation: 'Comparing with root: 20 < 50 (go left to 30). Comparing with 30: 20 < 30 (go left). It becomes the left child of 30.'
  },
  {
    val: 40,
    question: 'Where should incoming value [40] be placed?',
    options: [
      { label: 'Right child of 30 (since 40 < 50 and 40 > 30)', isCorrect: true },
      { label: 'Left child of 20', isCorrect: false },
      { label: 'Right child of 70', isCorrect: false }
    ],
    explanation: 'Comparing with root: 40 < 50 (go left to 30). Comparing with 30: 40 > 30 (go right). It becomes the right child of 30.'
  }
];

export const BSTBuilderModal: React.FC<BSTBuilderModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onAwardReward
}) => {
  const [currentStepIdx, setCurrentStepIdx] = useState<number>(0);
  const [placedValues, setPlacedValues] = useState<number[]>([50]);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<string>('Root node [50] is established. Place the remaining numbers into the BST.');
  const [hasCompleted, setHasCompleted] = useState<boolean>(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const currentStep = STEPS[currentStepIdx];

  const handleSelectOption = (isCorrect: boolean) => {
    if (isCorrect) {
      const newPlaced = [...placedValues, currentStep.val];
      setPlacedValues(newPlaced);
      setFeedback(`Correct! ${currentStep.explanation}`);

      if (currentStepIdx + 1 < STEPS.length) {
        setCurrentStepIdx(prev => prev + 1);
      } else {
        setHasCompleted(true);
        onAwardReward?.(50, 20);
      }
    } else {
      setFeedback('Incorrect choice! Remember the BST Invariant: Left Subtree < Parent < Right Subtree.');
    }
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setCurrentStepIdx(0);
    setPlacedValues([50]);
    setFeedback('Reset. Root node [50] is established.');
    setHasCompleted(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-xl bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 text-[var(--text-primary)]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#14B8A6]/20 border border-[#14B8A6]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#14B8A6]">
              <Network className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase text-[#14B8A6]">CO4 Mini-Game</span>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black">Interactive BST Builder</h3>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tree ASCII Visualizer */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col items-center">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-2">Current BST Structure:</span>
          <pre className="font-mono text-xs text-[#06B6D4] leading-tight text-center">
            {placedValues.includes(50) && `          [50]\n`}
            {(placedValues.includes(30) || placedValues.includes(70)) && `         /    \\\n`}
            {placedValues.includes(30) && placedValues.includes(70) && `      [30]    [70]\n`}
            {placedValues.includes(30) && !placedValues.includes(70) && `      [30]      ?\n`}
            {(placedValues.includes(20) || placedValues.includes(40)) && `      /  \\\n`}
            {placedValues.includes(20) && placedValues.includes(40) && `   [20]  [40]\n`}
            {placedValues.includes(20) && !placedValues.includes(40) && `   [20]    ?\n`}
          </pre>
        </div>

        {/* Question Prompt */}
        {!hasCompleted ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
              Step {currentStepIdx + 1} of {STEPS.length}: Placing Value [{currentStep.val}]
            </span>
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
              {currentStep.question}
            </p>

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 mt-1">
              {currentStep.options.map((opt, idx) => (
                <button
                  key={idx}
                  onClick={() => handleSelectOption(opt.isCorrect)}
                  className="p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:border-[#14B8A6] text-left text-xs font-mono font-medium transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {opt.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#10B981]/15 border border-[#10B981]/40 text-[#10B981] text-xs font-mono flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0" />
            <span>Flawless! You successfully constructed the BST with all 5 nodes obeying left &lt; parent &lt; right! +50 XP, +20 Coins.</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Feedback message */}
        <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          {feedback}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <button
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Reset Tree</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="py-2 px-4 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer"
          >
            Done
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

FILE: src/components/DSAMechanics/CircularQueueModal.tsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, RefreshCw, PlusCircle, MinusCircle, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { CircularQueue } from '../../algorithms/circularQueue';

interface CircularQueueModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAwardReward?: (xp: number, coins: number) => void;
}

export const CircularQueueModal: React.FC<CircularQueueModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onAwardReward
}) => {
  const SIZE = 5;
  const [cq] = useState<CircularQueue<number>>(() => new CircularQueue<number>(SIZE));
  const [buffer, setBuffer] = useState<(number | null)[]>(cq.getBuffer());
  const [frontIndex, setFrontIndex] = useState<number>(cq.getFrontIndex());
  const [rearIndex, setRearIndex] = useState<number>(cq.getRearIndex());
  const [nextValue, setNextValue] = useState<number>(10);
  const [statusMsg, setStatusMsg] = useState<string>('Circular queue ready (SIZE = 5). Enqueue and dequeue to observe wrap-around.');
  const [hasWrapped, setHasWrapped] = useState<boolean>(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleEnqueue = () => {
    if (cq.isFull()) {
      setStatusMsg(`Circular Queue is FULL! Condition (rear + 1) % ${SIZE} == FRONT (${(rearIndex + 1) % SIZE} == ${frontIndex}).`);
      return;
    }

    const prevRear = rearIndex;
    cq.enqueue(nextValue);
    setBuffer(cq.getBuffer());
    const newFront = cq.getFrontIndex();
    const newRear = cq.getRearIndex();
    setFrontIndex(newFront);
    setRearIndex(newRear);

    let msg = `Enqueued ${nextValue} at index ${newRear}.`;
    if (prevRear === SIZE - 1 && newRear === 0) {
      msg = `🔄 WRAP-AROUND! REAR moved from index ${prevRear} to 0 using (${prevRear} + 1) % ${SIZE} = 0!`;
      if (!hasWrapped) {
        setHasWrapped(true);
        onAwardReward?.(45, 20);
      }
    }
    setStatusMsg(msg);
    setNextValue(prev => prev + 5);
  };

  const handleDequeue = () => {
    if (cq.isEmpty()) {
      setStatusMsg('Circular Queue Underflow! Cannot dequeue from an empty queue.');
      return;
    }

    const prevFront = frontIndex;
    const removed = cq.dequeue();
    setBuffer(cq.getBuffer());
    const newFront = cq.getFrontIndex();
    const newRear = cq.getRearIndex();
    setFrontIndex(newFront);
    setRearIndex(newRear);

    let msg = `Dequeued ${removed} from index ${prevFront}.`;
    if (prevFront === SIZE - 1 && newFront === 0) {
      msg = `🔄 FRONT WRAP-AROUND! FRONT moved from ${prevFront} to 0 via (${prevFront} + 1) % ${SIZE} = 0.`;
    }
    setStatusMsg(msg);
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    cq.clear();
    setBuffer(cq.getBuffer());
    setFrontIndex(-1);
    setRearIndex(-1);
    setNextValue(10);
    setStatusMsg('Circular Queue reset.');
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 text-[var(--text-primary)]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#06B6D4]/20 border border-[#06B6D4]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#06B6D4]">
              <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase text-[#06B6D4]">CO2 Mini-Game</span>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black">Circular Queue Lab (Wrap-Around)</h3>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* State Banner */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-center text-xs font-mono">
          <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] block">SIZE</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-sm">{SIZE}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[#06B6D4] block">FRONT</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-sm text-[#06B6D4]">{frontIndex}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[#10B981] block">REAR</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-sm text-[#10B981]">{rearIndex}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] block">COUNT</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-sm">{cq.size()}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Circular Buffer Slot Array */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            Array Buffer Indices [0 .. {SIZE - 1}]
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-2 w-full">
            {buffer.map((val, idx) => {
              const isFront = idx === frontIndex;
              const isRear = idx === rearIndex;
              return (
                <div
                  key={idx}
                  className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-xl border transition-all ${
                    val !== null
                      ? 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[#06B6D4]'
                      : 'border-dashed border-[var(--border-subtle)] opacity-40'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)]">[{idx}]</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-black my-1">{val ?? '-'}</span>
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 text-[9px] font-mono font-bold">
                    {isFront && <span className="bg-[#06B6D4] text-white px-1 rounded">FRONT</span>}
                    {isRear && <span className="bg-[#10B981] text-white px-1 rounded">REAR</span>}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Status display */}
        <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          {statusMsg}
        </div>

        {/* Buttons */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={handleEnqueue}
            disabled={cq.isFull()}
            className="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-[#06B6D4] hover:bg-[#0891B2] disabled:opacity-40 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <PlusCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>ENQUEUE ({nextValue})</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={handleDequeue}
            disabled={cq.isEmpty()}
            className="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-[#F43F5E] hover:bg-[#E11D48] disabled:opacity-40 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <MinusCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>DEQUEUE</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs">
          <button
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Reset</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer"
          >
            Close Lab
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
