import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Compass, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, ArrowRight, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { Graph } from '../../algorithms/graphs';

interface GraphRouteModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAwardReward?: (xp: number, coins: number) => void;
}

type GraphTask = 'bfs' | 'dfs' | 'dijkstra' | 'mst';

export const GraphRouteModal: React.FC<GraphRouteModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onAwardReward
}) => {
  const [activeTask, setActiveTask] = useState<GraphTask>('dijkstra');
  const [selectedAnswer, setSelectedAnswer] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isEvaluated, setIsEvaluated] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [hasClaimed, setHasClaimed] = useState<boolean>(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const TASKS: Record<GraphTask, {
    question: string;
    options: string[];
    correct: string;
    explanation: string;
  }> = {
    bfs: {
      question: 'What is the BFS traversal order starting from vertex A? (Neighbors visited alphabetically)',
      options: ['A, B, C, D', 'A, B, D, C', 'A, C, B, D', 'D, C, B, A'],
      correct: 'A, B, C, D',
      explanation: 'From A, visit immediate neighbors B and C. Then from B, visit unvisited neighbor D. BFS order: A, B, C, D.'
    },
    dfs: {
      question: 'What is the DFS traversal order starting from vertex A? (Neighbors visited alphabetically)',
      options: ['A, B, C, D', 'A, B, D, C', 'A, C, D, B', 'B, A, C, D'],
      correct: 'A, B, C, D',
      explanation: 'From A -> go to first neighbor B -> from B go to first neighbor C -> from C go to D. Order: A, B, C, D.'
    },
    dijkstra: {
      question: 'Using Dijkstra\'s algorithm, what is the cost of the shortest path from A to D?',
      options: ['4 (Path: A -> B -> C -> D)', '6 (Path: A -> B -> D)', '5 (Path: A -> C -> D)', '7'],
      correct: '4 (Path: A -> B -> C -> D)',
      explanation: 'Edge weights: A->B is 1; B->C is 2 (total 3); C->D is 1 (total 4). Direct path A->B->D is 1 + 5 = 6. Path A->C->D is 4 + 1 = 5. Shortest path is 4.'
    },
    mst: {
      question: 'Using Prim or Kruskal, what is the total weight of the Minimum Spanning Tree (MST)?',
      options: ['4 (Edges: A-B=1, C-D=1, B-C=2)', '5', '6', '7'],
      correct: '4 (Edges: A-B=1, C-D=1, B-C=2)',
      explanation: 'Cheapest edges: A-B (1), C-D (1), B-C (2). These 3 edges connect all 4 vertices without cycles. Total MST weight = 1 + 1 + 2 = 4.'
    }
  };

  const current = TASKS[activeTask];
  const isCorrect = selectedAnswer === current.correct;

  const handleVerify = () => {
    setIsEvaluated(true);
    if (isCorrect && !hasClaimed) {
      setHasClaimed(true);
      onAwardReward?.(50, 25);
    }
  };

  const handleTaskChange = (task: GraphTask) => {
    setActiveTask(task);
    setSelectedAnswer(null);
    setIsEvaluated(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-xl bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 text-[var(--text-primary)]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#6366F1]/20 border border-[#6366F1]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#6366F1]">
              <Compass className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase text-[#6366F1]">CO4 Mini-Game</span>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black">Graph Route Challenge</h3>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Algorithm Tabs */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
          {(['dijkstra', 'mst', 'bfs', 'dfs'] as GraphTask[]).map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t}
              onClick={() => handleTaskChange(t)}
              className={`py-1.5 px-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold uppercase font-mono transition cursor-pointer ${
                activeTask === t
                  ? 'bg-[#6366F1] text-white shadow-sm'
                  : 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
              }`}
            >
              {t}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Graph Visual ASCII Diagram */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col items-center">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">Graph Topology (4 Vertices, 5 Weighted Edges):</span>
          <pre className="font-mono text-xs text-[#06B6D4] leading-relaxed text-center py-1">
{`    (A) ----- 1 ----- (B)
     |                 |  \\
     4                 2    5
     |                 |      \\
    (C) ----- 1 ----- (D)      (D)`}
          </pre>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Edges: (A,B)=1, (A,C)=4, (B,C)=2, (B,D)=5, (C,D)=1</span>
        </div>

        {/* Question Prompt */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {current.question}
          </p>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mt-1">
            {current.options.map((opt, idx) => (
              <button
                key={idx}
                disabled={isEvaluated}
                onClick={() => setSelectedAnswer(opt)}
                className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-left text-xs font-mono font-bold transition cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-default ${
                  selectedAnswer === opt
                    ? isEvaluated
                      ? opt === current.correct
                        ? 'bg-[#10B981] text-white border-[#10B981]'
                        : 'bg-[#F43F5E] text-white border-[#F43F5E]'
                      : 'bg-[#6366F1]/20 border-[#6366F1] text-[#6366F1]'
                    : 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                }`}
              >
                {opt}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Evaluation */}
        {isEvaluated && (
          <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs font-mono ${
            isCorrect
              ? 'bg-[#10B981]/15 border-[#10B981]/40 text-[#10B981]'

              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <span>Incorrect! Check the edge relaxations and traversal queue/stack rules.</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <button
            onClick={() => { setSelectedAnswer(null); setIsEvaluated(false); }}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

              onClick={onClose}

            >
              Done
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Users, ArrowRight, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

interface QueueStationModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAwardReward?: (xp: number, coins: number) => void;
}

interface Command {
  op: 'ENQUEUE' | 'DEQUEUE';
  val?: number;
}

const COMMAND_SEQUENCE: Command[] = [
  { op: 'ENQUEUE', val: 10 },
  { op: 'ENQUEUE', val: 20 },
  { op: 'DEQUEUE' },
  { op: 'ENQUEUE', val: 30 },
  { op: 'DEQUEUE' },
  { op: 'ENQUEUE', val: 40 }
];

export const QueueStationModal: React.FC<QueueStationModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onAwardReward
}) => {
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState<number>(0);
  const [queueState, setQueueState] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [log, setLog] = useState<string[]>(['Queue station ready. Step through the FIFO command sequence.']);
  const [hasCompleted, setHasCompleted] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleNextStep = () => {
    if (currentStep >= COMMAND_SEQUENCE.length) return;

    const cmd = COMMAND_SEQUENCE[currentStep];
    const newQueue = [...queueState];
    let msg = '';

    if (cmd.op === 'ENQUEUE' && cmd.val !== undefined) {
      newQueue.push(cmd.val);
      msg = `Step ${currentStep + 1}: ENQUEUE ${cmd.val} -> added at REAR. Current: [${newQueue.join(', ')}]`;
    } else {
      const removed = newQueue.shift();
      msg = `Step ${currentStep + 1}: DEQUEUE -> removed ${removed} from FRONT. Current: [${newQueue.join(', ')}]`;
    }

    setQueueState(newQueue);
    setLog(prev => [msg, ...prev]);
    const next = currentStep + 1;
    setCurrentStep(next);

    if (next === COMMAND_SEQUENCE.length && !hasCompleted) {
      setHasCompleted(true);
      onAwardReward?.(40, 15);
    }
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setCurrentStep(0);
    setQueueState([]);
    setLog(['Queue station reset.']);
    setHasCompleted(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 text-[var(--text-primary)]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#F59E0B]/20 border border-[#F59E0B]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#F59E0B]">
              <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase text-[#F59E0B]">CO2 Mini-Game</span>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black">Queue Station: FIFO Simulation</h3>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Task description */}
        <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs flex flex-col gap-1">
          <span className="font-bold text-[#F59E0B]">Command Sequence:</span>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 font-mono text-[11px] mt-1">
            {COMMAND_SEQUENCE.map((c, i) => (
              <span
                key={i}
                className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border text-[10px] ${
                  i < currentStep
                    ? 'bg-[#10B981]/20 border-[#10B981]/40 text-[#10B981] line-through'
                    : i === currentStep
                    ? 'bg-[#F59E0B]/20 border-[#F59E0B] text-[#F59E0B] font-bold'
                    : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]'
                }`}
              >
                {c.op} {c.val ?? ''}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Queue Visual Conveyor Belt */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full text-[11px] font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)] px-2">
            <span className="text-[#F43F5E] font-bold">← FRONT (Deletions)</span>
            <span className="text-[#10B981] font-bold">REAR (Insertions) ←</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-h-[50px] w-full p-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)]/50 border border-dashed border-[var(--border-subtle)] overflow-x-auto justify-center">
            {queueState.length > 0 ? (
              queueState.map((val, idx) => (
                <div
                  key={idx}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#F59E0B] text-white font-mono font-black text-sm shadow-md shadow-[#F59E0B]/20 border border-white/20 flex flex-col items-center"
                >
                  <span>{val}</span>
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-normal opacity-80">
                    {idx === 0 && 'FRONT'}
                    {idx === queueState.length - 1 && idx !== 0 && 'REAR'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))
            ) : (
              <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] italic">Queue is currently empty</span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Step log */}
        <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] max-h-28 overflow-y-auto font-mono text-[11px] flex flex-col gap-1">
          {log.map((item, idx) => (
            <div key={idx} className={idx === 0 ? 'text-[var(--text-primary)] font-semibold' : 'text-[var(--text-secondary)]'}>
              {item}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <button
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Restart</span>
          </button>

          {!hasCompleted ? (
            <button
              onClick={handleNextStep}
              className="py-2 px-4 rounded-xl bg-[#F59E0B] hover:bg-[#D97706] text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-[#F59E0B]/20"
            >
              <span>Execute Step {currentStep + 1}</span>
              <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#10B981] flex items-center gap-1">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                Done! +40 XP
              </span>
              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                className="py-2 px-4 rounded-xl bg-[#10B981] text-white font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer"
              >
                Close Station
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: src/components/DSAMechanics/SortingRaceModal.tsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Play, RotateCcw, ArrowRight, CheckCircle2, Award } from 'lucide-react';
import { insertionSortWithSteps, mergeSortWithSteps, quickSortWithSteps, heapSortWithSteps, SortStep } from '../../algorithms/sorting';

interface SortingRaceModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAwardReward?: (xp: number, coins: number) => void;
}

type SortType = 'insertion' | 'merge' | 'quick' | 'heap';

const INITIAL_ARRAY = [8, 3, 6, 1, 9];

export const SortingRaceModal: React.FC<SortingRaceModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onAwardReward
}) => {
  const [selectedSort, setSelectedSort] = useState<SortType>('insertion');
  const [steps, setSteps] = useState<SortStep[]>(() => insertionSortWithSteps(INITIAL_ARRAY).steps);
  const [currentStepIdx, setCurrentStepIdx] = useState<number>(0);
  const [hasCompleted, setHasCompleted] = useState<boolean>(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSelectSort = (type: SortType) => {
    setSelectedSort(type);
    setCurrentStepIdx(0);
    setHasCompleted(false);

    let res: { sorted: number[]; steps: SortStep[] };
    if (type === 'insertion') res = insertionSortWithSteps(INITIAL_ARRAY);
    else if (type === 'merge') res = mergeSortWithSteps(INITIAL_ARRAY);
    else if (type === 'quick') res = quickSortWithSteps(INITIAL_ARRAY);
    else res = heapSortWithSteps(INITIAL_ARRAY);

    setSteps(res.steps);
  };

  const handleNextStep = () => {
    if (currentStepIdx < steps.length - 1) {
      const next = currentStepIdx + 1;
      setCurrentStepIdx(next);
      if (next === steps.length - 1 && !hasCompleted) {
        setHasCompleted(true);
        onAwardReward?.(45, 20);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setCurrentStepIdx(0);
    setHasCompleted(false);
  };

  const activeStep = steps[currentStepIdx] || steps[0];

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-xl bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 text-[var(--text-primary)]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#3B82F6]/20 border border-[#3B82F6]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#3B82F6]">
              <Play className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase text-[#3B82F6]">CO3 Mini-Game</span>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black">Sorting Race: Step-by-Step Simulation</h3>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Algorithm Select Tabs */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
          {(['insertion', 'merge', 'quick', 'heap'] as SortType[]).map((type) => (
            <button
              key={type}
              onClick={() => handleSelectSort(type)}
              className={`py-1.5 px-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold capitalize transition cursor-pointer ${
                selectedSort === type
                  ? 'bg-[#3B82F6] text-white shadow-sm'
                  : 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
              }`}
            >
              {type} Sort
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Array Bars Visualization */}
        <div className="p-5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col items-center gap-4">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            Step {currentStepIdx} of {steps.length - 1} • {activeStep.description}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-end justify-center gap-3 h-28 w-full">
            {activeStep.arrayState.map((val, idx) => {
              const heightPct = (val / 9) * 100;
              return (
                <div key={idx} className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold">{val}</span>
                  <div
                    className="w-10 rounded-t-lg bg-[#3B82F6] transition-all duration-300 shadow-md shadow-[#3B82F6]/25"
                    style={{ height: `${heightPct}%` }}
                  />
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)]">[{idx}]</span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Complexity Info */}
        <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs font-mono flex justify-between items-center text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          <span>Algorithm: <strong className="text-[var(--text-primary)] uppercase">{selectedSort} Sort</strong></span>
          <span>Time: <strong className="text-[#3B82F6]">{selectedSort === 'insertion' ? 'O(n^2) worst / O(n) best' : 'O(n log n)'}</strong></span>
        </div>

        {/* Action Controls */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <button
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Restart</span>
          </button>

          {!hasCompleted ? (
            <button
              onClick={handleNextStep}
              className="py-2 px-4 rounded-xl bg-[#3B82F6] hover:bg-[#2563EB] text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-[#3B82F6]/20"
            >
              <span>Next Simulation Step</span>
              <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#10B981] flex items-center gap-1">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                Sorted! +45 XP
              </span>
              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                className="py-2 px-4 rounded-xl bg-[#10B981] text-white font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer"
              >
                Done
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

============================================================
FILE: src/components/DSAMechanics/StackTowerModal.tsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Layers, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Eye, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
import { ArrayStack } from '../../algorithms/stack';

interface StackTowerModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAwardReward?: (xp: number, coins: number) => void;
}

export const StackTowerModal: React.FC<StackTowerModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onAwardReward
}) => {
  const CAPACITY = 5;
  const [stack] = useState<ArrayStack<number>>(() => new ArrayStack<number>(CAPACITY));
  const [stackItems, setStackItems] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState<number>(10);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string>('Use PUSH, POP, and PEEK to manipulate the stack.');
  const [targetGoal] = useState<number[]>([10, 20, 30]);
  const [isGoalMet, setIsGoalMet] = useState(false);
  const [peekedValue, setPeekedValue] = useState<number | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handlePush = () => {
    setPeekedValue(null);
    if (stack.isFull()) {
      setMessage('Stack Overflow! Cannot push into a full stack (top == MAX - 1).');
      return;
    }
    stack.push(inputValue);
    const updated = stack.toArray();
    setStackItems(updated);
    setInputValue(prev => prev + 10);
    setMessage(`Pushed ${inputValue} onto the stack. Top is now at index ${updated.length - 1}.`);

    // Check goal: [10, 20, 30]
    if (updated.length === 3 && updated[0] === 10 && updated[1] === 20 && updated[2] === 30 && !isGoalMet) {
      setIsGoalMet(true);
      setMessage('Great job! You built the target stack [10, 20, 30] in strict LIFO order! +50 XP, +20 Coins.');
      onAwardReward?.(50, 20);
    }
  };

  const handlePop = () => {
    setPeekedValue(null);
    if (stack.isEmpty()) {
      setMessage('Stack Underflow! Cannot pop from an empty stack (top == -1).');
      return;
    }
    const popped = stack.pop();
    const updated = stack.toArray();
    setStackItems(updated);
    setMessage(`Popped value ${popped} from the top of the stack.`);
  };

  const handlePeek = () => {
    if (stack.isEmpty()) {
      setMessage('Stack is empty (top == -1). Peek returns NULL.');
      setPeekedValue(null);
      return;
    }
    const val = stack.peek();
    setPeekedValue(val);
    setMessage(`PEEK (Top Element): ${val} at index ${stackItems.length - 1}. Stack state unchanged.`);
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    stack.clear();
    setStackItems([]);
    setPeekedValue(null);
    setIsGoalMet(false);
    setInputValue(10);
    setMessage('Stack cleared. Ready for new operations.');
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 text-[var(--text-primary)]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#8B5CF6]/20 border border-[#8B5CF6]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#8B5CF6]">
              <Layers className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase text-[#8B5CF6]">CO2 Mini-Game</span>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black">Stack Tower Challenge</h3>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Task banner */}
        <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs flex flex-col gap-1">
          <span className="font-bold text-[#8B5CF6] flex items-center gap-1">
            🎯 Goal: Build a stack with [10, 20, 30] from bottom to top.
          </span>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            Observe LIFO discipline. Capacity is {CAPACITY}. Notice how top moves up with PUSH and down with POP.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Visual Stack Tower */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="w-48 border-2 border-dashed border-[#8B5CF6]/50 border-t-0 rounded-b-xl p-2 flex flex-col-reverse gap-1.5 min-h-[170px] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)]/40 relative">
            {Array.from({ length: CAPACITY }).map((_, idx) => {
              const item = stackItems[idx];
              const isTop = idx === stackItems.length - 1;
              return (
                <div
                  key={idx}
                  className={`w-full h-7 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between px-3 text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-all ${
                    item !== undefined
                      ? isTop
                        ? 'bg-[#8B5CF6] text-white shadow-md shadow-[#8B5CF6]/30 border-2 border-white/40'
                        : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                      : 'border border-dashed border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] opacity-30 justify-center'
                  }`}
                >
                  {item !== undefined ? (
                    <>
                      <span>Slot [{idx}]</span>
                      <span className="text-sm font-black">{item}</span>
                      {isTop && <span className="text-[10px] bg-white text-[#8B5CF6] px-1 rounded">TOP</span>}
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <span>empty [{idx}]</span>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          <div className="w-56 h-2 bg-[#8B5CF6] rounded-full mt-1" />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)] mt-1">Stack Base (Index 0)</span>
        </div>

        {/* Status Message */}
        <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-mono leading-relaxed ${
          isGoalMet
            ? 'bg-[#10B981]/15 border-[#10B981]/40 text-[#10B981]'
            : 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]'
        }`}>
          {isGoalMet ? <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 inline mr-1" /> : <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 inline mr-1" />}
          {message}
          {peekedValue !== null && (
            <span className="font-bold text-[#8B5CF6] block mt-1">Peeked: {peekedValue}</span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Action Controls */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={handlePush}
            disabled={stackItems.length >= CAPACITY}
            className="py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-[#8B5CF6] hover:bg-[#7C3AED] disabled:opacity-40 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>PUSH ({inputValue})</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={handlePop}
            disabled={stackItems.length === 0}
            className="py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-[#F43F5E] hover:bg-[#E11D48] disabled:opacity-40 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>POP</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={handlePeek}
            disabled={stackItems.length === 0}
            className="py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#06B6D4]" />
            <span>PEEK</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
          <button
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Clear Stack</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] font-bold text-xs hover:bg-[var(--card-bg)] cursor-pointer"
          >
            Done
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Swords, Trophy, ArrowRight, Skull, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { BossBattle } from '../../types/evolution';

interface BossBattleModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  boss: BossBattle | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onVictory: (tileNumber: number, xp: number, coins: number, energy: number) => void;
}

export const BossBattleModal: React.FC<BossBattleModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  boss,
  onClose,
  onVictory,
}) => {
  const [currentStepIndex, setCurrentStepIndex] = useState(0);
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [hasSubmitted, setHasSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [isCorrect, setIsCorrect] = useState(false);
  const [isComplete, setIsComplete] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen || !boss) return null;

  const currentStep = boss.steps[currentStepIndex];

  const handleSelectOption = (index: number) => {
    if (hasSubmitted && isCorrect) return;
    setSelectedOption(index);
    setHasSubmitted(false);
  };

  const handleVerify = () => {
    if (selectedOption === null) return;
    const correct = selectedOption === currentStep.correctIndex;
    setIsCorrect(correct);
    setHasSubmitted(true);
  };

  const handleNextStep = () => {
    if (currentStepIndex + 1 < boss.steps.length) {
      setCurrentStepIndex(prev => prev + 1);
      setSelectedOption(null);
      setHasSubmitted(false);
      setIsCorrect(false);
    } else {
      setIsComplete(true);
    }
  };

  const handleClaimVictory = () => {
    onVictory(boss.tileNumber, boss.rewardXp, boss.rewardCoins, boss.rewardEnergy);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fade-in">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-3xl bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--color-violet-border)] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl text-[var(--text-primary)] overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh] transition-colors duration-200">
        {/* Subtle glow */}
        <div className="absolute -top-24 -left-24 w-80 h-80 bg-[var(--color-violet)]/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] pb-4 mb-4">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-violet-light)] border border-[var(--color-violet-border)] flex items-center justify-center text-[var(--color-violet)] shrink-0">
            <Swords className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs uppercase font-mono tracking-wider text-[var(--color-violet)] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                <Skull className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Regional Boss Encounter &bull; Tile {boss.tileNumber}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] font-mono">
                {boss.regionName}
              </span>
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-tight mt-0.5">{boss.bossName}</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Victory Screen */}
        {isComplete ? (
          <div className="py-8 flex flex-col items-center text-center">
            <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--color-amber-light)] border border-[var(--color-amber-border)] flex items-center justify-center text-[var(--color-amber)] mb-4 animate-bounce">
              <Trophy className="w-10 h-10" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] mb-2">Boss Vanquished!</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] max-w-md mb-6">
              You systematically dismantled the {boss.bossName} through architectural foresight, loop invariants, and boundary precision.
            </p>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 p-4 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] mb-6 shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-center px-4">
                <div className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Experience</div>
                <div className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--color-cyan)]">+{boss.rewardXp} XP</div>
              </div>
              <div className="h-8 w-px bg-[var(--border-subtle)]" />
              <div className="text-center px-4">
                <div className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Coins</div>
                <div className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--color-amber)]">+{boss.rewardCoins}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="h-8 w-px bg-[var(--border-subtle)]" />
              <div className="text-center px-4">
                <div className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Energy</div>
                <div className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--color-emerald)]">+{boss.rewardEnergy} ⚡</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handleClaimVictory}
              className="py-3 px-8 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-violet)] hover:opacity-90 text-white font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            >
              Continue Adventure <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Step Progress & Lore */}
            <div className="mb-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1.5 font-mono">
                <span>Phase {currentStepIndex + 1} of {boss.steps.length}: {currentStep.title}</span>
                <span className="text-[var(--color-violet)] font-semibold">{Math.round(((currentStepIndex) / boss.steps.length) * 100)}% Complete</span>
              </div>
              <div className="w-full h-2 rounded-full bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] overflow-hidden">
                <div
                  className="h-full bg-[var(--color-violet)] transition-all duration-300"
                  style={{ width: `${((currentStepIndex + 1) / boss.steps.length) * 100}%` }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Step Question */}
            <div className="overflow-y-auto pr-1 flex-1">
              <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] mb-4">
                <p className="text-xs text-[var(--color-violet)] font-mono mb-1">{boss.lore}</p>
                <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-relaxed">{currentStep.question}</h4>
              </div>

              {/* Options */}
              <div className="space-y-2.5 mb-4">
                {currentStep.options.map((option, idx) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedOption === idx;
                  let optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:border-[var(--color-indigo)]';

                  if (hasSubmitted) {
                    if (idx === currentStep.correctIndex) {
                      optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] border-2 border-[var(--color-emerald)] text-[var(--color-emerald)]';
                    } else if (isSelected && !isCorrect) {
                      optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] border-2 border-[var(--color-rose)] text-[var(--color-rose)]';
                    }
                  } else if (isSelected) {
                    optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--color-violet-light)] border-2 border-[var(--color-violet)] text-[var(--text-primary)] shadow-sm';
                  }

                  return (
                    <button
                      key={idx}
                      disabled={hasSubmitted && isCorrect}
                      onClick={() => handleSelectOption(idx)}
                      className={`w-full p-3 rounded-xl border text-left text-xs font-medium transition-all flex items-start gap-3 cursor-pointer shadow-sm ${optionStyle}`}
                    >
                      <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-[10px] font-mono mt-0.5 text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                        {String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}
                      </span>
                      <span className="leading-relaxed flex-1">{option}</span>
                      {hasSubmitted && idx === currentStep.correctIndex && (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-emerald)] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      )}
                      {hasSubmitted && isSelected && !isCorrect && (
                        <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-rose)] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      )}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* Explanation feedback */}
              {hasSubmitted && (
                <div
                  className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs mb-4 ${
                    isCorrect
                      ? 'bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] border-[var(--color-emerald-border)] text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                      : 'bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] border-[var(--color-rose-border)] text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <p className={`font-semibold mb-1 ${isCorrect ? 'text-[var(--color-emerald)]' : 'text-[var(--color-rose)]'}`}>
                    {isCorrect ? 'Correct Tactical Strike!' : 'The Boss Counterattacked!'}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">{currentStep.explanation}</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Footer Buttons */}
            <div className="pt-3 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex justify-end gap-3 mt-auto">
              {!hasSubmitted ? (
                <button
                  disabled={selectedOption === null}
                  onClick={handleVerify}
                  className="py-2 px-5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-violet)] hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-50 text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed active:scale-95"
                >
                  Execute Tactical Move
                </button>
              ) : isCorrect ? (
                <button
                  onClick={handleNextStep}
                  className="py-2 px-5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-emerald)] hover:opacity-90 text-white text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                >
                  {currentStepIndex + 1 < boss.steps.length ? 'Next Battle Phase' : 'Claim Victory!'} <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button
                  onClick={() => setHasSubmitted(false)}
                  className="py-2 px-5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Re-evaluate Approach
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: src/components/Evolution/BugBotModal.tsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Bot, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  AlertCircle, 
  ArrowRight, 
  Trophy, 
  X,
  Swords,
  Play
} from 'lucide-react';
import { BugBotScenario } from '../../types/evolution';

interface BugBotModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  scenario: BugBotScenario | null;
  onVictory: (xp: number, coins: number, energy: number) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

interface AlgorithmOption {
  name: string;
  complexity: string;
  opsFor5k: number;
  timeMs: number;
  isSuperior: boolean;
  takeaway: string;
}

const PLAYER_ALGORITHMS: AlgorithmOption[] = [
  {
    name: 'Merge Sort (Divide & Conquer)',
    complexity: 'O(N log N)',
    opsFor5k: 61500,
    timeMs: 2,
    isSuperior: true,
    takeaway: 'Guaranteed O(N log N) divide-and-conquer splits array into halves, requiring only 61,500 operations for 5,000 items.'
  },
  {
    name: 'Quick Sort with Median-of-Three',
    complexity: 'O(N log N)',
    opsFor5k: 58000,
    timeMs: 1.5,
    isSuperior: true,
    takeaway: 'In-place partitioning with cache locality runs blazing fast in ~58,000 operations.'
  },
  {
    name: 'Selection Sort (Quadratic)',
    complexity: 'O(N²)',
    opsFor5k: 12500000,
    timeMs: 180,
    isSuperior: false,
    takeaway: 'Suffers 12.5 million operations because it repeatedly scans the entire remaining unsorted array.'
  }
];

export const BugBotModal: React.FC<BugBotModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  scenario,
  onVictory,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'duel' | 'repair'>('duel');

  // Duel State
  const [chosenAlgo, setChosenAlgo] = useState<AlgorithmOption>(PLAYER_ALGORITHMS[0]);
  const [isDuelSimulating, setIsDuelSimulating] = useState(false);
  const [duelFinished, setDuelFinished] = useState(false);
  const [simulatedPlayerOps, setSimulatedPlayerOps] = useState(0);
  const [simulatedRivalOps, setSimulatedRivalOps] = useState(0);

  // Bug Repair State
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [hasSubmitted, setHasSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [isCorrect, setIsCorrect] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen || !scenario) return null;

  const handleStartDuel = () => {
    setIsDuelSimulating(true);
    setDuelFinished(false);
    setSimulatedPlayerOps(0);
    setSimulatedRivalOps(0);

    const targetPlayerOps = chosenAlgo.opsFor5k;
    const targetRivalOps = 12500000; // Bubble Sort O(N^2)

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setSimulatedPlayerOps(prev => {
        const next = prev + Math.floor(targetPlayerOps / 15);
        if (next >= targetPlayerOps) {
          return targetPlayerOps;
        }
        return next;
      });

      setSimulatedRivalOps(prev => {
        const next = prev + Math.floor(targetRivalOps / 25);
        if (next >= targetRivalOps) {
          clearInterval(interval);
          setIsDuelSimulating(false);
          setDuelFinished(true);
          return targetRivalOps;
        }
        return next;
      });
    }, 60);
  };

  const handleSelectOption = (index: number) => {
    if (hasSubmitted && isCorrect) return;
    setSelectedOption(index);
    setHasSubmitted(false);
  };

  const handleVerify = () => {
    if (selectedOption === null) return;
    const correct = scenario.options[selectedOption].isCorrect;
    setIsCorrect(correct);
    setHasSubmitted(true);
  };

  const handleClaim = () => {
    onVictory(scenario.rewardXp, scenario.rewardCoins, scenario.rewardEnergy);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-3xl bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden text-[var(--text-primary)] flex flex-col max-h-[92vh] transition-colors duration-200">
        {/* Glow */}
        <div className="absolute -top-24 -right-24 w-72 h-72 bg-[var(--color-pink)]/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-pink-light)] border border-[var(--color-pink-border)] flex items-center justify-center text-[var(--color-pink)] shrink-0">
              <Bot className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider text-[var(--color-pink)] font-mono flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Swords className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Virtual Rival Arena
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-mono">
                  {scenario.topic}
                </span>
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-tight">
                Rival BugBot Challenge Arena
              </h2>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--card-bg)] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Switcher */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2 bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('duel')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold transition cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'duel'
                ? 'bg-[var(--color-pink)] text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
            }`}
          >
            <Swords className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Head-to-Head Algorithm Duel</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('repair')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold transition cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'repair'
                ? 'bg-[var(--color-pink)] text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
            }`}
          >
            <Bot className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Fix BugBot's Flawed Code</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Scrollable Body */}
        <div className="p-5 overflow-y-auto flex-1">
          {activeTab === 'duel' ? (
            /* TAB 1: DUEL BENCHMARK */
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
              <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[var(--color-pink)] uppercase tracking-wider block font-bold">
                  Asymptotic Race Condition: N = 5,000 Elements
                </span>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] mt-1">
                  Race BugBot's Quadratic Implementation against Your Scalable Choice!
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                  BugBot is deploying a naïve nested loop algorithm. Choose an optimal data structure or divide-and-conquer strategy to beat it in raw CPU operations.
                </p>

              {/* Player Algorithm Selection */}
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Select Your Algorithm for the Duel:
                </span>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                  {PLAYER_ALGORITHMS.map((algo) => (
                    <button
                      key={algo.name}
                      disabled={isDuelSimulating}

                        setChosenAlgo(algo);
                        setDuelFinished(false);
                      }}
                      className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left flex flex-col justify-between transition cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed shadow-sm ${
                        chosenAlgo.name === algo.name
                          ? 'bg-[var(--color-pink-light)] border-2 border-[var(--color-pink)] text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                          : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:border-[var(--color-pink)]'

                  <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">{scenario.errorCategory}</span>
                </div>
                <pre className="text-[var(--text-primary)] overflow-x-auto leading-relaxed">{scenario.buggyCode}</pre>
              </div>

              <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase tracking-wider">
                Identify the Fatal Flaw in BugBot's Solution:
              </h4>

              {/* Options */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {scenario.options.map((option, idx) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedOption === idx;
                  let optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:border-[var(--color-indigo)]';

                  if (hasSubmitted) {
                    if (option.isCorrect) {
                      optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] border-2 border-[var(--color-emerald)] text-[var(--color-emerald)]';
                    } else if (isSelected && !option.isCorrect) {
                      optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] border-2 border-[var(--color-rose)] text-[var(--color-rose)]';
                    }
                  } else if (isSelected) {
                    optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--color-pink-light)] border-2 border-[var(--color-pink)] text-[var(--text-primary)] shadow-sm';
                  }

                  return (
                    <button
                      key={idx}
                      disabled={hasSubmitted && isCorrect}
                      onClick={() => handleSelectOption(idx)}
                      className={`w-full p-3 rounded-xl border text-left text-xs font-medium transition-all flex items-start gap-3 cursor-pointer shadow-sm ${optionStyle}`}
                    >
                      <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-[10px] font-mono mt-0.5 text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                        {String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}
                      </span>
                      <span className="leading-relaxed flex-1">{option.text}</span>
                      {hasSubmitted && option.isCorrect && (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-emerald)] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      )}
                      {hasSubmitted && isSelected && !option.isCorrect && (
                        <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-rose)] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      )}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* Feedback */}
              {hasSubmitted && (
                <div
                  className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs ${
                    isCorrect
                      ? 'bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] border-[var(--color-emerald-border)] text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                      : 'bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] border-[var(--color-rose-border)] text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <p className={`font-semibold mb-1 ${isCorrect ? 'text-[var(--color-emerald)]' : 'text-[var(--color-rose)]'}`}>
                    {isCorrect ? 'BugBot Refuted!' : 'BugBot Laughs at Your Guess!'}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">{selectedOption !== null ? scenario.options[selectedOption].explanation : scenario.bugExplanation}</p>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Repair Footer */}
              <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end">
                {!hasSubmitted ? (
                  <button
                    disabled={selectedOption === null}
                    onClick={handleVerify}
                    className="py-2 px-5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-pink)] hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-50 text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                  >
                    Expose Bug
                  </button>
                ) : isCorrect ? (
                  <button
                    onClick={handleClaim}
                    className="py-2 px-5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-emerald)] hover:opacity-90 text-white text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                  >
                    Claim Victory <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setHasSubmitted(false)}
                    className="py-2 px-5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Try Again
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span>Bounty:</span>
            <span className="text-[var(--color-indigo)] font-semibold">+{scenario.rewardXp} XP</span>
            <span className="text-[var(--color-amber)] font-semibold">+{scenario.rewardCoins} Coins</span>
            <span className="text-[var(--color-emerald)] font-semibold">+{scenario.rewardEnergy} ⚡</span>
          </div>
          <button

            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            Close Arena
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

  );

import React from 'react';
import { 
  Zap, 
  Shield, 
  HelpCircle, 
  RotateCcw, 
  Crosshair, 
  ArrowUpRight, 
  Sparkles,
  Compass,
  Bot
} from 'lucide-react';
import { EnergyAbility, RouteType } from '../../types/evolution';
import { ENERGY_ABILITIES, MAX_ENERGY } from '../../engine/energyEngine';

interface EnergyActionBarProps {
  energy: number;
  hasShield: boolean;
  hasLadderBoost: boolean;
  canReroll: boolean;
  turn?: number;
  currentRouteType?: RouteType;
  onOpenCrossroads?: () => void;
  onOpenBugBot?: () => void;
  onUseAbility: (abilityId: EnergyAbility['id']) => void;
}

export const EnergyActionBar: React.FC<EnergyActionBarProps> = ({
  energy,
  hasShield,
  hasLadderBoost,
  canReroll,
  turn = 1,
  currentRouteType = 'knowledge',
  onOpenCrossroads,
  onOpenBugBot,
  onUseAbility,
}) => {
  const getIcon = (id: EnergyAbility['id']) => {
    switch (id) {
      case 'hint':
        return HelpCircle;
      case 'shield':
        return Shield;
      case 'debug_scan':
        return Crosshair;
      case 'reroll':
        return RotateCcw;
      case 'second_chance':
        return Sparkles;
      case 'ladder_boost':
        return ArrowUpRight;
    }
  };

  const getAbilityShortName = (id: EnergyAbility['id']) => {
    switch (id) {
      case 'hint': return 'Hint';
      case 'shield': return 'Shield';
      case 'debug_scan': return 'Scan';
      case 'reroll': return 'Reroll';
      case 'second_chance': return 'Retry';
      case 'ladder_boost': return 'Boost';
      default: return 'Ability';
    }
  };

  const getRouteBadgeStyle = (type: RouteType) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'risk':
        return 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--color-amber)] border-[var(--color-amber-border)]';
      case 'challenge':
        return 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--color-indigo)] border-[var(--color-indigo-border)]';
      case 'knowledge':
      default:
        return 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--color-cyan)] border-[var(--color-cyan-border)]';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div 
      className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto bg-[var(--header-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-between gap-2 overflow-x-auto shrink-0 transition-colors duration-200"
    >
      {/* Left: Turn, Route, Energy & Buffs */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
        <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-medium hidden sm:inline">
          Turn {turn}
        </span>

        {/* Route Badge */}
        {onOpenCrossroads ? (
          <button
            onClick={onOpenCrossroads}
            title="Inspect Decision Crossroads"
            className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-medium border transition shadow-sm ${getRouteBadgeStyle(
              currentRouteType
            )}`}
          >
            <Compass className="w-3 h-3" />
            <span className="capitalize">{currentRouteType} Path</span>
          </button>
        ) : (
          <span
            className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-medium border shadow-sm ${getRouteBadgeStyle(
              currentRouteType
            )}`}
          >
            <Compass className="w-3 h-3" />
            <span className="capitalize">{currentRouteType} Path</span>
          </span>
        )}

        {/* Energy Meter */}
        <div 
          className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] font-mono text-[11px] font-medium shadow-sm"
          title={`Algorithm Energy: ${energy} of ${MAX_ENERGY}`}
        >
          <Zap className="w-3 h-3 text-[var(--color-amber)] fill-[var(--color-amber)]" />
          <span className="font-bold text-[var(--color-amber)]">{energy}</span>
          <span className="text-[9px] text-[var(--text-muted)]">/ {MAX_ENERGY}</span>
        </div>

        {/* Active Buffs */}
        {hasShield && (
          <span 
            className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-medium bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--color-indigo)] border border-[var(--color-indigo-border)] shadow-sm"
            title="Shield absorbs the next penalty or snake drop"
          >
            <Shield className="w-2.5 h-2.5" /> Shield active
          </span>
        )}
        {hasLadderBoost && (
          <span 
            className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-medium bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--color-amber)] border border-[var(--color-amber-border)] shadow-sm"
            title="Boost grants +2 bonus tiles on next ladder"
          >
            <Sparkles className="w-2.5 h-2.5" /> +2 Boost active
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Center: Tactical Abilities */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto py-0.2 shrink-0">
        {ENERGY_ABILITIES.map((ability) => {
          const Icon = getIcon(ability.id);
          const isAffordable = energy >= ability.cost;
          const isAlreadyBuffed =
            (ability.id === 'shield' && hasShield) ||
            (ability.id === 'ladder_boost' && hasLadderBoost);
          const isDisabled = !isAffordable || isAlreadyBuffed || (ability.id === 'reroll' && !canReroll);

          return (
            <button
              key={ability.id}
              disabled={isDisabled}
              onClick={() => onUseAbility(ability.id)}
              title={`${ability.name} (${ability.cost} ⚡): ${ability.description}`}
              className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-normal flex items-center gap-1 transition-all border shrink-0 ${
                isDisabled
                  ? 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-muted)] cursor-not-allowed opacity-40'
                  : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:border-[var(--color-indigo)] hover:text-[var(--color-indigo)] shadow-sm active:scale-95 cursor-pointer'
              }`}
            >
              <Icon className="w-3 h-3 text-[var(--color-amber)] shrink-0" />
              <span className="hidden md:inline">{getAbilityShortName(ability.id)}</span>
              <span className="text-[9.5px] font-mono text-[var(--color-amber)] font-medium">
                {ability.cost}⚡
              </span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Right: Rival Duel Action */}
      {onOpenBugBot && (
        <button
          onClick={onOpenBugBot}
          title="Duel BugBot Rival"
          className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--color-pink-border)] text-[var(--color-pink)] text-[10px] font-bold transition shrink-0 cursor-pointer shadow-sm active:scale-95"
        >
          <Bot className="w-3 h-3" />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Rival Duel</span>
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Award, CheckCircle, History, X, Search, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { TopicMasteryScore } from '../../types/evolution';

interface MasteryModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  topicMasteryMap: Record<string, TopicMasteryScore>;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const MasteryModal: React.FC<MasteryModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  topicMasteryMap,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [selectedTopicId, setSelectedTopicId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const topics = Object.values(topicMasteryMap);
  const filteredTopics = topics.filter(t =>
    t.topicName.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
  );

  const averageScore = Math.round(
    topics.reduce((acc, t) => acc + t.score, 0) / (topics.length || 1)
  );
  const learningDebt = Math.max(0, 100 - averageScore);

  const getTierColor = (level: string) => {
    switch (level) {
      case 'master':
        return 'text-[var(--color-emerald)] bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] border-[var(--color-emerald-border)]';
      case 'expert':
        return 'text-[var(--color-violet)] bg-[var(--color-violet-light)] border-[var(--color-violet-border)]';
      case 'practitioner':
        return 'text-[var(--color-cyan)] bg-[var(--color-cyan-light)] border-[var(--color-cyan-border)]';
      default:
        return 'text-[var(--text-secondary)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)]';
    }
  };

  const selectedTopic = selectedTopicId ? topicMasteryMap[selectedTopicId] : topics[0];

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fade-in">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-4xl bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl text-[var(--text-primary)] overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh] transition-colors duration-200">
        {/* Glow */}
        <div className="absolute -top-24 -left-24 w-80 h-80 bg-[var(--color-indigo)]/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] pb-4 mb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] border border-[var(--color-indigo-border)] flex items-center justify-center text-[var(--color-indigo)] shrink-0">
              <Award className="w-6 h-6" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <span className="text-xs uppercase font-mono tracking-wider text-[var(--color-indigo)] font-semibold">
                  Cognitive Mastery Matrix
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-mono">
                  Mastery Index: {averageScore}/100
                </span>
                <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-mono border ${
                  learningDebt < 30 
                    ? 'bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] text-[var(--color-emerald)] border-[var(--color-emerald-border)]' 
                    : learningDebt < 60 
                    ? 'bg-[var(--color-amber-light)] text-[var(--color-amber)] border-[var(--color-amber-border)]' 
                    : 'bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] text-[var(--color-rose)] border-[var(--color-rose-border)]'
                }`}>
                  Learning Debt: {learningDebt}%
                </span>
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] tracking-tight">DSA Topic Mastery Dashboard</h2>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Search & Topic list layout */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-5 flex-1 overflow-hidden">
          {/* Left: Topic list */}
          <div className="md:col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-3 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="relative">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--text-muted)] absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search topics..."
                value={search}
                onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-1.5 bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-lg text-xs text-[var(--text-primary)] placeholder-[var(--text-muted)] focus:outline-none focus:border-[var(--color-cyan)]"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="overflow-y-auto space-y-2 pr-1 flex-1">
              {filteredTopics.map((topic) => {
                const isSelected = (selectedTopic && selectedTopic.topicId === topic.topicId);
                const tierClass = getTierColor(topic.level);

                return (
                  <div
                    key={topic.topicId}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedTopicId(topic.topicId)}
                    className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left cursor-pointer transition-all shadow-sm ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] border-2 border-[var(--color-indigo)]'
                        : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] hover:border-[var(--color-cyan)]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate max-w-[170px]">
                        {topic.topicName}
                      </span>
                      <span className={`text-[10px] uppercase font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border ${tierClass}`}>
                        {topic.level}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] rounded-full overflow-hidden mb-1">
                      <div
                        className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--color-indigo)] to-[var(--color-emerald)] rounded-full transition-all"
                        style={{ width: `${topic.score}%` }}
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-mono">
                      <span>Score: {topic.score}/100</span>
                      <span>{topic.correctCount}/{topic.attempts} Solved</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right: Detailed Topic Inspection */}
          <div className="md:col-span-7 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-y-auto bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm">
            {selectedTopic ? (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] pb-3">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">{selectedTopic.topicName}</h3>
                    <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                      Last evaluated: {new Date(selectedTopic.lastUpdated).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-[var(--color-indigo)]">
                      {selectedTopic.score} <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">/ 100</span>
                    </div>
                    <span
                      className={`text-[10px] uppercase font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded border ${getTierColor(
                        selectedTopic.level
                      )}`}
                    >
                      {selectedTopic.level} Tier
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Score Breakdown Cards */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                  <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-center shadow-sm">
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Attempts</div>
                    <div className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] font-mono">{selectedTopic.attempts}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-center shadow-sm">
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Accuracy</div>
                    <div className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--color-emerald)] font-mono">
                      {selectedTopic.attempts > 0
                        ? `${Math.round((selectedTopic.correctCount / selectedTopic.attempts) * 100)}%`
                        : '0%'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-center shadow-sm">
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">First-Try</div>
                    <div className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--color-indigo)] font-mono">{selectedTopic.firstTryCount}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-center shadow-sm">
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Hints Used</div>
                    <div className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--color-amber)] font-mono">{selectedTopic.hintsUsedCount}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Anti-Inflation Calibration Note */}
                <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs text-[var(--color-indigo)] flex items-start gap-2 shadow-sm">
                  <Zap className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-indigo)] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                    <strong className="text-[var(--text-primary)]">Evidence-based progression:</strong> High tier scores (60+) scale with diminished returns, requiring repeated independent solutions and comeback proofs to reach <strong className="text-[var(--color-emerald)]">Mastery (85+)</strong>.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* Evidence Log */}
                <div>
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <History className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
                    Cognitive Evidence Trail
                  </h4>
                  <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-36 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                    {selectedTopic.evidence && selectedTopic.evidence.length > 0 ? (
                      selectedTopic.evidence.map((ev, i) => (
                        <div
                          key={i}
                          className="text-xs p-2 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] flex items-start gap-2 shadow-sm"
                        >
                          <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-emerald)] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />

                      <div className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] italic p-2">No evidence recorded yet.</div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : null}

        </div>
