import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Flame, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, ArrowRight, Zap, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { BoardMutationEvent } from '../../types/evolution';

interface MutationModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  mutation: BoardMutationEvent | null;
  onResolve: (isCorrect: boolean, bonusTiles: number, penaltyTiles: number, destination?: number) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const MutationModal: React.FC<MutationModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  mutation,
  onResolve,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [hasSubmitted, setHasSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [isCorrect, setIsCorrect] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen || !mutation) return null;

  const challenge = mutation.challenge;

  const handleSelectOption = (idx: number) => {
    if (hasSubmitted && isCorrect) return;
    setSelectedOption(idx);
    setHasSubmitted(false);
  };

  const handleVerify = () => {
    if (selectedOption === null) return;
    const correct = selectedOption === challenge.correctOptionIndex;
    setIsCorrect(correct);
    setHasSubmitted(true);
  };

  const handleContinue = () => {
    onResolve(isCorrect, mutation.bonusTiles, mutation.penaltyTiles, mutation.portalDestination);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fade-in">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-3xl bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl text-[var(--text-primary)] overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh] transition-colors duration-200">
        {/* Glow */}
        <div className="absolute -top-24 -left-24 w-72 h-72 bg-[var(--color-amber)]/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] pb-4 mb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-amber-light)] border border-[var(--color-amber-border)] flex items-center justify-center text-[var(--color-amber)] shrink-0">
              <Flame className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs uppercase font-mono tracking-wider text-[var(--color-amber)] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Turn {mutation.triggerTurn} Board Mutation
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-mono">
                  {mutation.type.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase()}
                </span>
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] tracking-tight">{mutation.title}</h2>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Mutation Description & Risks */}
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs">
          <p className="text-[var(--text-primary)] mb-2">{mutation.description}</p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-[11px] pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <span className="text-[var(--color-emerald)] font-medium">Reward: {mutation.bonusReward}</span>
            <span className="text-[var(--color-rose)] font-medium">Risk: {mutation.penaltyRisk}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Challenge prompt */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto pr-1 flex-1 space-y-4 mb-4">
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--color-cyan)] mb-1">{challenge.title}</h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] leading-relaxed">{challenge.prompt}</p>
          </div>

          <h5 className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase tracking-wider">Select the Solution:</h5>

          <div className="space-y-2.5">
            {(challenge.options || []).map((option, idx) => {
              const isSelected = selectedOption === idx;
              let optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:border-[var(--color-indigo)]';

              if (hasSubmitted) {
                if (idx === challenge.correctOptionIndex) {
                  optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] border-2 border-[var(--color-emerald)] text-[var(--color-emerald)]';
                } else if (isSelected && !isCorrect) {
                  optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] border-2 border-[var(--color-rose)] text-[var(--color-rose)]';
                }
              } else if (isSelected) {
                optionStyle = 'bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] border-2 border-[var(--color-indigo)] text-[var(--text-primary)] shadow-sm';
              }

              return (
                <button
                  key={idx}
                  disabled={hasSubmitted && isCorrect}
                  onClick={() => handleSelectOption(idx)}
                  className={`w-full p-3 rounded-xl border text-left text-xs font-medium transition-all flex items-start gap-3 cursor-pointer shadow-sm active:scale-98 ${optionStyle}`}
                >
                  <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-[10px] font-mono mt-0.5 text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                    {String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}
                  </span>
                  <span className="leading-relaxed flex-1">{option}</span>
                  {hasSubmitted && idx === challenge.correctOptionIndex && (
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-emerald)] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  )}
                  {hasSubmitted && isSelected && !isCorrect && (
                    <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-rose)] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Feedback */}
          {hasSubmitted && (
            <div
              className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs ${
                isCorrect
                  ? 'bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] border-[var(--color-emerald-border)] text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                  : 'bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] border-[var(--color-rose-border)] text-[var(--text-primary)]'
              }`}
            >
              <p className={`font-semibold mb-1 ${isCorrect ? 'text-[var(--color-emerald)]' : 'text-[var(--color-rose)]'}`}>
                {isCorrect ? 'Mutation Invariant Resolved!' : 'Failed to Stabilize Mutation!'}
              </p>
              <p className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">{challenge.explanation}</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="pt-3 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex justify-end gap-3 mt-auto">
          {!hasSubmitted ? (
            <button
              disabled={selectedOption === null}
              onClick={handleVerify}
              className="py-2 px-5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-indigo)] hover:bg-[var(--color-indigo-hover)] disabled:opacity-50 text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            >
              Submit Invariant Solution
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button
              onClick={handleContinue}
              className="py-2 px-5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-emerald)] hover:opacity-90 text-white text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            >
              Continue Adventure <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { Compass, ShieldCheck, Zap, Lock, ArrowRight, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { RouteOption, RouteType } from '../../types/evolution';

interface RouteModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  tile: number;
  routeOptions: RouteOption[];
  currentSelectedRoute: RouteType;
  onSelectRoute: (type: RouteType) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const RouteModal: React.FC<RouteModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  tile,
  routeOptions,
  currentSelectedRoute,
  onSelectRoute,
  onClose,
}) => {
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const getRouteBadge = (type: RouteType) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'knowledge':
        return {
          icon: ShieldCheck,
          badgeBg: 'bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] text-[var(--color-emerald)] border-[var(--color-emerald-border)]',
          borderHover: 'hover:border-[var(--color-emerald)]',
        };
      case 'challenge':
        return {
          icon: Compass,
          badgeBg: 'bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] text-[var(--color-indigo)] border-[var(--color-indigo-border)]',
          borderHover: 'hover:border-[var(--color-indigo)]',
        };
      case 'risk':
        return {
          icon: Zap,
          badgeBg: 'bg-[var(--color-amber-light)] text-[var(--color-amber)] border-[var(--color-amber-border)]',
          borderHover: 'hover:border-[var(--color-amber)]',
        };
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fade-in">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-4xl bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl text-[var(--text-primary)] overflow-hidden max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col transition-colors duration-200">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] pb-4 mb-5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] border border-[var(--color-indigo-border)] flex items-center justify-center text-[var(--color-indigo)]">
              <Compass className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs uppercase font-mono tracking-wider text-[var(--color-indigo)] font-bold">Decision Crossroads</span>
                <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-mono">
                  Tile {tile}
                </span>
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] tracking-tight">Choose Your Algorithmic Path</h2>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-6">
          Decision tiles test your strategic foresight. Select the path that best matches your mastery and appetite for risk.
          Unlocked routes depend on demonstrated topic mastery and algorithmic energy.
        </p>

        {/* Route Cards */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
          {routeOptions.map((opt) => {
            const badge = getRouteBadge(opt.type);
            const Icon = badge.icon;
            const isSelected = currentSelectedRoute === opt.type;

            return (
              <div
                key={opt.id}
                className={`relative flex flex-col justify-between rounded-xl border p-5 transition-all duration-200 bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] shadow-sm ${
                  opt.isUnlocked
                    ? `${badge.borderHover} cursor-pointer active:scale-98 ${
                        isSelected ? 'ring-2 ring-[var(--color-indigo)] border-[var(--color-indigo)]' : 'border-[var(--border-subtle)]'
                      }`
                    : 'opacity-60 border-[var(--border-subtle)] cursor-not-allowed'
                }`}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (opt.isUnlocked) {
                    onSelectRoute(opt.type);
                  }
                }}
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                    <span
                      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold border ${badge.badgeBg}`}
                    >
                      <Icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      {opt.title}
                    </span>
                    {!opt.isUnlocked && (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-[var(--color-rose)] bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-[var(--color-rose-border)]">
                        <Lock className="w-3 h-3" /> Locked
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] leading-relaxed mb-4">{opt.description}</p>

                  <div className="space-y-2 text-xs border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] pt-3 mb-4">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                      <span className="text-[var(--text-muted)]">Difficulty:</span>
                      <span className="font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)] uppercase text-[10px] tracking-wide">
                        {opt.difficulty}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                      <span className="text-[var(--text-muted)]">Reward:</span>
                      <span className="text-[var(--color-emerald)] font-medium">{opt.movementReward}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                      <span className="text-[var(--text-muted)]">Risk / Penalty:</span>
                      <span className="text-[var(--color-rose)] font-medium">{opt.possiblePenalty}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  {!opt.isUnlocked && opt.lockedReason && (
                    <div className="mb-3 p-2 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] border border-[var(--color-rose-border)] text-[11px] text-[var(--color-rose)]">
                      <strong>Requirements:</strong> {opt.lockedReason}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <button
                    disabled={!opt.isUnlocked}
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      if (opt.isUnlocked) {
                        onSelectRoute(opt.type);
                        onClose();
                      }
                    }}
                    className={`w-full py-2.5 px-3 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                      opt.isUnlocked
                        ? isSelected
                          ? 'bg-[var(--color-indigo)] hover:bg-[var(--color-indigo-hover)] text-white shadow-md'
                          : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]'
                        : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] text-[var(--text-muted)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] cursor-not-allowed'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {opt.isUnlocked ? (
                      isSelected ? (
                        'Active Route'
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          Select Route <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </>
                      )
                    ) : (
                      'Locked'
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

                      ? 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] hover:border-[var(--text-secondary)]'
                      : isConcept
                      ? 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--color-amber-border)] hover:border-[var(--color-amber)]'
                      : 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--color-emerald-border)] hover:border-[var(--color-emerald)]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">{choice.title}</span>
                      {isAccept && <ArrowDownRight className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />}
                      {isConcept && <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-amber)]" />}
                      {isDebug && <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-emerald)]" />}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-2 leading-relaxed">{choice.description}</p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                    <span className="text-[var(--text-muted)] font-mono">
                      Target: Tile {snake.to + choice.recoveryDelta}
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className={`font-semibold ${
                        choice.recoveryDelta > 0 ? 'text-[var(--color-emerald)]' : 'text-[var(--text-muted)]'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {choice.recoveryDelta > 0 ? `+${choice.recoveryDelta} Recovery` : 'Standard'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

                Interactive Asymptotic Analysis
              </span>
              <h2 id="complexity-meter-title" className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-tight">
                Asymptotic Complexity Meter
              </h2>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] transition cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Close Complexity Meter"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 flex flex-col gap-4 text-xs sm:text-sm">
          {/* Interactive N Slider Controls */}
          <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col gap-3 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Sliders className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-indigo)]" />
                <span className="font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] text-xs sm:text-sm">
                  Simulate Input Size (N):
                </span>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--color-indigo)] font-mono font-black text-sm">
                  N = {inputSize.toLocaleString()} elements
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Quick Preset Buttons */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                {N_PRESETS.map(n => (
                  <button
                    key={n}
                    onClick={() => setInputSize(n)}
                    className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-mono font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                      inputSize === n
                        ? 'bg-[var(--color-indigo)] text-white shadow-sm'
                        : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {n >= 1000 ? `${n / 1000}k` : n}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Slider */}
            <input
              type="range"
              min="10"
              max="100000"
              step="100"
              value={inputSize}
              onChange={(e) => setInputSize(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full accent-[var(--color-indigo)] cursor-pointer"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Comparative Complexity Bars */}
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase tracking-wider">
              Theoretical Execution Operations & Scaling
            </span>

            {COMPLEXITY_CLASSES.map(cls => {
              const ops = cls.calculateOps(inputSize);
              // Calculate visual bar width logarithmically bounded
              const logRatio = Math.min(100, Math.max(3, (Math.log10(Math.max(1, ops)) / Math.log10(1e10)) * 100));

              return (
                <div 
                  key={cls.notation}
                  className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
                >
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-mono font-black border text-xs ${cls.badgeClass}`}>
                        {cls.notation}
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">{cls.name}</span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 font-mono text-[11px]">
                      <span className="text-[var(--text-primary)] font-bold">
                        {ops >= 1e9 ? '> 1,000,000,000+ ops' : `${ops.toLocaleString()} ops`}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] hidden sm:inline">&bull; {cls.timeEstimate}</span>
                      <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-sans text-[10px] font-bold ${
                        cls.rating === 'Optimal' ? 'text-[var(--color-emerald)] bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)]' :
                        cls.rating === 'Near-Optimal' ? 'text-[var(--color-cyan)] bg-[var(--color-cyan-light)]' :
                        cls.rating === 'Scalable' ? 'text-[var(--color-indigo)] bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)]' :
                        cls.rating === 'Standard' ? 'text-[var(--color-violet)] bg-[var(--color-violet-light)]' :
                        cls.rating === 'Bottleneck' ? 'text-[var(--color-amber)] bg-[var(--color-amber-light)]' :
                        'text-[var(--color-rose)] bg-[var(--color-rose-light)]'
                      }`}>
                        {cls.rating}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Relative Bar Indicator */}
                  <div className="w-full h-2 bg-[var(--card-bg)] rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
                    <div 
                      className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${cls.barClass}`}
                      style={{ width: `${logRatio}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-[10.5px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] mt-0.5 leading-tight">
                    <strong className="text-[var(--text-primary)]">Standard Examples:</strong> {cls.example}
                  </p>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Educational Takeaway Callout */}
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] flex items-start gap-2 shadow-sm">
            <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-cyan)] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div>
              <strong className="text-[var(--text-primary)]">Interview Takeaway: </strong>
              As input size N scales from 1,000 to 100,000 elements, an O(N log N) algorithm executes ~1.7 million operations, whereas an O(N²) algorithm explodes to 10 billion operations. In coding interviews, optimizing from O(N²) down to O(N log N) or O(N) is what distinguishes senior engineers.
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          <span>Operations estimated based on standard abstract RAM model calculations.</span>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] font-bold text-xs transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            Done Exploring
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  X, 
  Cpu, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Award, 
  ArrowRight, 
  Sparkles,
  HelpCircle,

  Database

interface DecisionLabModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAwardReward?: (xp: number, coins: number) => void;
}

interface DecisionScenario {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  scaleMetric: string;
  constraint: string;
  scenarioText: string;
  options: Array<{
    title: string;
    complexity: string;
    isOptimal: boolean;
    tradeoffSummary: string;
  }>;
  followUpReasoning: {
    question: string;
    choices: string[];
    correctIndex: number;
    explanation: string;
  };
}

const SCENARIOS: DecisionScenario[] = [
  {
    id: 'sensor-stream-sort',
    title: 'High-Volume Sensor Stream Sort',
    scaleMetric: '10,000,000 Data Points',
    constraint: 'Input values bounded in integer range [0, 1000]. Maximum latency: < 50ms.',
    scenarioText: 'An industrial IoT gateway receives 10 million telemetry readings every minute. Each reading is an integer temperature from 0 to 1,000. Which algorithm achieves optimal throughput?',
    options: [
      {
        title: 'Counting Sort (Histogram Array of Size 1001)',
        complexity: 'O(N + K) Time • O(K) Auxiliary Space',
        isOptimal: true,
        tradeoffSummary: 'Because key range K = 1,000 is tiny compared to N = 10,000,000, counting sort runs in pure linear O(N) time with only ~4KB of RAM!'
      },
      {
        title: 'Standard Quick Sort (In-Place Partitioning)',
        complexity: 'O(N log N) Average • O(log N) Space',
        isOptimal: false,
        tradeoffSummary: 'Requires ~230 million comparisons (N log₂ N), wasting CPU cycles when range K is bounded.'
      },
      {
        title: 'Standard Merge Sort (Divide & Conquer)',
        complexity: 'O(N log N) Time • O(N) Auxiliary Space',
        isOptimal: false,
        tradeoffSummary: 'Allocates a second 10M array in RAM (~80MB), triggering garbage collection overhead.'
      },
      {
        title: 'Bubble Sort with Early Exit',
        complexity: 'O(N²) Quadratic Time',
        isOptimal: false,
        tradeoffSummary: 'Catastrophic failure: 10¹⁴ operations would take weeks to finish.'
      }
    ],
    followUpReasoning: {
      question: 'Why does Counting Sort bypass the mathematical comparison sort barrier of Ω(N log N)?',
      choices: [
        'It uses array indices as direct memory addresses (bucketing) rather than comparing elements pairwise',
        'It utilizes multi-threaded parallel GPU acceleration automatically',
        'Modern compilers translate counting loops into quantum registers',
        'It drops duplicate items to save time'
      ],
      correctIndex: 0,
      explanation: 'Non-comparison sorts (Counting Sort, Radix Sort, Bucket Sort) avoid pairwise decision trees by using integer address indexing, achieving true linear O(N + K) time.'
    }
  },
  {
    id: 'leaderboard-top-k',
    title: 'Real-Time Top 100 Leaderboard',
    scaleMetric: '500,000 Active Players',
    constraint: 'Continuous score updates. Real-time Top-100 extraction under 1ms.',
    scenarioText: 'An online competitive gaming platform has 500,000 players whose scores change every second. You must maintain and return the current Top 100 players instantly.',
    options: [
      {
        title: 'Min-Heap of Fixed Size K = 100',
        complexity: 'O(N log K) Ingestion • O(1) Top-K Extraction • O(K) Space',
        isOptimal: true,
        tradeoffSummary: 'Root stores the 100th player. New scores only compare against the root in O(1). If higher, replace and sift down in O(log 100) ≈ 7 operations!'
      },
      {
        title: 'Sort Full 500,000 Array on Every Request',
        complexity: 'O(N log N) per query (~9,500,000 ops)',
        isOptimal: false,
        tradeoffSummary: 'Sorting 500K records on every query causes server CPU spikes and 500ms API lag.'
      },
      {
        title: 'Unsorted Array with Linear Scan',
        complexity: 'O(N · K) Time (~50,000,000 ops)',
        isOptimal: false,

    followUpReasoning: {

      choices: [

        'A Min-Heap uses half as much memory as a Max-Heap',
        'Max-Heaps cannot store numerical scores',
        'Because Min-Heaps sort elements in reverse'
      ],
      correctIndex: 0,
      explanation: 'In a Top-K Min-Heap, the root is the current threshold. If a new score is smaller than the root, it cannot be in the top K and is discarded in O(1).'
    }
  }
];

export const DecisionLabModal: React.FC<DecisionLabModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onAwardReward
}) => {
  const [scenarioIndex, setScenarioIndex] = useState(0);
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [selectedReasoning, setSelectedReasoning] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [isEvaluated, setIsEvaluated] = useState(false);
  const [hasClaimed, setHasClaimed] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const currentScenario = SCENARIOS[scenarioIndex];
  const chosenOption = selectedOption !== null ? currentScenario.options[selectedOption] : null;

  const handleEvaluate = () => {
    if (selectedOption === null || selectedReasoning === null) return;
    setIsEvaluated(true);
    if (chosenOption?.isOptimal && selectedReasoning === currentScenario.followUpReasoning.correctIndex && !hasClaimed) {
      setHasClaimed(true);
      if (onAwardReward) {
        onAwardReward(75, 25);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleNextScenario = () => {
    setScenarioIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % SCENARIOS.length);
    setSelectedOption(null);
    setSelectedReasoning(null);
    setIsEvaluated(false);
    setHasClaimed(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md animate-fadeIn">
      <div 
        className="relative w-full max-w-3xl max-h-[92vh] bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden text-[var(--text-primary)] flex flex-col"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="decision-lab-title"
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-[#F59E0B]/20 border border-[#F59E0B]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#F59E0B] shrink-0">
              <Cpu className="w-5 h-5 animate-pulse" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider text-[#F59E0B] font-mono">
                Production-Scale Architecture Lab
              </span>
              <h2 id="decision-lab-title" className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-tight">
                Algorithm Decision Lab
              </h2>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] transition cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Close Decision Lab"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 flex flex-col gap-4 text-xs sm:text-sm">
          {/* Scenario Overview Banner */}
          <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col gap-2">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[11px] font-mono">
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[#F59E0B]/40 text-[#F59E0B] font-bold">
                Scale: {currentScenario.scaleMetric}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                Scenario {scenarioIndex + 1} of {SCENARIOS.length}
              </span>
            </div>

            <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-snug">
              {currentScenario.title}
            </h3>

            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] leading-relaxed">
              {currentScenario.scenarioText}
            </p>

            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[11px] text-[#06B6D4] font-mono">
              <strong className="text-[var(--text-primary)]">Constraint:</strong> {currentScenario.constraint}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Step 1: Choose Algorithm */}
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase tracking-wider">
              Step 1: Choose Production-Scale Algorithm Strategy
            </span>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              {currentScenario.options.map((opt, idx) => {
                const isSelected = selectedOption === idx;
                let cardStyle = 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:border-[#6366F1]';

                if (isEvaluated) {
                  if (opt.isOptimal) {
                    cardStyle = 'bg-[#10B981]/20 border-2 border-[#10B981] text-[#10B981]';
                  } else if (isSelected && !opt.isOptimal) {
                    cardStyle = 'bg-[#F43F5E]/20 border-2 border-[#F43F5E] text-[#F43F5E]';
                  }
                } else if (isSelected) {
                  cardStyle = 'bg-[#6366F1]/20 border-2 border-[#6366F1] text-[var(--text-primary)] shadow-md shadow-[#6366F1]/25';
                }

                return (
                  <button
                    key={idx}
                    disabled={isEvaluated}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedOption(idx)}
                    className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left flex items-start justify-between gap-3 transition cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-default ${cardStyle}`}
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">{opt.title}</div>
                      <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-[#06B6D4] mt-0.5">{opt.complexity}</div>
                      {isEvaluated && (
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] mt-1 leading-snug">
                          {opt.tradeoffSummary}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {isEvaluated && opt.isOptimal && (
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#10B981]/20 text-[#10B981] font-bold text-[10px] shrink-0 border border-[#10B981]/40">
                        Optimal Choice
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Step 2: Reason Justification */}
          {selectedOption !== null && (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 animate-fadeIn">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-[#F59E0B] uppercase tracking-wider">
                Step 2: Algorithmic Justification (Why does this choice scale?)
              </span>
              <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col gap-2.5">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                  {currentScenario.followUpReasoning.question}
                </p>
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                  {currentScenario.followUpReasoning.choices.map((choice, cIdx) => {
                    const isChoiceSelected = selectedReasoning === cIdx;
                    let cStyle = 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:border-[#6366F1]';

                    if (isEvaluated) {
                      if (cIdx === currentScenario.followUpReasoning.correctIndex) {
                        cStyle = 'bg-[#10B981]/20 border-2 border-[#10B981] text-[#10B981] font-semibold';
                      } else if (isChoiceSelected) {
                        cStyle = 'bg-[#F43F5E]/20 border-2 border-[#F43F5E] text-[#F43F5E]';
                      }
                    } else if (isChoiceSelected) {
                      cStyle = 'bg-[#6366F1]/20 border-2 border-[#6366F1] text-[var(--text-primary)]';
                    }

                    return (
                      <button
                        key={cIdx}
                        disabled={isEvaluated}
                        onClick={() => setSelectedReasoning(cIdx)}
                        className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-left text-xs leading-snug transition cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-default ${cStyle}`}
                      >
                        {choice}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Post Evaluation Feedback */}
          {isEvaluated && (
            <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[#6366F1]/40 text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs flex flex-col gap-2 animate-fadeIn">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-[#F59E0B]" />
                <span>Production Architecture Verdict:</span>
              </div>
              <p className="leading-relaxed">
                {currentScenario.followUpReasoning.explanation}
              </p>
              {hasClaimed && (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-[#F59E0B] text-xs">
                  <Award className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Awarded +75 XP and +25 Coins for flawless architectural reasoning!</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] flex items-center justify-between">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] font-semibold text-xs transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            Close Lab
          </button>

          {!isEvaluated ? (
            <button
              onClick={handleEvaluate}
              disabled={selectedOption === null || selectedReasoning === null}
              className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#6366F1] hover:bg-[#4F46E5] disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-wide transition shadow-md shadow-[#6366F1]/25 cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              Verify Architectural Decision
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button
              onClick={handleNextScenario}
              className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#6366F1] hover:bg-[#4F46E5] text-white font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-[#6366F1]/25"
            >
              <span>Next Scenario</span>
              <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

                    <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </button>

        </div>

        <div className="px-5 py-3 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">

          >
            Close Report
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  X, 
  HelpCircle, 
  Play, 
  RotateCcw, 
  Sparkles, 
  Layers, 
  Network, 
  Binary, 
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowRight
} from 'lucide-react';

interface WhatIfSimulatorModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

interface SimulationScenario {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  topic: string;
  question: string;
  initialStateDescription: string;
  actions: Array<{
    label: string;
    resultTitle: string;
    resultDescription: string;
    asciiDiagram: string;
    isOptimal: boolean;
    takeaway: string;
  }>;
}

const SCENARIOS: SimulationScenario[] = [
  {
    id: 'bst-deletion',
    title: 'BST Two-Child Node Deletion',
    topic: 'Trees & Heaps',
    question: 'You want to delete node [50], which has both a left child [30] and a right child [70]. What happens under each strategy?',
    initialStateDescription: 'BST Structure: [50] (root) -> Left: [30] (with child [20], [40]), Right: [70] (with child [60], [80])',
    actions: [
      {
        label: 'Strategy A: Replace with Inorder Successor',
        resultTitle: 'Inorder Successor Preserves BST Invariant',
        resultDescription: 'Find the minimum element in the right subtree ([60]). Copy [60] into root position and delete the leaf [60]. Left subtree remains strictly < 60, right subtree strictly > 60.',
        asciiDiagram: `      [60] <--- (Replaced by Inorder Successor)\n     /    \\\n   [30]   [70]\n   /  \\      \\\n [20] [40]   [80]`,
        isOptimal: true,
        takeaway: 'Standard textbook implementation. Guarantees that BST ordering property is maintained across all levels.'
      },
      {
        label: 'Strategy B: Replace with Inorder Predecessor',
        resultTitle: 'Inorder Predecessor Also Valid',
        resultDescription: 'Find the maximum element in the left subtree ([40]). Copy [40] into root position and delete leaf [40]. Left subtree remains < 40, right subtree remains > 40.',
        asciiDiagram: `      [40] <--- (Replaced by Inorder Predecessor)\n     /    \\\n   [30]   [70]\n   /      /  \\\n [20]   [60] [80]`,
        isOptimal: true,
        takeaway: 'Equally valid alternative! Alternating between successor and predecessor prevents tree skewing in long-running applications.'
      },
      {
        label: 'Strategy C: Naively Delete & Shift Left Child',
        resultTitle: 'Invariant Violation! Structure Ruined',
        resultDescription: 'Promoting [30] leaves the right subtree [70] orphaned, or violates ordering if right subtree is attached blindly under [40].',
        asciiDiagram: `      [30] (Broken BST)\n     /    \\\n   [20]   [40] -> [70] ? (Violates binary tree degree <= 2)`,
        isOptimal: false,
        takeaway: 'Without finding successor/predecessor, tree properties collapse or require costly complete tree reconstruction.'
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    id: 'hash-load-factor',
    title: 'Hash Table High Load Factor Collision',
    topic: 'Hashing',
    question: 'A hash table with capacity 8 currently holds 7 items (Load factor α = 7/8 = 0.875). What happens next?',
    initialStateDescription: 'Buckets: [0] -> itemA, [1] -> itemB -> itemC (collision chain), [3] -> itemD, [7] -> itemE -> itemF -> itemG',
    actions: [
      {
        label: 'Option A: Automatic Dynamic Rehashing (Capacity × 2)',
        resultTitle: 'Rehashing Restores O(1) Expected Time',
        resultDescription: 'Array doubles from 8 to 16 buckets. Every key is re-hashed (hash(key) % 16). Collisions disperse, dropping load factor to 7/16 = 0.4375.',
        asciiDiagram: `Capacity 16: α = 0.44\n[0]->A, [1]->B, [3]->D, [7]->E, [9]->C, [11]->F, [15]->G\nMax chain length drops from 3 down to 1!`,
        isOptimal: true,
        takeaway: 'Amortized cost of occasional O(N) resize is O(1) per insert, preserving fast constant-time performance.'
      },
      {
        label: 'Option B: Omit Resizing & Keep Appending Chaining',
        resultTitle: 'Degradation into O(N) Linked List Traversal',
        resultDescription: 'As items grow to 1,000 without resizing, 8 buckets hold an average of 125 nodes per chain. Lookup deteriorates into slow linear search O(N).',
        asciiDiagram: `Bucket [1]: [item1] -> [item2] -> [item3] ... -> [item125]\nLookup requires traversing 125 linked pointers! (O(N) catastrophe)`,
        isOptimal: false,
        takeaway: 'Always trigger dynamic resizing when load factor α exceeds threshold (typically 0.75).'
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    id: 'graph-cycle',
    title: 'Dijkstra on Negative Edge Weights',
    topic: 'Graph Algorithms',
    question: 'A directed graph contains edge A -> B with weight -5. What happens if Dijkstra\'s algorithm is run?',
    initialStateDescription: 'Path 1: S -> A (weight 2) -> B (weight -5) = Total -3. Path 2: S -> B (weight 1) directly.',
    actions: [
      {
        label: 'Option A: Run Dijkstra Without Check',
        resultTitle: 'Greedy Choice Fails with Negative Edges',
        resultDescription: 'Dijkstra greedily marks B as visited with distance 1. Because Dijkstra assumes visited vertices never need re-evaluation, it permanently misses the cheaper path S -> A -> B (-3)!',
        asciiDiagram: `Dijkstra visited: B (dist = 1)\nTrue shortest path was S -> A -> B (dist = -3)!\nDijkstra output is mathematically incorrect!`,
        isOptimal: false,
        takeaway: 'Dijkstra\'s greedy invariant requires all edge weights to be non-negative (w >= 0).'
      },
      {
        label: 'Option B: Use Bellman-Ford or SPFA Algorithm',
        resultTitle: 'Bellman-Ford Handles Negative Edges Safely',
        resultDescription: 'Bellman-Ford relaxes all |E| edges |V|-1 times. It correctly finds path S -> A -> B = -3, and detects if any negative weight cycles exist!',
        asciiDiagram: `Round 1: relax (S,B)=1, (S,A)=2\nRound 2: relax (A,B) -> updates dist(B) to -3!\nCorrect shortest path found in O(V · E) time!`,
        isOptimal: true,
        takeaway: 'Use Bellman-Ford or Floyd-Warshall whenever negative edge weights are present.'
      }
    ]
  }
];

export const WhatIfSimulatorModal: React.FC<WhatIfSimulatorModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose
}) => {
  const [selectedScenarioIndex, setSelectedScenarioIndex] = useState(0);
  const [selectedActionIndex, setSelectedActionIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const currentScenario = SCENARIOS[selectedScenarioIndex];
  const activeAction = selectedActionIndex !== null ? currentScenario.actions[selectedActionIndex] : null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md animate-fadeIn">
      <div 
        className="relative w-full max-w-3xl max-h-[92vh] bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden text-[var(--text-primary)] flex flex-col"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="what-if-title"
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-[#8B5CF6]/20 border border-[#8B5CF6]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#8B5CF6] shrink-0">
              <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 animate-pulse" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider text-[#8B5CF6] font-mono">
                Interactive DSA Sandbox
              </span>
              <h2 id="what-if-title" className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-tight">
                "What If?" Structural Simulator
              </h2>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] transition cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Close What-If Simulator"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 flex flex-col gap-4 text-xs sm:text-sm">
          {/* Scenario Tabs */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            {SCENARIOS.map((sc, idx) => (
              <button
                key={sc.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectedScenarioIndex(idx);
                  setSelectedActionIndex(null);
                }}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs whitespace-nowrap transition cursor-pointer ${
                  selectedScenarioIndex === idx
                    ? 'bg-[#8B5CF6] text-white shadow-md shadow-[#8B5CF6]/25'
                    : 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'

            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Scenario Prompt */}
          <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col gap-2">

            </p>

            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase tracking-wider">
              Choose an Architectural Action to Simulate:
            </span>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              {currentScenario.actions.map((act, idx) => (
                <button
                  key={idx}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedActionIndex(idx)}
                  className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left flex items-start gap-2.5 transition cursor-pointer ${
                    selectedActionIndex === idx
                      ? 'bg-[#8B5CF6]/20 border-2 border-[#8B5CF6] text-[var(--text-primary)] shadow-lg shadow-[#8B5CF6]/25 scale-[1.01]'
                      : 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:border-[#8B5CF6]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black shrink-0 ${
                    selectedActionIndex === idx ? 'bg-[#8B5CF6] text-white' : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]'
                  }`}>
                    {idx + 1}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold leading-snug">{act.label}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Simulation Outcome Card */}
          {activeAction ? (

              activeAction.isOptimal

                : 'bg-[#F43F5E]/15 border-[#F43F5E]/40 text-[var(--text-primary)]'
            }`}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm">
                <span>{activeAction.resultTitle}</span>
                <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] uppercase font-bold border ${
                  activeAction.isOptimal ? 'bg-[#10B981]/20 text-[#10B981] border-[#10B981]/40' : 'bg-[#F43F5E]/20 text-[#F43F5E] border-[#F43F5E]/40'
                }`}>
                  {activeAction.isOptimal ? 'Invariant Preserved' : 'Violation / Inefficient'}
                </span>
              </div>

              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] leading-relaxed">
                {activeAction.resultDescription}
              </p>

              {/* ASCII Visual Structure */}
              <pre className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] font-mono text-[11px] text-[#06B6D4] overflow-x-auto border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
                <code>{activeAction.asciiDiagram}</code>
              </pre>

              <div className="pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                <strong className="text-[var(--text-primary)]">Algorithmic Insight: </strong>
                {activeAction.takeaway}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-dashed border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-center text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          <span>Experiment freely with different invariants to observe algorithmic outcomes.</span>

            onClick={onClose}

          >
            Close Sandbox
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

import React from 'react';
import { 
  Trophy, 
  X, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Lock, 
  Flame, 
  Zap, 
  Bug, 
  Layers, 
  Clock, 
  RotateCcw, 
  Network, 
  TrendingUp, 
  Crown,
  Footprints
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Achievement } from '../../types/rewards';

interface AchievementsModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  achievements: Achievement[];
}

export const AchievementsModal: React.FC<AchievementsModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  achievements
}) => {
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const unlockedCount = achievements.filter(a => a.unlocked).length;

  const getAchievementIcon = (iconName: string) => {
    switch (iconName) {
      case 'Footprints': return <Footprints className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-indigo)]" />;
      case 'Layers': return <Layers className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-emerald)]" />;
      case 'Bug': return <Bug className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-rose)]" />;
      case 'Zap': return <Zap className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-amber)]" />;
      case 'Clock': return <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-indigo)]" />;
      case 'RotateCcw': return <RotateCcw className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-teal)]" />;
      case 'Network': return <Network className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-violet)]" />;
      case 'TrendingUp': return <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-pink)]" />;
      case 'Flame': return <Flame className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-orange)]" />;
      case 'Crown': return <Crown className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-amber)]" />;
      default: return <Trophy className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--color-amber)]" />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[88vh] bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl p-5 flex flex-col text-[var(--text-primary)] transition-colors duration-200">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3.5 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-amber-light)] text-[var(--color-amber)] border border-[var(--color-amber-border)]">
              <Trophy className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">DSA Achievements</h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Milestones, streaks and masteries ({unlockedCount} / {achievements.length} Unlocked)</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 rounded-lg text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Total Progress Bar */}
        <div className="my-3 p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs mb-1.5 font-bold">
            <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Completion Progress</span>
            <span className="text-[var(--color-amber)] font-mono">{Math.round((unlockedCount / achievements.length) * 100)}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="w-full h-2 bg-[var(--card-bg)] rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <div 
              className="h-full bg-[var(--color-amber)] rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
              style={{ width: `${(unlockedCount / achievements.length) * 100}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Achievements List */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 overflow-y-auto flex-1 py-1">
          {achievements.map(ach => (
            <div
              key={ach.id}
              className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border flex items-start gap-3 transition shadow-sm ${
                ach.unlocked
                  ? 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--color-amber-border)]'
                  : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] opacity-75'
              }`}
            >
              <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center border flex-shrink-0 ${
                ach.unlocked 
                  ? 'bg-[var(--color-amber-light)] border-[var(--color-amber-border)]' 
                  : 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)]'
              }`}>
                {ach.unlocked ? getAchievementIcon(ach.icon) : <Lock className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />}
              </div>

              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                  <h4 className={`font-bold text-xs truncate ${ach.unlocked ? 'text-[var(--color-amber)]' : 'text-[var(--text-primary)]'}`}>
                    {ach.name}
                  </h4>
                  {ach.unlocked && (
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-emerald)] flex-shrink-0" />

                  {ach.description}

                {/* Progress Mini Bar */}
                <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="flex-1 h-1.5 bg-[var(--card-bg)] rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
                    <div 
                      className={`h-full rounded-full ${ach.unlocked ? 'bg-[var(--color-emerald)]' : 'bg-[var(--color-indigo)]'}`}
                      style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, (ach.progress / ach.maxProgress) * 100)}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                    {ach.progress}/{ach.maxProgress}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="pt-3 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex justify-end">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            Close
          </button>

      </div>

import { ALGORITHM_CARDS, AlgorithmCard } from '../../data/algorithmCards';

interface AlgorithmCardsModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const AlgorithmCardsModal: React.FC<AlgorithmCardsModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose
}) => {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('All');
  const [selectedCO, setSelectedCO] = useState<string>('All');

  const categories = ['All', 'Searching', 'Sorting', 'Trees', 'Graphs'];
  const courseOutcomes = ['All', 'CO1', 'CO2', 'CO3', 'CO4'];

  const filteredCards = useMemo(() => {
    return ALGORITHM_CARDS.filter(card => {
      const matchesSearch = 
        card.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
        card.purpose.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
        card.keyInvariant.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
      const matchesCategory = selectedCategory === 'All' || card.category === selectedCategory;
      const matchesCO = selectedCO === 'All' || card.co === selectedCO;
      return matchesSearch && matchesCategory && matchesCO;
    });
  }, [searchQuery, selectedCategory, selectedCO]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[90vh] bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--header-bg)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] text-[var(--color-indigo)] border border-[var(--color-indigo-border)]">
              <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-black text-[var(--text-primary)] tracking-tight">
                DSA Algorithm Study Cards
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                Essential revision reference for University DSA curriculum exams and lab viva
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Filter Controls */}
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          {/* Search Input */}
          <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--text-secondary)]" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search algorithm, purpose, invariant..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs text-[var(--text-primary)] placeholder-[var(--text-secondary)] focus:outline-none focus:border-[var(--color-indigo)]"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Category Filter */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)] flex items-center gap-1">
              <Filter className="w-3 h-3" /> Topic:
            </span>
            {categories.map(cat => (
              <button
                key={cat}
                onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(cat)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                  selectedCategory === cat
                    ? 'bg-[var(--color-indigo)] text-white shadow-sm'
                    : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]'
                }`}
              >
                {cat}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* CO Filter */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)]">CO:</span>
            {courseOutcomes.map(co => (
              <button
                key={co}
                onClick={() => setSelectedCO(co)}
                className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                  selectedCO === co
                    ? 'bg-[var(--color-cyan)] text-white shadow-sm'
                    : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]'
                }`}
              >
                {co}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Cards Grid */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-5 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          {filteredCards.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="col-span-full py-12 text-center text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
              No algorithm flashcards matched your search criteria.
            </div>
          ) : (
            filteredCards.map(card => (
              <div
                key={card.id}
                className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] hover:border-[var(--color-indigo-border)] transition-all shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between gap-3"
              >
                <div>
                  {/* Card Title & Badges */}
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
                    <div>
                      <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] m-0">
                        {card.name}
                      </h3>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-medium">
                        {card.category}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-[var(--color-cyan-light)] text-[var(--color-cyan)] border border-[var(--color-cyan-border)]">
                      {card.co}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Purpose */}
                  <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-3 leading-relaxed">
                    {card.purpose}
                  </p>

                  {/* Complexities */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[11px] mb-3">
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                      <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-amber)] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      <div>
                        <div className="font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Time Complexity</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-mono">
                          Best: <span className="text-[var(--color-emerald)]">{card.timeComplexity.best}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-mono">
                          Avg: <span className="text-[var(--color-amber)]">{card.timeComplexity.average}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-mono">
                          Worst: <span className="text-[var(--color-rose)]">{card.timeComplexity.worst}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                      <HardDrive className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-cyan)] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      <div>
                        <div className="font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Aux Space</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--color-cyan)] font-mono">
                          {card.spaceComplexity}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* When to use */}
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
                    <span className="font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Application: </span>
                    {card.whenToUse}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Key Invariant */}
                <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] border border-[var(--color-indigo-border)] text-[11px] text-[var(--color-indigo)] flex items-start gap-1.5">
