import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { X, Clock, Award, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { Challenge } from '../../types/challenge';
import { ChallengeRegistry } from '../../data/challenges';

interface ExamModeModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onRecordResult?: (scoreDelta: number, coinsDelta: number) => void;
}

const EXAM_QUESTION_COUNT = 20;
const EXAM_DURATION_SECONDS = 20 * 60; // 20 minutes

export const ExamModeModal: React.FC<ExamModeModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onRecordResult
}) => {
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<Challenge[]>([]);
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState<number>(0);
  const [userAnswers, setUserAnswers] = useState<Record<number, number>>({});
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState<number>(EXAM_DURATION_SECONDS);
  const [isExamActive, setIsExamActive] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isExamSubmitted, setIsExamSubmitted] = useState<boolean>(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isExamActive || isExamSubmitted) return;

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setTimeLeft(prev => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(timer);
          handleSubmitExam();
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [isExamActive, isExamSubmitted]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleStartExam = () => {
    const registry = new ChallengeRegistry();
    const examQuestions = registry.getExamQuestions(EXAM_QUESTION_COUNT);
    setQuestions(examQuestions);
    setCurrentIndex(0);
    setUserAnswers({});
    setTimeLeft(EXAM_DURATION_SECONDS);
    setIsExamActive(true);
    setIsExamSubmitted(false);
  };

  const handleSelectOption = (qIdx: number, optIdx: number) => {
    if (isExamSubmitted) return;
    setUserAnswers(prev => ({ ...prev, [qIdx]: optIdx }));
  };

  const handleSubmitExam = () => {
    setIsExamSubmitted(true);
    setIsExamActive(false);

    // Calculate score
    let correctCount = 0;
    questions.forEach((q, idx) => {
      if (userAnswers[idx] === q.correctOptionIndex) {
        correctCount++;
      }
    });

    onRecordResult?.(correctCount * 15, correctCount * 5);
  };

  const formatTime = (secs: number) => {
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    const s = secs % 60;
    return `${m.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  const currentQ = questions[currentIndex];

  // Final performance evaluation
  let correctCount = 0;
  const topicBreakdown: Record<string, { correct: number; total: number }> = {};
  if (isExamSubmitted) {
    questions.forEach((q, idx) => {
      const isCorrect = userAnswers[idx] === q.correctOptionIndex;
      if (isCorrect) correctCount++;
      const current = topicBreakdown[q.topic] || { correct: 0, total: 0 };
      topicBreakdown[q.topic] = {
        correct: current.correct + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
        total: current.total + 1
      };
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[92vh] bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 text-[var(--text-primary)] overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#F43F5E]/20 border border-[#F43F5E]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#F43F5E]">
              <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase text-[#F43F5E]">Exam Simulation</span>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black">DSA Lab Examination (20 Questions)</h3>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* State 1: Start Screen */}
        {!isExamActive && !isExamSubmitted ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 py-4 text-center items-center">
            <Clock className="w-12 h-12 text-[#F43F5E] my-2" />
            <h4 className="text-lg font-black">Timed DSA Assessment</h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] max-w-md">
              20 randomized multiple-choice questions across CO1, CO2, CO3, and CO4. Strict 20-minute countdown timer with no hints.
            </p>
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)] flex flex-col gap-1 w-full max-w-sm mt-2">
              <span>• Total Questions: 20</span>
              <span>• Time Allowed: 20:00</span>
              <span>• Negative Marking: None</span>
              <span>• Comprehensive Topic Breakdown at Finish</span>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handleStartExam}
              className="mt-4 py-2.5 px-6 rounded-xl bg-[#F43F5E] hover:bg-[#E11D48] text-white font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-[#F43F5E]/25"
            >
              Start Exam Now
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : isExamActive && currentQ ? (
          /* State 2: Active Exam */
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
            {/* Top Bar: Progress & Timer */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs font-mono">
              <span>Question {currentIndex + 1} of {questions.length}</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-sm text-[#F43F5E] flex items-center gap-1">
                <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                {formatTime(timeLeft)}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Question Card */}
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col gap-1">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#06B6D4] font-bold">{currentQ.co} • {currentQ.topic}</span>
              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-relaxed">
                {currentQ.prompt}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Options */}
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
              {currentQ.options?.map((opt, idx) => {
                const isSelected = userAnswers[currentIndex] === idx;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={idx}
                    onClick={() => handleSelectOption(currentIndex, idx)}
                    className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left text-xs font-mono transition cursor-pointer flex items-start gap-2 ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'bg-[#6366F1]/20 border-[#6366F1] text-[var(--text-primary)] font-bold'
                        : 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] shrink-0 font-bold">
                      {String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}
                    </span>
                    <span className="leading-snug">{opt}</span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Navigator Palette */}
            <div className="pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <button
                  disabled={currentIndex === 0}
                  onClick={() => setCurrentIndex(prev => prev - 1)}
                  className="py-1.5 px-3 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Previous
                </button>
                <button
                  disabled={currentIndex === questions.length - 1}
                  onClick={() => setCurrentIndex(prev => prev + 1)}
                  className="py-1.5 px-3 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Next
                </button>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={handleSubmitExam}
                className="py-1.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-[#F43F5E] hover:bg-[#E11D48] text-white font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer shadow-sm"
              >
                Submit Exam
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* State 3: Final Exam Score & Topic Breakdown */
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 py-2 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col items-center gap-1 text-center">
              <Award className="w-8 h-8 text-[#EAB308] mb-1" />
              <h4 className="text-base font-black">Exam Evaluation Complete!</h4>
              <div className="text-3xl font-black font-mono text-[#EAB308] my-1">
                {correctCount} / {questions.length} ({Math.round((correctCount / questions.length) * 100)}%)
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Awarded +{correctCount * 15} XP and +{correctCount * 5} Coins.</p>
            </div>

            {/* Topic Performance Grid */}
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Topic-wise Score Breakdown:</span>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs font-mono">
                {Object.entries(topicBreakdown).map(([t, s]) => {
                  const pct = Math.round((s.correct / s.total) * 100);
                  return (
                    <div key={t} className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col gap-1">
                      <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px]">
                        <span className="font-bold truncate">{t}</span>
                        <span className={pct >= 70 ? 'text-[#10B981]' : 'text-[#F59E0B]'}>
                          {s.correct}/{s.total} ({pct}%)
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="w-full h-1 bg-[var(--card-bg)] rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                        <div
                          className="h-full rounded-full"
                          style={{ width: `${pct}%`, backgroundColor: pct >= 70 ? '#10B981' : '#F59E0B' }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Footer */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
              <button
                onClick={handleStartExam}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Retake Exam</span>
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                className="py-2 px-5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer hover:bg-[var(--card-bg)]"
              >
                Close Exam
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: src/components/Dashboard/MistakeLogModal.tsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, AlertCircle, RefreshCw, CheckCircle2, HelpCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { LearnerProfile } from '../../types/learner';
import { CHALLENGE_MAP } from '../../data/challenges';
import { Challenge } from '../../types/challenge';

interface MistakeLogModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  learnerProfile: LearnerProfile;
  onRetryChallenge?: (challenge: Challenge) => void;
}

export const MistakeLogModal: React.FC<MistakeLogModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  learnerProfile,
  onRetryChallenge
}) => {
  const [filterCO, setFilterCO] = useState<string>('All');

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Find all incorrect attempts
  const incorrectAttempts = learnerProfile.attemptHistory.filter(h => !h.isCorrect);

  // Deduplicate by challengeId (keep latest)
  const uniqueMistakesMap = new Map<string, typeof incorrectAttempts[0]>();
  incorrectAttempts.forEach(attempt => {
    uniqueMistakesMap.set(attempt.challengeId, attempt);
  });
  const mistakes = Array.from(uniqueMistakesMap.values()).reverse();

  const filteredMistakes = mistakes.filter(m => {
    const challenge = CHALLENGE_MAP.get(m.challengeId);
    if (!challenge) return true;
    if (filterCO === 'All') return true;
    return challenge.co === filterCO;
  });

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[90vh] bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--header-bg)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] text-[var(--color-rose)] border border-[var(--color-rose-border)]">
              <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-black text-[var(--text-primary)] tracking-tight">
                Academic Mistake Log & Remediation
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                Review your misconceptions, study the correct concepts, and retry questions to cement your mastery
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Filter Bar */}
        <div className="p-3 sm:p-4 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Filter by Syllabus CO:</span>
            {['All', 'CO1', 'CO2', 'CO3', 'CO4'].map(co => (
              <button
                key={co}
                onClick={() => setFilterCO(co)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                  filterCO === co
                    ? 'bg-[var(--color-rose)] text-white shadow-sm'
                    : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]'
                }`}
              >
                {co}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-medium">
            Total Logged Mistakes: <span className="font-bold text-[var(--color-rose)]">{mistakes.length}</span>
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Mistake Items List */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-4">
          {filteredMistakes.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-16 text-center">
              <div className="w-14 h-14 mx-auto mb-3 rounded-full bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] text-[var(--color-emerald)] flex items-center justify-center">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-8 h-8" />
              </div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] mb-1">
                {mistakes.length === 0 ? 'No Mistakes Logged Yet!' : 'No Mistakes in Selected Category'}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] max-w-sm mx-auto">
                {mistakes.length === 0
                  ? 'As you encounter challenging questions on the board, any incorrect attempts will appear here for targeted review and retry.'
                  : 'Great job! You have no unresolved misconceptions in this course outcome category.'}
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            filteredMistakes.map(item => {
              const challenge = CHALLENGE_MAP.get(item.challengeId);
              return (
                <div
                  key={item.challengeId}
                  className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] hover:border-[var(--color-rose-border)] transition-all shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-3"
                >
                  {/* Item Header */}
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-[var(--color-rose-light)] text-[var(--color-rose)] border border-[var(--color-rose-border)]">
                        Square {item.squareId}
                      </span>
                      {challenge?.co && (
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-[var(--color-cyan-light)] text-[var(--color-cyan)] border border-[var(--color-cyan-border)]">
                          {challenge.co}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                        Topic: <strong className="text-[var(--text-primary)]">{item.topic}</strong>
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {challenge && onRetryChallenge && (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => {
                          onClose();
                          onRetryChallenge(challenge);
                        }}
                        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-indigo)] hover:bg-[var(--color-indigo-hover)] text-white text-xs font-bold transition shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Retry</span>
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Question Prompt */}
                  {challenge && (
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-relaxed">
                      {challenge.title}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Code snippet if present */}
                  {challenge?.codeSnippet && (
                    <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--board-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] font-mono text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] overflow-x-auto">
                      <pre className="m-0">{challenge.codeSnippet}</pre>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Pedagogical Explanation & Correct Answer */}
                  {challenge && (
                    <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col gap-2">
                      <div className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] flex items-start gap-1.5">
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-emerald)] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                        <div>
                          <span className="font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Correct Solution: </span>
                          <span className="font-semibold text-[var(--color-emerald)]">
                            {challenge.correctOptionIndex !== undefined && challenge.options
                              ? `${challenge.options[challenge.correctOptionIndex]}`
                              : challenge.correctAnswerText || 'Review concept explanation below'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] flex items-start gap-1.5">
                        <HelpCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-indigo)] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                        <div>
                          <span className="font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Explanation: </span>
                          {challenge.explanation}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="p-3 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--header-bg)] flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          <span>Targeted remediation based on learning history</span>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] font-bold text-xs transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            Close
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: src/components/Dashboard/PracticeModeModal.tsx
============================================================

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, GraduationCap, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, ArrowRight, RotateCcw, Award } from 'lucide-react';
import { CourseOutcome } from '../../types/curriculum';
import { Challenge } from '../../types/challenge';
import { ChallengeRegistry } from '../../data/challenges';

interface PracticeModeModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onRecordResult?: (scoreDelta: number, coinsDelta: number) => void;
  onRecordMistake?: (topic: string, question: string, yourAnswer: string, correctAnswer: string) => void;
}

export const PracticeModeModal: React.FC<PracticeModeModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onRecordResult,
  onRecordMistake
}) => {
  const [selectedCO, setSelectedCO] = useState<CourseOutcome | null>(null);
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<Challenge[]>([]);
  const [currentQuestionIdx, setCurrentQuestionIdx] = useState<number>(0);
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [isAnswered, setIsAnswered] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [score, setScore] = useState<number>(0);
  const [topicStats, setTopicStats] = useState<Record<string, { correct: number; total: number }>>({});
  const [isCompleted, setIsCompleted] = useState<boolean>(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const registry = new ChallengeRegistry();

  const handleStartPractice = (co: CourseOutcome) => {
    setSelectedCO(co);
    const qList = registry.getPracticeQuestions(co, 10);
    setQuestions(qList);
    setCurrentQuestionIdx(0);
    setSelectedOption(null);
    setIsAnswered(false);
    setScore(0);
    setTopicStats({});
    setIsCompleted(false);
  };

  const currentQ = questions[currentQuestionIdx];

  const handleSubmitAnswer = () => {
    if (selectedOption === null || !currentQ) return;
    setIsAnswered(true);

    const isCorrect = selectedOption === currentQ.correctOptionIndex;
    if (isCorrect) {
      setScore(prev => prev + 1);
    } else {
      const yourAnswer = currentQ.options ? currentQ.options[selectedOption] : 'Option ' + selectedOption;
      const correctAnswer = currentQ.options && currentQ.correctOptionIndex !== undefined ? currentQ.options[currentQ.correctOptionIndex] : 'Correct answer';
      onRecordMistake?.(currentQ.topic, currentQ.prompt, yourAnswer, correctAnswer);
    }

    setTopicStats(prev => {
      const existing = prev[currentQ.topic] || { correct: 0, total: 0 };
      return {
        ...prev,
        [currentQ.topic]: {
          correct: existing.correct + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
          total: existing.total + 1
        }
      };
    });
  };

  const handleNextQuestion = () => {
    if (currentQuestionIdx + 1 < questions.length) {
      setCurrentQuestionIdx(prev => prev + 1);
      setSelectedOption(null);
      setIsAnswered(false);
    } else {
      setIsCompleted(true);
      onRecordResult?.(score * 10, score * 5);
    }
  };

  const handleRestart = () => {
    setSelectedCO(null);
    setQuestions([]);
    setIsCompleted(false);
  };

  // Analyze strengths & weaknesses
  const strongTopics: string[] = [];
  const needsPracticeTopics: string[] = [];

  Object.entries(topicStats).forEach(([t, s]) => {
    if (s.correct / s.total >= 0.7) {
      strongTopics.push(t);
    } else {
      needsPracticeTopics.push(t);
    }
  });

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 text-[var(--text-primary)]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#10B981]/20 border border-[#10B981]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#10B981]">
              <GraduationCap className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase text-[#10B981]">Exam Preparation</span>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black">Practice Mode (10 Questions)</h3>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* State 1: Choose CO */}
        {!selectedCO ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 py-2">
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
              Choose a Course Outcome (CO) unit to practice 10 focused questions with immediate explanations:
            </p>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
              {[
                { co: 'CO1' as CourseOutcome, title: 'CO1 — Techniques & Analysis', desc: 'Mathematical Foundation, Asymptotic Notations, Recurrences, Master Theorem' },
                { co: 'CO2' as CourseOutcome, title: 'CO2 — Stacks, Queues & Lists', desc: 'Array Stacks, Balanced Parentheses, Infix/Postfix, Circular Queues, Linked Lists' },
                { co: 'CO3' as CourseOutcome, title: 'CO3 — Sorting & Searching', desc: 'Insertion/Counting/Radix/Merge/Quick/Heap Sort, Binary/Jump Search, Hashing' },
                { co: 'CO4' as CourseOutcome, title: 'CO4 — Trees, Graphs & Algorithms', desc: 'BST, AVL Rotations, BFS/DFS, Dijkstra, Prim/Kruskal, Huffman, Matrix-Chain' }
              ].map((item) => (
                <button
                  key={item.co}
                  onClick={() => handleStartPractice(item.co)}
                  className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:border-[#10B981] text-left transition flex flex-col justify-between gap-1 cursor-pointer group"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold text-xs text-[var(--text-primary)] group-hover:text-[#10B981]">
                    <span>{item.title}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">{item.co}</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] leading-relaxed">{item.desc}</p>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : !isCompleted && currentQ ? (
          /* State 2: Answering questions */
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)] pb-2 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
              <span>Question {currentQuestionIdx + 1} of {questions.length} ({selectedCO})</span>
              <span>Score: <strong className="text-[#10B981]">{score}</strong> / {currentQuestionIdx}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#06B6D4] font-bold">{currentQ.topic} • {currentQ.subtopic}</span>
              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-relaxed">
                {currentQ.prompt}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Options */}
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
              {currentQ.options?.map((opt, idx) => {
                const isSelected = selectedOption === idx;
                const isCorrect = idx === currentQ.correctOptionIndex;

                let btnStyle = 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)]';
                if (isAnswered) {
                  if (isCorrect) btnStyle = 'bg-[#10B981]/20 border-[#10B981] text-[#10B981] font-bold';
                  else if (isSelected && !isCorrect) btnStyle = 'bg-[#F43F5E]/20 border-[#F43F5E] text-[#F43F5E]';
                } else if (isSelected) {
                  btnStyle = 'bg-[#10B981]/20 border-[#10B981] text-[var(--text-primary)]';
                }

                return (
                  <button
                    key={idx}
                    disabled={isAnswered}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedOption(idx)}
                    className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left text-xs font-mono transition cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-default flex items-start gap-2 ${btnStyle}`}
                  >
                    <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] shrink-0 font-bold">
                      {String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}
                    </span>
                    <span className="leading-snug">{opt}</span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Explanation on submit */}
            {isAnswered && (
              <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs font-mono ${
                selectedOption === currentQ.correctOptionIndex
                  ? 'bg-[#10B981]/15 border-[#10B981]/40 text-[#10B981]'
                  : 'bg-[#F43F5E]/15 border-[#F43F5E]/40 text-[#F43F5E]'
              }`}>
                <strong>{selectedOption === currentQ.correctOptionIndex ? 'Correct!' : 'Incorrect.'}</strong> {currentQ.explanation}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Question Actions */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-mono">
                {currentQ.difficulty.toUpperCase()} Level
              </span>

              {!isAnswered ? (
                <button
                  onClick={handleSubmitAnswer}
                  disabled={selectedOption === null}
                  className="py-2 px-5 rounded-xl bg-[#10B981] hover:bg-[#059669] disabled:opacity-40 text-white font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Submit Answer
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button
                  onClick={handleNextQuestion}
                  className="py-2 px-5 rounded-xl bg-[#10B981] hover:bg-[#059669] text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <span>{currentQuestionIdx + 1 === questions.length ? 'View Results' : 'Next Question'}</span>
                  <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* State 3: Final Results & Analysis */
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 py-2">
            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col items-center gap-1 text-center">
              <Award className="w-8 h-8 text-[#10B981] mb-1" />
              <h4 className="text-base font-black">Practice Session Complete!</h4>
              <div className="text-2xl font-black font-mono text-[#10B981] my-1">
                Score: {score} / {questions.length} ({Math.round((score / questions.length) * 100)}% Accuracy)
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Awarded +{score * 10} XP and +{score * 5} Coins.</p>
            </div>

            {/* Strengths & Weaknesses */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs font-mono">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#10B981]/10 border border-[#10B981]/30 flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                <span className="font-bold text-[#10B981] flex items-center gap-1">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Strong Topics:
                </span>
                {strongTopics.length > 0 ? (
                  <ul className="list-disc pl-4 text-[11px] text-[var(--text-primary)] space-y-0.5">
                    {strongTopics.map((t, i) => <li key={i}>{t}</li>)}
                  </ul>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] italic">Keep practicing to build topic mastery!</span>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#F59E0B]/10 border border-[#F59E0B]/30 flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                <span className="font-bold text-[#F59E0B] flex items-center gap-1">
                  <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Needs Practice:
                </span>
                {needsPracticeTopics.length > 0 ? (
                  <ul className="list-disc pl-4 text-[11px] text-[var(--text-primary)] space-y-0.5">
                    {needsPracticeTopics.map((t, i) => <li key={i}>{t}</li>)}
                  </ul>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-[#10B981] font-bold">Flawless performance across all tested topics!</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
              <button
                onClick={handleRestart}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Practice Another Unit</span>
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                className="py-2 px-5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer hover:bg-[var(--card-bg)]"
              >
                Back to Board
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { 
  Sparkles, 
  X, 
  Calendar, 
  Play 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { RevisionItem } from '../../types/learner';

interface RevisionModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  revisionQueue: RevisionItem[];
  onStartRevision: (squareId: number) => void;
}

export const RevisionModal: React.FC<RevisionModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  revisionQueue,
  onStartRevision
}) => {
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const dueItems = revisionQueue.filter(item => item.isDue || item.nextDueDate <= Date.now());
  const upcomingItems = revisionQueue.filter(item => !dueItems.includes(item));

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-xl max-h-[85vh] bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl p-5 flex flex-col text-[var(--text-primary)] transition-colors duration-200">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3.5 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] text-[var(--color-emerald)] border border-[var(--color-emerald-border)]">
              <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Spaced Repetition Review</h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">SM-2 algorithmic retention scheduler</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Body list */}
        <div className="py-4 overflow-y-auto flex-1 flex flex-col gap-4 text-xs">
          {/* Due Now */}
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--color-emerald)] mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span>Ready for Review ({dueItems.length})</span>
            </h3>
            {dueItems.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-center">
                All reviewed! No topics currently due for revision.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                {dueItems.map(item => (
                  <div 
                    key={item.id}
                    className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--color-emerald-border)] flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm"
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] text-xs">{item.topicName}</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                        Square {item.squareId} &bull; Repetition #{item.repetitionCount} &bull; Interval {item.intervalDays}d
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        onClose();
                        onStartRevision(item.squareId);
                      }}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-indigo)] hover:bg-[var(--color-indigo-hover)] text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer shadow-sm active:scale-95"
                    >
                      <Play className="w-3 h-3 fill-white" />
                      Review Now
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Upcoming Schedule */}
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-cyan)]" />
              <span>Upcoming Reviews ({upcomingItems.length})</span>
            </h3>
            {upcomingItems.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-[var(--text-muted)] text-center py-2">No scheduled future reviews yet.</p>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto">
                {upcomingItems.map(item => {
                  const daysLeft = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((item.nextDueDate - Date.now()) / (24 * 3600 * 1000)));
                  return (
                    <div 
                      key={item.id}
                      className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex items-center justify-between"
                    >
                      <span className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">{item.topicName}</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--color-cyan)] font-mono">in {daysLeft} day(s)</span>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="pt-3 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex justify-end">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            Close
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { Settings, X, Volume2, Shield, Eye, Flame, Sun, Moon } from 'lucide-react';
import { GameSettings } from '../../types/game';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

interface SettingsModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  settings: GameSettings;
  onUpdateSettings: (newSettings: Partial<GameSettings>) => void;
}

export const SettingsModal: React.FC<SettingsModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  settings,
  onUpdateSettings
}) => {
  const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme();

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl p-5 flex flex-col text-[var(--text-primary)] transition-colors duration-200">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3.5 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-indigo-light)] text-[var(--color-indigo)] border border-[var(--color-indigo-border)]">
              <Settings className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Game Settings</h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Audio, theme, animations and gameplay preferences</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Settings options */}
        <div className="py-4 flex flex-col gap-3.5 text-xs">
          {/* Theme Mode Toggle Option */}
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[var(--text-primary)] font-semibold">
                {theme === 'dark' ? <Moon className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-indigo)]" /> : <Sun className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-amber)]" />}
                <span>Interface Theme</span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono capitalize text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-bold">
                {theme} Mode
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTheme('light')}
                className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                  theme === 'light'
                    ? 'bg-[var(--color-indigo)] text-white shadow-sm'
                    : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                }`}
              >
                <Sun className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Light Mode</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTheme('dark')}
                className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                  theme === 'dark'
                    ? 'bg-[var(--color-indigo)] text-white shadow-sm'
                    : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                }`}
              >
                <Moon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Dark Mode</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Sound Toggle */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <Volume2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-indigo)]" />
              <div>
                <div className="font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Sound Effects</div>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Audio synthesizer effects for rolls and leaps</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={settings.soundEnabled}
              onChange={(e) => onUpdateSettings({ soundEnabled: e.target.checked })}
              className="w-4 h-4 accent-[var(--color-indigo)] rounded cursor-pointer"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Sound Volume Slider */}
          {settings.soundEnabled && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col gap-1.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-medium">Volume</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-[var(--color-indigo)]">{Math.round(settings.soundVolume * 100)}%</span>
              </div>
              <input
                type="range"
                min="0"
                max="1"
                step="0.05"
                value={settings.soundVolume}
                onChange={(e) => onUpdateSettings({ soundVolume: parseFloat(e.target.value) })}
                className="w-full accent-[var(--color-indigo)] cursor-pointer"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Reduced Motion Toggle */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <Eye className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-cyan)]" />
              <div>
                <div className="font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Reduced Motion</div>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Minimize animations for vestibular comfort</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={settings.reducedMotion}
              onChange={(e) => onUpdateSettings({ reducedMotion: e.target.checked })}
              className="w-4 h-4 accent-[var(--color-indigo)] rounded cursor-pointer"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Auto Open Challenge */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-emerald)]" />
              <div>
                <div className="font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Auto-Open Challenges</div>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Prompt challenge immediately upon landing</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={settings.autoOpenChallenge}
              onChange={(e) => onUpdateSettings({ autoOpenChallenge: e.target.checked })}
              className="w-4 h-4 accent-[var(--color-emerald)] rounded cursor-pointer"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Difficulty Selection */}
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[var(--text-primary)] font-semibold">
              <Flame className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-amber)]" />
              <span>Challenge Difficulty</span>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5">
              {(['beginner', 'intermediate', 'interview_ready'] as const).map(diff => (
                <button
                  key={diff}
                  onClick={() => onUpdateSettings({ difficulty: diff })}
                  className={`py-1.5 px-2 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold capitalize transition cursor-pointer ${
                    settings.difficulty === diff 
                      ? 'bg-[var(--color-indigo)] text-white shadow-md' 
                      : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                  }`}
                >
                  {diff.replace('_', ' ')}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="pt-3 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex justify-end">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-indigo)] hover:bg-[var(--color-indigo-hover)] font-bold text-white text-xs transition cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow-sm"
          >
            Save & Close
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: src/components/Dashboard/SyllabusModal.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { X, BookOpen, CheckCircle2, Award } from 'lucide-react';
import { CURRICULUM_TOPICS, STAGES } from '../../data/curriculum100';
import { CourseOutcome } from '../../types/curriculum';

interface SyllabusModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  completedSquares: number[];
  onSelectRange?: (range: [number, number]) => void;
}

export const SyllabusModal: React.FC<SyllabusModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  completedSquares,
  onSelectRange
}) => {
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const completedSet = new Set(completedSquares);

  const CO_MAP: Record<CourseOutcome, { title: string; color: string }> = {
    CO1: { title: 'CO1 — Mathematical Foundations & Analysis', color: '#10B981' },
    CO2: { title: 'CO2 — Stacks, Queues & Linked Lists', color: '#06B6D4' },
    CO3: { title: 'CO3 — Sorting, Searching & Hashing', color: '#6366F1' },
    CO4: { title: 'CO4 — Trees, Graphs & Algorithm Design', color: '#8B5CF6' }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 text-[var(--text-primary)] overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#6366F1]/20 border border-[#6366F1]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#6366F1]">
              <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase text-[#6366F1]">Academic Curriculum</span>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black">DSA Syllabus & Progress Tracker</h3>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Topics List */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto pr-1 flex flex-col gap-3 flex-1 text-xs">
          {(['CO1', 'CO2', 'CO3', 'CO4'] as CourseOutcome[]).map((coKey) => {
            const coInfo = CO_MAP[coKey];
            const topics = CURRICULUM_TOPICS.filter(t => t.co === coKey);

            return (
              <div key={coKey} className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col gap-2.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]" style={{ color: coInfo.color }}>
                    {coInfo.title}
                  </h4>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
                    {coKey}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                  {topics.map((t) => {
                    const [start, end] = t.boardRange;
                    let completedCount = 0;
                    for (let s = start; s <= end; s++) {
                      if (completedSet.has(s)) completedCount++;
                    }
                    const totalTiles = end - start + 1;
                    const pct = Math.round((completedCount / totalTiles) * 100);

                    return (
                      <div key={t.id} className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold">
                          <span>{t.title}</span>
                          <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                            Tiles {start}–{end} • {pct}%
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        {/* Progress Bar */}
                        <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
                          <div
                            className="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
                            style={{ width: `${pct}%`, backgroundColor: coInfo.color }}
                          />
                        </div>

                        {/* Subtopics pill list */}
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1">
                          {t.subtopics.map((sub, i) => (
                            <span key={i} className="text-[9px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
                              {sub}
                            </span>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          <span>Syllabus mapped strictly to VIT university curriculum.</span>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="py-1.5 px-4 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-primary)] font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer hover:bg-[var(--card-bg)]"
          >
            Close Syllabus
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { 
  Trophy, 
  Crown, 
  Sparkles, 
  RotateCcw, 
  X, 
  Target, 
  CheckCircle, 
  Compass
} from 'lucide-react';
import { TopicMasteryScore } from '../../types/evolution';

interface VictoryModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onPlayAgain: () => void;
  totalScore: number;
  coins?: number;
  laddersClimbed: number;
  snakesEncountered?: number;
  turnsCompleted?: number;
  questionsAttempted?: number;
  questionsCorrect?: number;
  longestStreak?: number;
  energyUsed?: number;
  topicMasteryMap?: Record<string, TopicMasteryScore>;
}

export const VictoryModal: React.FC<VictoryModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onPlayAgain,
  totalScore,
  coins = 0,
  laddersClimbed,
  snakesEncountered = 0,
  turnsCompleted = 0,
  questionsAttempted = 0,
  questionsCorrect = 0,
  longestStreak = 0,
  energyUsed = 0,
  topicMasteryMap = {}
}) => {
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const totalAttempts = Math.max(1, questionsAttempted || 1);
  const accuracy = Math.round(((questionsCorrect || 0) / totalAttempts) * 100);

  // Compute Topic Strengths and Focus Areas
  const topicsArray = Object.values(topicMasteryMap);
  const sortedTopics = [...topicsArray].sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  const strengths = sortedTopics.slice(0, 2);
  const focusAreas = sortedTopics.length > 2 
    ? [...sortedTopics].reverse().slice(0, 2) 
    : [];

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div 
        className="relative w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border-2 border-[var(--color-amber)] rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden text-[var(--text-primary)] transition-colors duration-200"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="victory-modal-title"
      >
        <button 
          onClick={onClose} 
          aria-label="Close Victory Review"
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--card-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] transition cursor-pointer z-10"
        >
          <X className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>

        {/* Modal Scrollable Content */}
        <div className="p-6 sm:p-8 overflow-y-auto flex-1 flex flex-col items-center text-center">
          {/* Big Trophy Graphic */}
          <div className="w-16 h-16 sm:w-20 sm:h-20 rounded-3xl bg-[var(--color-amber)] shadow-xl shadow-[var(--color-amber)]/30 flex items-center justify-center text-white mb-3 animate-bounce">
            <Trophy className="w-8 h-8 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 fill-white" />
          </div>

          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--color-amber-light)] text-[var(--color-amber)] border border-[var(--color-amber-border)] text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
            <Crown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            DSA Grandmaster Achieved
          </div>

          <h2 id="victory-modal-title" className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-[var(--text-primary)] tracking-tight">
            Congratulations, Developer!
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] mt-1 max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">
            You have ascended all 100 Squares of Code & Ladders, vanquished the Master Bug Titan, and proven algorithmic mastery!
          </p>

          {/* Performance Overview Badges */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 w-full my-5">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-center shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase font-semibold">Final XP</div>
              <div className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-[var(--color-indigo)] mt-0.5">{totalScore}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-center shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase font-semibold">Coins Earned</div>
              <div className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-[var(--color-amber)] mt-0.5">{coins} 🪙</div>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-center shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase font-semibold">Accuracy</div>
              <div className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-[var(--color-emerald)] mt-0.5">
                {questionsAttempted > 0 ? `${accuracy}%` : '100%'}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-center shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase font-semibold">Best Streak</div>
              <div className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-[var(--color-orange)] mt-0.5">{longestStreak} 🔥</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Secondary Statistical Breakdown */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 w-full text-left bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] p-3 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border-subtle)] mb-5 text-[11px]">
            <div>
              <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Total Moves: </span>
              <span className="font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">{turnsCompleted} turns</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Ladders Leaped: </span>
              <span className="font-bold text-[var(--color-emerald)]">{laddersClimbed}</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Traps Encountered: </span>
              <span className="font-bold text-[var(--color-rose)]">{snakesEncountered}</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Energy Cast: </span>
              <span className="font-bold text-[var(--color-cyan)]">{energyUsed} ⚡</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Post-Game Topic Analysis & Recommendations */}
          <div className="w-full text-left flex flex-col gap-3">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-secondary)] flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Target className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-indigo)]" />
              <span>Cognitive Mastery & Recommended Practice</span>
            </h3>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {/* Strengths */}
              <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--color-emerald-border)] shadow-sm">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-[var(--color-emerald)] text-xs mb-2">
                  <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Top Demonstrated Strengths:</span>
                </div>
                {strengths.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                    {strengths.map((t, idx) => (
                      <div key={idx} className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                        <span className="text-[var(--text-primary)] font-medium">{t.topicName}</span>
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[var(--color-emerald-light)] text-[var(--color-emerald)] font-mono text-[10px] font-bold border border-[var(--color-emerald-border)]">
                          {t.score}% Mastery
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Consistent performance across all curriculum stages.</p>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Recommended Focus */}
              <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--color-amber-border)] shadow-sm">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-[var(--color-amber)] text-xs mb-2">
                  <Compass className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Recommended Revision Focus:</span>
                </div>
                {focusAreas.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                    {focusAreas.map((t, idx) => (
                      <div key={idx} className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                        <span className="text-[var(--text-primary)] font-medium">{t.topicName}</span>
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[var(--color-amber-light)] text-[var(--color-amber)] font-mono text-[10px] font-bold border border-[var(--color-amber-border)]">
                          {t.score}% Mastery
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    ))}

                ) : (
                  <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">All topics validated at interview-ready proficiency!</p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] flex items-start gap-2">

                <strong className="text-[var(--text-primary)]">Next Milestone:</strong> Practice implementing the optimal O(N) Space-Time tradeoffs for your lowest-scoring topics on LeetCode / NeetCode 150 to lock in your interview readiness!

FILE: src/components/Shop/ShopModal.tsx
