import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  ShoppingBag, 
  X, 
  Coins, 
  Check, 
  Palette, 
  Dices, 
  User, 
  Sparkles,
  Lock
} from 'lucide-react';
import { CosmeticItem, CosmeticType, EquippedCosmetics } from '../../types/rewards';
import { SHOP_ITEMS } from '../../data/shopItems';

interface ShopModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  coinBalance: number;
  purchasedIds: string[];
  equipped: EquippedCosmetics;
  onPurchaseItem: (item: CosmeticItem) => void;
  onEquipItem: (type: CosmeticType, itemId: string) => void;
}

export const ShopModal: React.FC<ShopModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  coinBalance,
  purchasedIds,
  equipped,
  onPurchaseItem,
  onEquipItem
}) => {
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<CosmeticType>('board_theme');

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const filteredItems = SHOP_ITEMS.filter(item => item.type === activeCategory);
  const purchasedSet = new Set(purchasedIds);

  const isEquipped = (item: CosmeticItem) => {
    if (item.type === 'board_theme') return equipped.boardTheme === item.id;
    if (item.type === 'dice_skin') return equipped.diceSkin === item.id;
    if (item.type === 'player_marker') return equipped.playerMarker === item.id;
    return false;
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[88vh] bg-[var(--modal-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl p-5 flex flex-col text-[var(--text-primary)] transition-colors duration-200">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3.5 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--color-amber-light)] text-[var(--color-amber)] border border-[var(--color-amber-border)]">
              <ShoppingBag className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Cosmetics & Themes Shop</h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Personalize your game board, dice, and developer avatar</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {/* Coin Balance Badge */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--color-amber-border)] text-[var(--color-amber)] font-bold text-xs shadow-inner">
              <Coins className="w-4 h-4 text-[var(--color-amber)] fill-[var(--color-amber)]/20" />
              <span className="font-mono text-sm">{coinBalance}</span>
            </div>

            <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 rounded-lg text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer">
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Category Tabs */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 my-3 p-1 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveCategory('board_theme')}
            className={`flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
              activeCategory === 'board_theme'
                ? 'bg-[var(--color-indigo)] text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
            }`}
          >
            <Palette className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Board Themes
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveCategory('dice_skin')}
            className={`flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
              activeCategory === 'dice_skin'
                ? 'bg-[var(--color-indigo)] text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
            }`}
          >
            <Dices className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Dice Skins
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveCategory('player_marker')}
            className={`flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
              activeCategory === 'player_marker'
                ? 'bg-[var(--color-indigo)] text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
            }`}
          >
            <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Player Markers
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Items Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 overflow-y-auto flex-1 py-1">
          {filteredItems.map(item => {
            const owned = purchasedSet.has(item.id) || item.cost === 0;
            const equippedItem = isEquipped(item);
            const canAfford = coinBalance >= item.cost;

            return (
              <div
                key={item.id}
                className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl border flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 transition shadow-sm ${
                  equippedItem
                    ? 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border-2 border-[var(--color-indigo)]'
                    : owned
                    ? 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)]'
                    : 'bg-[var(--card-bg)] border-[var(--border-subtle)] opacity-90'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  {/* Item Color Preview Pill */}
                  <div 
                    className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shadow-inner flex-shrink-0 border border-black/10 dark:border-white/20"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: item.previewBg, color: item.previewAccent }}
                  >
                    <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] text-xs truncate">{item.name}</h4>
                      {equippedItem && (
                        <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-[var(--color-indigo)] text-white text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider">
                          EQUIPPED
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] mt-0.5 line-clamp-2">
                      {item.description}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] pt-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    {owned ? (
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[var(--color-emerald)] flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Owned
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[var(--color-amber)] flex items-center gap-1 font-mono">
                        <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--color-amber)]" />
                        {item.cost} Coins
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {owned ? (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onEquipItem(item.type, item.id)}
                      disabled={equippedItem}
                      className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer active:scale-95 ${
                        equippedItem
                          ? 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-muted)] cursor-default'
                          : 'bg-[var(--color-indigo)] hover:bg-[var(--color-indigo-hover)] text-white shadow-sm'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {equippedItem ? 'Equipped' : 'Equip'}
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onPurchaseItem(item)}
                      disabled={!canAfford}
                      className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer active:scale-95 ${
                        canAfford
                          ? 'bg-[var(--color-amber)] hover:opacity-90 text-white shadow-sm'
                          : 'bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-[var(--text-muted)] cursor-not-allowed'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {!canAfford && <Lock className="w-3 h-3" />}
                      Buy
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="pt-3 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] flex justify-between items-center text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          <span>Earn coins by rolling dice, solving challenges, and climbing ladders!</span>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--card-secondary-bg)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            Close
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


================================================================================
SECTION: 10. Game Engine & State Management
Description: Central game state hook and deterministic engines for movement, economy, energy abilities, achievements, adaptive mastery, error cognitive profiling, spaced repetition, sound synthesis, and local storage persistence
================================================================================
============================================================
FILE: src/hooks/useGameState.ts
============================================================

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';
import { 
  loadGameState, 
  saveGameState, 
  resetGameStorage, 
  PersistentGameState 
} from '../engine/storage';
import { 
  rollDice, 
  computeMovementPlan, 
  MovementPlan 
} from '../engine/gameEngine';
import { sound } from '../engine/soundEngine';
import { ChallengeRegistry } from '../data/challenges';
import { SQUARE_MAP, CURRICULUM_100 } from '../data/curriculum100';
import { Challenge, ChallengeAttemptResult } from '../types/challenge';
import { recordChallengeAttempt } from '../engine/adaptiveEngine';
import { scheduleTopicRevision } from '../engine/spacedRevision';
import { AutoplaySpeed, GamePhase } from '../types/game';
import { 
  calculateLevelInfo, 
  calculateCorrectMovement, 
  calculateIncorrectPenalty, 
  calculateEconomyReward 
} from '../engine/economyEngine';
import { evaluateAchievements } from '../engine/achievementEngine';
import { CosmeticItem, CosmeticType, MovementNotification } from '../types/rewards';
import { SNAKE_MAP, LADDER_MAP } from '../data/snakesAndLadders';

// Evolution Imports
import { 
  RouteType, 
  RouteOption, 
  IntelligentSnake, 
  SnakeRecoveryChoice, 
  OptimizationLadderChoice, 
  BossBattle, 
  BugBotScenario, 
  BoardMutationEvent, 
  EnergyAbility 
} from '../types/evolution';
import { INTELLIGENT_SNAKE_MAP } from '../data/intelligentSnakes';
import { OPTIMIZATION_LADDER_MAP } from '../data/optimizationLadders';
import { DECISION_TILE_MAP, evaluateRouteAvailability } from '../data/routeSelection';
import { BOSS_BATTLES } from '../data/bossBattles';
import { BOARD_MUTATIONS } from '../data/boardMutations';
import { BUGBOT_SCENARIOS } from '../data/bugBotScenarios';
import { updateTopicMastery, normalizeDsaTopic } from '../engine/masteryEngine';
import { generatePersonalizedFinalBoss } from '../engine/personalizedBossEngine';
import { addEnergy, consumeEnergy } from '../engine/energyEngine';
import { createMisconceptionRecord, generateEchoChallenge } from '../engine/futureEchoEngine';

export function useGameState() {
  const [gameState, setGameState] = useState<PersistentGameState>(() => loadGameState());
  const [displayedPosition, setDisplayedPosition] = useState<number>(() => gameState.currentPosition);
  const [gamePhase, setGamePhase] = useState<GamePhase>('IDLE');
  const [isRolling, setIsRolling] = useState(false);
  const [isMoving, setIsMoving] = useState(false);
  const [lastDiceRoll, setLastDiceRoll] = useState<number>(3);
  const eventQueueRef = useRef<Array<() => void>>([]);
  
  // Standard Modals
  const [activeChallenge, setActiveChallenge] = useState<Challenge | null>(null);
  const [isChallengeOpen, setIsChallengeOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isResetModalOpen, setIsResetModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isRevisionModalOpen, setIsRevisionModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isAdaptiveModalOpen, setIsAdaptiveModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isSettingsModalOpen, setIsSettingsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isVictoryModalOpen, setIsVictoryModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isShopModalOpen, setIsShopModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isAchievementsModalOpen, setIsAchievementsModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // Evolution Modals & State
  const [isRouteModalOpen, setIsRouteModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [currentDecisionTile, setCurrentDecisionTile] = useState<number>(15);
  const [availableRouteOptions, setAvailableRouteOptions] = useState<RouteOption[]>([]);

  const [activeIntelligentSnake, setActiveIntelligentSnake] = useState<IntelligentSnake | null>(null);
  const [isSnakeRecoveryModalOpen, setIsSnakeRecoveryModalOpen] = useState(false);

  const [activeOptimizationLadder, setActiveOptimizationLadder] = useState<OptimizationLadderChoice | null>(null);
  const [isLadderChoiceModalOpen, setIsLadderChoiceModalOpen] = useState(false);

  const [activeBossBattle, setActiveBossBattle] = useState<BossBattle | null>(null);
  const [isBossModalOpen, setIsBossModalOpen] = useState(false);

  const [activeBugBotScenario, setActiveBugBotScenario] = useState<BugBotScenario | null>(null);
  const [isBugBotModalOpen, setIsBugBotModalOpen] = useState(false);

  const [activeMutation, setActiveMutation] = useState<BoardMutationEvent | null>(null);
  const [isMutationModalOpen, setIsMutationModalOpen] = useState(false);

  const [isMasteryModalOpen, setIsMasteryModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // Floating notifications / toasts
  const [currentNotification, setCurrentNotification] = useState<MovementNotification | null>(null);
  const notificationTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  // Autoplay
  const [isAutoplayRunning, setIsAutoplayRunning] = useState(false);
  const [isAutoplayPaused, setIsAutoplayPaused] = useState(false);
  const [autoplaySpeed, setAutoplaySpeed] = useState<AutoplaySpeed>(1);
  const autoplayTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  // Challenge Registry with anti-repetition tracking
  const challengeRegistryRef = useRef<ChallengeRegistry>(
    new ChallengeRegistry(gameState.learnerProfile.attemptHistory.map(h => h.challengeId))
  );

  const showNotification = useCallback((notif: Omit<MovementNotification, 'id' | 'timestamp'>) => {
    if (notificationTimeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(notificationTimeoutRef.current);
    }
    const fullNotif: MovementNotification = {
      ...notif,
      id: `notif-${Date.now()}`,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    };
    setCurrentNotification(fullNotif);
    notificationTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setCurrentNotification(null);
    }, 3800);
  }, []);

  // Sync sound settings
  useEffect(() => {
    sound.setEnabled(gameState.settings.soundEnabled);
    sound.setVolume(gameState.settings.soundVolume);
  }, [gameState.settings.soundEnabled, gameState.settings.soundVolume]);

  // Sync persistence
  useEffect(() => {
    saveGameState(gameState);
  }, [gameState]);

  // Keep displayedPosition synced when gameState.currentPosition jumps directly
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMoving) {
      setDisplayedPosition(gameState.currentPosition);
    }
  }, [gameState.currentPosition, isMoving]);

  /**
   * Smooth step-by-step tile movement animation (forward or backward)
   */
  const animateStepPath = useCallback((startPos: number, endPos: number, onComplete: () => void, isDemo: boolean = false) => {
    if (startPos === endPos) {
      onComplete();
      return;
    }

    setIsMoving(true);
    const stepDelay = Math.max(90, Math.floor(260 / (isDemo ? autoplaySpeed : 1)));
    const isForward = endPos > startPos;

    let curr = startPos;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      curr = isForward ? curr + 1 : curr - 1;
      setDisplayedPosition(curr);
      sound.playMoveStep();

      if (curr === endPos) {
        clearInterval(interval);
        setIsMoving(false);
        onComplete();
      }
    }, stepDelay);
  }, [autoplaySpeed]);

  /**
   * Evaluates decision tile crossroads
   */
  const triggerDecisionCrossroads = useCallback((tile: number) => {
    const config = DECISION_TILE_MAP.get(tile);
    if (!config) return;

    const evaluated = evaluateRouteAvailability(config, gameState.topicMasteryMap, gameState.energy);
    const optionsArray: RouteOption[] = [evaluated.knowledge, evaluated.challenge, evaluated.risk];

    setCurrentDecisionTile(tile);
    setAvailableRouteOptions(optionsArray);
    setIsRouteModalOpen(true);
  }, [gameState.topicMasteryMap, gameState.energy]);

  /**
   * Checks and triggers Regional Boss Battle (dynamically personalized at Tile 100)
   */
  const checkBossBattle = useCallback((tile: number): boolean => {
    const boss = BOSS_BATTLES.find(b => b.tileNumber === tile);
    if (boss && !gameState.defeatedBosses.includes(tile)) {
      if (tile === 100) {
        const personalized = generatePersonalizedFinalBoss(gameState.topicMasteryMap, gameState.learnerProfile);
        setActiveBossBattle(personalized);
      } else {
        setActiveBossBattle(boss);
      }
      setIsBossModalOpen(true);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }, [gameState.defeatedBosses, gameState.topicMasteryMap, gameState.learnerProfile]);

  /**
   * Checks and triggers Board Mutation every 5 turns
   */
  const checkBoardMutation = useCallback((turnCount: number): boolean => {
    const mutation = BOARD_MUTATIONS.find(m => m.triggerTurn === turnCount);
    if (mutation && !gameState.completedMutations.includes(mutation.id)) {
      setActiveMutation(mutation);
      setIsMutationModalOpen(true);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }, [gameState.completedMutations]);

  /**
   * Checks Future Echo return challenge
   */
  const checkFutureEcho = useCallback((tile: number): Challenge | null => {
    const echoIndex = gameState.futureEchoes.findIndex(e => e.active && e.scheduledTile === tile);
    if (echoIndex !== -1) {
      const echo = gameState.futureEchoes[echoIndex];
      showNotification({
        type: 'recovery',
        title: 'FUTURE ECHO RETURNS!',
        subtitle: `A past misconception in ${echo.originalTopic} resurfaces for mastery redemption!`
      });
      return echo.challenge;
    }
    return null;
  }, [gameState.futureEchoes, showNotification]);

  /**
   * Sequential Event Queue Processor to prevent overlapping modals
   */
  const processNextEvent = useCallback(() => {
    if (eventQueueRef.current.length > 0) {
      const nextEvent = eventQueueRef.current.shift();
      if (nextEvent) {
        nextEvent();
      }
    } else {
      if (gameState.currentPosition >= 100) {
        if (gameState.defeatedBosses.includes(100)) {
          sound.playStageComplete();
          confetti({ particleCount: 100, spread: 100, origin: { y: 0.6 } });
          setIsVictoryModalOpen(true);
          setGamePhase('VICTORY');
        } else {
          const finalBoss = BOSS_BATTLES.find(b => b.tileNumber === 100);
          if (finalBoss) {
            const personalized = generatePersonalizedFinalBoss(gameState.topicMasteryMap, gameState.learnerProfile);
            setActiveBossBattle(personalized);
            setIsBossModalOpen(true);
            setGamePhase('EVENT');
          } else {
            sound.playStageComplete();
            confetti({ particleCount: 100, spread: 100, origin: { y: 0.6 } });
            setIsVictoryModalOpen(true);
            setGamePhase('VICTORY');
          }
        }
      } else {
        setGamePhase('IDLE');
      }
    }
  }, [gameState.currentPosition, gameState.defeatedBosses]);

  /**
   * Main player dice roll handler
   */
  const handleRollDice = useCallback(() => {
    if (gamePhase !== 'IDLE' || isRolling || isMoving || isAutoplayRunning) return;

    setIsRolling(true);
    setGamePhase('ROLLING');
    sound.playDiceRoll();

    const rollValue = rollDice();
    setLastDiceRoll(rollValue);

    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsRolling(false);
      setGamePhase('MOVING');
      setIsMoving(true);

      const passedSet = new Set(gameState.passedCheckpoints);
      const plan = computeMovementPlan(gameState.currentPosition, rollValue, passedSet);
      const landingTile = plan.targetSquareBeforeTransitions;

      if (plan.overshotTarget) {
        sound.playFailure();
        showNotification({
          type: 'penalty',
          title: 'ROLL EXCEEDS FINISH!',
          subtitle: plan.overshotExplanation || `Exact roll required to reach Tile 100.`
        });
      }

      // Execute primary dice roll movement
      animateStepPath(gameState.currentPosition, landingTile, () => {
        setIsMoving(false);
        setGamePhase('LANDING');
        const newTurns = gameState.turnsCompleted + 1;

        setGameState(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          currentPosition: landingTile,
          turnsCompleted: newTurns,
          completedSquares: Array.from(new Set([...prev.completedSquares, landingTile]))
        }));

        // Build sequential event queue for this landing tile
        const events: Array<() => void> = [];

        // 1. Check for Regional Boss Encounter
        const boss = BOSS_BATTLES.find(b => b.tileNumber === landingTile);
        const hasBoss = boss && !gameState.defeatedBosses.includes(landingTile);
        if (hasBoss) {
          events.push(() => {
            if (landingTile === 100) {
              const personalized = generatePersonalizedFinalBoss(gameState.topicMasteryMap, gameState.learnerProfile);
              setActiveBossBattle(personalized);
            } else {
              setActiveBossBattle(boss);
            }
            setIsBossModalOpen(true);
            setGamePhase('EVENT');
          });
        }

        // 2. Check for Intelligent Snake
        const intelligentSnake = INTELLIGENT_SNAKE_MAP.get(landingTile);
        if (intelligentSnake) {
          if (gameState.activeShield) {
            sound.playSuccess();
            showNotification({
              type: 'bonus',
              title: 'INVARIANT SHIELD DEFLECTED TRAP!',
              subtitle: `Absorbed ${intelligentSnake.name}! You remain safely at Tile ${landingTile}.`
            });
            setGameState(prev => ({
              ...prev,
              activeShield: false,
              snakesEncountered: prev.snakesEncountered + 1
            }));
          } else {
            events.push(() => {
              setActiveIntelligentSnake(intelligentSnake);
              setIsSnakeRecoveryModalOpen(true);
              setGameState(prev => ({
                ...prev,
                snakesEncountered: prev.snakesEncountered + 1
              }));
              setGamePhase('EVENT');
            });
          }
        }

        // 3. Check for Optimization Ladder
        const optimizationLadder = OPTIMIZATION_LADDER_MAP.get(landingTile);
        if (optimizationLadder) {
          events.push(() => {
            setActiveOptimizationLadder(optimizationLadder);
            setIsLadderChoiceModalOpen(true);
            setGameState(prev => ({
              ...prev,
              laddersClimbed: prev.laddersClimbed + 1
            }));
            setGamePhase('EVENT');
          });
        }

        // 4. Check for Decision Crossroads Tile (15, 30, 60, 75)
        if (DECISION_TILE_MAP.has(landingTile) && gameState.activeRouteTile !== landingTile) {
          events.push(() => {
            triggerDecisionCrossroads(landingTile);
            setGamePhase('EVENT');
          });
        }

        // 5. Check for Turn-based Board Mutation
        const mutation = BOARD_MUTATIONS.find(m => m.triggerTurn === newTurns);
        if (mutation && !gameState.completedMutations.includes(mutation.id)) {
          events.push(() => {
            setActiveMutation(mutation);
            setIsMutationModalOpen(true);
            setGamePhase('EVENT');
          });
        }

        // 6. Check for Future Echo or Standard Challenge
        if (landingTile < 100 && gameState.settings.autoOpenChallenge && !hasBoss) {
          const echoChallenge = checkFutureEcho(landingTile);
          const challenge = echoChallenge || challengeRegistryRef.current.getChallengeForSquare(
            landingTile, 
            true, 
            gameState.settings.difficulty
          );

          events.push(() => {
            setActiveChallenge(challenge);
            setIsChallengeOpen(true);
            setGamePhase('CHALLENGE');
          });
        }

        // 7. Victory / Final Boss Event
        if (landingTile >= 100) {
          events.push(() => {
            if (gameState.defeatedBosses.includes(100)) {
              sound.playStageComplete();
              confetti({ particleCount: 100, spread: 100, origin: { y: 0.6 } });
              setIsVictoryModalOpen(true);
              setGamePhase('VICTORY');
            } else {
              const finalBoss = BOSS_BATTLES.find(b => b.tileNumber === 100);
              if (finalBoss) {
                const personalized = generatePersonalizedFinalBoss(gameState.topicMasteryMap, gameState.learnerProfile);
                setActiveBossBattle(personalized);
                setIsBossModalOpen(true);
                setGamePhase('EVENT');
              }
            }
          });
        }

        eventQueueRef.current = events;
        processNextEvent();
      }, false);
    }, 550);
  }, [
    gamePhase,
    isRolling, 
    isMoving, 
    isAutoplayRunning, 
    gameState.currentPosition, 
    gameState.passedCheckpoints, 
    gameState.activeShield,
    gameState.turnsCompleted,
    gameState.activeRouteTile,
    gameState.settings.autoOpenChallenge, 
    gameState.settings.difficulty,
    gameState.defeatedBosses,
    gameState.completedMutations,
    animateStepPath, 
    checkFutureEcho,
    triggerDecisionCrossroads,
    showNotification,
    processNextEvent
  ]);

  /**
   * Ability trigger handler
   */
  const handleUseAbility = useCallback((abilityId: EnergyAbility['id']) => {
    setGameState(prev => {
      const newEnergy = consumeEnergy(prev.energy, abilityId);
      if (newEnergy === null) {
        showNotification({
          type: 'penalty',
          title: 'INSUFFICIENT ENERGY!',
          subtitle: `You need more algorithm energy to cast this ability.`
        });
        return prev;
      }

      sound.playSuccess();
      const abilityCost = abilityId === 'shield' ? 25 : abilityId === 'second_chance' ? 30 : abilityId === 'debug_scan' ? 20 : abilityId === 'ladder_boost' ? 15 : abilityId === 'reroll' ? 15 : 10;
      const newEnergyUsed = (prev.energyUsed || 0) + abilityCost;

      if (abilityId === 'shield') {
        showNotification({
          type: 'bonus',
          title: 'INVARIANT SHIELD ACTIVATED!',
          subtitle: 'The next snake trap or incorrect penalty will be completely absorbed.'
        });
        return {
          ...prev,
          energy: newEnergy,
          energyUsed: newEnergyUsed,
          activeShield: true
        };
      }

      if (abilityId === 'second_chance') {
        showNotification({
          type: 'bonus',
          title: 'SECOND CHANCE PRIMED!',
          subtitle: 'The next incorrect challenge will grant a free retry without penalty.'
        });
        return {
          ...prev,
          energy: newEnergy,
          energyUsed: newEnergyUsed,
          activeSecondChance: true
        };
      }

      if (abilityId === 'ladder_boost') {
        showNotification({
          type: 'bonus',
          title: 'OPTIMIZATION OVERDRIVE!',
          subtitle: 'The next ladder climbed will grant +2 bonus tiles!'
        });
        return {
          ...prev,
          energy: newEnergy,
          energyUsed: newEnergyUsed,
          activeLadderBoost: true
        };
      }

      if (abilityId === 'reroll') {
        if (gamePhase !== 'IDLE') return prev;
        showNotification({
          type: 'bonus',
          title: 'QUANTUM REROLL!',
          subtitle: 'Rerolling dice to navigate alternate board timeline.'
        });
        setTimeout(() => handleRollDice(), 100);
        return {
          ...prev,
          energy: newEnergy,
          energyUsed: newEnergyUsed
        };
      }

      if (abilityId === 'debug_scan') {
        showNotification({
          type: 'bonus',
          title: 'DEBUG SCAN ACTIVE!',
          subtitle: 'Eliminated one incorrect answer choice from the challenge.'
        });
        return {
          ...prev,
          energy: newEnergy,
          energyUsed: newEnergyUsed
        };
      }

      if (abilityId === 'hint') {
        showNotification({
          type: 'bonus',
          title: 'HINT TIER UNLOCKED!',
          subtitle: 'Deeper algorithmic reasoning and code anchor revealed.'
        });
        return {
          ...prev,
          energy: newEnergy,
          energyUsed: newEnergyUsed
        };
      }

      return {
        ...prev,
        energy: newEnergy,
        energyUsed: newEnergyUsed
      };
    });
  }, [gamePhase, showNotification, handleRollDice]);

  /**
   * Route selection handler
   */
  const handleSelectRoute = useCallback((routeType: RouteType) => {
    setGameState(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      currentRouteType: routeType,
      activeRouteTile: currentDecisionTile
    }));
    setIsRouteModalOpen(false);

    sound.playSuccess();
    showNotification({
      type: 'bonus',
      title: `${routeType.toUpperCase()} ROUTE ENGAGED!`,
      subtitle: `Your path is now calibrated for ${routeType} challenges!`
    });

    setTimeout(() => processNextEvent(), 300);
  }, [currentDecisionTile, showNotification, processNextEvent]);

  /**
   * Snake Recovery choice handler
   */
  const handleSelectSnakeChoice = useCallback((choice: SnakeRecoveryChoice) => {
    if (!activeIntelligentSnake) return;

    const snake = activeIntelligentSnake;
    const finalPos = Math.max(1, snake.to + choice.recoveryDelta);

    setIsSnakeRecoveryModalOpen(false);
    setActiveIntelligentSnake(null);

    if (choice.recoveryDelta > 0) {
      sound.playSuccess();
      showNotification({
        type: 'recovery',
        title: 'TRAP MITIGATED!',
        subtitle: `Demonstrated ${snake.misconceptionType} insight! Landed at Tile ${finalPos} (+${choice.recoveryDelta} tiles saved).`
      });
    } else {
      sound.playSnakeDrop();
      showNotification({
        type: 'snake',
        title: 'SNAKE SLIDE ACCEPTED',
        subtitle: `Slid down to Tile ${finalPos}. Analyze the code snippet for future avoidance.`
      });
    }

    animateStepPath(snake.from, finalPos, () => {
      setGameState(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        currentPosition: finalPos,
        completedSquares: Array.from(new Set([...prev.completedSquares, finalPos]))
      }));
      setTimeout(() => processNextEvent(), 200);
    });
  }, [activeIntelligentSnake, animateStepPath, showNotification, processNextEvent]);

  /**
   * Ladder Choice handler (Safe vs Expert)
   */
  const handleSelectLadderOption = useCallback((option: 'safe' | 'expert') => {
    if (!activeOptimizationLadder) return;

    const ladder = activeOptimizationLadder;
    const boostBonus = gameState.activeLadderBoost ? 2 : 0;
    const targetTile = option === 'safe'
      ? Math.min(100, ladder.safeOption.destinationTile + boostBonus)
      : Math.min(100, ladder.expertOption.destinationTile + boostBonus);

    setIsLadderChoiceModalOpen(false);
    setActiveOptimizationLadder(null);

    sound.playLadderClimb();
    confetti({ particleCount: 45, spread: 70, origin: { y: 0.7 } });

    showNotification({
      type: 'ladder',
      title: option === 'expert' ? 'EXPERT LADDER ASCENDED!' : 'SAFE LADDER CLIMBED!',
      subtitle: `Ascended to Tile ${targetTile}! (+${targetTile - ladder.from} tiles gained)`
    });

    animateStepPath(ladder.from, targetTile, () => {
      setGameState(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        currentPosition: targetTile,
        activeLadderBoost: false,
        energy: addEnergy(prev.energy, option === 'expert' ? 3 : 1),
        completedSquares: Array.from(new Set([...prev.completedSquares, targetTile]))
      }));
      setTimeout(() => processNextEvent(), 200);
    });
  }, [activeOptimizationLadder, gameState.activeLadderBoost, animateStepPath, showNotification, processNextEvent]);

  /**
   * Boss Battle Victory
   */
  const handleBossVictory = useCallback((tileNumber: number, xp: number, coins: number, energy: number) => {
    sound.playStageComplete();
    confetti({ particleCount: 90, spread: 90, origin: { y: 0.6 } });

    showNotification({
      type: 'achievement',
      title: 'REGIONAL BOSS VANQUISHED!',
      subtitle: `Mastery proven at Tile ${tileNumber}! (+${xp} XP, +${coins} Coins, +${energy} Energy)`
    });

    setGameState(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      totalScore: prev.totalScore + xp,
      coins: prev.coins + coins,
      energy: addEnergy(prev.energy, energy),
      defeatedBosses: Array.from(new Set([...prev.defeatedBosses, tileNumber]))
    }));

    setIsBossModalOpen(false);
    setActiveBossBattle(null);

    if (tileNumber >= 100) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        sound.playStageComplete();
        confetti({ particleCount: 120, spread: 120, origin: { y: 0.5 } });
        setIsVictoryModalOpen(true);
        setGamePhase('VICTORY');
      }, 400);
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => processNextEvent(), 300);
    }
  }, [showNotification, processNextEvent]);

  /**
   * BugBot Rival Victory
   */
  const handleBugBotVictory = useCallback((xp: number, coins: number, energy: number) => {
    sound.playSuccess();
    confetti({ particleCount: 50, spread: 70, origin: { y: 0.6 } });

    showNotification({
      type: 'bonus',
      title: 'BUGBOT DUEL WON!',
      subtitle: `Rival solution refuted! (+${xp} XP, +${coins} Coins, +${energy} Energy)`
    });

    setGameState(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      totalScore: prev.totalScore + xp,
      coins: prev.coins + coins,
      energy: addEnergy(prev.energy, energy)
    }));

    setIsBugBotModalOpen(false);
    setActiveBugBotScenario(null);
    setTimeout(() => processNextEvent(), 300);
  }, [showNotification, processNextEvent]);

  /**
   * Board Mutation Resolution
   */
  const handleResolveMutation = useCallback((isCorrect: boolean, bonusTiles: number, penaltyTiles: number, destination?: number) => {
    if (!activeMutation) return;

    const mutation = activeMutation;
    setIsMutationModalOpen(false);
    setActiveMutation(null);

    setGameState(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      completedMutations: [...prev.completedMutations, mutation.id]
    }));

    const startPos = gameState.currentPosition;
    let targetPos = destination ?? Math.max(1, Math.min(100, startPos + (isCorrect ? bonusTiles : penaltyTiles)));

    if (isCorrect) {
      sound.playSuccess();
      confetti({ particleCount: 35, spread: 60, origin: { y: 0.7 } });
      showNotification({
        type: 'bonus',
        title: 'MUTATION STABILIZED!',
        subtitle: `${mutation.title} resolved! Moving ${bonusTiles > 0 ? `+${bonusTiles} tiles` : 'forward'}.`
      });
      setGameState(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        energy: addEnergy(prev.energy, 2)
      }));
    } else {
      sound.playFailure();
      showNotification({
        type: 'penalty',
        title: 'MUTATION DESTABILIZED!',
        subtitle: `${mutation.title} caused an anomaly. Slide ${penaltyTiles} tiles.`
      });
    }

    animateStepPath(startPos, targetPos, () => {
      setGameState(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        currentPosition: targetPos,
        completedSquares: Array.from(new Set([...prev.completedSquares, targetPos]))
      }));
      setTimeout(() => processNextEvent(), 200);
    });
  }, [activeMutation, gameState.currentPosition, animateStepPath, showNotification, processNextEvent]);

  /**
   * Start challenge on current or selected square
   */
  const handleOpenSquareChallenge = useCallback((squareId?: number) => {
    const targetId = squareId ?? gameState.currentPosition;
    const challenge = challengeRegistryRef.current.getChallengeForSquare(targetId);
    setActiveChallenge(challenge);
    setIsChallengeOpen(true);
  }, [gameState.currentPosition]);

  /**
   * Submits challenge answer and executes Answer-Based Movement & Evolution Tracking
   */
  const handleCompleteChallenge = useCallback((
    result: ChallengeAttemptResult, 
    isFirstAttempt: boolean = true, 
    isRecovery: boolean = false, 
    isDemo: boolean = false
  ) => {
    challengeRegistryRef.current.markAttempted(result.challengeId, result.squareId);

    const targetSquare = SQUARE_MAP.get(result.squareId) || CURRICULUM_100[0];
    const isOptimization = targetSquare.type === 'ladder_start';

    // 1. Calculate Economy Rewards (XP and Coins)
    const economy = calculateEconomyReward(
      result.isCorrect,
      targetSquare.difficulty,
      isFirstAttempt,
      isRecovery,
      isOptimization,
      result.hintUsed
    );

    // 2. Calculate Answer-Based Movement with Route Modifiers
    let tilesDelta = 0;
    let notifTitle = '';
    let notifSubtitle = '';

    if (result.isCorrect) {
      sound.playSuccess();
      if (!isDemo) {
        confetti({ particleCount: 25, spread: 50, origin: { y: 0.8 } });
      }

      const rewardCalc = calculateCorrectMovement(targetSquare.difficulty, isFirstAttempt, isRecovery);
      tilesDelta = rewardCalc.tilesDelta;

      // Risk Route bonus
      if (gameState.currentRouteType === 'risk') {
        tilesDelta += 1;
      }

      notifTitle = isRecovery ? 'COMEBACK!' : 'CORRECT ANSWER!';
      notifSubtitle = rewardCalc.explanation;

      showNotification({
        type: isRecovery ? 'recovery' : 'bonus',
        title: notifTitle,
        subtitle: `${notifSubtitle} (+${economy.xpDelta} XP, +${economy.coinsDelta} Coins, +1 ⚡)`,
        tilesDelta
      });
    } else {
      sound.playFailure();
      
      // If shield is active, deflect penalty!
      if (gameState.activeShield) {
        showNotification({
          type: 'bonus',
          title: 'INVARIANT SHIELD ABSORPTION!',
          subtitle: 'Shield absorbed your incorrect answer penalty! No backward slide applied.'
        });
        tilesDelta = 0;
      } else {
        const penaltyCalc = calculateIncorrectPenalty(gameState.consecutiveIncorrect + 1);
        tilesDelta = penaltyCalc.tilesDelta;

        showNotification({
          type: 'penalty',
          title: 'NOT QUITE!',
          subtitle: `${penaltyCalc.explanation} (Slide ${tilesDelta} tiles)`,
          tilesDelta
        });
      }
    }

    // 3. Centralized Movement Resolution
    const startPos = gameState.currentPosition;
    let intendedPos = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, startPos + tilesDelta));

    animateStepPath(startPos, intendedPos, () => {
      const isWin = intendedPos >= 100;
      if (isWin) {
        sound.playStageComplete();
        confetti({ particleCount: 100, spread: 100, origin: { y: 0.6 } });
        setIsVictoryModalOpen(true);
      }

      // 4. Update Evolution Mastery & Future Echo Tracking
      setGameState(prev => {
        const oldLevel = calculateLevelInfo(prev.totalScore).level;
        const newScore = prev.totalScore + (isDemo ? 0 : economy.xpDelta);
        const newCoins = prev.coins + (isDemo ? 0 : economy.coinsDelta);
        const newLevel = calculateLevelInfo(newScore).level;

        // Energy gain
        const energyGained = result.isCorrect ? (prev.currentRouteType === 'risk' ? 2 : 1) : 0;
        const newEnergy = addEnergy(prev.energy, energyGained);

        // Canonical Topic Mastery update
        const canonicalTopic = normalizeDsaTopic(result.topic);
        const currentTopicMastery = prev.topicMasteryMap[canonicalTopic] || {
          topicId: canonicalTopic,
          topicName: canonicalTopic,
          score: 15,
          level: 'novice',
          attempts: 0,
          correctCount: 0,
          incorrectCount: 0,
          firstTryCount: 0,
          hintsUsedCount: 0,
          evidence: [],
          lastUpdated: Date.now()
        };

        const updatedTopicScore = updateTopicMastery(
          currentTopicMastery,
          result.isCorrect,
          targetSquare.difficulty,
          isFirstAttempt,
          isRecovery,
          result.hintUsed
        );

        const newMasteryMap = {
          ...prev.topicMasteryMap,
          [canonicalTopic]: updatedTopicScore
        };

        // Future Echo handling
        const newEchoes = [...prev.futureEchoes];
        const newMisconceptions = [...prev.misconceptions];

        if (!result.isCorrect && !isDemo) {
          const misc = createMisconceptionRecord(
            result.topic,
            result.skillCategory,
            result.challengeId,
            result.feedback || 'Misconception identified',
            result.hintUsed
          );
          newMisconceptions.push(misc);
          newEchoes.push(generateEchoChallenge(misc, intendedPos));
        } else if (result.isCorrect) {
          // Resolve any active echo on this square
          const echoIdx = newEchoes.findIndex(e => e.scheduledTile === result.squareId && e.active);
          if (echoIdx !== -1) {
            newEchoes[echoIdx] = { ...newEchoes[echoIdx], active: false };
          }
        }

        const newStreak = result.isCorrect ? prev.streak + 1 : 0;
        const newLongest = Math.max(prev.longestStreak, newStreak);
        const newRecoveryStreak = isRecovery ? prev.recoveryStreak + 1 : (result.isCorrect ? prev.recoveryStreak : 0);
        const newConsecutiveIncorrect = result.isCorrect ? 0 : prev.consecutiveIncorrect + 1;

        // Learner profile update
        const updatedProfile = recordChallengeAttempt(prev.learnerProfile, result);
        const updatedRevision = scheduleTopicRevision(
          updatedProfile.revisionQueue,
          result.topic,
          result.squareId,
          result.isCorrect
        );
        updatedProfile.revisionQueue = updatedRevision;

        // Achievements check
        const { updatedList, newlyUnlocked } = evaluateAchievements(prev.achievements, {
          totalSolved: updatedProfile.totalCorrect,
          streak: newStreak,
          recoveryCount: newRecoveryStreak,
          arraySolved: updatedProfile.topicMasteries['Arrays']?.correct || 0,
          debugSolved: updatedProfile.attemptHistory.filter(h => h.skillCategory === 'debugging' && h.isCorrect).length,
          optSolved: prev.laddersClimbed,
          complexitySolved: updatedProfile.attemptHistory.filter(h => h.skillCategory === 'complexity' && h.isCorrect).length,
          graphSolved: updatedProfile.topicMasteries['Graphs']?.correct || 0,
          dpSolved: updatedProfile.topicMasteries['Dynamic Programming']?.correct || 0,
          currentTile: intendedPos
        });

        if (newlyUnlocked.length > 0 && !isDemo) {
          sound.playSuccess();
          newlyUnlocked.forEach(ach => {
            showNotification({
              type: 'achievement',
              title: 'ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED!',
              subtitle: `${ach.name}: ${ach.description}`
            });
          });
        }

        const activities = [...prev.recentActivities];
        activities.unshift({
          id: `act-${Date.now()}`,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
          type: 'challenge',
          square: result.squareId,
          title: `${result.isCorrect ? 'Solved' : 'Attempted'}: ${result.topic}`,
          detail: result.isCorrect 
            ? `${tilesDelta > 0 ? `+${tilesDelta} Tiles` : ''} (+${economy.xpDelta} XP, +${economy.coinsDelta} Coins, +${energyGained} ⚡)` 
            : `${tilesDelta} Tiles Penalty (+3 XP, +1 Coin for effort)`,
          scoreDelta: result.isCorrect ? economy.xpDelta : 3
        });

        return {
          ...prev,
          currentPosition: intendedPos,
          completedSquares: Array.from(new Set([...prev.completedSquares, intendedPos])),
          totalScore: newScore,
          coins: newCoins,
          energy: newEnergy,
          activeShield: !result.isCorrect && prev.activeShield ? false : prev.activeShield,
          activeSecondChance: !result.isCorrect && prev.activeSecondChance ? false : prev.activeSecondChance,
          streak: newStreak,
          longestStreak: newLongest,
          recoveryStreak: newRecoveryStreak,
          consecutiveIncorrect: newConsecutiveIncorrect,
          questionsAttempted: (prev.questionsAttempted || 0) + 1,
          questionsCorrect: (prev.questionsCorrect || 0) + (result.isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
          topicMasteryMap: newMasteryMap,
          misconceptions: newMisconceptions,
          futureEchoes: newEchoes,
          achievements: updatedList,
          learnerProfile: updatedProfile,
          recentActivities: activities.slice(0, 30)
        };
      });

      setTimeout(() => processNextEvent(), 200);
    }, isDemo);

    setIsChallengeOpen(false);
    setActiveChallenge(null);
  }, [
    gameState.consecutiveIncorrect, 
    gameState.currentPosition, 
    gameState.currentRouteType,
    gameState.activeShield,
    animateStepPath, 
    showNotification,
    processNextEvent
  ]);

  /**
   * Shop purchase handler
   */
  const handlePurchaseCosmetic = useCallback((item: CosmeticItem) => {
    if (gameState.coins < item.cost) return;

    sound.playSuccess();
    setGameState(prev => {
      if (prev.purchasedCosmetics.includes(item.id)) return prev;

      return {
        ...prev,
        coins: prev.coins - item.cost,
        purchasedCosmetics: [...prev.purchasedCosmetics, item.id]
      };
    });

    showNotification({
      type: 'bonus',
      title: 'PURCHASE SUCCESSFUL!',
      subtitle: `Unlocked ${item.name} for ${item.cost} Coins!`
    });
  }, [gameState.coins, showNotification]);

  /**
   * Equip cosmetic item
   */
  const handleEquipCosmetic = useCallback((type: CosmeticType, itemId: string) => {
    sound.playMoveStep();
    setGameState(prev => {
      const equipped = { ...prev.equippedCosmetics };
      if (type === 'board_theme') equipped.boardTheme = itemId;
      if (type === 'dice_skin') equipped.diceSkin = itemId;
      if (type === 'player_marker') equipped.playerMarker = itemId;

      return {
        ...prev,
        equippedCosmetics: equipped
      };
    });
  }, []);

  /**
   * Autoplay Loop
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAutoplayRunning || isAutoplayPaused || isMoving || isRolling || isChallengeOpen || isRouteModalOpen || isSnakeRecoveryModalOpen || isLadderChoiceModalOpen || isBossModalOpen || isMutationModalOpen) {
      if (autoplayTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(autoplayTimerRef.current);
        autoplayTimerRef.current = null;
      }
      return;
    }

    const intervalMs = Math.max(700, Math.floor(2200 / autoplaySpeed));

    autoplayTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      if (gameState.currentPosition >= 100) {
        setIsAutoplayRunning(false);
        return;
      }

      setIsRolling(true);
      sound.playDiceRoll();
      const rollValue = rollDice();
      setLastDiceRoll(rollValue);

      setTimeout(() => {
        setIsRolling(false);
        const passedSet = new Set(gameState.passedCheckpoints);
        const plan = computeMovementPlan(gameState.currentPosition, rollValue, passedSet);

        animateStepPath(gameState.currentPosition, plan.targetSquareBeforeTransitions, () => {
          const targetSquare = SQUARE_MAP.get(plan.targetSquareBeforeTransitions) || CURRICULUM_100[0];
          const challenge = challengeRegistryRef.current.getChallengeForSquare(targetSquare.id);

          setActiveChallenge(challenge);
          setIsChallengeOpen(true);

          setTimeout(() => {
            handleCompleteChallenge({
              challengeId: challenge.id,
              squareId: targetSquare.id,
              isCorrect: true,
              selectedOptionIndex: challenge.correctOptionIndex ?? 0,
              scoreAwarded: 0,
              timeSpentSeconds: 2,
              hintUsed: false,
              skillCategory: challenge.skillCategory,
              topic: challenge.topic,
              feedback: 'Autoplay demonstration completed'
            }, true, false, true);
          }, Math.max(900, Math.floor(2400 / autoplaySpeed)));
        }, true);
      }, 400);
    }, intervalMs);

    return () => {
      if (autoplayTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(autoplayTimerRef.current);
        autoplayTimerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [
    isAutoplayRunning, 
    isAutoplayPaused, 
    isMoving, 
    isRolling, 
    isChallengeOpen, 
    isRouteModalOpen,
    isSnakeRecoveryModalOpen,
    isLadderChoiceModalOpen,
    isBossModalOpen,
    isMutationModalOpen,
    autoplaySpeed, 
    gameState.currentPosition, 
    gameState.passedCheckpoints, 
    animateStepPath, 
    handleCompleteChallenge
  ]);

  const startAutoplay = useCallback(() => {
    setIsAutoplayRunning(true);
    setIsAutoplayPaused(false);
  }, []);

  const pauseAutoplay = useCallback(() => {
    setIsAutoplayPaused(true);
  }, []);

  const resumeAutoplay = useCallback(() => {
    setIsAutoplayPaused(false);
  }, []);

  const stopAutoplay = useCallback(() => {
    setIsAutoplayRunning(false);
    setIsAutoplayPaused(false);
    if (autoplayTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(autoplayTimerRef.current);
      autoplayTimerRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  const handleResetGame = useCallback(() => {
    stopAutoplay();
    const fresh = resetGameStorage();
    setGameState(fresh);
    setDisplayedPosition(1);
    setIsResetModalOpen(false);
    setIsVictoryModalOpen(false);
    setIsBossModalOpen(false);
    setIsRouteModalOpen(false);
    setIsSnakeRecoveryModalOpen(false);
    setIsLadderChoiceModalOpen(false);
    setIsMutationModalOpen(false);
    challengeRegistryRef.current = new ChallengeRegistry([]);
    sound.playMoveStep();
  }, [stopAutoplay]);

  const updateSettings = useCallback((newSettings: Partial<PersistentGameState['settings']>) => {
    setGameState(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      settings: { ...prev.settings, ...newSettings }
    }));
  }, []);

  const triggerBugBotDuel = useCallback((scenarioIndex: number = 0) => {
    const scenario = BUGBOT_SCENARIOS[scenarioIndex % BUGBOT_SCENARIOS.length];
    setActiveBugBotScenario(scenario);
    setIsBugBotModalOpen(true);
  }, []);

  const handleAwardReward = useCallback((xp: number, coins: number) => {
    sound.playSuccess();
    setGameState(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      totalScore: prev.totalScore + xp,
      coins: prev.coins + coins
    }));
  }, []);

  const handleRecordPracticeMistake = useCallback((topic: string, question: string, _yourAnswer: string, _correctAnswer: string) => {
    setGameState(prev => {
      const historyItem = {
        challengeId: `practice-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
        topic,
        squareId: prev.currentPosition,
        isCorrect: false,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        skillCategory: 'conceptual' as const
      };
      return {
        ...prev,
        learnerProfile: {
          ...prev.learnerProfile,
          totalAttempts: prev.learnerProfile.totalAttempts + 1,
          attemptHistory: [...prev.learnerProfile.attemptHistory, historyItem]
        }
      };
    });
  }, []);

  return {
    gameState,
    displayedPosition,
    gamePhase,
    isRolling,
    isMoving,
    lastDiceRoll,
    activeChallenge,
    isChallengeOpen,
    isResetModalOpen,
    isRevisionModalOpen,
    isAdaptiveModalOpen,
    isSettingsModalOpen,
    isVictoryModalOpen,
    isShopModalOpen,
    isAchievementsModalOpen,
    currentNotification,
    isAutoplayRunning,
    isAutoplayPaused,
    autoplaySpeed,

    // Evolution exports
    isRouteModalOpen,
    currentDecisionTile,
    availableRouteOptions,
    activeIntelligentSnake,
    isSnakeRecoveryModalOpen,
    activeOptimizationLadder,
    isLadderChoiceModalOpen,
    activeBossBattle,
    isBossModalOpen,
    activeBugBotScenario,
    isBugBotModalOpen,
    activeMutation,
    isMutationModalOpen,
    isMasteryModalOpen,

    handleRollDice,
    handleOpenSquareChallenge,
    handleCompleteChallenge,
    handlePurchaseCosmetic,
    handleEquipCosmetic,
    startAutoplay,
    pauseAutoplay,
    resumeAutoplay,
    stopAutoplay,
    setAutoplaySpeed,
    handleResetGame,
    updateSettings,
    handleAwardReward,
    handleRecordPracticeMistake,
    dismissNotification: () => setCurrentNotification(null),

    // Evolution actions
    handleSelectRoute,
    handleUseAbility,
    handleSelectSnakeChoice,
    handleSelectLadderOption,
    handleBossVictory,
    handleBugBotVictory,
    handleResolveMutation,
    triggerBugBotDuel,
    triggerDecisionCrossroads,

    setIsResetModalOpen,
    setIsRevisionModalOpen,
    setIsAdaptiveModalOpen,
    setIsSettingsModalOpen,
    setIsVictoryModalOpen,
    setIsShopModalOpen,
    setIsAchievementsModalOpen,
    setIsChallengeOpen,
    setIsRouteModalOpen,
    setIsSnakeRecoveryModalOpen,
    setIsLadderChoiceModalOpen,
    setIsBossModalOpen,
    setIsBugBotModalOpen,
    setIsMutationModalOpen,
    setIsMasteryModalOpen
  };
}

import { SNAKE_MAP, LADDER_MAP } from '../data/snakesAndLadders';
import { SQUARE_MAP } from '../data/curriculum100';
import { SnakeOrLadder } from '../types/game';

export interface GridCoords {
  gridRow: number; // 0 to 9 (0 is top row 91-100, 9 is bottom row 1-10)
  gridCol: number; // 0 to 9 (0 is left, 9 is right)
}

export interface PercentCoords {
  x: number; // 0 to 100 (%)
  y: number; // 0 to 100 (%)
}

/**
 * Maps 1-100 square ID to 10x10 serpentine grid coordinates.
 * Row 1 (1-10): Left to Right (gridRow 9)
 * Row 2 (11-20): Right to Left (gridRow 8)
 * ...
 * Row 10 (91-100): Right to Left (gridRow 0, 100 at col 0)
 */
export function getSquareGridCoords(squareId: number): GridCoords {
  const clampedId = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, squareId));
  const bottomRow = Math.floor((clampedId - 1) / 10);
  const gridRow = 9 - bottomRow;
  const colInRow = (clampedId - 1) % 10;
  const isEvenBottomRow = bottomRow % 2 === 0;

  const gridCol = isEvenBottomRow ? colInRow : 9 - colInRow;
  return { gridRow, gridCol };
}

/**
 * Returns center coordinates of the square in percentage (0% to 100%)
 */
export function getSquarePercentCoords(squareId: number): PercentCoords {
  const { gridRow, gridCol } = getSquareGridCoords(squareId);
  return {
    x: (gridCol + 0.5) * 10,
    y: (gridRow + 0.5) * 10
  };
}

/**
 * Generate a random die roll between 1 and 6.
 */
export function rollDice(): number {
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1;
}

export interface MovementPlan {
  initialPosition: number;
  diceRoll: number;
  intermediateSteps: number[];
  stoppedAtCheckpoint: boolean;
  checkpointSquareId?: number;
  targetSquareBeforeTransitions: number;
  snakeOrLadderEncountered?: SnakeOrLadder;
  finalPosition: number;
  isGameFinished: boolean;
  overshotTarget?: boolean;
  overshotExplanation?: string;
}

/**
 * Calculates step-by-step movement plan respecting:
 * 1. Step-by-step path
 * 2. Stopping at mandatory checkpoints (cannot skip with high roll)
 * 3. 100 Finish boundaries (exact landing required: rolls exceeding 100 remain in place)
 * 4. Snakes and Ladders transitions
 */
export function computeMovementPlan(
  currentPos: number,
  roll: number,
  passedCheckpoints: Set<number>
): MovementPlan {
  let target = currentPos + roll;
  let isGameFinished = false;
  let overshotTarget = false;
  let overshotExplanation: string | undefined = undefined;

  // Exact landing rule for Tile 100: If roll exceeds 100, player remains in place
  if (target > 100) {
    overshotTarget = true;
    const needed = 100 - currentPos;
    overshotExplanation = `Rolled ${roll}! Exact roll of ${needed} needed to face the Final Titan on Tile 100. Remaining on Tile ${currentPos}.`;
    target = currentPos;
  }

  // Check if any unpassed checkpoint lies strictly between currentPos and target
  let stoppedAtCheckpoint = false;
  let checkpointSquareId: number | undefined = undefined;

  for (let s = currentPos + 1; s <= Math.min(target, 100); s++) {
    const sq = SQUARE_MAP.get(s);
    if (sq && sq.isCheckpoint && !passedCheckpoints.has(s) && s !== target) {
      target = s;
      stoppedAtCheckpoint = true;
      checkpointSquareId = s;
      break;
    }
  }

  // Generate intermediate step sequence for animation
  const intermediateSteps: number[] = [];
  if (target > currentPos) {
    for (let s = currentPos + 1; s <= target; s++) {
      intermediateSteps.push(s);
    }
  } else if (target < currentPos) {
    for (let s = currentPos - 1; s >= target; s--) {
      intermediateSteps.push(s);
    }
  }

  // Check for snake or ladder on target square
  let snakeOrLadderEncountered: SnakeOrLadder | undefined = undefined;
  let finalPos = target;

  const ladder = LADDER_MAP.get(target);
  const snake = SNAKE_MAP.get(target);

  if (ladder) {
    snakeOrLadderEncountered = ladder;
    finalPos = ladder.to;
  } else if (snake) {
    snakeOrLadderEncountered = snake;
    finalPos = snake.to;
  }

  if (finalPos === 100 || target === 100) {
    isGameFinished = true;
  }

  return {
    initialPosition: currentPos,
    diceRoll: roll,
    intermediateSteps,
    stoppedAtCheckpoint,
    checkpointSquareId,
    targetSquareBeforeTransitions: target,
    snakeOrLadderEncountered,
    finalPosition: finalPos,
    isGameFinished,
    overshotTarget,
    overshotExplanation
  };
}

import { LevelInfo, DifficultyLevel } from '../types/rewards';

export const LEVEL_TIERS: { level: number; title: string; minXp: number; maxXp: number }[] = [
  { level: 1, title: 'Beginner Coder', minXp: 0, maxXp: 200 },
  { level: 2, title: 'Array Explorer', minXp: 200, maxXp: 500 },
  { level: 3, title: 'Logic Builder', minXp: 500, maxXp: 1000 },
  { level: 4, title: 'Algorithm Apprentice', minXp: 1000, maxXp: 1800 },
  { level: 5, title: 'Debugging Detective', minXp: 1800, maxXp: 2800 },
  { level: 6, title: 'Data Structure Specialist', minXp: 2800, maxXp: 4000 },
  { level: 7, title: 'Algorithm Strategist', minXp: 4000, maxXp: 5500 },
  { level: 8, title: 'Optimization Expert', minXp: 5500, maxXp: 7200 },
  { level: 9, title: 'Graph Master', minXp: 7200, maxXp: 9200 },
  { level: 10, title: 'DSA Grandmaster', minXp: 9200, maxXp: 999999 }
];

export function calculateLevelInfo(totalXp: number): LevelInfo {
  let tier = LEVEL_TIERS[0];
  for (let i = LEVEL_TIERS.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (totalXp >= LEVEL_TIERS[i].minXp) {
      tier = LEVEL_TIERS[i];
      break;
    }
  }

  const isMaxLevel = tier.level === 10;
  const currentLevelXp = totalXp - tier.minXp;
  const span = tier.maxXp - tier.minXp;
  const xpNeededForNext = isMaxLevel ? 0 : Math.max(0, tier.maxXp - totalXp);
  const progressPercent = isMaxLevel ? 100 : Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (currentLevelXp / span) * 100));

  return {
    level: tier.level,
    title: tier.title,
    minXp: tier.minXp,
    maxXp: tier.maxXp,
    progressPercent,
    currentLevelXp,
    xpNeededForNext
  };
}

export interface MovementRewardCalculation {
  tilesDelta: number;
  isRecovery: boolean;
  isFirstAttempt: boolean;
  explanation: string;
  badgeText: string;
}

/**
 * Calculates answer-based forward movement according to specifications:
 * - Easy: +1, Medium: +2, Hard: +3, Expert: +4
 * - First attempt: +1 additional tile
 * - Recovery after error: +1 recovery tile instead of normal difficulty bonus
 */
export function calculateCorrectMovement(
  difficulty: DifficultyLevel,
  isFirstAttempt: boolean,
  isRecovery: boolean
): MovementRewardCalculation {
  if (isRecovery) {
    return {
      tilesDelta: 1,
      isRecovery: true,
      isFirstAttempt: false,
      explanation: 'COMEBACK! You learned from the mistake. +1 RECOVERY TILE!',
      badgeText: '+1 RECOVERY TILE'
    };
  }

  let baseTiles = 1;
  switch (difficulty) {
    case 'easy': baseTiles = 1; break;
    case 'medium': baseTiles = 2; break;
    case 'hard': baseTiles = 3; break;
    case 'expert': baseTiles = 4; break;
  }

  const bonusTiles = isFirstAttempt ? 1 : 0;
  const totalDelta = baseTiles + bonusTiles;

  const badge = isFirstAttempt 
    ? `+${baseTiles} ${difficulty.toUpperCase()} + 1 FIRST-TRY BONUS` 
    : `+${baseTiles} ${difficulty.toUpperCase()} TILES`;

  const explanation = isFirstAttempt 
    ? `CORRECT ANSWER! +${baseTiles} BONUS TILES + FIRST-TRY BONUS!` 
    : `CORRECT ANSWER! +${baseTiles} BONUS TILES!`;

  return {
    tilesDelta: totalDelta,
    isRecovery: false,
    isFirstAttempt,
    explanation,
    badgeText: badge
  };
}

export interface MovementPenaltyCalculation {
  tilesDelta: number; // Negative number
  consecutiveIncorrect: number;
  explanation: string;
  badgeText: string;
}

/**
 * Calculates answer-based backward movement penalty for incorrect attempts:
 * - 1st error: -1 tile
 * - 2nd consecutive error: -2 tiles
 * - 3rd+ consecutive error: -3 tiles
 */
export function calculateIncorrectPenalty(
  consecutiveIncorrect: number
): MovementPenaltyCalculation {
  let penalty = 1;
  if (consecutiveIncorrect === 1) {
    penalty = 1;
  } else if (consecutiveIncorrect === 2) {
    penalty = 2;
  } else {
    penalty = 3;
  }

  return {
    tilesDelta: -penalty,
    consecutiveIncorrect,
    explanation: `NOT QUITE! -${penalty} TILE${penalty > 1 ? 'S' : ''}. REVIEW THE EXPLANATION AND TRY AGAIN.`,
    badgeText: `-${penalty} TILE${penalty > 1 ? 'S' : ''} PENALTY`
  };
}

export interface EconomyRewardResult {
  xpDelta: number;
  coinsDelta: number;
  explanation: string;
}

/**
 * Centralized XP and Coins Reward calculation
 */
export function calculateEconomyReward(
  isCorrect: boolean,
  difficulty: DifficultyLevel,
  isFirstAttempt: boolean,
  isRecovery: boolean,
  isOptimization: boolean,
  hintUsed: boolean
): EconomyRewardResult {
  if (!isCorrect) {
    // Participation reward for incorrect attempt (+3 XP, +1 coin)
    return {
      xpDelta: 3,
      coinsDelta: 1,
      explanation: '+3 XP and +1 Coin participation reward for effort.'
    };
  }

  if (isRecovery) {
    // Recovery reward: +15 XP, +5 Coins
    return {
      xpDelta: 15,
      coinsDelta: 5,
      explanation: '+15 XP and +5 Coins for recovering from a previous mistake!'
    };
  }

  // Base rewards
  let baseXp = 20;
  let baseCoins = 10;

  switch (difficulty) {
    case 'easy': baseXp = 20; baseCoins = 10; break;
    case 'medium': baseXp = 35; baseCoins = 15; break;
    case 'hard': baseXp = 60; baseCoins = 25; break;
    case 'expert': baseXp = 100; baseCoins = 40; break;
  }

  let bonusXp = 0;
  let bonusCoins = 0;

  if (isFirstAttempt) {
    bonusXp += 10;
    bonusCoins += 5;
  }

  if (isOptimization) {
    bonusXp += 20;
    bonusCoins += 10;
  }

  if (hintUsed) {
    // Slightly reduced bonus if hint was used
    baseXp = Math.max(10, baseXp - 10);
  }

  return {
    xpDelta: baseXp + bonusXp,
    coinsDelta: baseCoins + bonusCoins,
    explanation: `Earned +${baseXp + bonusXp} XP and +${baseCoins + bonusCoins} Coins!`
  };
}

/**
 * Adds energy with boundary clamp [0, MAX_ENERGY].
 */
export function addEnergy(currentEnergy: number, amount: number): number {
  return Math.min(MAX_ENERGY, Math.max(0, currentEnergy + amount));
}

/**
 * Checks if the player has enough energy for an ability.
 */
export function canAffordAbility(currentEnergy: number, abilityId: EnergyAbility['id']): boolean {
  const ability = ENERGY_ABILITIES.find(a => a.id === abilityId);
  if (!ability) return false;
  return currentEnergy >= ability.cost;
}

/**
 * Consumes energy if affordable, returning the new energy balance.
 * Returns null if unaffordable.
 */
export function consumeEnergy(currentEnergy: number, abilityId: EnergyAbility['id']): number | null {
  const ability = ENERGY_ABILITIES.find(a => a.id === abilityId);
  if (!ability || currentEnergy < ability.cost) {
    return null;
  }
  return currentEnergy - ability.cost;
}

export interface AchievementEvaluationContext {
  totalSolved: number;
  streak: number;
  recoveryCount: number;
  arraySolved: number;
  debugSolved: number;
  optSolved: number;
  complexitySolved: number;
  graphSolved: number;
  dpSolved: number;
  currentTile: number;
}

/**
 * Checks all achievement conditions against the player's cumulative stats.
 * Returns updated achievements list and array of newly unlocked achievements.
 */
export function evaluateAchievements(
  currentAchievements: Achievement[],
  context: AchievementEvaluationContext
): { updatedList: Achievement[]; newlyUnlocked: Achievement[] } {
  const newlyUnlocked: Achievement[] = [];

  const updatedList = currentAchievements.map(ach => {
    let progress = ach.progress;
    let unlocked = ach.unlocked;

    switch (ach.id) {
      case 'first_steps':
        progress = Math.min(1, context.totalSolved);
        break;
      case 'array_explorer':
        progress = Math.min(3, context.arraySolved);
        break;
      case 'debugging_detective':
        progress = Math.min(2, context.debugSolved);
        break;
      case 'optimization_master':
        progress = Math.min(2, context.optSolved);
        break;
      case 'complexity_analyst':
        progress = Math.min(1, context.complexitySolved);
        break;
      case 'comeback_champion':
        progress = Math.min(2, context.recoveryCount);
        break;
      case 'graph_navigator':
        progress = Math.min(2, context.graphSolved);
        break;
      case 'dp_strategist':
        progress = Math.min(2, context.dpSolved);
        break;
      case 'consistent_learner':
        progress = Math.min(5, context.streak);
        break;
      case 'board_champion':
        progress = context.currentTile >= 100 ? 1 : 0;
        break;
    }

    if (!unlocked && progress >= ach.maxProgress) {
      unlocked = true;
      const unlockedItem = {
        ...ach,
        progress,
        unlocked: true,
        unlockedAt: Date.now()
      };
      newlyUnlocked.push(unlockedItem);
      return unlockedItem;
    }

    return {
      ...ach,
      progress,
      unlocked
    };
  });

  return { updatedList, newlyUnlocked };
}

import { LearnerProfile, TopicMasteryRecord, AdaptiveRecommendation, SkillMasteryRecord } from '../types/learner';
import { ChallengeAttemptResult, SkillCategory } from '../types/challenge';
import { CURRICULUM_100, SQUARE_MAP } from '../data/curriculum100';

const DEFAULT_SKILLS: Record<SkillCategory, SkillMasteryRecord> = {
  conceptual: { attempts: 0, correct: 0, incorrect: 0, accuracy: 1, level: 'novice' },
  tracing: { attempts: 0, correct: 0, incorrect: 0, accuracy: 1, level: 'novice' },
  dry_run: { attempts: 0, correct: 0, incorrect: 0, accuracy: 1, level: 'novice' },
  implementation: { attempts: 0, correct: 0, incorrect: 0, accuracy: 1, level: 'novice' },
  complexity: { attempts: 0, correct: 0, incorrect: 0, accuracy: 1, level: 'novice' },
  optimization: { attempts: 0, correct: 0, incorrect: 0, accuracy: 1, level: 'novice' },
  debugging: { attempts: 0, correct: 0, incorrect: 0, accuracy: 1, level: 'novice' },
  numerical: { attempts: 0, correct: 0, incorrect: 0, accuracy: 1, level: 'novice' },
  compare_approaches: { attempts: 0, correct: 0, incorrect: 0, accuracy: 1, level: 'novice' },
  code_trace: { attempts: 0, correct: 0, incorrect: 0, accuracy: 1, level: 'novice' }
};

export function createInitialLearnerProfile(userId: string = 'guest-dev', displayName: string = 'Developer'): LearnerProfile {
  return {
    userId,
    displayName,
    level: 1,
    totalXp: 0,
    totalAttempts: 0,
    totalCorrect: 0,
    overallAccuracy: 1,
    laddersClimbed: 0,
    snakesEncountered: 0,
    checkpointsPassed: 0,
    topicMasteries: {},
    revisionQueue: [],
    recentRecommendations: [],
    attemptHistory: []
  };
}

export function evaluateSkillLevel(attempts: number, accuracy: number): SkillMasteryRecord['level'] {
  if (attempts < 2) return 'novice';
  if (accuracy >= 0.85 && attempts >= 4) return 'mastered';
  if (accuracy >= 0.65) return 'proficient';
  return 'learning';
}

/**
 * Updates learner profile deterministically upon completing an assessment attempt.
 */
export function recordChallengeAttempt(
  profile: LearnerProfile,
  attempt: ChallengeAttemptResult
): LearnerProfile {
  const updated = { ...profile };
  const topicId = attempt.topic;

  // 1. Overall stats
  updated.totalAttempts += 1;
  if (attempt.isCorrect) {
    updated.totalCorrect += 1;
    updated.totalXp += attempt.scoreAwarded;
  }
  updated.overallAccuracy = updated.totalCorrect / updated.totalAttempts;
  updated.level = Math.max(1, Math.floor(updated.totalXp / 150) + 1);

  // 2. Topic stats
  const existingTopic: TopicMasteryRecord = updated.topicMasteries[topicId] || {
    topicId,
    topicName: topicId,
    attempts: 0,
    correct: 0,
    incorrect: 0,
    accuracy: 1,
    lastPracticed: Date.now(),
    streak: 0,
    commonErrors: [],
    skills: { ...DEFAULT_SKILLS }
  };

  const newTopicAttempts = existingTopic.attempts + 1;
  const newTopicCorrect = existingTopic.correct + (attempt.isCorrect ? 1 : 0);
  const newTopicIncorrect = existingTopic.incorrect + (attempt.isCorrect ? 0 : 1);
  const newTopicAccuracy = newTopicCorrect / newTopicAttempts;
  const newStreak = attempt.isCorrect ? existingTopic.streak + 1 : 0;

  // Update specific skill
  const skill = attempt.skillCategory;
  const existingSkill = existingTopic.skills[skill] || { attempts: 0, correct: 0, incorrect: 0, accuracy: 1, level: 'novice' };
  const newSkillAttempts = existingSkill.attempts + 1;
  const newSkillCorrect = existingSkill.correct + (attempt.isCorrect ? 1 : 0);
  const newSkillIncorrect = existingSkill.incorrect + (attempt.isCorrect ? 0 : 1);
  const newSkillAccuracy = newSkillCorrect / newSkillAttempts;
  const newSkillLevel = evaluateSkillLevel(newSkillAttempts, newSkillAccuracy);

  const updatedSkills = {
    ...existingTopic.skills,
    [skill]: {
      attempts: newSkillAttempts,
      correct: newSkillCorrect,
      incorrect: newSkillIncorrect,
      accuracy: newSkillAccuracy,
      level: newSkillLevel
    }
  };

  const commonErrors = [...existingTopic.commonErrors];
  if (!attempt.isCorrect && attempt.feedback && !commonErrors.includes(attempt.feedback)) {
    commonErrors.push(attempt.feedback);
    if (commonErrors.length > 5) commonErrors.shift();
  }

  updated.topicMasteries = {
    ...updated.topicMasteries,
    [topicId]: {
      ...existingTopic,
      attempts: newTopicAttempts,
      correct: newTopicCorrect,
      incorrect: newTopicIncorrect,
      accuracy: newTopicAccuracy,
      lastPracticed: Date.now(),
      streak: newStreak,
      commonErrors,
      skills: updatedSkills
    }
  };

  // 3. Append to attempt history
  updated.attemptHistory = [
    {
      challengeId: attempt.challengeId,
      topic: attempt.topic,
      squareId: attempt.squareId,
      isCorrect: attempt.isCorrect,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      skillCategory: attempt.skillCategory
    },
    ...updated.attemptHistory.slice(0, 49) // retain last 50 attempts
  ];

  // 4. Generate Explainable Recommendations
  updated.recentRecommendations = generateAdaptiveRecommendations(updated);

  return updated;
}

/**
 * Produces explainable recommendations based on learner strengths and diagnosed weaknesses.
 */
export function generateAdaptiveRecommendations(profile: LearnerProfile): AdaptiveRecommendation[] {
  const recommendations: AdaptiveRecommendation[] = [];

  // Check for skill weaknesses
  for (const [topicId, topicRecord] of Object.entries(profile.topicMasteries)) {
    for (const [skillKey, skillRecord] of Object.entries(topicRecord.skills)) {
      const skill = skillKey as SkillCategory;
      if (skillRecord.attempts >= 2 && skillRecord.accuracy < 0.6) {
        // Find matching square in curriculum
        const targetSquare = CURRICULUM_100.find(s => s.topic === topicId) || CURRICULUM_100[0];
        
        let headline = `Remediate ${skill.toUpperCase()} in ${topicId}`;
        let explanation = `Recommended because your recent accuracy in ${skill} is ${(skillRecord.accuracy * 100).toFixed(0)}% across ${skillRecord.attempts} attempts.`;
        let action = `Complete a targeted ${skill} dry-run exercise on Square ${targetSquare.id}.`;

        if (skill === 'debugging') {
          headline = `Debug Edge-Cases in ${topicId}`;
          explanation = `Recommended because you stumbled on edge-case conditions in your recent ${topicId} debugging attempts.`;
          action = `Review loop boundary invariants on Square ${targetSquare.id}.`;
        } else if (skill === 'complexity') {
          headline = `Strengthen Asymptotic Complexity in ${topicId}`;
          explanation = `Recommended because algorithm implementation succeeded, but Big-O complexity analysis was incorrect.`;
          action = `Practice Big-O summation and call stack space analysis on Square ${targetSquare.id}.`;
        }

        recommendations.push({
          id: `rec-${topicId}-${skill}-${Date.now()}`,
          type: 'weakness_remediation',
          topicId,
          topicName: topicId,
          targetSquareId: targetSquare.id,
          targetSkill: skill,
          headline,
          explanation,
          evidence: `${skillRecord.incorrect} errors in ${skillRecord.attempts} recent attempts (${(skillRecord.accuracy * 100).toFixed(0)}% accuracy)`,
          recommendedAction: action,
          timestamp: Date.now()
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // If no weaknesses, recommend advancement
  if (recommendations.length === 0) {
    const highestAttemptedSquare = profile.attemptHistory[0]?.squareId || 1;
    const nextSquareId = Math.min(100, highestAttemptedSquare + 1);
    const nextSquare = SQUARE_MAP.get(nextSquareId) || CURRICULUM_100[0];

    recommendations.push({
      id: `rec-advance-${nextSquareId}`,
      type: 'challenge_advancement',
      topicId: nextSquare.topic,
      topicName: nextSquare.topic,
      targetSquareId: nextSquareId,
      targetSkill: 'implementation',
      headline: `Advance to Square ${nextSquareId}: ${nextSquare.title}`,
      explanation: `Recommended because your overall performance is strong (${(profile.overallAccuracy * 100).toFixed(0)}% accuracy). Ready for higher complexity concepts!`,
      evidence: `Consecutive accurate attempts with stable mastery.`,
      recommendedAction: `Roll the dice and conquer Square ${nextSquareId} (${nextSquare.subtopic}).`,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    });
  }

  return recommendations.slice(0, 3);
}
