import { TopicMasteryScore, MasteryLevel } from '../types/evolution';
import { DifficultyLevel } from '../types/curriculum';

export const DSA_TOPICS = [
  'Arrays and strings',
  'Linked lists',
  'Stacks and queues',
  'Searching and sorting',
  'Hashing',
  'Recursion and backtracking',
  'Trees and heaps',
  'Graphs',
  'Greedy algorithms',
  'Dynamic programming',
  'Time and space complexity'
] as const;

export type DsaTopicName = typeof DSA_TOPICS[number];

/**
 * Maps raw curriculum topics and challenge titles to canonical DSA mastery categories.
 */
export function normalizeDsaTopic(rawTopic: string): DsaTopicName {
  if (!rawTopic) return 'Arrays and strings';
  const lower = rawTopic.toLowerCase();

  if (lower.includes('graph') || lower.includes('bfs') || lower.includes('dfs') || lower.includes('dijkstra') || lower.includes('mst') || lower.includes('network') || lower.includes('topological')) {
    return 'Graphs';
  }
  if (lower.includes('dynamic') || lower.includes('dp') || lower.includes('knapsack') || lower.includes('memoization') || lower.includes('tabulation') || lower.includes('subsequence')) {
    return 'Dynamic programming';
  }
  if (lower.includes('greedy') || lower.includes('interval') || lower.includes('huffman')) {
    return 'Greedy algorithms';
  }
  if (lower.includes('tree') || lower.includes('bst') || lower.includes('heap') || lower.includes('priority') || lower.includes('trie') || lower.includes('segment')) {
    return 'Trees and heaps';
  }
  if (lower.includes('hash') || lower.includes('map') || lower.includes('set') || lower.includes('collision')) {
    return 'Hashing';
  }
  if (lower.includes('recur') || lower.includes('backtrack') || lower.includes('subset') || lower.includes('n-queens')) {
    return 'Recursion and backtracking';
  }
  if (lower.includes('search') || lower.includes('sort') || lower.includes('binary search') || lower.includes('quicksort') || lower.includes('mergesort')) {
    return 'Searching and sorting';
  }
  if (lower.includes('stack') || lower.includes('queue') || lower.includes('deque') || lower.includes('lifo') || lower.includes('fifo')) {
    return 'Stacks and queues';
  }
  if (lower.includes('list') || lower.includes('pointer') || lower.includes('linked') || lower.includes('node')) {
    return 'Linked lists';
  }
  if (lower.includes('complex') || lower.includes('time') || lower.includes('space') || lower.includes('big-o') || lower.includes('asymptot')) {
    return 'Time and space complexity';
  }
  return 'Arrays and strings';
}

export function getInitialMasteryMap(): Record<string, TopicMasteryScore> {
  const map: Record<string, TopicMasteryScore> = {};

  DSA_TOPICS.forEach(topic => {
    map[topic] = {
      topicId: topic,
      topicName: topic,
      score: 15, // Base starting baseline
      level: 'novice',
      attempts: 0,
      correctCount: 0,
      incorrectCount: 0,
      firstTryCount: 0,
      hintsUsedCount: 0,
      evidence: ['Initial topic enrollment.'],
      lastUpdated: Date.now()
    };
  });

  return map;
}

export const createInitialMasteryMap = getInitialMasteryMap;

export function calculateMasteryLevel(score: number): MasteryLevel {
  if (score >= 85) return 'master';
  if (score >= 65) return 'expert';
  if (score >= 40) return 'practitioner';
  return 'novice';
}

/**
 * Updates topic mastery score based on answer correctness, difficulty, hints, and comeback proof.
 * Bounded strictly between 0 and 100.
 */
export function updateTopicMastery(
  current: TopicMasteryScore,
  isCorrect: boolean,
  difficulty: DifficultyLevel,
  isFirstAttempt: boolean,
  isRecovery: boolean,
  hintUsed: boolean
): TopicMasteryScore {
  const attempts = current.attempts + 1;
  const correctCount = current.correctCount + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0);
  const incorrectCount = current.incorrectCount + (isCorrect ? 0 : 1);
  const firstTryCount = current.firstTryCount + (isCorrect && isFirstAttempt ? 1 : 0);
  const hintsUsedCount = current.hintsUsedCount + (hintUsed ? 1 : 0);

  let delta = 0;
  const newEvidence = [...current.evidence];

  if (isCorrect) {
    // Base gain by difficulty
    let baseGain = 8;
    if (difficulty === 'medium') baseGain = 12;
    if (difficulty === 'hard') baseGain = 18;

    // Bonus for first attempt
    if (isFirstAttempt) {
      baseGain += 4;
    }

    // Bonus for recovery after a mistake
    if (isRecovery) {
      baseGain += 8;
      newEvidence.unshift(`Recovered with comeback answer on ${difficulty} challenge.`);
    }

    // Slight reduction if hint was used
    if (hintUsed) {
      baseGain = Math.max(4, baseGain - 4);
    }

    // Anti-inflation scaling: higher scores require more evidence
    if (current.score >= 80) {
      baseGain = Math.round(baseGain * 0.5);
    } else if (current.score >= 60) {
      baseGain = Math.round(baseGain * 0.75);
    }

    delta = baseGain;
    if (isFirstAttempt && !isRecovery) {
      newEvidence.unshift(`Solved ${difficulty} question on first attempt without hints.`);
    }
  } else {
    // Demonstrated misconception: slight decay
    delta = -6;
    newEvidence.unshift(`Misconception demonstrated on ${difficulty} challenge.`);
  }

  const newScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, current.score + delta));
  const newLevel = calculateMasteryLevel(newScore);

  return {
    ...current,
    score: newScore,
    level: newLevel,
    attempts,
    correctCount,
    incorrectCount,
    firstTryCount,
    hintsUsedCount,
    evidence: newEvidence.slice(0, 5), // Keep latest 5 evidence records
    lastUpdated: Date.now()
  };
}

FILE: src/engine/spacedRevision.ts
============================================================

import { RevisionItem } from '../types/learner';
import { SQUARE_MAP } from '../data/curriculum100';

const ONE_DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

/**
 * Updates SM-2 spaced repetition parameters when a topic is reviewed.
 * quality: 0-5 (5 = perfect recall, 3 = remembered with effort, 0 = complete blackout)
 */
export function updateSpacedInterval(item: RevisionItem, quality: number): RevisionItem {
  let { repetitionCount, intervalDays, easeFactor } = item;

  // Update ease factor (SM-2 formula)
  // EF' = EF + (0.1 - (5 - q) * (0.08 + (5 - q) * 0.02))
  easeFactor = Math.max(1.3, easeFactor + (0.1 - (5 - quality) * (0.08 + (5 - quality) * 0.02)));

  if (quality < 3) {
    // Reset repetitions on failure
    repetitionCount = 0;
    intervalDays = 1;
  } else {
    repetitionCount += 1;
    if (repetitionCount === 1) {
      intervalDays = 1;
    } else if (repetitionCount === 2) {
      intervalDays = 3;
    } else {
      intervalDays = Math.round(intervalDays * easeFactor);
    }
  }

  const now = Date.now();
  const nextDueDate = now + intervalDays * ONE_DAY_MS;

  return {
    ...item,
    repetitionCount,
    intervalDays,
    easeFactor,
    lastReviewed: now,
    nextDueDate,
    isDue: false,
    priority: intervalDays <= 2 ? 'high' : intervalDays <= 7 ? 'medium' : 'low'
  };
}

/**
 * Creates or schedules a new topic into the revision queue
 */
export function scheduleTopicRevision(
  queue: RevisionItem[],
  topicId: string,
  squareId: number,
  isCorrect: boolean
): RevisionItem[] {
  const existingIdx = queue.findIndex(item => item.topicId === topicId);
  const quality = isCorrect ? 4 : 1;

  if (existingIdx >= 0) {
    const updatedItem = updateSpacedInterval(queue[existingIdx], quality);
    const updatedQueue = [...queue];
    updatedQueue[existingIdx] = updatedItem;
    return updatedQueue;
  }

  const sq = SQUARE_MAP.get(squareId);
  const topicName = sq?.topic || topicId;

  const newItem: RevisionItem = {
    id: `rev-${topicId}`,
    topicId,
    topicName,
    squareId,
    intervalDays: isCorrect ? 2 : 1,
    repetitionCount: isCorrect ? 1 : 0,
    easeFactor: 2.5,
    nextDueDate: Date.now() + (isCorrect ? 2 : 1) * ONE_DAY_MS,
    lastReviewed: Date.now(),
    isDue: false,
    priority: isCorrect ? 'medium' : 'high'
  };

  return [...queue, newItem];
}

/**
 * Refreshes isDue flags across the queue.
 */
export function getDueRevisionItems(queue: RevisionItem[]): RevisionItem[] {
  const now = Date.now();
  return queue.map(item => ({
    ...item,
    isDue: item.nextDueDate <= now
  })).filter(item => item.isDue);
}

FILE: src/engine/errorDnaEngine.ts

import { LearnerProfile } from '../types/learner';
import { MisconceptionRecord, TopicMasteryScore } from '../types/evolution';
import { DSA_TOPICS } from './masteryEngine';

export type CognitiveErrorCategory = 
  | 'complexity_confusion'
  | 'off_by_one'
  | 'edge_case_neglect'
  | 'data_structure_mismatch'
  | 'recursion_base_case'
  | 'logic_invariant_flaw';

export interface ErrorDnaProfile {
  totalMistakesAnalyzed: number;
  primaryVector: {
    category: CognitiveErrorCategory;
    displayName: string;
    count: number;
    percentage: number;
    description: string;
    remedialFocus: string;
  };
  secondaryVector?: {
    category: CognitiveErrorCategory;
    displayName: string;
    count: number;
    percentage: number;
  };
  categoryBreakdown: Record<CognitiveErrorCategory, { count: number; percentage: number; displayName: string }>;
  learningDebtPercentage: number;
  topicHealthMap: Record<string, 'stable' | 'needs_attention' | 'critical'>;
  recommendedDrills: Array<{
    title: string;
    topic: string;
    targetSquare: number;
    rationale: string;
  }>;
}

const CATEGORY_NAMES: Record<CognitiveErrorCategory, string> = {
  complexity_confusion: 'Asymptotic Complexity Confusion',
  off_by_one: 'Off-By-One & Boundary Bounds',
  edge_case_neglect: 'Edge-Case & Null-Safety Neglect',
  data_structure_mismatch: 'Data Structure Mismatch',
  recursion_base_case: 'Recursion Call Stack & Base Case',
  logic_invariant_flaw: 'Algorithm Invariant & State Flaw'
};

const CATEGORY_DESCRIPTIONS: Record<CognitiveErrorCategory, string> = {
  complexity_confusion: 'Tendency to miscalculate Big-O worst-case vs average-case time, or neglect auxiliary space recursion frames.',
  off_by_one: 'Loop bounds checking (<= vs <, 0 vs 1 indexing, or two-pointer crossover) is the frequent point of failure.',
  edge_case_neglect: 'Submissions succeed on standard inputs but fail empty arrays, single elements, duplicates, or negative bounds.',
  data_structure_mismatch: 'Selecting sub-optimal container types (e.g. array lookup O(N) when hash set O(1) or heap O(log N) was required).',
  recursion_base_case: 'Omitting termination return conditions or causing unnecessary branching stack frame depth.',
  logic_invariant_flaw: 'The core state transition or greedy premise was flawed or failed to preserve loop invariants.'
};

/**
 * Classifies a raw misconception / incorrect attempt into a cognitive error vector.
 */
export function classifyError(topic: string, skill: string, feedback: string): CognitiveErrorCategory {
  const text = `${topic} ${skill} ${feedback}`.toLowerCase();

  if (text.includes('complex') || text.includes('big-o') || text.includes('o(') || text.includes('time') || text.includes('space') || skill === 'complexity') {
    return 'complexity_confusion';
  }
  if (text.includes('bound') || text.includes('off-by-one') || text.includes('index') || text.includes('<=') || text.includes('loop condition')) {
    return 'off_by_one';
  }
  if (text.includes('edge') || text.includes('null') || text.includes('empty') || text.includes('negative') || text.includes('single element')) {
    return 'edge_case_neglect';
  }
  if (text.includes('heap') || text.includes('hash') || text.includes('stack') || text.includes('queue') || text.includes('structure') || text.includes('mismatch')) {
    return 'data_structure_mismatch';
  }
  if (text.includes('recur') || text.includes('base case') || text.includes('stack overflow') || text.includes('frame')) {
    return 'recursion_base_case';
  }
  return 'logic_invariant_flaw';
}

/**
 * Generates an authoritative Error DNA cognitive profile from learner history.
 */
export function generateErrorDnaProfile(
  profile: LearnerProfile,
  misconceptions: MisconceptionRecord[],
  topicMasteryMap: Record<string, TopicMasteryScore>
): ErrorDnaProfile {
  const counts: Record<CognitiveErrorCategory, number> = {
    complexity_confusion: 0,
    off_by_one: 0,
    edge_case_neglect: 0,
    data_structure_mismatch: 0,
    recursion_base_case: 0,
    logic_invariant_flaw: 0
  };

  // 1. Process explicit misconceptions
  misconceptions.forEach(m => {
    const cat = classifyError(m.topic, m.errorCategory, m.explanationShown);
    counts[cat] += 1;
  });

  // 2. Process failed attempts from profile
  const failedAttempts = profile.attemptHistory.filter(h => !h.isCorrect);
  failedAttempts.forEach(h => {
    const cat = classifyError(h.topic, h.skillCategory, '');
    counts[cat] += 1;
  });

  const totalMistakes = Object.values(counts).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

  // If player has made 0 mistakes yet, seed baseline distribution
  if (totalMistakes === 0) {
    counts.complexity_confusion = 1;
    counts.edge_case_neglect = 1;
  }

  const effectiveTotal = Math.max(1, Object.values(counts).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0));

  // Sort categories by frequency
  const sortedCategories = (Object.keys(counts) as CognitiveErrorCategory[]).sort(
    (a, b) => counts[b] - counts[a]
  );

  const primaryCat = sortedCategories[0];
  const secondaryCat = sortedCategories[1];

  const breakdown: ErrorDnaProfile['categoryBreakdown'] = {
    complexity_confusion: { count: counts.complexity_confusion, percentage: Math.round((counts.complexity_confusion / effectiveTotal) * 100), displayName: CATEGORY_NAMES.complexity_confusion },
    off_by_one: { count: counts.off_by_one, percentage: Math.round((counts.off_by_one / effectiveTotal) * 100), displayName: CATEGORY_NAMES.off_by_one },
    edge_case_neglect: { count: counts.edge_case_neglect, percentage: Math.round((counts.edge_case_neglect / effectiveTotal) * 100), displayName: CATEGORY_NAMES.edge_case_neglect },
    data_structure_mismatch: { count: counts.data_structure_mismatch, percentage: Math.round((counts.data_structure_mismatch / effectiveTotal) * 100), displayName: CATEGORY_NAMES.data_structure_mismatch },
    recursion_base_case: { count: counts.recursion_base_case, percentage: Math.round((counts.recursion_base_case / effectiveTotal) * 100), displayName: CATEGORY_NAMES.recursion_base_case },
    logic_invariant_flaw: { count: counts.logic_invariant_flaw, percentage: Math.round((counts.logic_invariant_flaw / effectiveTotal) * 100), displayName: CATEGORY_NAMES.logic_invariant_flaw }
  };

  // 3. Calculate Learning Debt & Topic Health
  let totalMasterySum = 0;
  let topicCount = 0;
  const topicHealthMap: Record<string, 'stable' | 'needs_attention' | 'critical'> = {};

  DSA_TOPICS.forEach(topic => {
    const tm = topicMasteryMap[topic];
    const score = tm?.score ?? 15;
    totalMasterySum += score;
    topicCount += 1;

    if (score >= 70) {
      topicHealthMap[topic] = 'stable';
    } else if (score >= 45) {
      topicHealthMap[topic] = 'needs_attention';
    } else {
      topicHealthMap[topic] = 'critical';
    }
  });

  const averageMastery = topicCount > 0 ? totalMasterySum / topicCount : 15;
  const learningDebtPercentage = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(100 - averageMastery)));

  // 4. Targeted Drills Prescription
  const recommendedDrills = [
    {
      title: `Remediate ${CATEGORY_NAMES[primaryCat]}`,
      topic: 'Algorithms & Complexity',
      targetSquare: primaryCat === 'complexity_confusion' ? 8 : primaryCat === 'off_by_one' ? 14 : 62,
      rationale: `Diagnosed as your #1 cognitive friction vector (${breakdown[primaryCat].percentage}% of errors). Targeted practice strengthens loop bounds and asymptotic reasoning.`
    },
    {
      title: `Defense against ${CATEGORY_NAMES[secondaryCat]}`,
      topic: 'Data Structures',
      targetSquare: secondaryCat === 'edge_case_neglect' ? 22 : 44,
      rationale: `Secondary friction vector (${breakdown[secondaryCat].percentage}% of errors). Review edge cases and container invariants.`
    }
  ];

  return {
    totalMistakesAnalyzed: totalMistakes,
    primaryVector: {
      category: primaryCat,
      displayName: CATEGORY_NAMES[primaryCat],
      count: counts[primaryCat],
      percentage: breakdown[primaryCat].percentage,
      description: CATEGORY_DESCRIPTIONS[primaryCat],
      remedialFocus: `Focus on invariant bounding and systematic dry-running before committing solutions.`
    },
    secondaryVector: {
      category: secondaryCat,
      displayName: CATEGORY_NAMES[secondaryCat],
      count: counts[secondaryCat],
      percentage: breakdown[secondaryCat].percentage
    },
    categoryBreakdown: breakdown,
    learningDebtPercentage,
    topicHealthMap,
    recommendedDrills
  };
}

/**
 * Calculates dynamic Learning Debt & debt status from topic mastery scores and misconceptions.
 */
export function calculateLearningDebt(
  topicMasteryMap: Record<string, TopicMasteryScore>,
  misconceptions: MisconceptionRecord[]
) {
  const topics = Object.values(topicMasteryMap);
  const avg = topics.length > 0
    ? topics.reduce((acc, t) => acc + t.score, 0) / topics.length
    : 15;
  const debtPercentage = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(100 - avg)));
  const totalMisconceptions = misconceptions.length;
  const activeWeakTopics = topics.filter(t => t.score < 50).map(t => t.topicName);

  let debtStatus: 'Minimal' | 'Moderate' | 'High' | 'Critical' = 'Minimal';
  if (debtPercentage > 75) debtStatus = 'Critical';
  else if (debtPercentage > 50) debtStatus = 'High';
  else if (debtPercentage > 25) debtStatus = 'Moderate';

  return {
    debtPercentage,
    totalMisconceptions,
    activeWeakTopics,
    debtStatus
  };
}

class SoundEngine {
  private audioCtx: AudioContext | null = null;
  private enabled: boolean = true;
  private volume: number = 0.6;

  private initCtx() {
    if (!this.audioCtx && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
      if (AudioContextClass) {
        this.audioCtx = new AudioContextClass();
      }
    }
    if (this.audioCtx && this.audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
      this.audioCtx.resume();
    }
  }

  public setEnabled(enabled: boolean) {
    this.enabled = enabled;
  }

  public setVolume(vol: number) {
    this.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, vol));
  }

  public isEnabled(): boolean {
    return this.enabled;
  }

  public playDiceRoll() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.initCtx();
    if (!this.audioCtx) return;

    // Rattle sequence of quick random pitch clicks
    const now = this.audioCtx.currentTime;
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const osc = this.audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.audioCtx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'triangle';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(220 + Math.random() * 260, now + i * 0.04);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2 * this.volume, now + i * 0.04);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + i * 0.04 + 0.03);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.audioCtx.destination);

      osc.start(now + i * 0.04);
      osc.stop(now + i * 0.04 + 0.04);
    }
  }

  public playMoveStep() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.initCtx();
    if (!this.audioCtx) return;

    const now = this.audioCtx.currentTime;
    const osc = this.audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const gain = this.audioCtx.createGain();

    osc.type = 'sine';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(440, now);
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(660, now + 0.08);

    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25 * this.volume, now);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.08);

    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(this.audioCtx.destination);

    osc.start(now);
    osc.stop(now + 0.09);
  }

  public playLadderClimb() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.initCtx();
    if (!this.audioCtx) return;

    const now = this.audioCtx.currentTime;
    // Ascending celebratory arpeggio: C4, E4, G4, C5
    const notes = [261.63, 329.63, 392.00, 523.25, 659.25];
    notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
      if (!this.audioCtx) return;
      const osc = this.audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.audioCtx.createGain();

      osc.type = 'triangle';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now + idx * 0.09);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3 * this.volume, now + idx * 0.09);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + idx * 0.09 + 0.16);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.audioCtx.destination);

      osc.start(now + idx * 0.09);
      osc.stop(now + idx * 0.09 + 0.18);
    });
  }

  public playSnakeDrop() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.initCtx();
    if (!this.audioCtx) return;

    const now = this.audioCtx.currentTime;
    // Descending slithering slide
    const osc = this.audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const gain = this.audioCtx.createGain();

    osc.type = 'sawtooth';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(400, now);
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(90, now + 0.4);

    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25 * this.volume, now);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.4);

    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(this.audioCtx.destination);

    osc.start(now);
    osc.stop(now + 0.42);
  }

  public playSuccess() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.initCtx();
    if (!this.audioCtx) return;

    const now = this.audioCtx.currentTime;
    const notes = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99]; // C5, E5, G5 major triad
    notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
      if (!this.audioCtx) return;
      const osc = this.audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.audioCtx.createGain();

      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now + idx * 0.07);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.28 * this.volume, now + idx * 0.07);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + idx * 0.07 + 0.25);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.audioCtx.destination);

      osc.start(now + idx * 0.07);
      osc.stop(now + idx * 0.07 + 0.28);
    });
  }

  public playFailure() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.initCtx();
    if (!this.audioCtx) return;

    const now = this.audioCtx.currentTime;
    const osc = this.audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const gain = this.audioCtx.createGain();

    osc.type = 'sawtooth';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(180, now);
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(140, now + 0.12);

    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25 * this.volume, now);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.25);

    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(this.audioCtx.destination);

    osc.start(now);
    osc.stop(now + 0.26);
  }

  public playStageComplete() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.initCtx();
    if (!this.audioCtx) return;

    const now = this.audioCtx.currentTime;
    // Victorious fanfare: G4, C5, E5, G5
    const fanfare = [392.00, 523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.50];
    fanfare.forEach((f, i) => {
      if (!this.audioCtx) return;
      const osc = this.audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.audioCtx.createGain();

      osc.type = 'triangle';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(f, now + i * 0.1);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.35 * this.volume, now + i * 0.1);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + i * 0.1 + 0.35);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.audioCtx.destination);

      osc.start(now + i * 0.1);
      osc.stop(now + i * 0.1 + 0.38);
    });
  }
}

export function loadGameState(): PersistentGameState {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return getInitialGameState();

  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_V3) 
      || localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_V2) 
      || localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_V1);

    if (!raw) return getInitialGameState();

    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
      const initial = getInitialGameState();
      const validPosition = typeof parsed.currentPosition === 'number' && !isNaN(parsed.currentPosition)
        ? Math.max(1, Math.min(100, Math.floor(parsed.currentPosition)))
        : initial.currentPosition;

      return {
        ...initial,
        ...parsed,
        version: 3,
        currentPosition: validPosition,
        coins: typeof parsed.coins === 'number' && !isNaN(parsed.coins) ? Math.max(0, parsed.coins) : initial.coins,
        streak: typeof parsed.streak === 'number' && !isNaN(parsed.streak) ? Math.max(0, parsed.streak) : initial.streak,
        longestStreak: typeof parsed.longestStreak === 'number' && !isNaN(parsed.longestStreak) ? Math.max(0, parsed.longestStreak) : initial.longestStreak,
        recoveryStreak: typeof parsed.recoveryStreak === 'number' && !isNaN(parsed.recoveryStreak) ? Math.max(0, parsed.recoveryStreak) : initial.recoveryStreak,
        consecutiveIncorrect: typeof parsed.consecutiveIncorrect === 'number' && !isNaN(parsed.consecutiveIncorrect) ? Math.max(0, parsed.consecutiveIncorrect) : 0,
        achievements: Array.isArray(parsed.achievements) && parsed.achievements.length > 0 
          ? parsed.achievements 
          : initial.achievements,
        purchasedCosmetics: Array.isArray(parsed.purchasedCosmetics) 
          ? parsed.purchasedCosmetics 
          : initial.purchasedCosmetics,
        equippedCosmetics: parsed.equippedCosmetics || initial.equippedCosmetics,
        learnerProfile: {
          ...createInitialLearnerProfile(),
          ...(parsed.learnerProfile || {})
        },
        settings: {
          ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
          ...(parsed.settings || {})
        },
        // Evolution migrations
        topicMasteryMap: parsed.topicMasteryMap && typeof parsed.topicMasteryMap === 'object'
          ? { ...initial.topicMasteryMap, ...parsed.topicMasteryMap }
          : initial.topicMasteryMap,
        energy: typeof parsed.energy === 'number' ? parsed.energy : initial.energy,
        activeShield: Boolean(parsed.activeShield),
        activeSecondChance: Boolean(parsed.activeSecondChance),
        activeLadderBoost: Boolean(parsed.activeLadderBoost),
        misconceptions: Array.isArray(parsed.misconceptions) ? parsed.misconceptions : [],
        futureEchoes: Array.isArray(parsed.futureEchoes) ? parsed.futureEchoes : [],
        turnsCompleted: typeof parsed.turnsCompleted === 'number' ? parsed.turnsCompleted : 0,
        defeatedBosses: Array.isArray(parsed.defeatedBosses) ? parsed.defeatedBosses : [],
        completedMutations: Array.isArray(parsed.completedMutations) ? parsed.completedMutations : [],
        currentRouteType: parsed.currentRouteType || 'knowledge',
        activeRouteTile: parsed.activeRouteTile || null,
        questionsAttempted: typeof parsed.questionsAttempted === 'number' ? parsed.questionsAttempted : 0,
        questionsCorrect: typeof parsed.questionsCorrect === 'number' ? parsed.questionsCorrect : 0,
        energyUsed: typeof parsed.energyUsed === 'number' ? parsed.energyUsed : 0,
      };
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to parse saved game state:', err);
  }

  return getInitialGameState();
}

export function saveGameState(state: PersistentGameState): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_V3, JSON.stringify(state));
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to write to localStorage:', err);
  }
}

export function resetGameStorage(): PersistentGameState {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY_V3);
    localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY_V2);
    localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY_V1);
  }
  return getInitialGameState();
}

/**
 * Searching Algorithms & Complexity Steps (CO3)
 * Linear Search, Binary Search, Jump Search
 */

export interface SearchStep {
  stepIndex: number;
  lowIndex?: number;
  midIndex?: number;
  highIndex?: number;
  currentIndex?: number;
  currentValue?: number;
  explanation: string;
}

/**
 * Linear Search: O(n) worst/avg, O(1) best.
 */
export function linearSearchWithSteps(arr: number[], target: number): { foundIndex: number; steps: SearchStep[] } {
  const steps: SearchStep[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
    steps.push({
      stepIndex: i + 1,
      currentIndex: i,
      currentValue: arr[i],
      explanation: `Checking index ${i}: element is ${arr[i]} (target: ${target})`
    });
    if (arr[i] === target) {
      return { foundIndex: i, steps };
    }
  }
  return { foundIndex: -1, steps };
}

/**
 * Binary Search: O(log n) on sorted array.
 */
export function binarySearchWithSteps(arr: number[], target: number): { foundIndex: number; steps: SearchStep[] } {
  const steps: SearchStep[] = [];
  let low = 0;
  let high = arr.length - 1;
  let stepCount = 1;

  while (low <= high) {
    const mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
    steps.push({
      stepIndex: stepCount++,
      lowIndex: low,
      midIndex: mid,
      highIndex: high,
      currentValue: arr[mid],
      explanation: `Search range [${low}..${high}], calculated mid index ${mid} with value ${arr[mid]}`
    });

    if (arr[mid] === target) {
      return { foundIndex: mid, steps };
    } else if (arr[mid] < target) {
      low = mid + 1;
    } else {
      high = mid - 1;
    }
  }

  return { foundIndex: -1, steps };
}

/**
 * Jump Search: O(sqrt(n)) on sorted array with optimal block size m = floor(sqrt(n)).
 */
export function jumpSearchWithSteps(arr: number[], target: number): { foundIndex: number; steps: SearchStep[] } {
  const steps: SearchStep[] = [];
  const n = arr.length;
  const stepSize = Math.floor(Math.sqrt(n));
  let prev = 0;
  let step = stepSize;
  let stepNum = 1;

  while (step < n && arr[Math.min(step, n) - 1] < target) {
    steps.push({
      stepIndex: stepNum++,
      currentIndex: Math.min(step, n) - 1,
      currentValue: arr[Math.min(step, n) - 1],
      explanation: `Jumping by block size ${stepSize}: checked index ${Math.min(step, n) - 1} (${arr[Math.min(step, n) - 1]} < ${target})`
    });
    prev = step;
    step += stepSize;
  }

  // Linear search within the identified block
  while (prev < Math.min(step, n)) {
    steps.push({
      stepIndex: stepNum++,
      currentIndex: prev,
      currentValue: arr[prev],
      explanation: `Linear scan in block at index ${prev}: value is ${arr[prev]}`
    });
    if (arr[prev] === target) {
      return { foundIndex: prev, steps };
    }
    prev++;
  }

  return { foundIndex: -1, steps };
}

/**
 * Hash Table with Separate Chaining (CO3)
 */
export class HashTableChaining<V = string> {
  private size: number;
  private buckets: Array<Array<{ key: number | string; value: V }>>;

  constructor(size: number = 7) {
    this.size = size;
    this.buckets = Array.from({ length: size }, () => []);
  }

  private hash(key: number | string): number {
    if (typeof key === 'number') {
      return Math.abs(key) % this.size;
    }
    let h = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < key.length; i++) {
      h = (h * 31 + key.charCodeAt(i)) % this.size;
    }
    return h;
  }

  public insert(key: number | string, value: V): void {
    const idx = this.hash(key);
    const bucket = this.buckets[idx];
    const existing = bucket.find(item => item.key === key);
    if (existing) {
      existing.value = value;
    } else {
      bucket.push({ key, value });
    }
  }

  public get(key: number | string): V | null {
    const idx = this.hash(key);
    const item = this.buckets[idx].find(b => b.key === key);
    return item ? item.value : null;
  }

  public getBuckets(): Array<Array<{ key: number | string; value: V }>> {
    return this.buckets;
  }
}

/**
 * Sorting Algorithms with Step Tracing (CO3)
 * Insertion Sort, Counting Sort, Radix Sort, Merge Sort, Quick Sort, Heap Sort
 */

export interface SortStep {
  stepIndex: number;
  arrayState: number[];
  description: string;
  comparedIndices?: [number, number];
  swappedIndices?: [number, number];
}

/**
 * Insertion Sort: O(n^2) worst/avg, O(n) best (nearly sorted).
 */
export function insertionSortWithSteps(arr: number[]): { sorted: number[]; steps: SortStep[] } {
  const a = [...arr];
  const steps: SortStep[] = [];
  steps.push({ stepIndex: 0, arrayState: [...a], description: 'Initial array state' });

  for (let i = 1; i < a.length; i++) {
    const key = a[i];
    let j = i - 1;
    while (j >= 0 && a[j] > key) {
      a[j + 1] = a[j];
      j--;
    }
    a[j + 1] = key;
    steps.push({
      stepIndex: steps.length,
      arrayState: [...a],
      description: `Inserted element ${key} into sorted subarray [0..${i}]`
    });
  }

  return { sorted: a, steps };
}

/**
 * Counting Sort: O(n + k) non-comparison sort for non-negative integers bounded by maxVal.
 */
export function countingSort(arr: number[]): number[] {
  if (arr.length <= 1) return [...arr];
  const max = Math.max(...arr);
  const min = Math.min(...arr);
  const range = max - min + 1;

  const count = new Array(range).fill(0);
  const output = new Array(arr.length);

  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
    count[arr[i] - min]++;
  }

  for (let i = 1; i < range; i++) {
    count[i] += count[i - 1];
  }

  for (let i = arr.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    output[count[arr[i] - min] - 1] = arr[i];
    count[arr[i] - min]--;
  }

  return output;
}

/**
 * Radix Sort: LSD (Least Significant Digit) using Counting Sort as subroutine.
 * Complexity: O(d * (n + b))
 */
export function radixSort(arr: number[]): number[] {
  if (arr.length <= 1) return [...arr];
  const a = [...arr];
  const max = Math.max(...a);

  for (let exp = 1; Math.floor(max / exp) > 0; exp *= 10) {
    const output = new Array(a.length).fill(0);
    const count = new Array(10).fill(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
      const digit = Math.floor(a[i] / exp) % 10;
      count[digit]++;
    }

    for (let i = 1; i < 10; i++) {
      count[i] += count[i - 1];
    }

    for (let i = a.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const digit = Math.floor(a[i] / exp) % 10;
      output[count[digit] - 1] = a[i];
      count[digit]--;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
      a[i] = output[i];
    }
  }

  return a;
}

/**
 * Merge Sort: O(n log n) divide-and-conquer with stable partitioning.
 */
export function mergeSortWithSteps(arr: number[]): { sorted: number[]; steps: SortStep[] } {
  const steps: SortStep[] = [];
  const a = [...arr];
  steps.push({ stepIndex: 0, arrayState: [...a], description: 'Initial array state' });

  function merge(low: number, mid: number, high: number) {
    const left = a.slice(low, mid + 1);
    const right = a.slice(mid + 1, high + 1);
    let i = 0, j = 0, k = low;

    while (i < left.length && j < right.length) {
      if (left[i] <= right[j]) {
        a[k++] = left[i++];
      } else {
        a[k++] = right[j++];
      }
    }
    while (i < left.length) a[k++] = left[i++];
    while (j < right.length) a[k++] = right[j++];

    steps.push({
      stepIndex: steps.length,
      arrayState: [...a],
      description: `Merged subarrays [${low}..${mid}] and [${mid + 1}..${high}]`
    });
  }

  function sort(low: number, high: number) {
    if (low < high) {
      const mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
      sort(low, mid);
      sort(mid + 1, high);
      merge(low, mid, high);
    }
  }

  sort(0, a.length - 1);
  return { sorted: a, steps };
}

/**
 * Quick Sort: O(n log n) average, O(n^2) worst case with Lomuto partition.
 */
export function quickSortWithSteps(arr: number[]): { sorted: number[]; steps: SortStep[] } {
  const steps: SortStep[] = [];
  const a = [...arr];
  steps.push({ stepIndex: 0, arrayState: [...a], description: 'Initial array state' });

  function partition(low: number, high: number): number {
    const pivot = a[high];
    let i = low - 1;
    for (let j = low; j < high; j++) {
      if (a[j] <= pivot) {
        i++;
        [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
      }
    }
    [a[i + 1], a[high]] = [a[high], a[i + 1]];
    steps.push({
      stepIndex: steps.length,
      arrayState: [...a],
      description: `Partitioned around pivot ${pivot} at index ${i + 1}`
    });
    return i + 1;
  }

  function sort(low: number, high: number) {
    if (low < high) {
      const pi = partition(low, high);
      sort(low, pi - 1);
      sort(pi + 1, high);
    }
  }

  sort(0, a.length - 1);
  return { sorted: a, steps };
}

/**
 * Heap Sort: O(n log n) in-place comparison sort using Max-Heap.
 */
export function heapSortWithSteps(arr: number[]): { sorted: number[]; steps: SortStep[] } {
  const steps: SortStep[] = [];
  const a = [...arr];
  steps.push({ stepIndex: 0, arrayState: [...a], description: 'Initial array state' });

  function heapify(n: number, i: number) {
    let largest = i;
    const left = 2 * i + 1;
    const right = 2 * i + 2;

    if (left < n && a[left] > a[largest]) largest = left;
    if (right < n && a[right] > a[largest]) largest = right;

    if (largest !== i) {
      [a[i], a[largest]] = [a[largest], a[i]];
      heapify(n, largest);
    }
  }

  const n = a.length;
  // Build max heap
  for (let i = Math.floor(n / 2) - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    heapify(n, i);
  }
  steps.push({ stepIndex: steps.length, arrayState: [...a], description: 'Built initial Max-Heap' });

  // Extract elements from heap one by one
  for (let i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    [a[0], a[i]] = [a[i], a[0]];
    heapify(i, 0);
    steps.push({
      stepIndex: steps.length,
      arrayState: [...a],
      description: `Extracted max element to index ${i} and restored heap`
    });
  }

  return { sorted: a, steps };
}

/**
 * Linked Lists: Singly, Doubly, Circular, and Polynomial Addition (CO2)
 */

export class SLLNode<T = number> {
  public value: T;
  public next: SLLNode<T> | null = null;

  constructor(value: T, next: SLLNode<T> | null = null) {
    this.value = value;
    this.next = next;
  }
}

export class SinglyLinkedList<T = number> {
  public head: SLLNode<T> | null = null;

  public insertAtHead(value: T): void {
    const newNode = new SLLNode(value, this.head);
    this.head = newNode;
  }

  public insertAtTail(value: T): void {
    const newNode = new SLLNode(value);
    if (!this.head) {
      this.head = newNode;
      return;
    }
    let curr = this.head;
    while (curr.next) {
      curr = curr.next;
    }
    curr.next = newNode;
  }

  public deleteValue(value: T): boolean {
    if (!this.head) return false;
    if (this.head.value === value) {
      this.head = this.head.next;
      return true;
    }
    let curr = this.head;
    while (curr.next && curr.next.value !== value) {
      curr = curr.next;
    }
    if (curr.next) {
      curr.next = curr.next.next;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  public reverse(): void {
    let prev: SLLNode<T> | null = null;
    let curr: SLLNode<T> | null = this.head;
    while (curr) {
      const nextNode: SLLNode<T> | null = curr.next;
      curr.next = prev;
      prev = curr;
      curr = nextNode;
    }
    this.head = prev;
  }

  public search(value: T): boolean {
    let curr = this.head;
    while (curr) {
      if (curr.value === value) return true;
      curr = curr.next;
    }
    return false;
  }

  public toArray(): T[] {
    const result: T[] = [];
    let curr = this.head;
    while (curr) {
      result.push(curr.value);
      curr = curr.next;
    }
    return result;
  }
}

export class DLLNode<T = number> {
  public value: T;
  public prev: DLLNode<T> | null = null;
  public next: DLLNode<T> | null = null;

  constructor(value: T) {
    this.value = value;
  }
}

export class DoublyLinkedList<T = number> {
  public head: DLLNode<T> | null = null;
  public tail: DLLNode<T> | null = null;

  public insertAtTail(value: T): void {
    const newNode = new DLLNode(value);
    if (!this.tail) {
      this.head = newNode;
      this.tail = newNode;
    } else {
      this.tail.next = newNode;
      newNode.prev = this.tail;
      this.tail = newNode;
    }
  }

  public deleteValue(value: T): boolean {
    let curr = this.head;
    while (curr) {
      if (curr.value === value) {
        if (curr.prev) curr.prev.next = curr.next;
        else this.head = curr.next;

        if (curr.next) curr.next.prev = curr.prev;
        else this.tail = curr.prev;

        return true;
      }
      curr = curr.next;
    }
    return false;
  }

  public search(value: T): boolean {
    let curr = this.head;
    while (curr) {
      if (curr.value === value) return true;
      curr = curr.next;
    }
    return false;
  }

  public toArray(): T[] {
    const result: T[] = [];
    let curr = this.head;
    while (curr) {
      result.push(curr.value);
      curr = curr.next;
    }
    return result;
  }

  public toReverseArray(): T[] {
    const result: T[] = [];
    let curr = this.tail;
    while (curr) {
      result.push(curr.value);
      curr = curr.prev;
    }
    return result;
  }
}

export class CircularLinkedList<T = number> {
  public head: SLLNode<T> | null = null;

  public insert(value: T): void {
    const newNode = new SLLNode(value);
    if (!this.head) {
      newNode.next = newNode;
      this.head = newNode;
      return;
    }
    let curr = this.head;
    while (curr.next !== this.head) {
      curr = curr.next!;
    }
    curr.next = newNode;
    newNode.next = this.head;
  }

  public toArray(maxElements: number = 10): T[] {
    if (!this.head) return [];
    const result: T[] = [];
    let curr = this.head;
    let count = 0;
    do {
      result.push(curr.value);
      curr = curr.next!;
      count++;
    } while (curr !== this.head && count < maxElements);
    return result;
  }
}

/**
 * Polynomial Term Node: coeff * x^exp
 */
export interface PolyTerm {
  coeff: number;
  exp: number;
}

/**
 * Linked List Application: Polynomial Addition (CO2)
 * Adds two polynomials sorted by descending exponent.
 */
export function addPolynomials(poly1: PolyTerm[], poly2: PolyTerm[]): PolyTerm[] {
  const result: PolyTerm[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  let j = 0;

  while (i < poly1.length && j < poly2.length) {
    if (poly1[i].exp === poly2[j].exp) {
      const sumCoeff = poly1[i].coeff + poly2[j].coeff;
      if (sumCoeff !== 0) {
        result.push({ coeff: sumCoeff, exp: poly1[i].exp });
      }
      i++;
      j++;
    } else if (poly1[i].exp > poly2[j].exp) {
      result.push({ ...poly1[i] });
      i++;
    } else {
      result.push({ ...poly2[j] });
      j++;
    }
  }

  while (i < poly1.length) {
    result.push({ ...poly1[i] });
    i++;
  }

  while (j < poly2.length) {
    result.push({ ...poly2[j] });
    j++;
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Array implementation of Stack & Classic Applications (CO2)
 */

export class ArrayStack<T = number> {
  private items: T[];
  private capacity: number;

  constructor(capacity: number = 10) {
    this.capacity = capacity;
    this.items = [];
  }

  public push(item: T): boolean {
    if (this.isFull()) {
      return false; // Overflow
    }
    this.items.push(item);
    return true;
  }

  public pop(): T | null {
    if (this.isEmpty()) {
      return null; // Underflow
    }
    return this.items.pop() ?? null;
  }

  public peek(): T | null {
    if (this.isEmpty()) {
      return null;
    }
    return this.items[this.items.length - 1];
  }

  public isEmpty(): boolean {
    return this.items.length === 0;
  }

  public isFull(): boolean {
    return this.items.length >= this.capacity;
  }

  public size(): number {
    return this.items.length;
  }

  public toArray(): T[] {
    return [...this.items];
  }

  public clear(): void {
    this.items = [];
  }
}

/**
 * Balanced Parentheses application using Stack (CO2)
 */
export function isBalancedParentheses(expression: string): boolean {
  const stack: string[] = [];
  const matchingPairs: Record<string, string> = {
    ')': '(',
    '}': '{',
    ']': '['
  };

  for (const char of expression) {
    if (char === '(' || char === '{' || char === '[') {
      stack.push(char);
    } else if (char === ')' || char === '}' || char === ']') {
      if (stack.length === 0) return false;
      const top = stack.pop();
      if (top !== matchingPairs[char]) return false;
    }
  }

  return stack.length === 0;
}

/**
 * Precedence helper for infix to postfix
 */
function precedence(op: string): number {
  if (op === '+' || op === '-') return 1;
  if (op === '*' || op === '/') return 2;
  if (op === '^') return 3;
  return 0;
}

/**
 * Infix to Postfix conversion using Stack (CO2)
 */
export function infixToPostfix(infix: string): string {
  const stack: string[] = [];
  let postfix = '';

  for (const char of infix) {
    if (/[a-zA-Z0-9]/.test(char)) {
      postfix += char;
    } else if (char === '(') {
      stack.push(char);
    } else if (char === ')') {
      while (stack.length > 0 && stack[stack.length - 1] !== '(') {
        postfix += stack.pop();
      }
      stack.pop(); // discard '('
    } else if (['+', '-', '*', '/', '^'].includes(char)) {
      while (
        stack.length > 0 &&
        precedence(stack[stack.length - 1]) >= precedence(char)
      ) {
        postfix += stack.pop();
      }
      stack.push(char);
    }
  }

  while (stack.length > 0) {
    postfix += stack.pop();
  }

  return postfix;
}

/**
 * Postfix Evaluation using Stack (CO2)
 */
export function evaluatePostfix(postfix: string): number {
  const stack: number[] = [];
  const tokens = postfix.trim().split(/\s+/);

  for (const token of tokens) {
    if (!token) continue;
    if (!isNaN(Number(token))) {
      stack.push(Number(token));
    } else {
      const b = stack.pop() ?? 0;
      const a = stack.pop() ?? 0;
      switch (token) {
        case '+':
          stack.push(a + b);
          break;
        case '-':
          stack.push(a - b);
          break;
        case '*':
          stack.push(a * b);
          break;
        case '/':
          stack.push(Math.trunc(a / b));
          break;
        case '^':
          stack.push(Math.pow(a, b));
          break;
      }
    }
  }

  return stack.pop() ?? 0;
}

export class ArrayQueue<T = number> {

    }
    this.items.push(item);

    if (this.isEmpty()) {

    return this.items.length === 0;
  }

    return this.items.length >= this.capacity;
  }

  public size(): number {
    return this.items.length;
  }

    return [...this.items];
  }

  public clear(): void {
    this.items = [];
  }
}

/**
 * Array implementation of Circular Queue (CO2)
 * Demonstrates wrap-around to reuse dequeued slots and solve linear queue fake overflow.
 */

export class CircularQueue<T = number> {
  private buffer: (T | null)[];
  private capacity: number;
  private frontIndex: number;
  private rearIndex: number;
  private count: number;

  constructor(capacity: number = 5) {
    this.capacity = capacity;
    this.buffer = new Array(capacity).fill(null);
    this.frontIndex = -1;
    this.rearIndex = -1;
    this.count = 0;
  }

  public enqueue(item: T): boolean {
    if (this.isFull()) {
      return false; // Circular Queue Overflow
    }

    if (this.isEmpty()) {
      this.frontIndex = 0;
      this.rearIndex = 0;
    } else {
      this.rearIndex = (this.rearIndex + 1) % this.capacity;
    }

    this.buffer[this.rearIndex] = item;
    this.count++;
    return true;
  }

  public dequeue(): T | null {
    if (this.isEmpty()) {
      return null; // Circular Queue Underflow
    }

    const item = this.buffer[this.frontIndex];
    this.buffer[this.frontIndex] = null;

    if (this.frontIndex === this.rearIndex) {
      // Last item removed, reset indices
      this.frontIndex = -1;
      this.rearIndex = -1;
    } else {
      this.frontIndex = (this.frontIndex + 1) % this.capacity;
    }

    this.count--;
    return item;
  }

  public front(): T | null {
    if (this.isEmpty()) return null;
    return this.buffer[this.frontIndex];
  }

  public rear(): T | null {
    if (this.isEmpty()) return null;
    return this.buffer[this.rearIndex];
  }

  public getFrontIndex(): number {
    return this.frontIndex;
  }

  public getRearIndex(): number {
    return this.rearIndex;
  }

  public isEmpty(): boolean {
    return this.count === 0;
  }

  public isFull(): boolean {
    return this.count === this.capacity;
  }

  public size(): number {
    return this.count;
  }

  public getCapacity(): number {
    return this.capacity;
  }

  public getBuffer(): (T | null)[] {
    return [...this.buffer];
  }

  public clear(): void {
    this.buffer = new Array(this.capacity).fill(null);
    this.frontIndex = -1;
    this.rearIndex = -1;
    this.count = 0;
  }
}

/**
 * Tree Data Structures: Binary Search Tree & AVL Trees (CO4)
 */

export class BSTNode {
  public val: number;
  public left: BSTNode | null = null;
  public right: BSTNode | null = null;

  constructor(val: number) {
    this.val = val;
  }
}

export class BinarySearchTree {
  public root: BSTNode | null = null;

  public insert(val: number): void {
    const newNode = new BSTNode(val);
    if (!this.root) {
      this.root = newNode;
      return;
    }
    let curr = this.root;
    while (true) {
      if (val < curr.val) {
        if (!curr.left) {
          curr.left = newNode;
          break;
        }
        curr = curr.left;
      } else {
        if (!curr.right) {
          curr.right = newNode;
          break;
        }
        curr = curr.right;
      }
    }
  }

  public search(val: number): boolean {
    let curr = this.root;
    while (curr) {
      if (curr.val === val) return true;
      if (val < curr.val) curr = curr.left;
      else curr = curr.right;
    }
    return false;
  }

  public inOrder(): number[] {
    const result: number[] = [];
    function traverse(node: BSTNode | null) {
      if (!node) return;
      traverse(node.left);
      result.push(node.val);
      traverse(node.right);
    }
    traverse(this.root);
    return result;
  }

  public preOrder(): number[] {
    const result: number[] = [];
    function traverse(node: BSTNode | null) {
      if (!node) return;
      result.push(node.val);
      traverse(node.left);
      traverse(node.right);
    }
    traverse(this.root);
    return result;
  }

  public postOrder(): number[] {
    const result: number[] = [];
    function traverse(node: BSTNode | null) {
      if (!node) return;
      traverse(node.left);
      traverse(node.right);
      result.push(node.val);
    }
    traverse(this.root);
    return result;
  }
}

/**
 * AVL Tree Node & Self-Balancing Operations (CO4)
 */
export class AVLNode {
  public val: number;
  public height: number;
  public left: AVLNode | null = null;
  public right: AVLNode | null = null;

  constructor(val: number) {
    this.val = val;
    this.height = 1;
  }
}

export type RotationType = 'LL' | 'RR' | 'LR' | 'RL' | 'NONE';

export class AVLTree {
  public root: AVLNode | null = null;

  public getHeight(node: AVLNode | null): number {
    return node ? node.height : 0;
  }

  public getBalance(node: AVLNode | null): number {
    if (!node) return 0;
    return this.getHeight(node.left) - this.getHeight(node.right);
  }

  private updateHeight(node: AVLNode): void {
    node.height = 1 + Math.max(this.getHeight(node.left), this.getHeight(node.right));
  }

  public rightRotate(y: AVLNode): AVLNode {
    const x = y.left!;
    const T2 = x.right;

    x.right = y;
    y.left = T2;

    this.updateHeight(y);
    this.updateHeight(x);

    return x;
  }

  public leftRotate(x: AVLNode): AVLNode {
    const y = x.right!;
    const T2 = y.left;

    y.left = x;
    x.right = T2;

    this.updateHeight(x);
    this.updateHeight(y);

    return y;
  }

  public insert(val: number): { root: AVLNode; rotationApplied: RotationType } {
    let rotation: RotationType = 'NONE';

    const insertNode = (node: AVLNode | null, value: number): AVLNode => {
      if (!node) return new AVLNode(value);

      if (value < node.val) {
        node.left = insertNode(node.left, value);
      } else if (value > node.val) {
        node.right = insertNode(node.right, value);
      } else {
        return node; // Duplicate values not allowed in standard AVL
      }

      this.updateHeight(node);
      const balance = this.getBalance(node);

      // LL Case: Left Left -> Right Rotate
      if (balance > 1 && value < node.left!.val) {
        rotation = 'LL';
        return this.rightRotate(node);
      }

      // RR Case: Right Right -> Left Rotate
      if (balance < -1 && value > node.right!.val) {
        rotation = 'RR';
        return this.leftRotate(node);
      }

      // LR Case: Left Right -> Left Rotate on left child, then Right Rotate on node
      if (balance > 1 && value > node.left!.val) {
        rotation = 'LR';
        node.left = this.leftRotate(node.left!);
        return this.rightRotate(node);
      }

      // RL Case: Right Left -> Right Rotate on right child, then Left Rotate on node
      if (balance < -1 && value < node.right!.val) {
        rotation = 'RL';
        node.right = this.rightRotate(node.right!);
        return this.leftRotate(node);
      }

      return node;
    };

    this.root = insertNode(this.root, val);
    return { root: this.root, rotationApplied: rotation };
  }

  public inOrder(): number[] {
    const result: number[] = [];
    function traverse(node: AVLNode | null) {
      if (!node) return;
      traverse(node.left);
      result.push(node.val);
      traverse(node.right);
    }
    traverse(this.root);
    return result;
  }
}

/**
 * Graph Algorithms, Traversals, Shortest Path & MST (CO4)
 * BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, Prim, Kruskal, Huffman Coding
 */

export interface Edge {
  u: string;
  v: string;
  weight: number;
}

export class Graph {
  public adjList: Map<string, Array<{ node: string; weight: number }>>;

  constructor() {
    this.adjList = new Map();
  }

  public addVertex(v: string): void {
    if (!this.adjList.has(v)) {
      this.adjList.set(v, []);
    }
  }

  public addEdge(u: string, v: string, weight: number = 1, directed: boolean = false): void {
    this.addVertex(u);
    this.addVertex(v);
    this.adjList.get(u)!.push({ node: v, weight });
    if (!directed) {
      this.adjList.get(v)!.push({ node: u, weight });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Breadth-First Search (BFS) using Queue (FIFO)
   */
  public bfs(start: string): string[] {
    const visited = new Set<string>();
    const queue: string[] = [start];
    const order: string[] = [];

    visited.add(start);

    while (queue.length > 0) {
      const u = queue.shift()!;
      order.push(u);

      const neighbors = this.adjList.get(u) || [];
      for (const neighbor of neighbors) {
        if (!visited.has(neighbor.node)) {
          visited.add(neighbor.node);
          queue.push(neighbor.node);
        }
      }
    }

    return order;
  }

  /**
   * Depth-First Search (DFS) using Call Stack / LIFO
   */
  public dfs(start: string): string[] {
    const visited = new Set<string>();
    const order: string[] = [];

    const traverse = (u: string) => {
      visited.add(u);
      order.push(u);

      const neighbors = this.adjList.get(u) || [];
      for (const neighbor of neighbors) {
        if (!visited.has(neighbor.node)) {
          traverse(neighbor.node);
        }
      }
    };

    traverse(start);
    return order;
  }

  /**
   * Dijkstra's Algorithm: Single-source shortest path with non-negative edge weights
   */
  public dijkstra(start: string): Map<string, number> {
    const distances = new Map<string, number>();
    const unvisited = new Set<string>();

    for (const v of this.adjList.keys()) {
      distances.set(v, Infinity);
      unvisited.add(v);
    }
    distances.set(start, 0);

    while (unvisited.size > 0) {
      // Find unvisited vertex with minimum distance
      let minNode: string | null = null;
      let minDist = Infinity;

      for (const node of unvisited) {
        const dist = distances.get(node)!;
        if (dist < minDist) {
          minDist = dist;
          minNode = node;
        }
      }

      if (!minNode || minDist === Infinity) break;

      unvisited.delete(minNode);

      const neighbors = this.adjList.get(minNode) || [];
      for (const neighbor of neighbors) {
        if (unvisited.has(neighbor.node)) {
          const newDist = minDist + neighbor.weight;
          if (newDist < distances.get(neighbor.node)!) {
            distances.set(neighbor.node, newDist);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return distances;
  }

  /**
   * Prim's Minimum Spanning Tree (MST)
   */
  public prim(start: string): { mstEdges: Edge[]; totalWeight: number } {
    const inMST = new Set<string>([start]);
    const mstEdges: Edge[] = [];
    let totalWeight = 0;
    const totalVertices = this.adjList.size;

    while (inMST.size < totalVertices) {
      let minEdge: Edge | null = null;

      for (const u of inMST) {
        const neighbors = this.adjList.get(u) || [];
        for (const neighbor of neighbors) {
          if (!inMST.has(neighbor.node)) {
            if (!minEdge || neighbor.weight < minEdge.weight) {
              minEdge = { u, v: neighbor.node, weight: neighbor.weight };
            }
          }
        }
      }

      if (!minEdge) break; // Disconnected graph

      inMST.add(minEdge.v);
      mstEdges.push(minEdge);
      totalWeight += minEdge.weight;
    }

    return { mstEdges, totalWeight };
  }
}

/**
 * Huffman Coding: Frequency Node & Prefix Code Generator (CO4)
 */
export interface HuffmanNode {
  char?: string;
  freq: number;
  left?: HuffmanNode;
  right?: HuffmanNode;
}

export function buildHuffmanTree(frequencies: Record<string, number>): HuffmanNode | null {
  const heap: HuffmanNode[] = Object.entries(frequencies).map(([char, freq]) => ({
    char,
    freq
  }));

  if (heap.length === 0) return null;

  while (heap.length > 1) {
    heap.sort((a, b) => a.freq - b.freq);
    const left = heap.shift()!;
    const right = heap.shift()!;
    const parent: HuffmanNode = {
      freq: left.freq + right.freq,
      left,
      right
    };
    heap.push(parent);
  }

  return heap[0];
}

export function generateHuffmanCodes(root: HuffmanNode | null): Record<string, string> {
  const codes: Record<string, string> = {};
  function traverse(node: HuffmanNode | undefined, code: string) {
    if (!node) return;
    if (node.char !== undefined) {
      codes[node.char] = code || '0';
      return;
    }
    traverse(node.left, code + '0');
    traverse(node.right, code + '1');
  }
  traverse(root ?? undefined, '');
  return codes;
}

/**
 * Matrix Chain Multiplication (Ordering Matrix Multiplication - CO4)
 * Returns the minimum number of scalar multiplications needed to multiply a chain of matrices.
 * Dimensions array p of size n+1 where matrix i has dimension p[i-1] x p[i].
 */
export function matrixChainOrder(p: number[]): number {
  const n = p.length - 1;
  const m: number[][] = Array.from({ length: n }, () => new Array(n).fill(0));

  for (let L = 2; L <= n; L++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n - L + 1; i++) {
      const j = i + L - 1;
      m[i][j] = Infinity;
      for (let k = i; k < j; k++) {
        const cost = m[i][k] + m[k + 1][j] + p[i] * p[k + 1] * p[j + 1];
        if (cost < m[i][j]) {
          m[i][j] = cost;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return m[0][n - 1];
}

/**
 * Mathematical Foundations & Recurrence Relations (CO1)
 * Substitution Method, Recurrence Tree & Master Theorem Solver
 */

export interface MasterTheoremResult {
  a: number;
  b: number;
  k: number;
  p: number;
  log_b_a: number;
  caseMatched: 1 | 2 | 3;
  complexity: string;
  explanation: string;
}

/**
 * Solves recurrences of standard divide-and-conquer form:
 * T(n) = a * T(n/b) + Theta(n^k * (log n)^p)
 */
export function solveMasterTheorem(
  a: number,
  b: number,
  k: number = 1,
  p: number = 0
): MasterTheoremResult {
  if (a < 1 || b <= 1) {
    throw new Error('Master Theorem requires a >= 1 and b > 1.');
  }

  const log_b_a = Math.log(a) / Math.log(b);
  const epsilon = 1e-6;

  // Case 1: log_b(a) > k
  if (log_b_a - k > epsilon) {
    const formattedLog = Number.isInteger(log_b_a) ? log_b_a.toString() : log_b_a.toFixed(2);
    return {
      a,
      b,
      k,
      p,
      log_b_a,
      caseMatched: 1,
      complexity: `Θ(n^${formattedLog})`,
      explanation: `Since log_${b}(${a}) = ${formattedLog} > k (${k}), the work is root-dominated by leaves. Complexity is Θ(n^(log_b a)) = Θ(n^${formattedLog}).`
    };
  }

  // Case 2: log_b(a) == k
  if (Math.abs(log_b_a - k) <= epsilon) {
    const logPower = p + 1;
    const logStr = logPower === 1 ? 'log n' : `log^${logPower} n`;
    const nStr = k === 0 ? '' : k === 1 ? 'n ' : `n^${k} `;
    return {
      a,
      b,
      k,
      p,
      log_b_a,
      caseMatched: 2,
      complexity: `Θ(${nStr}${logStr})`,
      explanation: `Since log_${b}(${a}) = k = ${k}, work is distributed equally across all tree levels. Complexity is Θ(n^k * log^(p+1) n) = Θ(${nStr}${logStr}).`
    };
  }

  // Case 3: log_b(a) < k
  const logStr = p === 0 ? '' : p === 1 ? ' log n' : ` log^${p} n`;
  const nStr = k === 1 ? 'n' : `n^${k}`;
  return {
    a,
    b,
    k,
    p,
    log_b_a,
    caseMatched: 3,
    complexity: `Θ(${nStr}${logStr})`,
    explanation: `Since log_${b}(${a}) (${log_b_a.toFixed(2)}) < k (${k}), the work is dominated by the top root level. Complexity is Θ(f(n)) = Θ(${nStr}${logStr}).`
  };
}

/**
 * Calculates Recurrence Tree statistics:
 * - Height: log_b(n)
 * - Number of subproblems at level i: a^i
 * - Size of subproblem at level i: n / (b^i)
 * - Work at level i
 */
export function getRecurrenceTreeLevelInfo(
  a: number,
  b: number,
  level: number
): { subproblems: number; subproblemSizeFraction: string; workFactor: number } {
  const subproblems = Math.pow(a, level);
  const sizeDivisor = Math.pow(b, level);
  return {
    subproblems,
    subproblemSizeFraction: `n / ${sizeDivisor}`,
    workFactor: subproblems / sizeDivisor
  };
}

export const CURRICULUM_100: SquareMetadata[] = RAW_CURRICULUM.map(sq => {
  const ladder = LADDER_MAP.get(sq.id);
  const snake = SNAKE_MAP.get(sq.id);

  let type: SquareMetadata['type'] = 'normal';
  if (sq.id === 1) type = 'start';
  else if (sq.id === 100) type = 'finish';
  else if (sq.isCheckpoint) type = 'checkpoint';
  else if (ladder) type = 'ladder_start';
  else if (snake) type = 'snake_head';

  return {
    ...sq,
    type
  };
});

export const SQUARE_MAP = new Map<number, SquareMetadata>();
CURRICULUM_100.forEach(sq => SQUARE_MAP.set(sq.id, sq));

export const DECISION_TILE_MAP = new Map<number, DecisionTileConfig>();
DECISION_TILES.forEach(d => DECISION_TILE_MAP.set(d.tileNumber, d));

export function evaluateRouteAvailability(
  config: DecisionTileConfig,
  masteryMap: Record<string, TopicMasteryScore>,
  currentEnergy: number
): { knowledge: RouteOption; challenge: RouteOption; risk: RouteOption } {
  const topicMastery = masteryMap[config.topicName]?.score || 0;

  // Knowledge route is always unlocked
  const knowledge: RouteOption = {
    ...config.routes.knowledge,
    isUnlocked: true
  };

  // Challenge route requires minMastery
  const challengeReq = config.routes.challenge.unlockRequirements;
  const challengeUnlocked = topicMastery >= (challengeReq.minMastery || 0);
  const challenge: RouteOption = {
    ...config.routes.challenge,
    isUnlocked: challengeUnlocked,
    lockedReason: !challengeUnlocked 
      ? `Requires ${challengeReq.minMastery}% mastery in ${config.topicName} (Current: ${topicMastery}%).` 
      : undefined
  };

  // Risk route requires high mastery and minimum energy
  const riskReq = config.routes.risk.unlockRequirements;
  const masteryMet = topicMastery >= (riskReq.minMastery || 0);
  const energyMet = currentEnergy >= (riskReq.minEnergy || 0);
  const riskUnlocked = masteryMet && energyMet;

  let riskLockedReason = undefined;
  if (!riskUnlocked) {
    if (!masteryMet) {
      riskLockedReason = `Requires ${riskReq.minMastery}% mastery in ${config.topicName} (Current: ${topicMastery}%).`;
    } else {
      riskLockedReason = `Requires ${riskReq.minEnergy} Algorithm Energy (Current: ${currentEnergy}).`;
    }
  }

  const risk: RouteOption = {
    ...config.routes.risk,
    isUnlocked: riskUnlocked,
    lockedReason: riskLockedReason
  };

  return { knowledge, challenge, risk };
}

import { Challenge } from '../types/challenge';
import { CourseOutcome } from '../types/curriculum';
import { ALL_CURRICULUM_CHALLENGES } from './challenges/index';
import { SQUARE_MAP } from './curriculum100';

export const CHALLENGES: Challenge[] = ALL_CURRICULUM_CHALLENGES;
export const BASE_CHALLENGES: Challenge[] = ALL_CURRICULUM_CHALLENGES;

export const CHALLENGE_MAP = new Map<string, Challenge>();
export const SQUARE_CHALLENGES_MAP = new Map<number, Challenge[]>();

CHALLENGES.forEach(c => {
  CHALLENGE_MAP.set(c.id, c);
  const existing = SQUARE_CHALLENGES_MAP.get(c.squareId) || [];
  existing.push(c);
  SQUARE_CHALLENGES_MAP.set(c.squareId, existing);
});

export class ChallengeRegistry {
  private attemptedIds: Set<string>;

  constructor(initialAttempted: string[] = []) {
    this.attemptedIds = new Set(initialAttempted);
  }

  public recordAttempt(challengeId: string): void {
    this.attemptedIds.add(challengeId);
  }

  public markAttempted(challengeId: string, _squareId?: number): void {
    this.attemptedIds.add(challengeId);
  }

  public getChallengeForSquare(
    squareId: number,
    allowRevision: boolean = true,
    difficultyMode: string = 'intermediate'
  ): Challenge {
    // 1. Get pre-authored challenges for this square
    const squareChallenges = SQUARE_CHALLENGES_MAP.get(squareId) || [];

    if (squareChallenges.length > 0) {
      let candidates = [...squareChallenges];

      // Filter by difficulty mode if multiple exist
      if (difficultyMode === 'beginner') {
        const easyMed = candidates.filter(c => c.difficulty === 'easy' || c.difficulty === 'medium');
        if (easyMed.length > 0) candidates = easyMed;
      } else if (difficultyMode === 'interview_ready' || difficultyMode === 'advanced') {
        const hardExp = candidates.filter(c => c.difficulty === 'hard' || c.difficulty === 'medium');
        if (hardExp.length > 0) candidates = hardExp;
      }

      // Find unattempted
      const unattempted = candidates.filter(c => !this.attemptedIds.has(c.id));
      if (unattempted.length > 0) {
        return unattempted[0];
      }

      // If all candidates are attempted, provide an unattempted synthesized question before looping back
      const synth = this.synthesizeSquareChallenge(squareId);
      if (!this.attemptedIds.has(synth.id)) {
        return synth;
      }

      if (allowRevision) {
        return candidates[0]; // Interleaved revision
      }
    }

    // 2. Synthesize fallback tailored challenge for this square's topic if ever needed
    return this.synthesizeSquareChallenge(squareId);
  }

  public synthesizeSquareChallenge(squareId: number): Challenge {
    const existing = CHALLENGE_MAP.get(`gen-${squareId}`);
    if (existing) return existing;

    const sq = SQUARE_MAP.get(squareId);
    const synth: Challenge = {
      id: `gen-${squareId}`,
      squareId,
      co: sq?.co || 'CO1',
      title: `${sq?.title || 'DSA'} Question`,
      topic: sq?.topic || 'DSA Concept',
      subtopic: sq?.subtopic || 'Core Concept',
      skillCategory: 'conceptual',
      difficulty: squareId <= 30 ? 'easy' : squareId <= 70 ? 'medium' : 'hard',
      type: 'conceptual_mcq',
      prompt: `Regarding ${sq?.title || 'this DSA topic'}: Which statement correctly identifies its core algorithmic property and complexity?`,
      options: [
        sq?.keyTakeaway || 'Maintains strict correctness while guaranteeing optimal time complexity',
        'Executes nested iterations over all permutations with unbounded memory',
        'Bypasses base cases and runs indefinitely',
        'Has no deterministic termination conditions'
      ],
      correctOptionIndex: 0,
      hints: [
        'Think about the foundational property taught on this square.',
        sq?.summary || 'Review the core syllabus takeaway.'
      ],
      explanation: sq?.keyTakeaway || 'This concept enforces correctness and bounded time complexity.',
      tags: ['syllabus', sq?.stage || 'dsa', `square-${squareId}`]
    };

    CHALLENGE_MAP.set(synth.id, synth);
    return synth;
  }

  /**
   * Returns all questions belonging to a specific Course Outcome (CO1, CO2, CO3, CO4).
   */
  public getQuestionsByCO(co: CourseOutcome): Challenge[] {
    return CHALLENGES.filter(c => c.co === co);
  }

  /**
   * Returns 10 randomized or sequential questions for Practice Mode on a specific CO.
   */
  public getPracticeQuestions(co: CourseOutcome, count: number = 10): Challenge[] {
    const pool = this.getQuestionsByCO(co);
    if (pool.length <= count) return [...pool];
    // Shuffle pool
    const shuffled = [...pool].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
    return shuffled.slice(0, count);
  }

  /**
   * Returns randomized questions across the full syllabus for Exam Mode.
   */
  public getExamQuestions(count: number = 20): Challenge[] {
    const shuffled = [...CHALLENGES].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
    return shuffled.slice(0, Math.min(count, shuffled.length));
  }
}

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { 
  rollDice, 
  getSquareGridCoords, 
  getSquarePercentCoords, 
  computeMovementPlan 
} from '../engine/gameEngine';
import { SNAKES_AND_LADDERS } from '../data/snakesAndLadders';

describe('Game Logic & Serpentine Coordinate Engine', () => {
  it('rolls valid dice values between 1 and 6', () => {
    for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
      const roll = rollDice();
      expect(roll).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      expect(roll).toBeLessThanOrEqual(6);
      expect(Number.isInteger(roll)).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it('correctly maps coordinates for 10x10 serpentine layout', () => {
    // Square 1: bottom-left (gridRow 9, gridCol 0)
    const sq1 = getSquareGridCoords(1);
    expect(sq1).toEqual({ gridRow: 9, gridCol: 0 });

    // Square 10: bottom-right (gridRow 9, gridCol 9)
    const sq10 = getSquareGridCoords(10);
    expect(sq10).toEqual({ gridRow: 9, gridCol: 9 });

    // Square 11: second row rightmost (gridRow 8, gridCol 9)
    const sq11 = getSquareGridCoords(11);
    expect(sq11).toEqual({ gridRow: 8, gridCol: 9 });

    // Square 20: second row leftmost (gridRow 8, gridCol 0)
    const sq20 = getSquareGridCoords(20);
    expect(sq20).toEqual({ gridRow: 8, gridCol: 0 });

    // Square 91: top row rightmost (gridRow 0, gridCol 9)
    const sq91 = getSquareGridCoords(91);
    expect(sq91).toEqual({ gridRow: 0, gridCol: 9 });

    // Square 100: top row leftmost finish (gridRow 0, gridCol 0)
    const sq100 = getSquareGridCoords(100);
    expect(sq100).toEqual({ gridRow: 0, gridCol: 0 });
  });

  it('computes valid center percentage coordinates for SVG rendering', () => {
    const coords1 = getSquarePercentCoords(1);
    expect(coords1.x).toBeCloseTo(5);
    expect(coords1.y).toBeCloseTo(95);

    const coords100 = getSquarePercentCoords(100);
    expect(coords100.x).toBeCloseTo(5);
    expect(coords100.y).toBeCloseTo(5);
  });

  it('validates all snakes and ladders', () => {
    expect(SNAKES_AND_LADDERS.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(10);

    SNAKES_AND_LADDERS.forEach(item => {
      expect(item.from).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      expect(item.from).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100);
      expect(item.to).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      expect(item.to).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100);

      if (item.type === 'ladder') {
        // Ladders must ascend
        expect(item.to).toBeGreaterThan(item.from);
      } else {
        // Snakes must descend
        expect(item.to).toBeLessThan(item.from);
      }
    });
  });

  it('enforces mandatory checkpoint stops when rolling a high number', () => {
    // Square 10 is a checkpoint. Starting at 8 with roll 5 would land on 13,
    // but checkpoint at 10 must intercept player!
    const passedCheckpoints = new Set<number>();
    const plan = computeMovementPlan(8, 5, passedCheckpoints);

    expect(plan.stoppedAtCheckpoint).toBe(true);
    expect(plan.checkpointSquareId).toBe(10);
    expect(plan.targetSquareBeforeTransitions).toBe(10);
  });

  it('allows progression past checkpoint once checkpoint is passed', () => {
    const passedCheckpoints = new Set<number>([10]);
    const plan = computeMovementPlan(8, 5, passedCheckpoints);

    expect(plan.stoppedAtCheckpoint).toBe(false);
    expect(plan.targetSquareBeforeTransitions).toBe(13);
  });

  it('correctly handles bounce back on overshooting square 100', () => {
    const passedCheckpoints = new Set<number>([10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90]);
    // At square 98, roll 4 -> reaches 100 then bounces back 2 to 98
    const plan = computeMovementPlan(98, 4, passedCheckpoints);
    expect(plan.targetSquareBeforeTransitions).toBe(98);
  });

  it('detects winning condition on landing on square 100', () => {
    const passedCheckpoints = new Set<number>([10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90]);
    const plan = computeMovementPlan(97, 3, passedCheckpoints);
    expect(plan.targetSquareBeforeTransitions).toBe(100);
    expect(plan.isGameFinished).toBe(true);
  });
});
