import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { ArrayStack, isBalancedParentheses, infixToPostfix, evaluatePostfix } from '../algorithms/stack';
import { ArrayQueue } from '../algorithms/queue';
import { CircularQueue } from '../algorithms/circularQueue';
import { SinglyLinkedList, DoublyLinkedList, addPolynomials } from '../algorithms/linkedList';
import { 
  insertionSortWithSteps, 
  countingSort, 
  radixSort, 
  mergeSortWithSteps, 
  quickSortWithSteps, 
  heapSortWithSteps 
} from '../algorithms/sorting';
import { 
  linearSearchWithSteps, 
  binarySearchWithSteps, 
  jumpSearchWithSteps, 
  HashTableChaining 
} from '../algorithms/searching';
import { BinarySearchTree, AVLTree } from '../algorithms/trees';
import { Graph, buildHuffmanTree, generateHuffmanCodes, matrixChainOrder } from '../algorithms/graphs';
import { solveMasterTheorem, getRecurrenceTreeLevelInfo } from '../algorithms/recurrence';

describe('Syllabus Algorithms Unit Verification', () => {

  describe('CO1 — Recurrence & Master Theorem', () => {
    it('solves Master Theorem Case 1: T(n) = 8T(n/2) + O(n^2) -> Θ(n^3)', () => {
      const res = solveMasterTheorem(8, 2, 2);
      expect(res.caseMatched).toBe(1);
      expect(res.complexity).toBe('Θ(n^3)');
      expect(res.log_b_a).toBe(3);
    });

    it('solves Master Theorem Case 2: T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n) -> Θ(n log n)', () => {
      const res = solveMasterTheorem(2, 2, 1);
      expect(res.caseMatched).toBe(2);
      expect(res.complexity).toBe('Θ(n log n)');
    });

    it('solves Master Theorem Case 3: T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n^2) -> Θ(n^2)', () => {
      const res = solveMasterTheorem(2, 2, 2);
      expect(res.caseMatched).toBe(3);
      expect(res.complexity).toBe('Θ(n^2)');
    });

    it('computes Recurrence Tree level info correctly', () => {
      const level2 = getRecurrenceTreeLevelInfo(2, 2, 2);
      expect(level2.subproblems).toBe(4); // 2^2
      expect(level2.subproblemSizeFraction).toBe('n / 4');
    });
  });

  describe('CO2 — Stacks & Expressions', () => {
    it('verifies ArrayStack LIFO operations and bounds', () => {
      const stack = new ArrayStack<number>(3);
      expect(stack.isEmpty()).toBe(true);
      stack.push(10);
      stack.push(20);
      stack.push(30);
      expect(stack.isFull()).toBe(true);
      expect(stack.peek()).toBe(30);
      expect(stack.pop()).toBe(30);
      expect(stack.pop()).toBe(20);
      expect(stack.pop()).toBe(10);
      expect(stack.pop()).toBeNull(); // Underflow guard
    });

    it('checks balanced parentheses correctly', () => {
      expect(isBalancedParentheses('{[()]}')).toBe(true);
      expect(isBalancedParentheses('{[}]')).toBe(false);
      expect(isBalancedParentheses('(((')).toBe(false);
    });

    it('converts infix to postfix and evaluates postfix expressions', () => {
      const postfix = infixToPostfix('a+b*(c-d)');
      expect(postfix).toBe('abcd-*+');
      const val = evaluatePostfix('3 4 2 * 1 5 - / +');
      expect(val).toBe(1); // 3 + (8 / -4) = 3 + (-2) = 1
    });
  });

  describe('CO2 — Queues & Circular Queues', () => {
    it('verifies FIFO Queue operations', () => {
      const q = new ArrayQueue<string>(3);
      q.enqueue('A');
      q.enqueue('B');
      expect(q.front()).toBe('A');
      expect(q.dequeue()).toBe('A');
      expect(q.dequeue()).toBe('B');
      expect(q.isEmpty()).toBe(true);
    });

    it('verifies Circular Queue modulo wrap-around', () => {
      const cq = new CircularQueue<number>(3);
      cq.enqueue(10);
      cq.enqueue(20);
      cq.enqueue(30);
      expect(cq.isFull()).toBe(true);
      expect(cq.dequeue()).toBe(10);
      cq.enqueue(40); // wraps around
      expect(cq.getBuffer()).toEqual([40, 20, 30]);
      expect(cq.front()).toBe(20);
      expect(cq.rear()).toBe(40);
    });
  });

  describe('CO2 — Linked Lists & Polynomials', () => {
    it('verifies Singly Linked List insertion and search', () => {
      const sll = new SinglyLinkedList<number>();
      sll.insertAtTail(10);
      sll.insertAtTail(20);
      sll.insertAtHead(5);
      expect(sll.toArray()).toEqual([5, 10, 20]);
      expect(sll.search(10)).toBe(true);
      expect(sll.search(99)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('verifies Doubly Linked List backward and forward traversal', () => {
      const dll = new DoublyLinkedList<number>();
      dll.insertAtTail(1);
      dll.insertAtTail(2);
      dll.insertAtTail(3);
      expect(dll.toArray()).toEqual([1, 2, 3]);
      expect(dll.toReverseArray()).toEqual([3, 2, 1]);
    });

    it('adds polynomials using linked lists', () => {
      const p1 = [
        { coeff: 3, exp: 2 },
        { coeff: 5, exp: 1 },
        { coeff: 1, exp: 0 }
      ];
      const p2 = [
        { coeff: 4, exp: 2 },
        { coeff: 2, exp: 0 }
      ];
      const result = addPolynomials(p1, p2);
      expect(result).toEqual([
        { coeff: 7, exp: 2 },
        { coeff: 5, exp: 1 },
        { coeff: 3, exp: 0 }
      ]);
    });
  });

  describe('CO3 — Sorting Algorithms', () => {
    const raw = [38, 27, 43, 3, 9, 82, 10];
    const sorted = [3, 9, 10, 27, 38, 43, 82];

    it('verifies insertion sort', () => {
      const res = insertionSortWithSteps([...raw]);
      expect(res.sorted).toEqual(sorted);
    });

    it('verifies merge sort', () => {
      const res = mergeSortWithSteps([...raw]);
      expect(res.sorted).toEqual(sorted);
    });

    it('verifies quick sort', () => {
      const res = quickSortWithSteps([...raw]);
      expect(res.sorted).toEqual(sorted);
    });

    it('verifies heap sort', () => {
      const res = heapSortWithSteps([...raw]);
      expect(res.sorted).toEqual(sorted);
    });

    it('verifies counting sort', () => {
      const res = countingSort([4, 2, 2, 8, 3, 3, 1]);
      expect(res).toEqual([1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4, 8]);
    });

    it('verifies radix sort', () => {
      const res = radixSort([170, 45, 75, 90, 802, 24, 2, 66]);
      expect(res).toEqual([2, 24, 45, 66, 75, 90, 170, 802]);
    });
  });

  describe('CO3 — Searching Algorithms & Hashing', () => {
    const arr = [2, 5, 8, 12, 16, 23, 38, 56, 72, 91];

    it('verifies linear search', () => {
      expect(linearSearchWithSteps(arr, 23).foundIndex).toBe(5);
      expect(linearSearchWithSteps(arr, 99).foundIndex).toBe(-1);
    });

    it('verifies binary search', () => {
      expect(binarySearchWithSteps(arr, 23).foundIndex).toBe(5);
      expect(binarySearchWithSteps(arr, 99).foundIndex).toBe(-1);
    });

    it('verifies jump search', () => {
      expect(jumpSearchWithSteps(arr, 23).foundIndex).toBe(5);
      expect(jumpSearchWithSteps(arr, 99).foundIndex).toBe(-1);
    });

    it('verifies Hash Table with separate chaining', () => {
      const ht = new HashTableChaining<number>(7);
      ht.insert('apple', 100);
      ht.insert('banana', 200);
      expect(ht.get('apple')).toBe(100);
      expect(ht.get('banana')).toBe(200);
      expect(ht.get('cherry')).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe('CO4 — Trees & AVL', () => {
    it('verifies Binary Search Tree insertion and in-order sort', () => {
      const bst = new BinarySearchTree();
      [50, 30, 70, 20, 40, 60, 80].forEach(k => bst.insert(k));
      expect(bst.inOrder()).toEqual([20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80]);
      expect(bst.search(40)).toBe(true);
      expect(bst.search(99)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('verifies AVL Tree self-balancing with rotations', () => {
      const avl = new AVLTree();
      // Insert in ascending order (triggers RR rotation, rebalancing height)
      [10, 20, 30].forEach(k => avl.insert(k));
      expect(avl.inOrder()).toEqual([10, 20, 30]);
      expect(avl.root?.val).toBe(20); // 20 becomes new balanced root
      expect(avl.getHeight(avl.root)).toBe(2);
    });
  });

  describe('CO4 — Graphs & Algorithm Design', () => {
    it('verifies Graph BFS and DFS traversals', () => {
      const g = new Graph();
      g.addVertex('A');
      g.addVertex('B');
      g.addVertex('C');
      g.addVertex('D');
      g.addEdge('A', 'B', 1);
      g.addEdge('A', 'C', 1);
      g.addEdge('B', 'D', 1);
      g.addEdge('C', 'D', 1);

      const bfsOrder = g.bfs('A');
      expect(bfsOrder).toEqual(['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']);

      const dfsOrder = g.dfs('A');
      expect(dfsOrder[0]).toBe('A');
      expect(dfsOrder.length).toBe(4);
    });

    it('computes shortest paths using Dijkstra algorithm', () => {
      const g = new Graph();
      ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'].forEach(v => g.addVertex(v));
      g.addEdge('A', 'B', 4);
      g.addEdge('A', 'C', 2);
      g.addEdge('C', 'B', 1);
      g.addEdge('B', 'D', 5);
      g.addEdge('C', 'D', 8);

      const dists = g.dijkstra('A');
      expect(dists.get('A')).toBe(0);
      expect(dists.get('C')).toBe(2);
      expect(dists.get('B')).toBe(3); // A -> C (2) + C -> B (1) = 3
      expect(dists.get('D')).toBe(8); // A -> C -> B -> D = 3 + 5 = 8
    });

    it('computes Minimum Spanning Tree using Prim algorithm', () => {
      const g = new Graph();
      ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'].forEach(v => g.addVertex(v));
      g.addEdge('A', 'B', 1);
      g.addEdge('B', 'C', 2);
      g.addEdge('C', 'D', 3);
      g.addEdge('A', 'D', 10);

      const mst = g.prim('A');
      expect(mst.totalWeight).toBe(6); // 1 + 2 + 3 = 6
      expect(mst.mstEdges.length).toBe(3); // V - 1 edges
    });

    it('builds Huffman Coding Tree correctly', () => {
      const freqs = { A: 5, B: 9, C: 12, D: 13, E: 16, F: 45 };
      const root = buildHuffmanTree(freqs);
      expect(root).not.toBeNull();
      expect(root?.freq).toBe(100);
      const codes = generateHuffmanCodes(root);
      expect(codes['F'].length).toBe(1); // highest frequency gets 1 bit
    });

    it('solves Matrix Chain Multiplication optimal parenthesization', () => {
      // Matrices: A1 (10x30), A2 (30x5), A3 (5x60)
      const dims = [10, 30, 5, 60];
      const minMults = matrixChainOrder(dims);
      expect(minMults).toBe(4500);
    });
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { CURRICULUM_100, SQUARE_MAP, STAGES } from '../data/curriculum100';
import { CHALLENGES, ChallengeRegistry } from '../data/challenges';
import { SNAKES_AND_LADDERS } from '../data/snakesAndLadders';

describe('100-Square Curriculum & Challenge Bank', () => {
  it('contains exactly 100 uniquely numbered squares from 1 to 100', () => {
    expect(CURRICULUM_100.length).toBe(100);

    const ids = CURRICULUM_100.map(s => s.id);
    const uniqueIds = new Set(ids);
    expect(uniqueIds.size).toBe(100);

    for (let i = 1; i <= 100; i++) {
      expect(SQUARE_MAP.has(i)).toBe(true);
      const sq = SQUARE_MAP.get(i);
      expect(sq?.id).toBe(i);
      expect(sq?.title).toBeDefined();
      expect(sq?.topic).toBeDefined();
      expect(sq?.stage).toBeDefined();
      expect(sq?.checkpointTasks.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
  });

  it('covers all 10 DSA curriculum stages properly', () => {
    expect(STAGES.length).toBe(10);
    
    STAGES.forEach(stage => {
      const squaresInStage = CURRICULUM_100.filter(s => s.stage === stage.id);
      expect(squaresInStage.length).toBe(10);
    });
  });

  it('contains unique challenge IDs without duplicates', () => {
    const challengeIds = CHALLENGES.map(c => c.id);
    const uniqueChallengeIds = new Set(challengeIds);
    expect(uniqueChallengeIds.size).toBe(CHALLENGES.length);
  });

  it('verifies curriculum ladders and snakes are mapped with pedagogical reasons', () => {
    expect(SNAKES_AND_LADDERS.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(10);

    SNAKES_AND_LADDERS.forEach(item => {
      expect(item.pedagogicalReason).toBeDefined();
      expect(item.pedagogicalReason.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
      expect(item.title).toBeDefined();
      expect(item.description).toBeDefined();
    });
  });

  it('verifies debugging and code analysis challenges exist with explanations', () => {
    const debugChallenges = CHALLENGES.filter(c => 
      c.skillCategory === 'debugging' || 
      c.skillCategory === 'dry_run' || 
      c.codeSnippet !== undefined
    );
    expect(debugChallenges.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(10);

    debugChallenges.forEach(ch => {
      expect(ch.explanation).toBeDefined();
      expect(ch.explanation.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
    });
  });

  it('prevents immediate question repetition using ChallengeRegistry', () => {
    const registry = new ChallengeRegistry([]);
    const firstChallenge = registry.getChallengeForSquare(1);
    expect(firstChallenge).toBeDefined();

    registry.markAttempted(firstChallenge.id, 1);
    const secondChallenge = registry.getChallengeForSquare(1);

    expect(secondChallenge.id).not.toBe(firstChallenge.id);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { CURRICULUM_100, SQUARE_MAP } from '../data/curriculum100';
import { CHALLENGES } from '../data/challenges';

describe('Academic Syllabus Compliance & Zero Out-Of-Scope Verification', () => {

  const FORBIDDEN_WORDS = [
    'segment tree',
    'fenwick',
    'bitmask',
    'disjoint set union',
    'dsu',
    'trie',
    'two sum',
    'sliding window',
    'longest palindromic',
    'trapping rain water',
    'kmp algorithm',
    'rabin karp',
    'z algorithm',
    'suffix tree',
    'suffix array',
    'max flow',
    'min cut',
    'bipartite matching'
  ];

  it('verifies that exactly 100 curriculum squares exist', () => {
    expect(CURRICULUM_100.length).toBe(100);
  });

  it('verifies that every square strictly belongs to CO1, CO2, CO3, or CO4', () => {
    const validCOs = new Set(['CO1', 'CO2', 'CO3', 'CO4']);
    CURRICULUM_100.forEach(sq => {
      expect(validCOs.has(sq.co)).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  it('verifies correct distribution of Course Outcomes across all 100 squares', () => {
    // Squares 1 to 40 -> CO1
    for (let id = 1; id <= 40; id++) {
      const sq = SQUARE_MAP.get(id);
      expect(sq?.co).toBe('CO1');
    }

    // Squares 41 to 70 -> CO2
    for (let id = 41; id <= 70; id++) {
      const sq = SQUARE_MAP.get(id);
      expect(sq?.co).toBe('CO2');
    }

    // Squares 71 to 80 -> CO3
    for (let id = 71; id <= 80; id++) {
      const sq = SQUARE_MAP.get(id);
      expect(sq?.co).toBe('CO3');
    }

    // Squares 81 to 100 -> CO4
    for (let id = 81; id <= 100; id++) {
      const sq = SQUARE_MAP.get(id);
      expect(sq?.co).toBe('CO4');
    }
  });

  it('verifies ZERO forbidden out-of-syllabus topics in curriculum squares', () => {
    CURRICULUM_100.forEach(sq => {
      const text = `${sq.title} ${sq.topic} ${sq.subtopic} ${sq.summary} ${sq.checkpointTasks.join(' ')}`;
      FORBIDDEN_WORDS.forEach(forbidden => {
        const regex = new RegExp(`\\b${forbidden}\\b`, 'i');
        expect(regex.test(text)).toBe(false);
      });
    });
  });

  it('verifies ZERO forbidden out-of-syllabus topics in all 124+ challenge questions', () => {
    expect(CHALLENGES.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(120);

    CHALLENGES.forEach(ch => {
      const text = `${ch.title} ${ch.topic} ${ch.prompt} ${(ch.options || []).join(' ')} ${ch.explanation}`;
      FORBIDDEN_WORDS.forEach(forbidden => {
        const regex = new RegExp(`\\b${forbidden}\\b`, 'i');
        expect(regex.test(text)).toBe(false);
      });
    });
  });

  it('verifies all 120+ challenges have valid syllabus course outcomes', () => {
    const validCOs = new Set(['CO1', 'CO2', 'CO3', 'CO4']);
    CHALLENGES.forEach(ch => {
      expect(validCOs.has(ch.co || 'CO1')).toBe(true);
      expect(ch.squareId).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      expect(ch.squareId).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100);
      expect(ch.explanation.length).toBeGreaterThan(15);
    });
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { 
  calculateLevelInfo, 
  calculateCorrectMovement, 
  calculateIncorrectPenalty, 
  calculateEconomyReward 
} from '../engine/economyEngine';
import { 
  INITIAL_ACHIEVEMENTS, 
  evaluateAchievements 
} from '../engine/achievementEngine';

describe('Reward & Punishment Economy Engine', () => {
  it('calculates player levels and titles accurately', () => {
    const lvl1 = calculateLevelInfo(50);
    expect(lvl1.level).toBe(1);
    expect(lvl1.title).toBe('Beginner Coder');
    expect(lvl1.progressPercent).toBe(25);

    const lvl2 = calculateLevelInfo(350);
    expect(lvl2.level).toBe(2);
    expect(lvl2.title).toBe('Array Explorer');

    const lvl5 = calculateLevelInfo(2000);
    expect(lvl5.level).toBe(5);
    expect(lvl5.title).toBe('Debugging Detective');

    const lvl10 = calculateLevelInfo(12000);
    expect(lvl10.level).toBe(10);
    expect(lvl10.title).toBe('DSA Grandmaster');
    expect(lvl10.progressPercent).toBe(100);
  });

  describe('Answer-Based Forward Movement Rewards', () => {
    it('awards correct forward tiles based on difficulty with first-try bonus', () => {
      // Easy: +1 base + 1 first-try = +2 tiles
      const easyFirst = calculateCorrectMovement('easy', true, false);
      expect(easyFirst.tilesDelta).toBe(2);

      // Medium: +2 base + 1 first-try = +3 tiles
      const medFirst = calculateCorrectMovement('medium', true, false);
      expect(medFirst.tilesDelta).toBe(3);

      // Hard: +3 base + 1 first-try = +4 tiles (Example 1 in prompt!)
      const hardFirst = calculateCorrectMovement('hard', true, false);
      expect(hardFirst.tilesDelta).toBe(4);
      expect(hardFirst.explanation).toContain('FIRST-TRY BONUS');

      // Expert: +4 base + 0 (not first try) = +4 tiles
      const expertNotFirst = calculateCorrectMovement('expert', false, false);
      expect(expertNotFirst.tilesDelta).toBe(4);
    });

    it('awards strictly +1 recovery tile when answering correctly after a mistake (Example 2 in prompt)', () => {
      // Correct after incorrect attempt: +1 recovery tile instead of normal difficulty bonus
      const recoveryHard = calculateCorrectMovement('hard', false, true);
      expect(recoveryHard.tilesDelta).toBe(1);
      expect(recoveryHard.isRecovery).toBe(true);
      expect(recoveryHard.badgeText).toBe('+1 RECOVERY TILE');
    });
  });

  describe('Answer-Based Backward Movement Penalties', () => {
    it('penalizes consecutive incorrect attempts progressively', () => {
      // First incorrect attempt: -1 tile
      const firstErr = calculateIncorrectPenalty(1);
      expect(firstErr.tilesDelta).toBe(-1);

      // Second consecutive incorrect attempt: -2 tiles
      const secondErr = calculateIncorrectPenalty(2);
      expect(secondErr.tilesDelta).toBe(-2);

      // Third consecutive incorrect attempt: -3 tiles
      const thirdErr = calculateIncorrectPenalty(3);
      expect(thirdErr.tilesDelta).toBe(-3);

      // Fourth consecutive incorrect attempt: capped at -3 tiles
      const fourthErr = calculateIncorrectPenalty(4);
      expect(fourthErr.tilesDelta).toBe(-3);
    });
  });

  describe('XP and Coins Reward Integrity', () => {
    it('calculates correct rewards for easy, medium, hard, expert', () => {
      const easyReward = calculateEconomyReward(true, 'easy', true, false, false, false);
      expect(easyReward.xpDelta).toBe(30); // 20 base + 10 first-try
      expect(easyReward.coinsDelta).toBe(15); // 10 base + 5 first-try

      const hardOptReward = calculateEconomyReward(true, 'hard', true, false, true, false);
      expect(hardOptReward.xpDelta).toBe(90); // 60 base + 10 first-try + 20 optimization
      expect(hardOptReward.coinsDelta).toBe(40); // 25 base + 5 first-try + 10 optimization
    });

    it('awards participation XP/coins for mistakes without penalizing currency', () => {
      const incorrectReward = calculateEconomyReward(false, 'hard', false, false, false, false);
      expect(incorrectReward.xpDelta).toBe(3);
      expect(incorrectReward.coinsDelta).toBe(1);
    });

    it('awards recovery reward upon solving previously failed challenge', () => {
      const recoveryReward = calculateEconomyReward(true, 'hard', false, true, false, false);
      expect(recoveryReward.xpDelta).toBe(15);
      expect(recoveryReward.coinsDelta).toBe(5);
    });
  });

  describe('Achievement System', () => {
    it('unlocks achievements when criteria are satisfied', () => {
      let achievements = [...INITIAL_ACHIEVEMENTS];

      const { updatedList: list1, newlyUnlocked: unlocked1 } = evaluateAchievements(achievements, {
        totalSolved: 1,
        streak: 1,
        recoveryCount: 0,
        arraySolved: 1,
        debugSolved: 0,
        optSolved: 0,
        complexitySolved: 0,
        graphSolved: 0,
        dpSolved: 0,
        currentTile: 5
      });

      expect(unlocked1.length).toBe(1);
      expect(unlocked1[0].id).toBe('first_steps');

      // Check consistent learner (5 streak)
      const { updatedList: list2, newlyUnlocked: unlocked2 } = evaluateAchievements(list1, {
        totalSolved: 6,
        streak: 5,
        recoveryCount: 0,
        arraySolved: 3,
        debugSolved: 0,
        optSolved: 0,
        complexitySolved: 0,
        graphSolved: 0,
        dpSolved: 0,
        currentTile: 25
      });

      const consistentAch = unlocked2.find(a => a.id === 'consistent_learner');
      expect(consistentAch).toBeDefined();

      const arrayAch = unlocked2.find(a => a.id === 'array_explorer');
      expect(arrayAch).toBeDefined();
    });
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { 
  createInitialLearnerProfile, 
  recordChallengeAttempt, 
  generateAdaptiveRecommendations 
} from '../engine/adaptiveEngine';
import { 
  updateSpacedInterval, 
  scheduleTopicRevision 
} from '../engine/spacedRevision';
import { ChallengeAttemptResult } from '../types/challenge';
import { RevisionItem } from '../types/learner';

describe('Adaptive Learning Engine & Spaced Repetition', () => {
  it('initializes a fresh learner profile', () => {
    const profile = createInitialLearnerProfile('user-1', 'Coder');
    expect(profile.level).toBe(1);
    expect(profile.totalXp).toBe(0);
    expect(profile.totalAttempts).toBe(0);
    expect(profile.attemptHistory.length).toBe(0);
  });

  it('updates mastery record accurately upon correct answer', () => {
    let profile = createInitialLearnerProfile('user-1', 'Coder');

    const attempt: ChallengeAttemptResult = {
      challengeId: 'c-1-mcq',
      squareId: 1,
      isCorrect: true,
      scoreAwarded: 50,
      timeSpentSeconds: 10,
      hintUsed: false,
      skillCategory: 'conceptual',
      topic: 'Arrays',
      feedback: 'Correct'
    };

    profile = recordChallengeAttempt(profile, attempt);
    expect(profile.totalAttempts).toBe(1);
    expect(profile.totalCorrect).toBe(1);
    expect(profile.totalXp).toBe(50);
    expect(profile.overallAccuracy).toBe(1);

    const arrayTopic = profile.topicMasteries['Arrays'];
    expect(arrayTopic).toBeDefined();
    expect(arrayTopic.attempts).toBe(1);
    expect(arrayTopic.correct).toBe(1);
    expect(arrayTopic.skills.conceptual.attempts).toBe(1);
    expect(arrayTopic.skills.conceptual.correct).toBe(1);
  });

  it('diagnoses skill weakness and generates explainable remediation', () => {
    let profile = createInitialLearnerProfile('user-1', 'Coder');

    // Simulate 2 failed debugging attempts
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      profile = recordChallengeAttempt(profile, {
        challengeId: `c-debug-${i}`,
        squareId: 14,
        isCorrect: false,
        scoreAwarded: 0,
        timeSpentSeconds: 20,
        hintUsed: true,
        skillCategory: 'debugging',
        topic: 'Functions & Scope',
        feedback: 'Scope shadowing error'
      });
    }

    expect(profile.topicMasteries['Functions & Scope'].skills.debugging.accuracy).toBe(0);
    const recs = generateAdaptiveRecommendations(profile);

    expect(recs.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const rec = recs.find(r => r.targetSkill === 'debugging');
    expect(rec).toBeDefined();
    expect(rec?.type).toBe('weakness_remediation');
    expect(rec?.explanation.toLowerCase()).toContain('recommended');
  });

  it('adjusts spaced repetition intervals using SM-2 algorithm', () => {
    let item: RevisionItem = {
      id: 'rev-arrays',
      topicId: 'Arrays',
      topicName: 'Arrays',
      squareId: 1,
      intervalDays: 1,
      repetitionCount: 1,
      easeFactor: 2.5,
      nextDueDate: Date.now() + 86400000,
      lastReviewed: Date.now(),
      isDue: false,
      priority: 'high'
    };

    // Quality 5 (perfect recall) -> should increase interval
    item = updateSpacedInterval(item, 5);
    expect(item.repetitionCount).toBe(2);
    expect(item.intervalDays).toBe(3);

    // Another successful recall
    item = updateSpacedInterval(item, 5);
    expect(item.repetitionCount).toBe(3);
    expect(item.intervalDays).toBeGreaterThan(3);

    // Failure (quality 1) -> resets repetition
    item = updateSpacedInterval(item, 1);
    expect(item.repetitionCount).toBe(0);
    expect(item.intervalDays).toBe(1);
  });

  it('schedules new topics into the revision queue', () => {
    const queue = scheduleTopicRevision([], 'Linked Lists', 22, true);
    expect(queue.length).toBe(1);
    expect(queue[0].topicId).toBe('Linked Lists');
    expect(queue[0].intervalDays).toBe(2);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { 
  getInitialMasteryMap, 
  updateTopicMastery, 
  calculateMasteryLevel, 
  DSA_TOPICS 
} from '../engine/masteryEngine';
import { 
  DECISION_TILES, 
  evaluateRouteAvailability

// In-memory localStorage mock for node environment
const localStorageMock = (() => {
  let store: Record<string, string> = {};
  return {
    getItem: (key: string) => store[key] || null,
    setItem: (key: string, value: string) => {
      store[key] = value.toString();
    },
    removeItem: (key: string) => {
      delete store[key];
    },
    clear: () => {
      store = {};
    }
  };
})();

(globalThis as any).localStorage = localStorageMock;
(globalThis as any).window = globalThis;

describe('FEATURE 1: LIVING BOARD & ROUTE SELECTION', () => {
  it('defines decision tiles at strategic intervals (15, 30, 60, 75)', () => {
    const tileNumbers = DECISION_TILES.map(d => d.tileNumber);
    expect(tileNumbers).toEqual([15, 30, 60, 75]);
  });

  it('evaluates Knowledge Route as unconditionally unlocked for foundational recovery', () => {
    const config = DECISION_TILES[0]; // Tile 15
    const masteryMap = getInitialMasteryMap();
    const result = evaluateRouteAvailability(config, masteryMap, 0);

    expect(result.knowledge.isUnlocked).toBe(true);
    expect(result.knowledge.type).toBe('knowledge');
  });

  it('locks Challenge Route when mastery requirement is not met', () => {
    const config = DECISION_TILES[0]; // Tile 15 requires 30 mastery
    const masteryMap = getInitialMasteryMap(); // initial score is 15
    const result = evaluateRouteAvailability(config, masteryMap, 0);

    expect(result.challenge.isUnlocked).toBe(false);
    expect(result.challenge.lockedReason).toContain('Requires 30% mastery');
  });

  it('unlocks Challenge Route once topic mastery threshold is reached', () => {
    const config = DECISION_TILES[0];
    const masteryMap = getInitialMasteryMap();
    masteryMap['Arrays and strings'].score = 45; // Met >= 30

    const result = evaluateRouteAvailability(config, masteryMap, 0);
    expect(result.challenge.isUnlocked).toBe(true);
  });

  it('locks Risk Route when energy is insufficient even if mastery is satisfied', () => {
    const config = DECISION_TILES[0]; // requires 55 mastery & 3 energy
    const masteryMap = getInitialMasteryMap();
    masteryMap['Arrays and strings'].score = 70;

    const result = evaluateRouteAvailability(config, masteryMap, 1); // only 1 energy
    expect(result.risk.isUnlocked).toBe(false);
    expect(result.risk.lockedReason).toContain('Algorithm Energy');
  });

  it('unlocks Risk Route when both high mastery and sufficient energy are present', () => {
    const config = DECISION_TILES[0];
    const masteryMap = getInitialMasteryMap();
    masteryMap['Arrays and strings'].score = 65;

    const result = evaluateRouteAvailability(config, masteryMap, 5); // 5 energy >= 3
    expect(result.risk.isUnlocked).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('FEATURE 2: MASTERY TRACKING & ANTI-INFLATION ENGINE', () => {
  it('initializes all 11 distinct DSA topics with baseline metrics', () => {
    const masteryMap = getInitialMasteryMap();
    const topics = Object.keys(masteryMap);
    expect(topics.length).toBe(11);
    expect(topics).toContain('Arrays and strings');
    expect(topics).toContain('Dynamic programming');
    expect(topics).toContain('Graphs');
  });

  it('correctly maps scores to mastery tiers', () => {
    expect(calculateMasteryLevel(20)).toBe('novice');
    expect(calculateMasteryLevel(45)).toBe('practitioner');
    expect(calculateMasteryLevel(72)).toBe('expert');
    expect(calculateMasteryLevel(90)).toBe('master');
  });

  it('applies anti-inflation diminishing returns to high scores', () => {
    const initial = getInitialMasteryMap()['Arrays and strings'];
    
    // Normal progress when score is low
    const lowScoreObj = { ...initial, score: 20 };
    const lowResult = updateTopicMastery(lowScoreObj, true, 'hard', true, false, false);
    const lowGain = lowResult.score - 20;

    // Diminished progress when score is in expert range (>= 80)
    const highScoreObj = { ...initial, score: 82 };
    const highResult = updateTopicMastery(highScoreObj, true, 'hard', true, false, false);
    const highGain = highResult.score - 82;

    expect(highGain).toBeLessThan(lowGain);
    expect(highResult.score).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100);
  });

  it('awards extra bonus for comeback recovery following an earlier mistake', () => {
    const initial = getInitialMasteryMap()['Dynamic programming'];
    const standardSolve = updateTopicMastery(initial, true, 'medium', false, false, false);
    const recoverySolve = updateTopicMastery(initial, true, 'medium', false, true, false);

    expect(recoverySolve.score).toBeGreaterThan(standardSolve.score);
    expect(recoverySolve.evidence[0]).toContain('Recovered with comeback answer');
  });

  it('strictly bounds mastery scores between 0 and 100', () => {
    const initial = getInitialMasteryMap()['Stacks and queues'];
    const zeroFloorObj = { ...initial, score: 2 };
    const decayed = updateTopicMastery(zeroFloorObj, false, 'hard', false, false, false);
    expect(decayed.score).toBe(0);

    const ceilingObj = { ...initial, score: 98 };
    const boosted = updateTopicMastery(ceilingObj, true, 'hard', true, true, false);
    expect(boosted.score).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100);
  });
});

    localStorageMock.clear();
  });

    const state = getInitialGameState();
    expect(state.version).toBe(3);
    expect(state.energy).toBe(5);
    expect(state.activeShield).toBe(false);
    expect(state.activeLadderBoost).toBe(false);
    expect(state.currentRouteType).toBe('knowledge');
    expect(Object.keys(state.topicMasteryMap).length).toBe(11);
  });

  it('migrates v2 state smoothly to v3 preserving score and coins', () => {
    const legacyV2State = {
      version: 2,
      currentPosition: 35,
      totalScore: 850,
      coins: 180,
      streak: 4,
      longestStreak: 7,
      completedSquares: [1, 2, 5, 10, 18, 35]
    };

    localStorageMock.setItem('code_and_ladders_save_v2', JSON.stringify(legacyV2State));

    const loaded = loadGameState();
    expect(loaded.version).toBe(3);
    expect(loaded.currentPosition).toBe(35);
    expect(loaded.totalScore).toBe(850);
    expect(loaded.coins).toBe(180);
    expect(loaded.streak).toBe(4);
    // Evolution fields populated with defaults
    expect(loaded.energy).toBe(5);
    expect(Object.keys(loaded.topicMasteryMap).length).toBe(11);
  });

  it('persists and reloads full v3 state', () => {
    const state = getInitialGameState();
    state.currentPosition = 42;
    state.energy = 12;
    state.activeShield = true;
    state.defeatedBosses = [20];
    state.currentRouteType = 'risk';

    saveGameState(state);

    const reloaded = loadGameState();
    expect(reloaded.currentPosition).toBe(42);
    expect(reloaded.energy).toBe(12);
    expect(reloaded.activeShield).toBe(true);
    expect(reloaded.defeatedBosses).toEqual([20]);
    expect(reloaded.currentRouteType).toBe('risk');
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { CHALLENGES, ChallengeRegistry } from '../data/challenges';
import { ALL_CURRICULUM_CHALLENGES } from '../data/challenges/index';
import { calculateCorrectMovement, calculateIncorrectPenalty, calculateEconomyReward } from '../engine/economyEngine';
import { consumeEnergy, addEnergy, STARTING_ENERGY } from '../engine/energyEngine';
import { BOSS_BATTLES } from '../data/bossBattles';
import { INTELLIGENT_SNAKE_MAP } from '../data/intelligentSnakes';
import { OPTIMIZATION_LADDER_MAP } from '../data/optimizationLadders';
import { DECISION_TILE_MAP } from '../data/routeSelection';
import { GamePhase } from '../types/game';

describe('Master Evolution & Anti-Exploit Verification Suite', () => {

  describe('1. 100-Square Comprehensive Curriculum Coverage', () => {
    it('verifies that all squares 1 to 100 have authored challenges', () => {
      const squareIdsWithChallenges = new Set(ALL_CURRICULUM_CHALLENGES.map(c => c.squareId));
      for (let sq = 1; sq <= 100; sq++) {
        expect(squareIdsWithChallenges.has(sq)).toBe(true);
      }
    });

    it('verifies each authored challenge has progressive hints', () => {
      ALL_CURRICULUM_CHALLENGES.forEach(c => {
        expect(c.hints).toBeDefined();
        expect(c.hints?.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      });
    });

    it('verifies each authored challenge has topic and pedagogical explanation', () => {
      ALL_CURRICULUM_CHALLENGES.forEach(c => {
        expect(c.topic).toBeDefined();
        expect(c.topic.length).toBeGreaterThan(2);
        expect(c.explanation).toBeDefined();
        expect(c.explanation.length).toBeGreaterThan(15);
      });
    });

    it('filters challenges appropriately based on difficulty mode', () => {
      const registry = new ChallengeRegistry();
      // On Square 96 (Tarjan's Bridges, expert level)
      const challengeInterview = registry.getChallengeForSquare(96, true, 'interview_ready');
      expect(challengeInterview.difficulty).toMatch(/hard|expert/);

      // On Square 1 (Array indexing, easy level)
      const challengeBeginner = registry.getChallengeForSquare(1, true, 'beginner');
      expect(challengeBeginner.difficulty).toMatch(/easy|medium/);
    });
  });

  describe('2. Anti-Exploit & Penalty Consequence Integrity', () => {
    it('applies negative tile slide penalty for incorrect submission', () => {
      const penalty1 = calculateIncorrectPenalty(1);
      expect(penalty1.tilesDelta).toBeLessThan(0);
      expect(penalty1.tilesDelta).toBe(-1);

      const penalty2 = calculateIncorrectPenalty(2);
      expect(penalty2.tilesDelta).toBe(-2);

      const penalty3 = calculateIncorrectPenalty(3);
      expect(penalty3.tilesDelta).toBe(-3);
    });

    it('verifies economy deduction gives minimal consolation XP and coins for incorrect attempt', () => {
      const economyIncorrect = calculateEconomyReward(false, 'medium', true, false, false, false);
      expect(economyIncorrect.xpDelta).toBe(3);
      expect(economyIncorrect.coinsDelta).toBe(1);
    });

    it('verifies correct answer grants movement bonus matching difficulty', () => {
      const easyMove = calculateCorrectMovement('easy', true, false);
      expect(easyMove.tilesDelta).toBe(2); // 1 base + 1 first-try

      const medMove = calculateCorrectMovement('medium', true, false);
      expect(medMove.tilesDelta).toBe(3); // 2 base + 1 first-try

      const hardMove = calculateCorrectMovement('hard', true, false);
      expect(hardMove.tilesDelta).toBe(4); // 3 base + 1 first-try

      const expertMove = calculateCorrectMovement('expert', true, false);
      expect(expertMove.tilesDelta).toBe(5); // 4 base + 1 first-try
    });
  });

  describe('3. Energy Abilities Mechanics', () => {
    it('deducts energy correctly when casting abilities', () => {
      let energy = 10;
      energy = consumeEnergy(energy, 'shield')!;
      expect(energy).toBe(7); // 10 - 3

      energy = consumeEnergy(energy, 'ladder_boost')!;
      expect(energy).toBe(2); // 7 - 5

      // Can afford hint (cost 2 from 2 leaves 0)
      energy = consumeEnergy(energy, 'hint')!;
      expect(energy).toBe(0);

      // Now 0 energy cannot afford any ability
      const cannotCast = consumeEnergy(energy, 'hint');
      expect(cannotCast).toBeNull();
    });

    it('correctly adds energy capped at max 15', () => {
      let energy = 10;
      energy = addEnergy(energy, 3);
      expect(energy).toBe(13);

      energy = addEnergy(energy, 10);
      expect(energy).toBe(15); // Capped at MAX_ENERGY = 15
    });

    it('handles Second Chance ability cost (4 energy)', () => {
      const energy = 10;
      const newEnergy = consumeEnergy(energy, 'second_chance');
      expect(newEnergy).toBe(6); // 10 - 4
    });

    it('handles Debug Scan ability cost (3 energy)', () => {
      const energy = 8;
      const newEnergy = consumeEnergy(energy, 'debug_scan');
      expect(newEnergy).toBe(5); // 8 - 3
    });
  });

  describe('4. State Machine & Event Queue Invariants', () => {
    it('defines valid GamePhase state transitions', () => {
      const phases: GamePhase[] = [
        'IDLE', 
        'ROLLING', 
        'MOVING', 
        'LANDING', 
        'CHALLENGE', 
        'EVALUATING', 
        'EVENT', 
        'REWARD', 
        'VICTORY', 
        'GAME_OVER'
      ];
      expect(phases).toHaveLength(10);
    });

    it('verifies Tile 100 has Grand Boss Battle before Victory', () => {
      const boss100 = BOSS_BATTLES.find(b => b.tileNumber === 100);
      expect(boss100).toBeDefined();
      expect(boss100?.bossName).toBe('Dynamic Programming Overlord');
      expect(boss100?.steps.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });

    it('verifies Decision Crossroads tiles exist at exact curriculum nodes', () => {
      const expectedDecisionTiles = [15, 30, 60, 75];
      expectedDecisionTiles.forEach(tile => {
        expect(DECISION_TILE_MAP.has(tile)).toBe(true);
      });
    });

    it('verifies Intelligent Snakes have recovery options', () => {
      expect(INTELLIGENT_SNAKE_MAP.size).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
      INTELLIGENT_SNAKE_MAP.forEach(snake => {
        expect(snake.choices).toHaveLength(3);
        expect(snake.choices[0].recoveryDelta).toBe(0);
        expect(snake.choices[1].recoveryDelta).toBe(1);
        expect(snake.choices[2].recoveryDelta).toBe(3);
      });
    });

    it('verifies Optimization Ladders have safe and expert routes', () => {
      expect(OPTIMIZATION_LADDER_MAP.size).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
      OPTIMIZATION_LADDER_MAP.forEach(ladder => {
        expect(ladder.safeOption).toBeDefined();
        expect(ladder.expertOption).toBeDefined();
        expect(ladder.expertOption.destinationTile).toBeGreaterThan(ladder.safeOption.destinationTile);
      });
    });
  });

  describe('5. Post-Game Analysis & Mastery Recommendations', () => {
    it('calculates accuracy percentage accurately', () => {
      const attempts = 20;
      const correct = 16;
      const accuracy = Math.round((correct / attempts) * 100);
      expect(accuracy).toBe(80);
    });

    it('identifies top strengths and targeted practice areas from mastery map', () => {
      const masteryScores = [
        { topicName: 'Arrays', score: 85 },
        { topicName: 'Trees', score: 92 },
        { topicName: 'Graphs', score: 45 },
        { topicName: 'Dynamic Programming', score: 38 }
      ];

      const sorted = [...masteryScores].sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
      const topStrengths = sorted.slice(0, 2);
      const focusAreas = [...sorted].reverse().slice(0, 2);

      expect(topStrengths[0].topicName).toBe('Trees');
      expect(topStrengths[1].topicName).toBe('Arrays');
      expect(focusAreas[0].topicName).toBe('Dynamic Programming');
      expect(focusAreas[1].topicName).toBe('Graphs');
    });
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { generateErrorDnaProfile, calculateLearningDebt, classifyError } from '../engine/errorDnaEngine';
import { generatePersonalizedFinalBoss } from '../engine/personalizedBossEngine';
import { normalizeDsaTopic, getInitialMasteryMap, updateTopicMastery } from '../engine/masteryEngine';
import { computeMovementPlan } from '../engine/gameEngine';
import { createInitialLearnerProfile } from '../engine/adaptiveEngine';
import { LearnerProfile } from '../types/learner';
import { MisconceptionRecord, TopicMasteryScore } from '../types/evolution';

describe('Novelty Systems & Pedagogical Verification', () => {
  const dummyProfile: LearnerProfile = {
    ...createInitialLearnerProfile(),
    totalAttempts: 12,
    totalCorrect: 8,
    overallAccuracy: 0.67,
    attemptHistory: [
      {
        challengeId: 'q-1',
        squareId: 14,
        topic: 'Binary Search',
        skillCategory: 'implementation',
        isCorrect: false,
        timestamp: Date.now() - 5000
      },
      {
        challengeId: 'q-2',
        squareId: 44,
        topic: 'Graph Traversal',
        skillCategory: 'dry_run',
        isCorrect: false,
        timestamp: Date.now() - 2000
      }
    ]
  };

  const dummyMisconceptions: MisconceptionRecord[] = [
    {
      id: 'misc-1',
      topic: 'Binary Search',
      errorCategory: 'off_by_one',
      questionId: 'q-1',
      timestamp: Date.now() - 5000,
      hintUsed: false,
      explanationShown: 'Midpoint pointer calculation exceeded upper boundary high = mid instead of mid - 1',
      resolved: false
    },
    {
      id: 'misc-2',
      topic: 'Recursion',
      errorCategory: 'recursion_base_case',
      questionId: 'q-3',
      timestamp: Date.now() - 1000,
      hintUsed: true,
      explanationShown: 'Missing base case returns undefined on empty node recursion',
      resolved: false
    }
  ];

  it('1. Cognitive Error DNA: accurately categorizes misconceptions and produces diagnostic breakdown', () => {
    const masteryMap = getInitialMasteryMap();
    const dnaProfile = generateErrorDnaProfile(dummyProfile, dummyMisconceptions, masteryMap);

    expect(dnaProfile.totalMistakesAnalyzed).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    expect(dnaProfile.primaryVector).toBeDefined();
    expect(dnaProfile.categoryBreakdown).toBeDefined();
    expect(dnaProfile.categoryBreakdown.off_by_one.count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(dnaProfile.learningDebtPercentage).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(dnaProfile.recommendedDrills.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
  });

  it('2. Learning Debt Engine: calculates intuitive deficit score and health status', () => {
    const masteryMap = getInitialMasteryMap();
    // Default fresh mastery has low initial scores (~15%), so debt is high
    const freshDebt = calculateLearningDebt(masteryMap, dummyMisconceptions);
    expect(freshDebt.debtPercentage).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(70);
    expect(freshDebt.totalMisconceptions).toBe(2);
    expect(freshDebt.debtStatus).toBe('Critical');

    // Upgrade all topics to mastery (95)
    const masteredMap: Record<string, TopicMasteryScore> = {};
    Object.keys(masteryMap).forEach(key => {
      masteredMap[key] = {
        ...masteryMap[key],
        score: 95
      };
    });

    const masteredDebt = calculateLearningDebt(masteredMap, []);
    expect(masteredDebt.debtPercentage).toBeLessThan(10);
    expect(masteredDebt.debtStatus).toBe('Minimal');
  });

  it('3. Personalized Final Boss: tailors Tile 100 Grandmaster encounter to player weakest topics', () => {
    const masteryMap = getInitialMasteryMap();
    // Intentionally make Dynamic Programming and Graphs the absolute weakest
    masteryMap['Dynamic programming'] = {
      ...masteryMap['Dynamic programming'],
      score: 5,
      incorrectCount: 8
    };
    masteryMap['Graphs'] = {
      ...masteryMap['Graphs'],
      score: 10,
      incorrectCount: 6
    };

    const boss = generatePersonalizedFinalBoss(masteryMap, dummyProfile);
    expect(boss.tileNumber).toBe(100);
    expect(boss.steps.length).toBe(3);
    expect(boss.lore).toContain('cognitive Error DNA');
    expect(boss.lore).toContain('Dynamic programming');
    expect(boss.lore).toContain('Graphs');
    expect(boss.steps[0].question).toBeDefined();
    expect(boss.steps[1].options.length).toBe(4);
    expect(boss.steps[2].correctIndex).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
  });

  it('4. Topic Mastery Normalization: maps curriculum topics deterministically into 11 foundational DSA pillars', () => {
    expect(normalizeDsaTopic('Sliding Window')).toBe('Arrays and strings');
    expect(normalizeDsaTopic('Binary Search Tree Insert')).toBe('Trees and heaps');
    expect(normalizeDsaTopic('Dijkstra Algorithm')).toBe('Graphs');
    expect(normalizeDsaTopic('Dynamic Programming')).toBe('Dynamic programming');
    expect(normalizeDsaTopic('Sorting & Searching')).toBe('Searching and sorting');
    expect(normalizeDsaTopic('Linked List Inversion')).toBe('Linked lists');
  });

  it('5. Exact-Roll Grandmaster Rule: rolls exceeding Tile 100 remain in place with explicit explanation', () => {
    const allCheckpoints = new Set<number>([10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90]);
    
    // Player is at Tile 99, rolls a 3 -> overshoots Tile 100
    const overshotPlan = computeMovementPlan(99, 3, allCheckpoints);
    expect(overshotPlan.targetSquareBeforeTransitions).toBe(99);
    expect(overshotPlan.overshotTarget).toBe(true);
    expect(overshotPlan.overshotExplanation).toContain('Exact roll of 1 needed');

    // Player is at Tile 99, rolls a 1 -> exact roll lands cleanly on Tile 100
    const exactPlan = computeMovementPlan(99, 1, allCheckpoints);
    expect(exactPlan.targetSquareBeforeTransitions).toBe(100);
    expect(exactPlan.overshotTarget).toBe(false);
  });

  it('6. Progressive Mastery Evolution: updates topic score on correct challenge and awards first-try bonus', () => {
    const initialMap = getInitialMasteryMap();
    const topicKey = 'Searching and sorting';
    const before = initialMap[topicKey];

    const updated = updateTopicMastery(before, true, 'medium', true, false, false);
    expect(updated.score).toBeGreaterThan(before.score);
    expect(updated.correctCount).toBe(1);
    expect(updated.firstTryCount).toBe(1);
    expect(updated.evidence.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { CURRICULUM_100, SQUARE_MAP } from '../data/curriculum100';
import { getSquareGridCoords, getSquarePercentCoords } from '../engine/gameEngine';

describe('Board Viewport & 100-Level Accessibility Tests', () => {
  it('verifies board contains exactly 100 tiles with unique numbers from 1 to 100', () => {
    expect(CURRICULUM_100.length).toBe(100);

    const ids = CURRICULUM_100.map(s => s.id);
    const uniqueIds = new Set(ids);
    expect(uniqueIds.size).toBe(100);

    for (let id = 1; id <= 100; id++) {
      expect(SQUARE_MAP.has(id)).toBe(true);
      const sq = SQUARE_MAP.get(id);
      expect(sq?.id).toBe(id);
      expect(sq?.title).toBeTruthy();
      expect(sq?.topic).toBeTruthy();
    }
  });

  it('verifies boundary levels Tile 1 and Tile 100 are defined and distinct', () => {
    const tile1 = SQUARE_MAP.get(1);
    const tile100 = SQUARE_MAP.get(100);

    expect(tile1).toBeDefined();
    expect(tile1?.id).toBe(1);
    expect(tile1?.stage).toBe('co1_math_analysis');

    expect(tile100).toBeDefined();
    expect(tile100?.id).toBe(100);
    expect(tile100?.stage).toBe('co4_graphs_algorithms');
  });

  it('verifies serpentine 10x10 grid coordinates for all 100 levels without overlapping coordinates', () => {
    const coordSet = new Set<string>();

    for (let id = 1; id <= 100; id++) {
      const { gridRow, gridCol } = getSquareGridCoords(id);
      expect(gridRow).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
      expect(gridRow).toBeLessThanOrEqual(9);
      expect(gridCol).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
      expect(gridCol).toBeLessThanOrEqual(9);

      const key = `${gridRow},${gridCol}`;
      expect(coordSet.has(key)).toBe(false);
      coordSet.add(key);
    }

    expect(coordSet.size).toBe(100);

    // Row 9 (bottom): Tile 1 is at (row 9, col 0), Tile 10 is at (row 9, col 9)
    expect(getSquareGridCoords(1)).toEqual({ gridRow: 9, gridCol: 0 });
    expect(getSquareGridCoords(10)).toEqual({ gridRow: 9, gridCol: 9 });

    // Row 8: Tile 11 is at (row 8, col 9), Tile 20 is at (row 8, col 0)
    expect(getSquareGridCoords(11)).toEqual({ gridRow: 8, gridCol: 9 });
    expect(getSquareGridCoords(20)).toEqual({ gridRow: 8, gridCol: 0 });

    // Row 0 (top): Tile 91 is at (row 0, col 9), Tile 100 is at (row 0, col 0)
    expect(getSquareGridCoords(91)).toEqual({ gridRow: 0, gridCol: 9 });
    expect(getSquareGridCoords(100)).toEqual({ gridRow: 0, gridCol: 0 });
  });

  it('verifies percentage coordinates for smooth SVG paths and player positioning', () => {
    for (let id = 1; id <= 100; id++) {
      const percent = getSquarePercentCoords(id);
      expect(percent.x).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(percent.x).toBeLessThan(100);
      expect(percent.y).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(percent.y).toBeLessThan(100);
    }
  });

  it('verifies 10 row sections cover all 100 levels sequentially without overlap', () => {
    const ROW_SECTIONS = [
      { label: '1–10', center: 5, min: 1, max: 10 },
      { label: '11–20', center: 15, min: 11, max: 20 },
      { label: '21–30', center: 25, min: 21, max: 30 },
      { label: '31–40', center: 35, min: 31, max: 40 },
      { label: '41–50', center: 45, min: 41, max: 50 },
      { label: '51–60', center: 55, min: 51, max: 60 },
      { label: '61–70', center: 65, min: 61, max: 70 },
      { label: '71–80', center: 75, min: 71, max: 80 },
      { label: '81–90', center: 85, min: 81, max: 90 },
      { label: '91–100', center: 95, min: 91, max: 100 },
    ];

    expect(ROW_SECTIONS.length).toBe(10);

    let expectedStart = 1;
    ROW_SECTIONS.forEach((sec, idx) => {
      expect(sec.min).toBe(expectedStart);
      expect(sec.max).toBe(expectedStart + 9);
      expect(sec.center).toBe(expectedStart + 4);
      expectedStart += 10;
    });
    expect(expectedStart - 1).toBe(100);
  });

  it('verifies jump to level validation handles valid and invalid inputs safely', () => {
    function validateJump(input: string): { valid: boolean; level?: number } {
      const num = parseInt(input.trim(), 10);
      if (!isNaN(num) && num >= 1 && num <= 100) {
        return { valid: true, level: num };
      }
      return { valid: false };
    }

    expect(validateJump('1')).toEqual({ valid: true, level: 1 });
    expect(validateJump('50')).toEqual({ valid: true, level: 50 });
    expect(validateJump('100')).toEqual({ valid: true, level: 100 });
    expect(validateJump(' 73 ')).toEqual({ valid: true, level: 73 });

    expect(validateJump('0').valid).toBe(false);
    expect(validateJump('-5').valid).toBe(false);
    expect(validateJump('101').valid).toBe(false);
    expect(validateJump('abc').valid).toBe(false);
    expect(validateJump('').valid).toBe(false);
  });

  it('verifies stepper previous/next level boundary checks', () => {
    function getStepperState(currentPosition: number) {
      return {
        canPrevious: currentPosition > 1,
        canNext: currentPosition < 100,
        previousLevel: currentPosition > 1 ? currentPosition - 1 : null,
        nextLevel: currentPosition < 100 ? currentPosition + 1 : null
      };
    }

    // At Start (Level 1)
    const atStart = getStepperState(1);
    expect(atStart.canPrevious).toBe(false);
    expect(atStart.canNext).toBe(true);
    expect(atStart.nextLevel).toBe(2);

    // At Level 50
    const atMiddle = getStepperState(50);
    expect(atMiddle.canPrevious).toBe(true);
    expect(atMiddle.canNext).toBe(true);
    expect(atMiddle.previousLevel).toBe(49);
    expect(atMiddle.nextLevel).toBe(51);

    // At Finish (Level 100)
    const atFinish = getStepperState(100);
    expect(atFinish.canPrevious).toBe(true);
    expect(atFinish.canNext).toBe(false);
    expect(atFinish.previousLevel).toBe(99);
  });

  it('verifies orderedSquares in BoardGrid preserves all 100 squares', () => {
    const orderedSquares = [];
    for (let gridRow = 0; gridRow < 10; gridRow++) {
      const bottomRow = 9 - gridRow;
      const isEven = bottomRow % 2 === 0;
      for (let gridCol = 0; gridCol < 10; gridCol++) {
        const colInRow = isEven ? gridCol : 9 - gridCol;
        const squareId = bottomRow * 10 + colInRow + 1;
        const sq = SQUARE_MAP.get(squareId);
        if (sq) orderedSquares.push(sq);
      }
    }

    expect(orderedSquares.length).toBe(100);
    // First tile rendered in top-left is Tile 100 (bottomRow 9, colInRow 9 -> 90 + 9 + 1 = 100)
    expect(orderedSquares[0].id).toBe(100);
    // Last tile rendered in bottom-right is Tile 10 (bottomRow 0, colInRow 9 -> 0 + 9 + 1 = 10)
    expect(orderedSquares[99].id).toBe(10);
    // Bottom-left tile is Tile 1
    expect(orderedSquares[90].id).toBe(1);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';

describe('PART 12: Comprehensive Board Movement & Gameplay Verification', () => {
  describe('1. Board Movement Tests', () => {
    it('Roll a 4 and verify movement by four tiles', () => {
      const currentTile = 10;
      const roll = 4;
      const passedCheckpoints = new Set<number>([10]);
      const plan = computeMovementPlan(currentTile, roll, passedCheckpoints);

      expect(plan.targetSquareBeforeTransitions).toBe(14);
      expect(plan.intermediateSteps).toEqual([11, 12, 13, 14]);
    });

    it('Answer an easy question correctly and verify +1 bonus tile', () => {
      // Easy question without first-try bonus: +1 tile
      const result = calculateCorrectMovement('easy', false, false);
      expect(result.tilesDelta).toBe(1);
    });

    it('Answer a medium question correctly and verify +2 bonus tiles', () => {
      // Medium question without first-try bonus: +2 tiles
      const result = calculateCorrectMovement('medium', false, false);
      expect(result.tilesDelta).toBe(2);
    });

    it('Answer a hard question correctly and verify +3 bonus tiles', () => {
      // Hard question without first-try bonus: +3 tiles
      const result = calculateCorrectMovement('hard', false, false);
      expect(result.tilesDelta).toBe(3);
    });

    it('Answer an expert question correctly and verify +4 bonus tiles', () => {
      // Expert question without first-try bonus: +4 tiles
      const result = calculateCorrectMovement('expert', false, false);
      expect(result.tilesDelta).toBe(4);
    });

    it('Answer correctly on the first attempt and verify the additional tile', () => {
      // Easy on first try: 1 + 1 = 2
      expect(calculateCorrectMovement('easy', true, false).tilesDelta).toBe(2);

      // Medium on first try: 2 + 1 = 3
      expect(calculateCorrectMovement('medium', true, false).tilesDelta).toBe(3);

      // Hard on first try (Example 1 in prompt): 3 + 1 = 4
      const hardFirst = calculateCorrectMovement('hard', true, false);
      expect(hardFirst.tilesDelta).toBe(4);
      expect(hardFirst.isFirstAttempt).toBe(true);

      // Expert on first try: 4 + 1 = 5
      expect(calculateCorrectMovement('expert', true, false).tilesDelta).toBe(5);
    });

    it('Answer incorrectly and verify the correct backward movement', () => {
      // First incorrect attempt: -1 tile
      const firstError = calculateIncorrectPenalty(1);
      expect(firstError.tilesDelta).toBe(-1);
    });

    it('Submit consecutive incorrect answers and verify the penalty sequence', () => {
      // 1st incorrect attempt: -1 tile
      expect(calculateIncorrectPenalty(1).tilesDelta).toBe(-1);

      // 2nd consecutive incorrect attempt: -2 tiles
      expect(calculateIncorrectPenalty(2).tilesDelta).toBe(-2);

      // 3rd consecutive incorrect attempt: -3 tiles
      expect(calculateIncorrectPenalty(3).tilesDelta).toBe(-3);

      // 4th and subsequent consecutive incorrect attempt: -3 tiles (capped)
      expect(calculateIncorrectPenalty(4).tilesDelta).toBe(-3);
      expect(calculateIncorrectPenalty(10).tilesDelta).toBe(-3);
    });

    it('Answer correctly after a mistake and verify the recovery movement', () => {
      // Correct after incorrect attempt: +1 recovery tile instead of normal difficulty bonus
      const recovery = calculateCorrectMovement('hard', false, true);
      expect(recovery.tilesDelta).toBe(1);
      expect(recovery.isRecovery).toBe(true);
      expect(recovery.explanation).toContain('COMEBACK');
    });

    it('Verify that the player cannot move below tile 1', () => {
      const currentPos = 2;
      const penaltyDelta = -3;
      const newPos = Math.max(1, currentPos + penaltyDelta);
      expect(newPos).toBe(1);

      const atTile1 = 1;
      const newPosFrom1 = Math.max(1, atTile1 + penaltyDelta);
      expect(newPosFrom1).toBe(1);
    });

    it('Verify that the player cannot move beyond tile 100', () => {
      const passedCheckpoints = new Set<number>([10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90]);
      // At tile 98, rolling 5 would exceed 100 -> stays in place at 98 per Rule 8 exact-roll rule
      const plan = computeMovementPlan(98, 5, passedCheckpoints);
      expect(plan.targetSquareBeforeTransitions).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100);
      expect(plan.targetSquareBeforeTransitions).toBe(98);
      expect(plan.overshotExplanation).toContain('Exact roll of 2 needed');
    });

    it('Verify snake movement downward', () => {
      expect(SNAKE_MAP.has(18)).toBe(true);
      const snake18 = SNAKE_MAP.get(18)!;
      expect(snake18.to).toBe(8);
      expect(snake18.to).toBeLessThan(snake18.from);

      expect(SNAKE_MAP.has(50)).toBe(true);
      const snake50 = SNAKE_MAP.get(50)!;
      expect(snake50.to).toBe(42);

      expect(SNAKE_MAP.has(95)).toBe(true);
      const snake95 = SNAKE_MAP.get(95)!;
      expect(snake95.to).toBe(84);
    });

    it('Verify ladder movement upward', () => {
      expect(LADDER_MAP.has(10)).toBe(true);
      const ladder10 = LADDER_MAP.get(10)!;
      expect(ladder10.to).toBe(28);
      expect(ladder10.to).toBeGreaterThan(ladder10.from);

      expect(LADDER_MAP.has(36)).toBe(true);

      const easy = calculateEconomyReward(true, 'easy', false, false, false, false);
      expect(easy.xpDelta).toBe(20);
      expect(easy.coinsDelta).toBe(10);

      // Medium: 35 XP, 15 Coins
      const med = calculateEconomyReward(true, 'medium', false, false, false, false);
      expect(med.xpDelta).toBe(35);
      expect(med.coinsDelta).toBe(15);

      // Hard: 60 XP, 25 Coins
      const hard = calculateEconomyReward(true, 'hard', false, false, false, false);
      expect(hard.xpDelta).toBe(60);
      expect(hard.coinsDelta).toBe(25);

      // Expert: 100 XP, 40 Coins
      const expert = calculateEconomyReward(true, 'expert', false, false, false, false);
      expect(expert.xpDelta).toBe(100);
      expect(expert.coinsDelta).toBe(40);
    });

    it('Verify first-attempt bonuses (+10 XP, +5 Coins)', () => {
      const easyFirst = calculateEconomyReward(true, 'easy', true, false, false, false);
      expect(easyFirst.xpDelta).toBe(30); // 20 + 10
      expect(easyFirst.coinsDelta).toBe(15); // 10 + 5

      const hardFirst = calculateEconomyReward(true, 'hard', true, false, false, false);
      expect(hardFirst.xpDelta).toBe(70); // 60 + 10

        getItem: (key: string) => storageMock[key] || null,
        setItem: (key: string, val: string) => { storageMock[key] = val; },
        removeItem: (key: string) => { delete storageMock[key]; }
      };

      (globalThis as any).localStorage = mockStorage;
      (globalThis as any).window = {
        localStorage: mockStorage
      };

      const state = getInitialGameState();
      state.currentPosition = 42;
      state.totalScore = 650;
      state.coins = 120;
      state.streak = 4;
